**(d)** 116–144행의 `insertImported`:
```ts
  /**
   * item + (new asset + first revision) + item_asset + extract job (+ the collection membership), all-or-nothing.
   * Returns whether the item was filed into `rec.collectionId`: false when none was asked for, and also when the
   * collection is deleted or unknown by now (the import itself still succeeds).
   */
  insertImported(rec: NewImportRecord): boolean {
    if (rec.assetIsNew && !rec.revision) throw new Error('a new asset requires an initial revision');
    const a = rec.asset;
    return this.db.transaction(() => {
      if (rec.assetIsNew) {
        this.db
          .prepare(`INSERT INTO assets (id, sha256, storage_mode, relative_path, external_path, original_name, mime, size, availability, created_at, checked_at)
                    VALUES (@id, @sha256, @storageMode, @relativePath, @externalPath, @originalName, @mime, @size, @availability, @createdAt, @checkedAt)`)
          .run(a);
      }
      this.db
        .prepare(`INSERT INTO items (id, type, title, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, '{}', ?, ?)`)
        .run(rec.item.id, rec.item.type, rec.item.title, rec.item.createdAt, rec.item.createdAt);
      this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO item_assets (item_id, asset_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'original')`).run(rec.item.id, a.id);
      if (rec.revision) {
        this.db
          .prepare(`INSERT INTO source_revisions (id, asset_id, hash, parent_revision_id, renderer_version, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, NULL, NULL, ?)`)
          .run(rec.revision.id, a.id, a.sha256, rec.revision.createdAt);
      }
      if (rec.job) {
        this.db
          .prepare(`INSERT INTO jobs (id, kind, dedupe_key, state, attempts, payload_json, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'queued', 0, ?, ?, ?)
                    ON CONFLICT(dedupe_key) DO NOTHING`)
          .run(rec.job.id, rec.job.kind, rec.job.dedupeKey, JSON.stringify(rec.job.payload), rec.item.createdAt, rec.item.createdAt);
      }
      if (!rec.collectionId) return false;
      // Selecting from collections (not inserting the id blind) is what skips a collection deleted after the import began.
      return (
        this.db
          .prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO collection_items (collection_id, item_id, added_at)
                    SELECT c.id, ?, ? FROM collections c WHERE c.id = ? AND c.deleted_at IS NULL`)
          .run(rec.item.id, rec.item.createdAt, rec.collectionId).changes > 0
      );
    })();
  }
```

**(e)** 173–178행 `listItems`:
```ts
  /** Non-trashed items, newest first. */
  listItems(): LibraryItem[] {
    const rows = this.db.prepare(`${ITEM_SELECT} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.rowid DESC`).all() as ItemDbRow[];
    return rows.map((r) => toItem(r));
  }

  /**
   * The non-trashed items among `ids`, each once, in the order the ids first appear; unknown and trashed ids are
   * skipped. One transaction, 500 ids per statement.
   */
  getItems(ids: readonly string[]): LibraryItem[] {
    const unique = [...new Set(ids)];
    const found = new Map<string, LibraryItem>();
    this.db.transaction(() => {
      for (let start = 0; start < unique.length; start += GET_ITEMS_CHUNK) {
        const chunk = unique.slice(start, start + GET_ITEMS_CHUNK);
        const rows = this.db.prepare(`${ITEM_SELECT} AND i.id IN (${chunk.map(() => '?').join(',')})`).all(...chunk) as ItemDbRow[];
        for (const r of rows) found.set(r.id, toItem(r));
      }
    })();
    return unique.flatMap((id) => {
      const item = found.get(id);
      return item ? [item] : [];
    });
  }
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { CollectionsRepository, LibraryRepository, TagsRepository, readOrganizeSnapshot, type Db } from '../src/index';
import { freshDb, seedItem } from './fixtures';

let db: Db;
let collections: CollectionsRepository;
let tags: TagsRepository;
let library: LibraryRepository;
beforeEach(() => {
  db = freshDb();
  collections = new CollectionsRepository(db);
  tags = new TagsRepository(db);
  library = new LibraryRepository(db);
});

describe('readOrganizeSnapshot', () => {
  it('is empty for an empty library', () => {
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db)).toEqual({ collections: [], tags: [], members: {}, tagged: {}, duplicates: [] });
  });

  it('lists live collections in creation order with the fields the tree needs, and none of the deleted subtree', () => {
    const a = collections.create({ name: '강의' });
    const b = collections.create({ name: '선형대수', parentId: a.id });
    const c = collections.create({ name: '해석학', parentId: b.id });
    const d = collections.create({ name: '읽기 자료' });
    collections.softDelete(b.id); // b and c
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).collections).toEqual([
      { id: a.id, name: '강의', parentId: null, createdAt: a.createdAt },
      { id: d.id, name: '읽기 자료', parentId: null, createdAt: d.createdAt },
    ]);
    collections.restore(c.id); // brings back c and its deleted ancestor b
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).collections.map((x) => [x.id, x.parentId])).toEqual([[a.id, null], [b.id, a.id], [c.id, b.id], [d.id, null]]);
  });

  it('lists tags the way TAG_ORDER does: colored ones by position first, then the rest in creation order', () => {
    const plain = tags.create('plain');
    const second = tags.create('second');
    const first = tags.create('first');
    const later = tags.create('later');
    tags.setColor(second.id, 'red', 2);
    tags.setColor(first.id, 'yellow', 1);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).tags).toEqual([
      { id: first.id, name: 'first', color: 'yellow', position: 1 },
      { id: second.id, name: 'second', color: 'red', position: 2 },
      { id: plain.id, name: 'plain', color: null, position: null },
      { id: later.id, name: 'later', color: null, position: null },
    ]);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).tags.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(tags.list().map((t) => t.id));
  });

  it('reads an unknown stored color as none, like the Tag type does', () => {
    const t = tags.create('odd');
    db.prepare('UPDATE tags SET color = ? WHERE id = ?').run('chartreuse', t.id);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).tags).toEqual([{ id: t.id, name: 'odd', color: null, position: null }]);
  });

  it('lists the direct, non-trashed members of live collections; empty collections and deleted ones have no key', () => {
    const a = collections.create({ name: 'a' });
    const child = collections.create({ name: 'child', parentId: a.id });
    const empty = collections.create({ name: 'empty' });
    const deleted = collections.create({ name: 'deleted' });
    const [i1, i2, i3, trashed] = [seedItem(db).itemId, seedItem(db).itemId, seedItem(db).itemId, seedItem(db).itemId];
    collections.addItems(a.id, [i1, i2, trashed]);
    collections.addItems(child.id, [i2, i3]); // i2 is in two collections
    collections.addItems(deleted.id, [i1]);
    collections.softDelete(deleted.id);
    library.trash([trashed]);
    const { members } = readOrganizeSnapshot(db);
    expect(members).toEqual({ [a.id]: [i1, i2], [child.id]: [i2, i3] }); // direct only: a does not list i3
    expect(members[empty.id]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(members[deleted.id]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('lists the non-trashed items each tag is on; a tag nothing has no key', () => {
    const [t1, t2, unused] = [tags.create('t1'), tags.create('t2'), tags.create('unused')];
    const [i1, i2, trashed] = [seedItem(db).itemId, seedItem(db).itemId, seedItem(db).itemId];
    tags.assign(t1.id, [i1, i2, trashed]);
    tags.assign(t2.id, [i2]);
    library.trash([trashed]);
    const { tagged } = readOrganizeSnapshot(db);
    expect(tagged).toEqual({ [t1.id]: [i1, i2], [t2.id]: [i2] });
    expect(tagged[unused.id]).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('groups the non-trashed items that share content, as duplicateGroups does, and drops a group trash leaves with one', () => {
    const first = seedItem(db, { sha: 'a'.repeat(64) });
    const second = seedItem(db, { reuseAsset: first.asset }); // same asset
    const linked = seedItem(db, { sha: 'a'.repeat(64), mode: 'linked' }); // same content, separate asset
    seedItem(db, { sha: 'b'.repeat(64) }); // unique
    const d1 = seedItem(db, { sha: 'd'.repeat(64) });
    const d2 = seedItem(db, { reuseAsset: d1.asset });
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).duplicates).toEqual([[first.itemId, second.itemId, linked.itemId], [d1.itemId, d2.itemId]]);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).duplicates).toEqual(library.duplicateGroups().map((g) => g.itemIds));
    library.trash([d2.itemId]);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db).duplicates).toEqual([[first.itemId, second.itemId, linked.itemId]]);
  });

  it('reads a trashed item back into every list when it is restored', () => {
    const c = collections.create({ name: 'c' });
    const t = tags.create('t');
    const { itemId } = seedItem(db);
    collections.addItems(c.id, [itemId]);
    tags.assign(t.id, [itemId]);
    library.trash([itemId]);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db)).toMatchObject({ members: {}, tagged: {} });
    library.restore([itemId]);
    expect(readOrganizeSnapshot(db)).toMatchObject({ members: { [c.id]: [itemId] }, tagged: { [t.id]: [itemId] } });
  });
});
```

Expected: FAIL — 전부 `TypeError: readOrganizeSnapshot is not a function`.

구현 — 새 파일 `packages/db/src/organize-query.ts`:
```ts
import type { OrganizeCollection, OrganizeSnapshot, OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Db } from './connection';
import { LibraryRepository } from './library-repository';
import { TAG_ORDER, isTagColor } from './tags-repository';

interface CollectionRow { id: string; name: string; parent_id: string | null; created_at: string }
interface TagRow { id: string; name: string; color: string | null; position: number | null }
interface PairRow { owner: string; item: string }

/** Rows of (owner, item) in their stored order → owner → items; an owner with no row has no key. */
function groupItems(rows: readonly PairRow[]): Record<string, string[]> {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const r of rows) (out[r.owner] ??= []).push(r.item);
  return out;
}

/**
 * The sidebar's data in one read: live collections, every tag, the direct memberships and the tag assignments of
 * non-trashed items, and the groups of non-trashed items that share a file. One transaction, so the five parts
 * describe the same moment even while main writes between two statements of a lazier version.
 */
export function readOrganizeSnapshot(db: Db): OrganizeSnapshot {
  return db.transaction((): OrganizeSnapshot => {
    const collections: OrganizeCollection[] = (
      db.prepare('SELECT id, name, parent_id, created_at FROM collections WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, rowid').all() as CollectionRow[]
    ).map((r) => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, parentId: r.parent_id, createdAt: r.created_at }));

    const tags: OrganizeTag[] = (db.prepare(`SELECT t.id, t.name, t.color, t.position FROM tags t ${TAG_ORDER}`).all() as TagRow[]).map((r) => ({
      id: r.id, name: r.name, color: isTagColor(r.color) ? r.color : null, position: r.position,
    }));

    const members = groupItems(
      db
        .prepare(`SELECT ci.collection_id AS owner, ci.item_id AS item
                  FROM collection_items ci
                  JOIN collections c ON c.id = ci.collection_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
                  JOIN items i ON i.id = ci.item_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ORDER BY ci.rowid`)
        .all() as PairRow[],
    );

    const tagged = groupItems(
      db
        .prepare(`SELECT it.tag_id AS owner, it.item_id AS item
                  FROM item_tags it
                  JOIN items i ON i.id = it.item_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ORDER BY it.rowid`)
        .all() as PairRow[],
    );

    const duplicates = new LibraryRepository(db).duplicateGroups().map((g) => g.itemIds);
    return { collections, tags, members, tagged, duplicates };
  })();
}
```

```ts
    cols.softDelete(coll.id);

    let cols!: CollectionsRepository;
    let coll!: { id: string };
    // The hook is fixed when the importer is made, before the collection exists: both are assigned right after.
    const { db, repo, importer } = setup({ beforeCommit: () => cols.softDelete(coll.id) });
    cols = new CollectionsRepository(db);
    coll = cols.create({ name: '가져오는 중에 지움' });
    const out = await importer.importOne(writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'mid'), { mode: 'managed', collectionId: coll.id });
    expect(out.status).toBe('imported');
    expect(out.status === 'imported' && 'collectionId' in out).toBe(false);
    expect(repo.counts()).toMatchObject({ items: 1, collectionItems: 0 });

  it('files nothing for a duplicate that is not imported, and files the new item when allowDuplicate adds it', async () => {
    const { db, importer } = setup();
    const coll = new CollectionsRepository(db).create({ name: 'c' });
    const src = writePdf(tempDir('src'), 'a.pdf', 'same');
    const first = await importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'managed' });
    expect(first.status === 'imported' && 'collectionId' in first).toBe(false); // none asked for, none reported
    const dup = await importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'managed', collectionId: coll.id });
    expect(dup.status).toBe('duplicate');
    expect(members(db, coll.id)).toEqual([]);
    const again = await importer.importOne(src, { mode: 'managed', allowDuplicate: true, collectionId: coll.id });
    expect(again.status === 'imported' && again.collectionId).toBe(coll.id);
    expect(members(db, coll.id)).toEqual([again.status === 'imported' ? again.item.id : '']);
  });
});
```

`M/ipc/reader.ts` 전체:
```ts
import { Channels, itemIdInput, savePositionInput } from '@learn/domain';
import { broadcast } from '../events';
import type { Handle, IpcDeps } from './register';

export function registerReaderIpc(handle: Handle, deps: IpcDeps): void {
  // The viewer calls this once per mount, so "opened" is recorded even when the position never changes.
  // Announced so the list can show the new openedAt (the 최근 연 자료 view) when the user comes back from the reader.
  handle(Channels.reader.open, itemIdInput, ({ itemId }) => {
    deps.getContext().reading.markOpened(itemId);
    broadcast('libraryChanged', { reason: 'opened', itemIds: [itemId] });
  });
  handle(Channels.reader.getPosition, itemIdInput, ({ itemId }) => deps.getContext().reading.get(itemId) ?? null);
  handle(Channels.reader.savePosition, savePositionInput, (input) => {
    deps.getContext().reading.save(input);
  });
}
```

### Task 3: 보기 모델과 행 파이프라인 — `R/organize/*`, 범위·태그 필터 저장소, 좁힌 다시 받기, 범위 → 필터 → 검색 → 정렬, "마지막으로 연 날" 열과 최근 정렬, 도구 막대 제목·선택 없음 통계 (사이드바 변화 없음)

#### 제안 판정 (Q-…)

뼈대·명세가 코드와 어긋나거나 정하지 않은 곳이다. 아래 모양대로 구현하고, 컨트롤러가 거부하면 해당 단계만 고친다.

1. **Q-10 (검색 색인은 자료별로 다시 만들 수 없다 — 색인을 통째로 물려받는다).** 명세 10.3은 "검색 텍스트는 그 자료만 다시 만든다"고 쓰지만, `R/library/search.ts`의 색인은 목록 배열 하나당 이어 붙인 문자열 하나(`short`·`initials`·`starts` …)이고 `searchIndexFor`가 **배열 객체**를 키로 캐시한다. 자료 하나의 문자열만 바꿀 수 없고, 고친 목록은 새 배열이라 색인 전체를 다시 만든다(1만 항목 수십 ms, `whenIdle`에서). 또 `library:searchTexts`는 id를 받지 않아 초록·메모를 자료별로 다시 받을 수도 없다. 제안: (a) 고친 자료들의 **찾는 칸**(제목·저자·출판사·원래 이름·연도)이 그대로면(`opened`·`availability`·`relink`가 늘 그렇다) 새 목록이 이전 목록의 색인을 그대로 물려받는다(`carrySearchIndex`, 비용 O(n) 참조 비교). (b) 찾는 칸이 바뀐 `metadata`는 지금처럼 색인을 한가할 때 통째로 다시 만든다. (c) `['library','searchTexts']`는 `metadata`일 때만 무효화한다(질의를 치는 중이 아니면 다시 받지 않는다). 효과: 리더에서 돌아올 때마다 일어나는 `opened`가 목록 IPC도, 색인 재작성도 부르지 않는다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 정말 자료별 색인을 원하면 `searchTexts({ ids? })`와 자료 단위 색인으로 `search.ts`를 다시 써야 한다(큰 재작업, Task 10 범위).
2. **Q-11 (빠른 검색은 전체 목록의 색인에서 찾고, 범위·필터 결과와 교집합을 낸다).** 범위를 바꿀 때마다 `useSearch(범위의 목록)`을 부르면 새 배열마다 색인을 다시 만든다(1만 항목에서 보기 전환 ≤ 100ms 예산을 깬다). 그래서 색인은 전체 목록(`useItems`)에 한 번만 두고, 행 = 정렬된 (범위 ∩ 태그 필터)에서 `found.ids`에 있는 것이다(M4의 `sorted.filter(found)`와 같은 모양). 결과는 명세 7.1의 "범위는 지금 보기"와 같다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 없음(결과 동일, 성능만 다름).
3. **Q-12 (범위의 "원래 값"은 저장소가, "보여 줄 값"은 해석이 정한다; 시작 때의 유효성 검사는 한 곳이다).** `useLibrary.scope`는 사용자가 고른 값이고, 컬렉션이 사라졌거나 스냅샷이 없을 때의 `all`로의 대체는 순수 함수 `resolveScope(model, scope)`가 한다(저장소를 고쳐 쓰지 않는다 — 실행 취소로 컬렉션이 돌아오면 그 보기가 다시 맞는다). 시작할 때의 규칙("그 컬렉션이 없어졌거나 특수 보기에 내용이 없으면 `all`")은 `restorableScope(raw, model, items, now)`(순수)가 정하고, 설정 `library.view`·스냅샷·목록 셋이 모두 **끝난**(성공이든 실패든) 뒤 한 번만 `useRestoreView`가 `restoreScope`로 넣는다. 그때까지 `scopeReady`가 거짓이라 표는 그려지지 않고 `app-ready`도 붙지 않는다(저장된 보기로 열 때 "내 라이브러리"가 한 프레임 깜박이지 않게). 스냅샷 읽기가 실패하면 컬렉션·미분류·중복은 `all`로 열린다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 깜박임 또는 `app-ready` 시점 이동(작음).
4. **Q-13 (`useLibrarySettings().sort`는 지금 범위의 정렬이다; 강제 열은 `forced`).** 뼈대는 "최근 연 자료는 자기 정렬(`library.sort.recent`)과 강제 열"만 정한다. 이 작업은 `useLibrarySettings()`의 반환 `sort`·`setSort`를 **지금 범위의 것**으로 바꾸고(최근이면 `library.sort.recent`, 나머지는 `library.sort`), `forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[]`를 더한다. 표·명령 환경(`sortRef`)·항목 패널의 여럿 선택 요약이 모두 이 훅을 이미 써서 고칠 곳이 없다. `visibleColumns(cfg, forced = [])`가 두 번째 인자를 받는다 — **Task 9가 `order`로 이 함수를 다시 쓸 때 `forced`(제목 바로 뒤)를 유지해야 한다.** 틀렸을 때 비용: 호출자마다 범위를 보고 고르게 된다(중복).
5. **Q-14 (`ui:showColumnMenu` 입력에 `locked`).** 열 머리 메뉴에서 최근 보기의 "마지막으로 연 날"이 체크된 채 비활성이려면 main이 알아야 한다. 입력 `{ visible, locked?, x, y }`(`.strict()` 그대로), `columnMenuEntries(visible, resetLabel, locked = [])`: 잠긴 열은 `checked: true, enabled: false`. 저장된 열 구성(`library.columns`)은 건드리지 않는다. Task 4가 `ui.ts`를 다시 쓸 때 이 입력을 유지한다.
6. **Q-15 (`OrganizeModel`에 더하는 것은 `collectionCount`·`flat`뿐, `scopeItems`는 읽기 전용 배열을 돌려준다).** 뼈대 계약의 이름·형은 그대로 두고 둘을 더한다: `collectionCount: number`(Task 4의 맥락 필드와 Task 5의 "미분류 행은 컬렉션이 하나 이상일 때"), `flat: readonly CollectionNode[]`(트리 순서 전개 — Task 5 키보드 이동, Task 7 "컬렉션에 추가" 목록, Task 10 팔레트가 쓴다). `scopeItems`·`filterByTags`는 `LibraryItem[]` 대신 `readonly LibraryItem[]`를 돌려준다(`all`·필터 없음에서 입력 배열을 그대로 돌려줘 메모 동일성이 이어진다). `scopeItems`·`scopeLabel`의 `model`은 `OrganizeModel | undefined`도 받는다(스냅샷이 오기 전의 `all`·`recent`).
7. **Q-16 (열 `openedAt`은 카탈로그에서 `updatedAt` 뒤).** 열 메뉴는 카탈로그 순서로 나오므로 "수정일 → 마지막으로 연 날 → 보관"이 된다. 이름 "마지막으로 연 날"은 명세 5.1. 기존 테스트 중 아홉 열을 못 박은 것(`library-columns.test.ts`, `columns.test.ts:17`, `table.spec.ts`의 열 메뉴 단언)을 이 작업이 고친다.
8. **Q-17 (E2E의 "목록을 다시 받지 않았다" 증명은 main의 IPC 호출 카운터).** 렌더러 쪽 탐침(쿼리 캐시 관찰)은 페이지 안에서 `queryClient`에 닿을 길이 없고(번들 모듈), `window.learn`은 `contextBridge`로 얼려 있어 감쌀 수 없다. main의 `createHandle`이 E2E에서만 켜지는 카운터 `globalThis.__learnIpcCalls`(채널 → 횟수)를 올리고 테스트가 `app.evaluate`로 읽는다(기존 `__learnTest`·`__learnShell`과 같은 방식). 운영에서는 전역이 없어 한 줄의 조건 검사뿐이다. 증명이 거짓일 수 없게: (1) 같은 변경이 옛 구현(`['library']` 통째 무효화)에서는 `library:list` 횟수를 1 올리므로 단언이 깨지고, (2) 대조군으로 가져오기가 `library:list`를 올리는 것을 같은 테스트에서 확인한다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 작음(테스트 도우미 한 곳).
9. **Q-18 (모델은 모듈 수준 캐시로 한 번만 만든다).** 훅 셋(`MainWindow`·`LibraryView`·`InfoPane`)이 `useOrganize()`를 각자 부르므로 `useMemo`만으로는 모델이 셋 만들어진다. `organizeModelFor(snapshot, items)`가 마지막 (스냅샷, **자료 id 열**)을 기억해, 목록이 `openedAt`처럼 id 이외의 값만 바뀐 새 배열일 때(좁힌 다시 받기의 결과) 같은 모델을 돌려준다. 모델은 목록에서 **있는지 없는지**만 쓰기 때문이다(P-7).
10. **Q-19 (설정 읽기 정리는 렌더러가 한다; 쓰기 도우미 `saveSetting`을 모은다).** "모르는 컬렉션 id는 읽을 때 버린다"(명세 10.4)는 스냅샷이 있어야 알 수 있어 도메인 스키마가 할 수 없다. 스키마(`D/settings.ts`)는 모양만 검사하고(`sidebar.expanded`: uuid 배열 ≤ 2,000 — 모양이 어긋나면 값 전체가 읽히지 않아 빈 목록), 모르는 id 버리기는 `parseExpanded(raw, known)`·`restorableScope`가 한다(Task 5가 `parseExpanded`를 쓰고 쓸 때 2,000개로 자른다). M4의 `useLibrarySettings.ts`에 있던 낙관적 쓰기(`save`)를 `R/data/saveSetting.ts`의 `saveSetting(key, value)`로 옮겨 저장소와 Task 5·6이 함께 쓴다. 이 작업에서는 새 보기가 비어 있어도(빈 컬렉션·빈 특수 보기) 표 몸통이 비어 있을 뿐이다 — 빈 상태 문구는 Task 5(명세 3.6)이고, 이 작업에서 거기에 닿는 길은 저장된 `library.view`뿐이다.

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

보기 계산의 순수 층과 그것을 읽는 훅을 만든다. 눈에 보이는 변화는 저장된 `library.view`로 다시 시작했을 때의 도구 막대 제목·표 행·개수, 그리고 "마지막으로 연 날" 열(기본 숨김)뿐이고, 기본 보기(`all`)의 화면은 투어 PNG와 같아야 한다.

- 도메인: `LibraryScope`·`libraryScopeSchema`, 설정 키 넷(`library.view`·`library.sort.recent`·`sidebar.expanded`·`tags.selector`), 열 `openedAt`, 열 메뉴 입력의 `locked`.
- 순수 모듈 `R/organize/{tree,model,scope,tagFilter,viewSettings}.ts`와 단위 테스트, `useOrganize`(쿼리 키 `['library','organize']`), `useRestoreView`.
- `useLibrary` 저장소: `scope`·`setScope`·`restoreScope`·`scopeReady`·`tagFilter`·`toggleTagFilter`·`clearTagFilter` (+ 표가 맨 위로 가거나 한 행을 보이게 하는 `scopeEpoch`·`revealOnScope`).
- 행 파이프라인 `R/library/useScopeView.ts`(범위 → 태그 필터) + `useLibraryRows`(→ 검색 → 정렬), 최근 보기의 정렬·강제 열.
- 좁힌 `useLibrarySync`(명세 10.3 표) + 검색 색인 물려받기.
- 도구 막대 제목(`scopeLabel`, 컬렉션은 전체 경로 툴팁), 선택 없음 통계(`libraryStats(label, items)`), 범위가 바뀌면 표를 맨 위로.
- E2E 도우미(`createCollection` …)와 `E/organize-data.spec.ts`, main의 E2E 호출 카운터.

```ts
/**
 * Which items the library table shows (spec 3.1). Held by the library view's store, not by the shell's `View`: coming back
 * from the reader must land on the same scope.
 */
export type LibraryScope =
  | { kind: 'all' }
  | { kind: 'recent' }
  | { kind: 'unfiled' }
  | { kind: 'duplicates' }
  | { kind: 'collection'; id: string };

/** library.view as stored. Strict: a value with keys this build does not know reads as unusable and the view opens at `all`. */
export const libraryScopeSchema: z.ZodType<LibraryScope> = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('all') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('recent') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('unfiled') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('duplicates') }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('collection'), id: z.uuid() }),
]);
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { OrganizeCollection } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildTree } from './tree';

const at = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const c = (id: string, name: string, parentId: string | null = null, createdAt = at): OrganizeCollection => ({ id, name, parentId, createdAt });
const names = (nodes: readonly { name: string }[]) => nodes.map((n) => n.name);

describe('the collection tree (spec 3.3)', () => {
  it('orders siblings by Korean name with numbers by value: 6장 < 7장 < 10장', () => {
    const tree = buildTree([c('a', '10장'), c('b', '6장'), c('c', '7장'), c('d', '가'), c('e', '나')]);
    expect(names(tree.roots)).toEqual(['6장', '7장', '10장', '가', '나']);
  });
  it('nests children under their parent with their depth, and lists the nodes in tree order', () => {
    const tree = buildTree([c('bio', '분자생물학'), c('c10', '10장', 'bio'), c('c6', '6장', 'bio'), c('stat', '통계'), c('reg', '회귀분석', 'stat'), c('deep', '잔차', 'reg')]);
    expect(names(tree.flat)).toEqual(['분자생물학', '6장', '10장', '통계', '회귀분석', '잔차']);
    expect(tree.flat.map((n) => n.depth)).toEqual([0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 2]);
    expect(tree.byId.get('deep')?.parentId).toBe('reg');
    expect(names(tree.byId.get('bio')!.children)).toEqual(['6장', '10장']);
  });
  it('puts equal names in creation order, then by id, so every build orders them alike', () => {
    const tree = buildTree([c('z', '같은 이름', null, '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z'), c('b', '같은 이름', null, at), c('a', '같은 이름', null, at)]);
    expect(tree.roots.map((n) => n.id)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'z']);
  });
  it('shows a collection whose parent is not live as a top-level one, and drops a cycle without looping', () => {
    const tree = buildTree([c('orphan', '고아', 'gone'), c('self', '자기', 'self'), c('x', '순환 1', 'y'), c('y', '순환 2', 'x')]);
    expect(names(tree.roots)).toEqual(['고아', '자기']);
    expect(tree.byId.get('orphan')?.parentId).toBeNull();
    expect(tree.byId.has('x')).toBe(false);
    expect(buildTree([]).roots).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

Expected: FAIL — `Cannot find module './tree'`.

`R/organize/tree.ts`:
```ts
import type { OrganizeCollection } from '@learn/domain';

export interface CollectionNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** The live parent, or null for a top-level collection (also one whose parent is not live). */
  parentId: string | null;
  depth: number;
  createdAt: string;
  children: CollectionNode[];
}

export interface CollectionTree {
  roots: CollectionNode[];
  byId: ReadonlyMap<string, CollectionNode>;
  /** Every node in tree order (a parent, then its children in name order, depth first). */
  flat: CollectionNode[];
}

/** Korean collation with numbers by value (6장 < 7장 < 10장): the order of sibling collections and of tag names (spec 0, 4.3). */
export const nameCollator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true });

const compare = (a: OrganizeCollection, b: OrganizeCollection): number =>
  nameCollator.compare(a.name, b.name) || (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? -1 : a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? 1 : 0) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);

/**
 * The nested collections from the snapshot's flat list. The database keeps no order for siblings, so every level is in
 * name order; equal names fall back to creation time and id so the order never depends on how the rows arrived. A
 * collection whose parent is not in the list is shown at the top rather than lost; a cycle (which the database refuses
 * to make) cannot be reached from a top-level collection and is left out instead of looping.
 */
export function buildTree(collections: readonly OrganizeCollection[]): CollectionTree {
  const known = new Set(collections.map((c) => c.id));
  const kids = new Map<string | null, OrganizeCollection[]>();
  for (const c of collections) {
    const parent = c.parentId !== null && c.parentId !== c.id && known.has(c.parentId) ? c.parentId : null;
    const list = kids.get(parent);
    if (list) list.push(c);
    else kids.set(parent, [c]);
  }
  const byId = new Map<string, CollectionNode>();
  const flat: CollectionNode[] = [];
  const make = (c: OrganizeCollection, parentId: string | null, depth: number): CollectionNode => {
    const node: CollectionNode = { id: c.id, name: c.name, parentId, depth, createdAt: c.createdAt, children: [] };
    byId.set(c.id, node);
    flat.push(node);
    for (const child of (kids.get(c.id) ?? []).sort(compare)) node.children.push(make(child, c.id, depth + 1));
    return node;
  };
  const roots = (kids.get(null) ?? []).sort(compare).map((c) => make(c, null, 0));
  return { roots, byId, flat };
}
```

`R/organize/model.ts`:
```ts
import type { LibraryItem, OrganizeSnapshot, OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildTree, nameCollator, type CollectionNode } from './tree';

export type { CollectionNode } from './tree';

export interface OrganizeModel {
  /** Top-level collections in name order (Korean, numbers by value); `children` likewise. */
  roots: CollectionNode[];
  /** Every collection in tree order. */
  flat: readonly CollectionNode[];
  collectionCount: number;
  node(id: string): CollectionNode | undefined;
  /** The collections from the top-level one down to `id` (empty for an unknown id). */
  path(id: string): CollectionNode[];
  /** `id` and its live descendants: the distinct items of them that the list has. */
  subtreeItems(id: string): ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** `subtreeItems(id).size`: what the sidebar shows beside the name. */
  count(id: string): number;
  /** The live collections that hold the item directly, in tree order. */
  directCollectionsOf(itemId: string): readonly string[];
  /** The item's tags: those with a position first, by position; then the rest by name. */
  tagsOfItem(itemId: string): readonly OrganizeTag[];
  tagItems(tagId: string): ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Items in no live collection (every item when there is no collection). */
  unfiled: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Items of a duplicate group that still has two or more items in the list. */
  duplicates: ReadonlySet<string>;
  tags: readonly OrganizeTag[];
  tagByPosition(position: number): OrganizeTag | undefined;
}

const NO_IDS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([]);
const NO_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();

const compareTags = (a: OrganizeTag, b: OrganizeTag): number => {
  if ((a.position === null) !== (b.position === null)) return a.position === null ? 1 : -1;
  if (a.position !== null && b.position !== null && a.position !== b.position) return a.position - b.position;
  return nameCollator.compare(a.name, b.name) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0);
};

/**
 * Everything the sidebar, the special views and the tag selector read, derived from the snapshot and the item list. Every
 * set counts only the items the list has: the snapshot and the list can arrive at different moments, and an item that
 * left must not be counted.
 */
export function buildOrganizeModel(snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot, items: readonly LibraryItem[]): OrganizeModel {
  const present = new Set<string>();
  for (const i of items) present.add(i.id);
  const { roots, byId, flat } = buildTree(snapshot.collections);

  const direct = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const inCollections = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const filed = new Set<string>();
  for (const node of flat) {
    const here = (snapshot.members[node.id] ?? []).filter((id) => present.has(id));
    direct.set(node.id, here);
    for (const id of here) {
      filed.add(id);
      const list = inCollections.get(id);
      if (list) list.push(node.id);
      else inCollections.set(id, [node.id]);
    }
  }
  const subtree = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string>>();
  const subtreeOf = (node: CollectionNode): ReadonlySet<string> => {
    const known = subtree.get(node.id);
    if (known) return known;
    const set = new Set(direct.get(node.id));
    for (const child of node.children) for (const id of subtreeOf(child)) set.add(id);
    subtree.set(node.id, set);
    return set;
  };

  const tagSets = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string>>();
  const perItem = new Map<string, OrganizeTag[]>();
  for (const tag of snapshot.tags) {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const id of snapshot.tagged[tag.id] ?? []) if (present.has(id)) set.add(id);
    tagSets.set(tag.id, set);
    for (const id of set) {
      const list = perItem.get(id);
      if (list) list.push(tag);
      else perItem.set(id, [tag]);
    }
  }
  for (const list of perItem.values()) list.sort(compareTags);

  const duplicates = new Set<string>();
  for (const group of snapshot.duplicates) {
    const here = group.filter((id) => present.has(id));
    if (here.length >= 2) for (const id of here) duplicates.add(id);
  }
  const unfiled = new Set<string>();
  for (const i of items) if (!filed.has(i.id)) unfiled.add(i.id);
  const byPosition = new Map<number, OrganizeTag>();
  for (const tag of snapshot.tags) if (tag.position !== null && !byPosition.has(tag.position)) byPosition.set(tag.position, tag);

  return {
    roots,
    flat,
    collectionCount: flat.length,
    node: (id) => byId.get(id),
    path(id) {
      const out: CollectionNode[] = [];
      for (let n = byId.get(id); n; n = n.parentId === null ? undefined : byId.get(n.parentId)) out.unshift(n);
      return out;
    },
    subtreeItems: (id) => {
      const n = byId.get(id);
      return n ? subtreeOf(n) : NO_SET;
    },
    count: (id) => {
      const n = byId.get(id);
      return n ? subtreeOf(n).size : 0;
    },
    directCollectionsOf: (itemId) => inCollections.get(itemId) ?? NO_IDS,
    tagsOfItem: (itemId) => perItem.get(itemId) ?? (NO_IDS as readonly OrganizeTag[]),
    tagItems: (tagId) => tagSets.get(tagId) ?? NO_SET,
    unfiled,
    duplicates,
    tags: snapshot.tags,
    tagByPosition: (position) => byPosition.get(position),
  };
}

let last: { snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot; ids: readonly string[]; model: OrganizeModel } | null = null;

/**
 * The model of this snapshot and list, shared by every caller (the toolbar, the table and the item panel each ask) and
 * kept while only values other than the ids change: a list patched after an `opened` or `metadata` notice is a new array
 * with the same ids, and the model reads nothing else from it.
 */
export function organizeModelFor(snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot, items: readonly LibraryItem[]): OrganizeModel {
  if (last && last.snapshot === snapshot && last.ids.length === items.length && last.ids.every((id, k) => id === items[k]!.id)) return last.model;
  const model = buildOrganizeModel(snapshot, items);
  last = { snapshot, ids: items.map((i) => i.id), model };
  return model;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { LibraryItem, LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from './model';
import { item } from './testing';
import { RECENT_DAYS, recentItems, resolveScope, restorableScope, sameScope, scopeItems, scopeLabel, scopePath } from './scope';

const NOW = Date.parse('2026-10-26T12:00:00.000Z');
const DAY = 86_400_000;
const ago = (days: number) => new Date(NOW - days * DAY).toISOString();
const at = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const ITEMS: LibraryItem[] = [
  item('new', { openedAt: ago(1) }),
  item('edge', { openedAt: ago(RECENT_DAYS) }), // exactly 30 days: in
  item('old', { openedAt: ago(RECENT_DAYS + 0.001) }),
  item('never', { openedAt: null }),
  item('broken', { openedAt: 'not a date' }),
  item('filed'),
  item('loose'),
];
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: at },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: at },
  ],
  tags: [],
  members: { bio: ['filed'], c6: ['new'] },
  tagged: {},
  duplicates: [['old', 'never']],
};
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ITEMS);
const idsOf = (xs: readonly LibraryItem[]) => xs.map((i) => i.id);
const ALL: LibraryScope = { kind: 'all' };

describe('the four scopes (spec 3.2)', () => {
  it('recent: opened within 30 days of the injected now, the boundary in, never-opened and unreadable dates out, list order kept', () => {
    expect(RECENT_DAYS).toBe(30);
    expect(idsOf(recentItems(ITEMS, NOW))).toEqual(['new', 'edge']);
    expect(idsOf(recentItems(ITEMS, NOW + 2 * DAY))).toEqual(['new']);
    expect(idsOf(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'recent' }, NOW))).toEqual(['new', 'edge']);
  });
  it('all returns the list itself', () => {
    expect(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, ALL, NOW)).toBe(ITEMS);
  });
  it('a collection shows its items and its descendants\' in list order; an unknown collection shows none', () => {
    expect(idsOf(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' }, NOW))).toEqual(['new', 'filed']);
    expect(idsOf(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'collection', id: 'c6' }, NOW))).toEqual(['new']);
    expect(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'collection', id: 'nope' }, NOW)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('unfiled is the items in no collection; duplicates the items of a group', () => {
    expect(idsOf(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'unfiled' }, NOW))).toEqual(['edge', 'old', 'never', 'broken', 'loose']);
    expect(idsOf(scopeItems(model, ITEMS, { kind: 'duplicates' }, NOW))).toEqual(['old', 'never']);
  });
  it('without a model only all and recent have anything to show', () => {
    expect(scopeItems(undefined, ITEMS, { kind: 'recent' }, NOW)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(scopeItems(undefined, ITEMS, ALL, NOW)).toBe(ITEMS);
  });
});

describe('names and equality', () => {
  it('names a scope, a collection by its own name and the full path as the tooltip', () => {
    expect(scopeLabel(model, ALL)).toBe('내 라이브러리');
    expect(scopeLabel(model, { kind: 'recent' })).toBe('최근 연 자료');
    expect(scopeLabel(model, { kind: 'unfiled' })).toBe('미분류');
    expect(scopeLabel(model, { kind: 'duplicates' })).toBe('중복 항목');
    expect(scopeLabel(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'c6' })).toBe('6장');
    expect(scopePath(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'c6' })).toBe('분자생물학 › 6장');
    expect(scopePath(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' })).toBe('분자생물학');
    expect(scopePath(model, { kind: 'recent' })).toBeUndefined();
    expect(scopeLabel(undefined, { kind: 'recent' })).toBe('최근 연 자료');
    expect(scopeLabel(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'nope' })).toBe('내 라이브러리');
  });
  it('compares scopes by kind, and collections by id', () => {
    expect(sameScope({ kind: 'all' }, { kind: 'all' })).toBe(true);
    expect(sameScope({ kind: 'all' }, { kind: 'recent' })).toBe(false);
    expect(sameScope({ kind: 'collection', id: 'a' }, { kind: 'collection', id: 'a' })).toBe(true);
    expect(sameScope({ kind: 'collection', id: 'a' }, { kind: 'collection', id: 'b' })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('what the table shows when the stored scope cannot be shown', () => {
  it('a collection that is gone, or any view that needs the snapshot before it came, is all', () => {
    expect(resolveScope(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'nope' })).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(resolveScope(model, { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' })).toEqual({ kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' });
    expect(resolveScope(undefined, { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' })).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(resolveScope(undefined, { kind: 'unfiled' })).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(resolveScope(undefined, { kind: 'duplicates' })).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(resolveScope(undefined, { kind: 'recent' })).toEqual({ kind: 'recent' });
  });
});

describe('the view restored at start (spec 3.1)', () => {
  it('opens a stored scope that still has what it needs', () => {
    const bioId = '5a0b8c1d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d';
    const live = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, collections: [{ id: bioId, name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: at }], members: {} }, ITEMS);
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'collection', id: bioId }, live, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'collection', id: bioId });
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'recent' }, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'recent' });
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'unfiled' }, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'unfiled' });
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'duplicates' }, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'duplicates' });
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'all' }, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
  });
  it('falls back to all: nothing stored, garbage, a collection that is gone, a special view without content', () => {
    for (const raw of [null, undefined, 'recent', { kind: 'trash' }, { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' } /* not a uuid */]) expect(restorableScope(raw, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
    const ghost = { kind: 'collection', id: '5a0b8c1d-3e4f-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d' };
    expect(restorableScope(ghost, model, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'recent' }, model, ITEMS, NOW + 40 * DAY)).toEqual(ALL);
    const none = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, duplicates: [], collections: [], members: {} }, ITEMS);
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'duplicates' }, none, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'unfiled' }, none, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL); // no collection at all: the view is not offered
    const allFiled = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, members: { bio: ITEMS.map((i) => i.id) } }, ITEMS);
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'unfiled' }, allFiled, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
  });
  it('without the snapshot only all and recent can open', () => {
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'recent' }, undefined, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual({ kind: 'recent' });
    expect(restorableScope({ kind: 'duplicates' }, undefined, ITEMS, NOW)).toEqual(ALL);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from './model';
import { item } from './testing';
import { filterByTags } from './tagFilter';

const ITEMS = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'].map((id) => item(id));
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [],
  tags: [
    { id: 'imp', name: '중요', color: 'yellow', position: 1 },
    { id: 'exam', name: '시험', color: 'red', position: 2 },
    { id: 'unused', name: '안 씀', color: null, position: null },
  ],
  members: {},
  tagged: { imp: ['a', 'b', 'c'], exam: ['b', 'c', 'd'] },
  duplicates: [],
};
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ITEMS);
const ids = (xs: readonly { id: string }[]) => xs.map((i) => i.id);

describe('the tag filter (spec 4.3: all the chosen tags)', () => {
  it('no tags chosen is no filtering: the same list back', () => {
    expect(filterByTags(model, ITEMS, new Set())).toBe(ITEMS);
  });
  it('one tag keeps its items, in list order', () => {
    expect(ids(filterByTags(model, ITEMS, new Set(['imp'])))).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c']);
  });
  it('several tags keep only the items that have every one of them (AND)', () => {
    expect(ids(filterByTags(model, ITEMS, new Set(['imp', 'exam'])))).toEqual(['b', 'c']);
  });
  it('a tag nobody has, or one that does not exist, leaves nothing', () => {
    expect(filterByTags(model, ITEMS, new Set(['imp', 'unused']))).toEqual([]);
    expect(filterByTags(model, ITEMS, new Set(['nope']))).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('filters the list it is given: the items outside it never come back', () => {
    expect(ids(filterByTags(model, ITEMS.slice(2), new Set(['imp'])))).toEqual(['c']);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { libraryScopeSchema, type LibraryItem, type LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { OrganizeModel } from './model';

/** The recent view's window: items opened within this many days (spec 3.2). */
export const RECENT_DAYS = 30;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
export const SCOPE_ALL: LibraryScope = Object.freeze({ kind: 'all' }) as LibraryScope;

export function sameScope(a: LibraryScope, b: LibraryScope): boolean {
  return a.kind === b.kind && (a.kind !== 'collection' || (b.kind === 'collection' && a.id === b.id));
}

/** Items opened within the last 30 days of `now` (ms), in the list's order. A date that does not read is not recent. */
export function recentItems(items: readonly LibraryItem[], now: number): readonly LibraryItem[] {
  const since = now - RECENT_DAYS * DAY_MS;
  return items.filter((i) => {
    if (i.openedAt === null) return false;
    const opened = Date.parse(i.openedAt);
    return !Number.isNaN(opened) && opened >= since;
  });
}

/**
 * The items of a scope, in the list's own order (sorting comes after). `all` is the list itself, so a memo downstream
 * keeps its identity. A scope that needs the snapshot, asked for without one, shows the whole list (resolveScope turns
 * such a scope into `all` first).
 */
export function scopeItems(model: OrganizeModel | undefined, items: readonly LibraryItem[], scope: LibraryScope, now: number): readonly LibraryItem[] {
  if (scope.kind === 'recent') return recentItems(items, now);
  if (scope.kind === 'all' || model === undefined) return items;
  switch (scope.kind) {
    case 'collection': {
      const inside = model.subtreeItems(scope.id);
      return items.filter((i) => inside.has(i.id));
    }
    case 'unfiled':
      return items.filter((i) => model.unfiled.has(i.id));
    case 'duplicates':
      return items.filter((i) => model.duplicates.has(i.id));
  }
}

/** The toolbar title: a special view by its name, a collection by its own name (its path is the tooltip). */
export function scopeLabel(model: OrganizeModel | undefined, scope: LibraryScope): string {
  switch (scope.kind) {
    case 'all':
      return t.shell.myLibrary;
    case 'recent':
      return t.organize.scopes.recent;
    case 'unfiled':
      return t.organize.scopes.unfiled;
    case 'duplicates':
      return t.organize.scopes.duplicates;
    case 'collection':
      return model?.node(scope.id)?.name ?? t.shell.myLibrary;
  }
}

/** A collection's full path ("분자생물학 › 6장 · 신호 전달"), for the title's tooltip; undefined for every other scope. */
export function scopePath(model: OrganizeModel | undefined, scope: LibraryScope): string | undefined {
  if (scope.kind !== 'collection' || model === undefined) return undefined;
  const path = model.path(scope.id);
  return path.length === 0 ? undefined : path.map((n) => n.name).join(t.organize.pathSeparator);
}

/**
 * What the table shows for the scope the user chose: a collection that is gone, or a view that needs the snapshot before
 * it arrived, shows `all`. The chosen scope itself is left as it is — an undo that brings the collection back brings the
 * view back with it.
 */
export function resolveScope(model: OrganizeModel | undefined, scope: LibraryScope): LibraryScope {
  switch (scope.kind) {
    case 'all':
    case 'recent':
      return scope;
    case 'collection':
      return model?.node(scope.id) ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
    case 'unfiled':
    case 'duplicates':
      return model ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
  }
}

/**
 * The view to open at start from the stored `library.view` (spec 3.1): the stored scope when it can still be shown — its
 * collection exists, the special view has content — else `all`. The unfiled view is offered only while a collection
 * exists (spec 3.2), so it needs one here too.
 */
export function restorableScope(raw: unknown, model: OrganizeModel | undefined, items: readonly LibraryItem[], now: number): LibraryScope {
  const parsed = libraryScopeSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) return SCOPE_ALL;
  const scope = parsed.data;
  switch (scope.kind) {
    case 'all':
      return scope;
    case 'recent':
      return recentItems(items, now).length > 0 ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
    case 'collection':
      return model?.node(scope.id) ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
    case 'unfiled':
      return model && model.collectionCount > 0 && model.unfiled.size > 0 ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
    case 'duplicates':
      return model && model.duplicates.size > 0 ? scope : SCOPE_ALL;
  }
}
```

`R/organize/tagFilter.ts`:
```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from './model';

const NONE: readonly LibraryItem[] = Object.freeze([]);

/**
 * The items that have every one of the chosen tags (spec 4.3, AND). No tag chosen filters nothing and gives the list
 * back as it is. Tags are tested smallest set first, so a rare tag decides at once.
 */
export function filterByTags(model: OrganizeModel, items: readonly LibraryItem[], tagIds: ReadonlySet<string>): readonly LibraryItem[] {
  if (tagIds.size === 0) return items;
  const sets = [...tagIds].map((id) => model.tagItems(id)).sort((a, b) => a.size - b.size);
  if (sets[0]!.size === 0) return NONE;
  return items.filter((i) => sets.every((s) => s.has(i.id)));
}
```

```ts
import { SETTINGS, SIDEBAR_EXPANDED_MAX } from '@learn/domain';

export interface TagsSelector {
  show: 'view' | 'all';
  sort: 'name' | 'count';
}
export const DEFAULT_TAGS_SELECTOR: Readonly<TagsSelector> = Object.freeze({ show: 'view', sort: 'name' });

/** tags.selector as stored (spec 4.3), else the default. */
export function parseTagsSelector(raw: unknown): TagsSelector {
  const r = SETTINGS['tags.selector'].safeParse(raw);
  return r.success ? r.data : { ...DEFAULT_TAGS_SELECTOR };
}

/**
 * sidebar.expanded as stored (spec 10.4): each collection once, and only those `known` to exist. Anything the schema
 * does not read is an empty list — the tree starts closed.
 */
export function parseExpanded(raw: unknown, known: (collectionId: string) => boolean): string[] {
  const r = SETTINGS['sidebar.expanded'].safeParse(raw);
  if (!r.success) return [];
  return [...new Set(r.data)].filter(known).slice(0, SIDEBAR_EXPANDED_MAX);
}
```

```ts
import type { SettingKey } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError, api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { queryClient } from './query-client';

/** The cache entry of a library setting: the same key the readers use (`keys.columns` is `settingKey('library.columns')`). */
export const settingKey = (key: SettingKey) => ['settings', key] as const;

/**
 * Optimistic: the screen follows at once. A refused write keeps the screen as chosen and logs the code only (the next
 * change writes the whole value again).
 */
export function saveSetting(key: SettingKey, value: unknown): void {
  queryClient.setQueryData(settingKey(key), value);
  void unwrap(api().settings.set({ key, value })).catch((e: unknown) => console.warn(`[settings] saving ${key} failed: ${e instanceof ApiError ? e.code : 'INTERNAL'}`));
}
```

```ts
  setScope(scope: LibraryScope, opts?: { keepSelected?: string }): void;
  /** Sets the stored view at start and marks the store ready; nothing is written back. */
  restoreScope(scope: LibraryScope): void;
```

```ts
  scopeReady: false,
  scopeEpoch: 0,
  revealOnScope: null,
  tagFilter: NO_TAGS,
  setScope: (scope, opts) => {
    const s = get();
    const keep = opts?.keepSelected ?? null;
    const moved = !sameScope(s.scope, scope);
    if (!moved && keep === null) return;
    set({
      scope,
      tagFilter: NO_TAGS,
      selected: keep === null ? NONE : new Set([keep]),
      anchorId: keep,
      cursorId: keep,

  restoreScope: (scope) => set({ scope, scopeReady: true }),

    const next = new Set(get().tagFilter);
    if (!next.delete(tagId)) next.add(tagId);
    set({ tagFilter: next });

    if (get().tagFilter.size > 0) set({ tagFilter: NO_TAGS });
```

```ts
/** 추가일, newest first (spec §3.1). */
export const DEFAULT_SORT: LibrarySort = { column: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' };
/** The recent view sorts by when the item was opened, newest first (spec 3.2). */
export const DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT: LibrarySort = { column: 'openedAt', direction: 'desc' };

/** library.sort (or library.sort.recent, with its own fallback) as stored, else the fallback. */
export function parseSort(raw: unknown, fallback: LibrarySort = DEFAULT_SORT): LibrarySort {
  const r = SETTINGS['library.sort'].safeParse(raw);
  return r.success ? r.data : fallback;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The shown columns, in catalogue order (`order` is not used yet). `forced` columns are shown whatever the config says and
 * sit right after the title: the recent view's 마지막으로 연 날 (spec 3.2).
 */
export function visibleColumns(cfg: ColumnConfig, forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = []): LibraryColumnSpec[] {
  const shown = LIBRARY_COLUMNS.filter((c) => cfg.visible.includes(c.id) || forced.includes(c.id));
  if (forced.length === 0) return shown;
  return [...shown.filter((c) => c.id === 'title'), ...shown.filter((c) => c.id !== 'title' && forced.includes(c.id)), ...shown.filter((c) => c.id !== 'title' && !forced.includes(c.id))];
}
```

**`R/library/useLibrarySettings.ts`** 전체를 다음으로 바꾼다(현재 파일은 위 조사 결과의 41행짜리):
```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { ColumnConfig, LibraryColumnId } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { saveSetting } from '../data/saveSetting';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { parseColumnConfig } from './columns';
import { DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT, parseSort, type LibrarySort } from './sort';

const NO_COLUMNS: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = [];
/** The recent view always shows when each item was opened (spec 3.2). */
const RECENT_COLUMNS: readonly LibraryColumnId[] = ['openedAt'];

/**
 * The table's columns and sort (library settings, ADR-0007 (b)): parsed values, defaults when unset or unreadable.
 * `sort` and `setSort` are those of the scope shown: the recent view has a sort of its own (`library.sort.recent`), every
 * other view shares `library.sort`. `forced` are the columns the scope shows whatever the stored columns say.
 * `ready` once all three reads have settled, so the table never paints the default columns for a frame before the stored ones.
 */
export function useLibrarySettings(): {
  columns: ColumnConfig;
  sort: LibrarySort;
  forced: readonly LibraryColumnId[];
  setColumns(next: ColumnConfig): void;
  setSort(next: LibrarySort): void;
  ready: boolean;
} {
  const recent = useLibrary((s) => s.scope.kind === 'recent');
  const columnsRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.columns, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.columns' })) });
  const sortRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sort, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort' })) });
  const recentRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sortRecent, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort.recent' })) });
  const columns = useMemo(() => parseColumnConfig(columnsRead.data ?? null), [columnsRead.data]);
  const sortAll = useMemo(() => parseSort(sortRead.data ?? null), [sortRead.data]);
  const sortRecent = useMemo(() => parseSort(recentRead.data ?? null, DEFAULT_SORT_RECENT), [recentRead.data]);
  const setColumns = useCallback((next: ColumnConfig) => saveSetting('library.columns', next), []);
  const setSort = useCallback((next: LibrarySort) => saveSetting(recent ? 'library.sort.recent' : 'library.sort', next), [recent]);
  return {
    columns,
    sort: recent ? sortRecent : sortAll,
    forced: recent ? RECENT_COLUMNS : NO_COLUMNS,
    setColumns,
    setSort,
    ready: !columnsRead.isPending && !sortRead.isPending && !recentRead.isPending,
  };
}
```

`R/data/libraryChange.ts`:
```ts
import type { LearnEventMap, LibraryChangeReason, LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';

/** Ids per notice that are read one by one (spec 10.3); more than this reads the whole list. */
export const NARROW_LIMIT = 500;
/** The reasons that change an item's own row and nothing about which items exist. */
const NARROW: ReadonlySet<LibraryChangeReason> = new Set<LibraryChangeReason>(['metadata', 'relink', 'availability', 'opened']);

export interface ChangeDeps {
  /** The list in the query cache, or undefined before it was first read. */
  cached(): readonly LibraryItem[] | undefined;
  /** A read of the whole list is running. */
  refetching(): boolean;
  /** Stores a patched list. */
  put(prev: readonly LibraryItem[], next: readonly LibraryItem[]): void;
  getItems(ids: string[]): Promise<LibraryItem[]>;
  /** Everything under ['library']: the list, the snapshot, the search texts, every item and detail. */
  invalidateAll(): void;
  invalidateOrganize(): void;
  invalidateItem(itemId: string): void;
  invalidateTexts(): void;
}

const same = (a: LibraryItem, b: LibraryItem): boolean => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);

/**
 * The list with `fresh` put over its rows, or null when it cannot be patched: an item that was asked for did not come
 * back (it left the library) or one came back that the list has no row for. An unchanged list comes back as it is.
 */
function patched(list: readonly LibraryItem[], ids: readonly string[], fresh: readonly LibraryItem[]): readonly LibraryItem[] | null {
  const byId = new Map(fresh.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
  if (ids.some((id) => !byId.has(id))) return null;
  const at = new Map(list.map((i, k) => [i.id, k]));
  let next: LibraryItem[] | null = null;
  for (const item of fresh) {
    const k = at.get(item.id);
    if (k === undefined) return null;
    if (same(list[k]!, item)) continue;
    next ??= [...list];
    next[k] = item;
  }
  return next ?? list;
}

/**
 * What the renderer reads again after `libraryChanged` (spec 10.3). Collections and tags change only the snapshot. A
 * change to the rows of known items (metadata, relink, availability, opened) with 1–500 ids reads those items and puts
 * them into the cached list; everything else reads the whole list. A patch that a whole-list read overtook is dropped
 * (the whole read has the change), and a patch that cannot be applied falls back to the whole read.
 */
export function createChangeHandler(d: ChangeDeps): (change: LearnEventMap['libraryChanged']) => void {
  let epoch = 0;
  const everything = (): void => {
    epoch += 1;
    d.invalidateAll();
  };
  return ({ reason, itemIds }) => {
    if (reason === 'collections' || reason === 'tags') {
      d.invalidateOrganize();
      return;
    }
    const ids = itemIds === undefined ? [] : [...new Set(itemIds)];
    if (!NARROW.has(reason) || ids.length === 0 || ids.length > NARROW_LIMIT || d.cached() === undefined || d.refetching()) {
      everything();
      return;
    }
    const started = epoch;
    for (const id of ids) d.invalidateItem(id);
    if (reason === 'metadata') d.invalidateTexts();
    d.getItems(ids).then(
      (fresh) => {
        if (started !== epoch) return;
        const list = d.cached();
        const next = list === undefined ? null : patched(list, ids, fresh);
        if (list === undefined || next === null) everything();
        else if (next !== list) d.put(list, next);
      },
      () => everything(),
    );
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Every change made through main pushes libraryChanged. Collections and tags read the snapshot only; a change to some
 * items' own rows reads those items and patches the list; the rest drops all cached library data (libraryChange.ts).
 */
const onLibraryChanged = createChangeHandler({
  cached: () => queryClient.getQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items),
  refetching: () => queryClient.isFetching({ queryKey: keys.items }) > 0,
  put: (prev, next) => {
    queryClient.setQueryData(keys.items, next);
    carrySearchIndex(prev, next);
  },
  getItems: (ids) => unwrap(api().library.getItems({ ids })),
  invalidateAll: () => void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['library'] }),
  invalidateOrganize: () => void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.organize }),
  invalidateItem: (itemId) => {
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.item(itemId) });
    void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.detail(itemId) });
  },
  invalidateTexts: () => void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.searchTexts }),
});
export function useLibrarySync(): void {
  useLearnEvent('libraryChanged', onLibraryChanged);
}
```

`R/library/search.ts` — `indexes` WeakMap과 `searchIndexFor` 정의(현재 `const indexes = new WeakMap<…>` 부터 `searchIndexFor` 끝까지) **바로 아래**에 더한다:
```ts
/** The fields the short index holds: a change to any of them changes what a query can find. */
function sameSearchedFields(a: LibraryItem, b: LibraryItem): boolean {
  return (
    a.title === b.title && a.publisher === b.publisher && a.originalName === b.originalName && a.year === b.year &&
    a.creators.length === b.creators.length && a.creators.every((c, k) => c === b.creators[k])
  );
}

/**
 * A list patched in place (same length and ids; a few rows replaced) keeps the old list's index when none of the replaced
 * rows changed a searched field: opening an item, a re-checked file or a relink must not make the next keystroke pay for a
 * new index. The index reads `items` for titles and ids only, which are the same. Anything else is left to build a new one.
 */
export function carrySearchIndex(prev: readonly LibraryItem[], next: readonly LibraryItem[]): void {
  if (prev.length !== next.length) return;
  for (let k = 0; k < prev.length; k++) {
    const a = prev[k]!;
    const b = next[k]!;
    if (a !== b && (a.id !== b.id || !sameSearchedFields(a, b))) return;
  }
  const short = shortParts.get(prev);
  if (short) shortParts.set(next, short);
  const full = indexes.get(prev);
  if (full) indexes.set(next, full);
}
```

```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys, useItems } from '../data/queries';
import { organizeModelFor, type OrganizeModel } from './model';

/**
 * The organize snapshot (spec 10.1) and the model built from it and the current item list. The model waits for both:
 * counts read before the list arrived would be zero. `settled` once the snapshot's read has answered, success or not.
 */
export function useOrganize(): { snapshot: OrganizeSnapshot | undefined; model: OrganizeModel | undefined; settled: boolean } {
  const read = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.organize, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().library.organize()) });
  const items = useItems().data;
  const snapshot = read.data;
  const model = useMemo(() => (snapshot !== undefined && items !== undefined ? organizeModelFor(snapshot, items) : undefined), [snapshot, items]);
  return { snapshot, model, settled: read.isSuccess || read.isError };
}
```

**`R/organize/useRestoreView.ts`**:
```ts
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys, useItems } from '../data/queries';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { restorableScope } from './scope';
import { useOrganize } from './useOrganize';

/**
 * Opens the view stored in `library.view` once, when everything it is judged by has answered — the setting, the organize
 * snapshot and the item list (success or failure: a failed read cannot confirm a collection, so the view opens at `all`).
 * Until then the library store is not ready and the table is not drawn. Returns whether the store is ready.
 */
export function useRestoreView(): boolean {
  const ready = useLibrary((s) => s.scopeReady);
  const view = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.view, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.view' })), enabled: !ready });
  const items = useItems();
  const { model, settled } = useOrganize();
  const answered = (view.isSuccess || view.isError) && (items.isSuccess || items.isError) && settled;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ready || !answered) return;
    useLibrary.getState().restoreScope(restorableScope(view.data ?? null, model, items.data ?? [], Date.now()));
  }, [ready, answered, view.data, model, items.data]);
  return ready;
}
```

**`R/library/useScopeView.ts`**:
```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem, LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { filterByTags } from '../organize/tagFilter';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { resolveScope, scopeItems, scopeLabel, scopePath } from '../organize/scope';
import { useOrganize } from '../organize/useOrganize';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { useNow } from '../useNow';

export interface ScopeView {
  /** The scope shown (resolveScope of the one chosen). */
  scope: LibraryScope;
  model: OrganizeModel | undefined;
  /** The toolbar title. */
  label: string;
  /** A collection's full path, for the title's tooltip. */
  tooltip: string | undefined;
  /** The items of the scope: what "M" counts in "N개 / M개". */
  scoped: readonly LibraryItem[];
  /** The scope's items that have every chosen tag. */
  filtered: readonly LibraryItem[];
}

/**
 * The first two steps of the table's rows (spec 3.1): the scope, then the tag filter — pure selectors over the snapshot,
 * no IPC. The quick search and the sort come after (useLibraryRows). `now` renews at midnight (useNow), which is when an
 * item can leave the recent view.
 */
export function useScopeView(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): ScopeView {
  const chosen = useLibrary((s) => s.scope);
  const tagFilter = useLibrary((s) => s.tagFilter);
  const { model } = useOrganize();
  const now = useNow().getTime();
  const scope = useMemo(() => resolveScope(model, chosen), [model, chosen]);
  const scoped = useMemo(() => scopeItems(model, items, scope, now), [model, items, scope, now]);
  const filtered = useMemo(() => (model ? filterByTags(model, scoped, tagFilter) : scoped), [model, scoped, tagFilter]);
  return { scope, model, label: scopeLabel(model, scope), tooltip: scopePath(model, scope), scoped, filtered };
}
```

**`R/library/useLibraryRows.ts`** 전체:
```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Match } from '../palette/hangul';
import type { SearchResult } from './search';
import { sortItems } from './sort';
import { useLibrarySettings } from './useLibrarySettings';
import { useScopeView } from './useScopeView';
import { useSearch } from './useSearch';

/** The rows the quick search keeps, in the order given. No search keeps them all. */
export function keepFound(rows: readonly LibraryItem[], found: SearchResult | null): readonly LibraryItem[] {
  return found ? rows.filter((i) => found.ids.has(i.id)) : rows;
}

/**
 * The rows the table shows (spec 3.1): the scope, then the tag filter, then the quick search, in the stored sort — the
 * recent view's own sort in the recent view. `titleMatches` is the search's matched range per title, null until a search exists.
 * The search index is built once for the whole list (never per scope, which would rebuild it at every view change); its
 * answer is intersected with the scope's rows.
 */
export function useLibraryRows(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): { rows: readonly LibraryItem[]; titleMatches: ReadonlyMap<string, Match> | null } {
  const { sort } = useLibrarySettings();
  const { filtered } = useScopeView(items);
  const sorted = useMemo(() => sortItems(filtered, sort), [filtered, sort]);
  // Quick search filters the sorted rows: the order stays the table's (spec 4.2); relevance ranks only the palette.
  // The index is built once per list (buildSearchIndex) and each query searched once (search), shared with the toolbar.
  const found = useSearch(items);
  const rows = useMemo(() => keepFound(sorted, found), [sorted, found]);
  return { rows, titleMatches: found?.titleMatches ?? null };
}
```

```ts
describe('the rows the quick search keeps', () => {
  const rows: LibraryItem[] = [item('a'), item('b'), item('c')];
  it('keeps the matching rows in the given order, and every row for no search', () => {
    expect(keepFound(rows, null)).toBe(rows);
    expect(keepFound(rows, { ids: new Set(['c', 'a']), titleMatches: new Map() }).map((i) => i.id)).toEqual(['a', 'c']);
    expect(keepFound(rows, { ids: new Set(), titleMatches: new Map() })).toEqual([]);
```

```ts
/**
 * Nothing selected: "분자생물학 · 자료 48개(PDF 35 · 동영상 13) · 1.9 GB" (the view's name, then its items); a kind without
 * items is left out, and a view without items says only "자료 0개".
 */
export function libraryStats(scope: string, items: readonly LibraryItem[]): string {
  if (items.length === 0) return t.inspector.statsNone(scope);
  const k = tally(items);
  const kinds = [k.pdf ? t.inspector.kindCount(t.library.type.pdf, k.pdf) : '', k.video ? t.inspector.kindCount(t.library.type.video, k.video) : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return t.inspector.stats(scope, items.length, kinds.join(' · '), bound(formatSize(k.bytes)));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Organize setup through the page's preload API (`window.learn.collections.*`, `tags.*`), as the sidebar will call it. The
 * screen's own flows are checked through the screen by the specs that own them; these make the data those specs need.
 */
export async function createCollection(page: Page, name: string, parentId: string | null = null): Promise<string> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.collections.create(input), { name, parentId });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`collections.create failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data.id;
}

/** Files the items in the collection; the number of memberships that are new. */
export async function addToCollection(page: Page, collectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<number> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.collections.addItems(input), { collectionId, itemIds: [...itemIds] });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`collections.addItems failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data;
}

export async function createTag(page: Page, name: string): Promise<string> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.tags.create(input), { name });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`tags.create failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data.id;
}

/** Puts the tag on the items; the number of assignments that are new. */
export async function assignTag(page: Page, tagId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<number> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.tags.assign(input), { tagId, itemIds: [...itemIds] });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`tags.assign failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data;
}

/** Colour and position together, as the screen always sets them (a position holds one tag). */
export async function setTagColor(page: Page, tagId: string, color: TagColorId | null, position: number | null): Promise<void> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.tags.setColor(input), { tagId, color, position });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`tags.setColor failed: ${r.code}`);
}

/** The organize snapshot as main sends it. Counts as a `library:organize` call. */
export async function organizeSnapshot(page: Page): Promise<OrganizeSnapshot> {
  const r = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.organize());
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.organize failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data;
}

/** How often main ran each IPC channel since launch (E2E only: ipc/register.ts counts, test-hooks.ts installs the counter). */
export const ipcCalls = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<Record<string, number>> =>
  app.evaluate(() => ({ ...((globalThis as { __learnIpcCalls?: Record<string, number> }).__learnIpcCalls ?? {}) }));

/**
 * The `library:*` call counts once none has changed for `quietMs`: what a change read is then final, and a count taken
 * next cannot be missing a read that is still on its way.
 */
export async function quietLibraryCalls(app: ElectronApplication, quietMs = 500): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const read = async () => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(await ipcCalls(app)).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('library:')));
  let last = JSON.stringify(await read());
  let since = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - since < quietMs) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    const now = JSON.stringify(await read());
    if (now !== last) {
      last = now;
      since = Date.now();
    }
  }
  return JSON.parse(last) as Record<string, number>;
}
```

```ts
    await storeView(s.page, { kind: 'recent' });
    await s.app.close();
    s = await launch(lib, ud);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-title')).toHaveText('최근 연 자료');
    expect(await titles(s.page)).toEqual([B, A]); // b was opened last
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('2개');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText(['제목', '마지막으로 연 날', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일']);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row').first().locator('[data-col="openedAt"]')).toHaveText(/\S/);
    await expect(s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="openedAt"]')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');

    // The header menu shows the forced column checked and fixed.
    await stubContextMenu(s.app, null);
    await s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="year"]').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await recordedPopups(s.app)).length).toBe(1);
    const [menu] = await recordedPopups(s.app);
    expect(menu!.find((i) => i.label === '마지막으로 연 날')).toMatchObject({ checked: true, enabled: false });
    expect(menu!.find((i) => i.label === '수정일')).toMatchObject({ checked: false, enabled: true });

    // Pressing its header flips the recent view's own sort; the main sort is untouched and the column stays out of the stored columns.
    await s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="openedAt"] button').click();
    expect(await titles(s.page)).toEqual([A, B]);
    await expect.poll(() => setting(s.page, 'library.sort.recent')).toEqual({ column: 'openedAt', direction: 'asc' });
    expect(await setting(s.page, 'library.sort')).toBeNull();
    expect(((await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')) as { visible?: string[] } | null)?.visible ?? []).not.toContain('openedAt');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

  }
});

test('a tag or collection change reads the snapshot only; a metadata or opened change reads those items only; an import reads the whole list', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [a, b] = await seeded(page);
    const tag = await createTag(page, '중요');
    const coll = await createCollection(page, '분자생물학');
    const base = await quietLibraryCalls(app);
    const n = (c: Record<string, number>, ch: string) => c[ch] ?? 0;

    // A tag: the snapshot is read once, the list and the items are not.
    await assignTag(page, tag, [a.id]);
    await expect.poll(async () => n(await ipcCalls(app), 'library:organize')).toBe(n(base, 'library:organize') + 1);
    const afterTag = await quietLibraryCalls(app);
    expect(n(afterTag, 'library:list'), 'a tag does not read the list').toBe(n(base, 'library:list'));
    expect(n(afterTag, 'library:getItems')).toBe(n(base, 'library:getItems'));

    // A collection: the same.
    await addToCollection(page, coll, [a.id, b.id]);
    await expect.poll(async () => n(await ipcCalls(app), 'library:organize')).toBe(n(afterTag, 'library:organize') + 1);
    const afterColl = await quietLibraryCalls(app);
    expect(n(afterColl, 'library:list'), 'a collection does not read the list').toBe(n(afterTag, 'library:list'));

    // Metadata of one item: that item is read, the list is not, and the row shows the new title.
    await seedMetadata(page, b.id, { creators: [] }, '단백질 접힘 개론');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, '단백질 접힘 개론')).toBeVisible();
    const afterMeta = await quietLibraryCalls(app);
    expect(n(afterMeta, 'library:getItems'), 'one read of the item').toBe(n(afterColl, 'library:getItems') + 1);
    expect(n(afterMeta, 'library:list'), 'metadata does not read the list').toBe(n(afterColl, 'library:list'));
    expect(n(afterMeta, 'library:organize'), 'nor the snapshot').toBe(n(afterColl, 'library:organize'));

    // Opening an item (the reader's notice): the item is read, the list is not.
    const opened = await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.reader.open({ itemId }), a.id);
    expect(opened.ok).toBe(true);
    await expect.poll(async () => n(await ipcCalls(app), 'library:getItems')).toBe(n(afterMeta, 'library:getItems') + 1);
    const afterOpen = await quietLibraryCalls(app);
    expect(n(afterOpen, 'library:list'), 'opened does not read the list').toBe(n(afterMeta, 'library:list'));

    // The control: an import does read the whole list, so the counter is able to show a list read.
    await importPaths(page, [EXTRA]);
    await expect.poll(async () => n(await ipcCalls(app), 'library:list')).toBe(n(afterOpen, 'library:list') + 1);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

### Task 4: 메뉴 기반 — 하위 메뉴·라디오·체크·값(`args`), 처리기 대상(`CommandTarget`), 맥락 필드, 메뉴 막대 다시 만들기, ⇧F10, 컨텍스트 메뉴 질의 한 번, 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ (첫 사용자)

이 작업은 Task 5–10이 메뉴에 올릴 모든 줄의 **기계**를 만든다. 레지스트리 명령 하나에 값을 붙인 줄(값 하위 메뉴 — 컬렉션에 추가·색 지정·정렬 기준), 명령 여럿을 한 하위 메뉴에 묶는 줄(묶음 하위 메뉴 — 색 태그 ▸ = `tag.color1`–`tag.color8`), 라디오·체크 표시, 표시만 하는 단축키("1"…"8"), 처리기가 받는 대상(`itemIds`·`collectionIds`·`tagIds`·`args`), 컬렉션·태그 컨텍스트 메뉴의 길, 컬렉션·태그가 바뀌면 메뉴 막대를 다시 만드는 장치, 키보드로 컨텍스트 메뉴를 여는 도우미(⇧F10)다. **실제 레지스트리에 올라가는 새 명령은 `library.sortBy`(보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸) 하나뿐**이다 — 처리기 없는 줄은 생길 수 없으므로 나머지 줄(컬렉션 명령·`tag.color1`–`8`)은 그 처리기를 만드는 Task 5–7이 레지스트리에 올린다. 묶음 하위 메뉴(`SUBMENUS`)는 실제 레지스트리에서는 **비어 있고**, 형·구성기·불변식을 이 작업이 시험 레지스트리로 시험한다. M4 잔여 두 가지(자료 메뉴의 `getItem` 반복 → `getItems` 한 번, 키보드만의 정렬)를 닫는다.

시각 검증: 네이티브 메뉴는 Linux 투어에 찍히지 않는다. **디자인 비평(opus) 단계는 없고**(바뀌는 웹 화면이 없다. 단, 표 행에 ⇧F10 포커스 고리가 이미 있는 그대로다), 대신 Linux에서는 메뉴 JSON 단언(E2E)과 투어를 갱신 없이 한 번 돌려 PNG가 그대로인지 확인하고, macOS는 Step 15의 "Mac" 단계(suite `evidence`)가 열린 메뉴 PNG를 받는다.

#### 제안 판정 (Q-20 … Q-29)

뼈대의 사전 판정(P-2·P-3·P-4·P-11·P-12·P-18)은 그대로 따른다. 아래는 코드와 어긋나거나 뼈대가 정하지 않아 여기서 정해야 했던 곳이다.

1. **Q-20 (P-4 보강: 자료 대상은 `kind: 'item'`이 붙은 새 객체다 — 렌더러 `targetsOf`는 대상 전체를 받는다).** `LibraryItem`에는 `kind` 필드가 없어서(`freshTargets`가 `LibraryItem[]`을 그대로 돌려주던 것) 합집합의 자료 변형에 그대로 맞지 않는다. 제안: ① 도메인에 `itemTarget(item) → ItemTargetInfo`(`kind`를 붙여 새 객체) 도우미, ② 렌더러 `CommandEnv.targetsOf`의 서명을 `(itemIds)`에서 `(target: CommandTarget)`으로 — 컬렉션·태그 대상도 한 곳에서 만든다(`R/commands/targets.ts`), ③ 규칙은 대상을 종류별로 가른 `Targets { items; collections; tags }`를 받고, 가르기는 배열 객체 하나당 한 번(`WeakMap`)이다. `selectionTargets`(메뉴 막대의 합성 대상)는 처음부터 갈라진 채로 등록해 100만 개 선택에서 한 번 더 도는 비용이 없다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 자료 대상을 `kind` 없는 모양으로 되돌리면 `isItemTarget` 판별이 `kind === undefined`가 되어 합집합이 느슨해진다(작음).
2. **Q-21 (메뉴 막대의 정렬 열 목록은 새 맥락 필드 `columnsShown`으로 안다).** 뼈대의 맥락 필드(`sortColumn`·`sortDirection` …)에는 "지금 보이는 열"이 없다. main이 도메인 카탈로그의 정렬 가능 열 전부를 그리고 렌더러의 보이는 집합을 모르면 보이지 않는 열이 라디오로 나와 "보이는 정렬 가능 열의 라디오 목록"(명세 5.2)이 깨진다. 제안: 평평한 필드 `columnsShown: number`(`LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS` 순서의 비트 마스크, 최대 2^열수−1 — `tagPositions`와 같은 방식)를 `CommandContextState`·`commandContextInput`(`.strict()`)에 더한다. 값은 **실제로 그려지는 열**(`visibleColumns(columns, forced)`, 최근 연 자료 보기의 강제 열 포함)이다. 숨긴 열로 정렬된 상태(예: 크기로 정렬하고 크기 열을 숨김)에서도 체크된 줄이 사라지지 않게, main은 현재 정렬 열을 보이는 열에 더해 그린다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 필드 하나를 빼고 카탈로그 전체를 그리면 된다(보이지 않는 열이 나온다).
3. **Q-22 (`library.sortBy`의 규칙·팔레트·열 고르기 방향).** (a) 명세 9.3은 켜지는 조건을 "라이브러리 보기"로만 적었는데, 빈 라이브러리에는 표가 없다(첫 실행 화면). 규칙 `libraryCount > 0`을 더한다(`view.toggleInspector`와 같다). (b) 값이 없으면 아무것도 못 하는 명령이 팔레트에 나오면 가짜 컨트롤이므로 `palette: false`, 그리고 불변식 `submenuProblems`가 "값 하위 메뉴 명령은 팔레트에 없다"를 지킨다. (c) 열을 라디오로 고르면 **방향은 그대로**다(머리 누르기의 `firstDirection`이 아니라) — 열 목록과 방향 목록이 독립된 두 라디오 묶음이기 때문이다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 처리기의 순수 함수 `sortFromArgs` 한 곳.
4. **Q-23 (메뉴 막대의 값 하위 메뉴는 "모양"이 바뀌면 다시 만들고, 켜짐·꺼짐은 그대로 제자리에서 바꾼다).** 지금 코드의 약속("라벨·가속기는 런타임에 안 바뀐다, 맥락 보고는 `enabled`만 제자리에서 바꾼다")은 정렬 라디오의 줄 구성(보이는 열)과 체크, 컬렉션·태그 하위 메뉴(DB에서 읽음)에는 맞지 않는다. 제안: `submenuShapeKey(ctx)`(정렬 열·방향·`columnsShown`)가 바뀌면 `createMenuRebuilder`로 메뉴를 다시 만든다 — 100ms 디바운스, 네이티브 메뉴가 열려 있는 동안(`nativeMenu { open }`)은 닫힐 때까지 미루고, 닫힌 뒤에도 100ms 더 기다린다(AppKit은 `menuDidClose` 다음에 항목의 동작을 보내므로 닫히는 순간 메뉴를 바꾸면 고른 줄의 `click`이 사라질 수 있다). 컬렉션·태그 알림(`libraryChanged` 이유 `collections`·`tags`)도 같은 장치를 쓰되, **메뉴 막대에 DB 하위 메뉴가 하나라도 있을 때만** 요청한다(`menuNeedsOrganize`; 이 작업의 레지스트리에서는 거짓이라 스냅샷을 읽지 않는다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 정렬 체크를 제자리에서 바꾸는 `applyMenuChecks`를 따로 쓰면 되지만, 보이는 열이 바뀔 때는 어차피 다시 만들어야 한다.
5. **Q-24 (메뉴 줄 id 규칙).** 값이 붙은 줄은 `<명령 id>?<키=값&…>`(`menuItemId`, 키 정렬 — 예 `library.sortBy?column=year`), 묶음 하위 메뉴의 머리는 `submenu.<id>`다. 값 하위 메뉴의 머리 줄은 명령 id 그대로다(`getMenuItemById('library.sortBy')`가 머리를 돌려주고, `applyMenuEnabled`가 그것만 바꾼다). E2E 도우미 `runMenuCommand(app, id, args?)`와 `stubContextMenu`의 경로 고르기가 이 규칙을 쓴다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 도우미와 테스트의 문자열.
6. **Q-25 (묶음 하위 메뉴의 구성원은 자기 배치가 없다).** `SUBMENUS`의 구성원 명령이 `menu`·`contextMenu`도 가지면 같은 줄이 두 번 나온다. 불변식 `submenuProblems(commands, submenus)`(도메인, 순수)가 구성원에 자기 배치가 있거나, 두 묶음에 있거나, 없는 명령이거나, 배치가 없는 묶음·값 하위 메뉴, 공급자가 만들 수 없는 곳(`tagColors`는 태그 메뉴 전용 …)을 문장으로 돌려주고, 실제 레지스트리는 `[]`이어야 하며 시험 레지스트리의 잘못된 변형은 각 문장을 돌려줘야 한다. `availableMenuCommands`는 메뉴 막대에 놓이는 묶음의 구성원도 센다(`tag.color1`이 메뉴 막대에서 켜짐 판정을 받는다).
7. **Q-26 (`LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS`를 `settings.ts`에서 `library-columns.ts`로 옮긴다).** `CommandArgs.column`의 형(`LibrarySortColumn`)이 `commands.ts`에 필요한데 `settings.ts`는 `commands.ts`를 import한다(`COMMAND_IDS`) — 순환이다. 상수와 형을 순수 모듈 `library-columns.ts`로 옮기고(`settings.ts`는 거기서 import), `index.ts`의 `export *`로 `@learn/domain`에서 그대로 보인다. 렌더러의 `sort.ts`가 로컬로 정의하던 `LibrarySortColumn`은 도메인 것을 다시 내보낸다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 없음(이름·값 그대로).
8. **Q-27 (대상 종류에 명령이 없으면 데이터베이스를 읽기 전에 돌려보낸다).** `ui:showContextMenu`의 `collection`·`tag`는 레지스트리의 어떤 명령도 그 종류에 놓이지 않은 동안 `null`이다(`kindHasMenu`). 그 앞에서 스냅샷을 읽거나 대상을 검증하지 않는다. 자료 메뉴도 스냅샷(컬렉션 트리·붙임)을 `menuNeedsOrganize(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS, 'item')`일 때만 읽는다 — 이 작업에서는 둘 다 읽지 않는다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 없음.
9. **Q-28 (사용자 이름의 `&`는 메뉴 글자에서 두 번 쓴다).** Windows·Linux의 네이티브 메뉴는 `&`를 니모닉 표시로 먹는다. "R&D" 컬렉션이 "RD"에 밑줄로 나오지 않게 `menuText(name)`이 `&`를 `&&`로 바꾼다(macOS의 Chromium 메뉴도 `&&`를 `&`로 풀어 그린다). 컬렉션 하위 메뉴·색 태그 줄·색 지정 줄의 "— <다른 태그 이름>"에 적용한다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 한 함수.
10. **Q-29 (⇧F10과 메뉴 키는 keydown에서 직접 열고 echo를 막는다).** Chromium은 Linux에서 keydown 기본 동작으로, Windows에서는 keyup으로 `contextmenu`를 만든다 — 키를 직접 처리하지 않으면 메뉴 위치가 포커스된 행의 왼쪽 위 모서리 근처로 정해지고 플랫폼마다 달라진다. 표는 keydown에서 `preventDefault()`하고 행 아래(`menuPointFor`)에 직접 열며, 500ms 안에 오는 `contextmenu`는 echo로 보고 무시한다(같은 메뉴가 두 번 뜨지 않게). macOS에는 메뉴 키가 없고 ⇧F10은 우리가 처리하므로 같은 길이다. 머리 행의 열 메뉴는 이 작업이 건드리지 않는다(브라우저 기본 동작 그대로). 틀렸을 때 비용: 키 처리 몇 줄.
