`D/library-columns.ts` — 4행(`export type LibraryColumnId = …;`) 다음에 더한다:
```ts

/** Sortable fields. `progress` has no column until M7; the rest are LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS (spec §3.1). It lives here, not in settings.ts: command arguments need the type and settings.ts imports the command registry. */
export const LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS = ['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt', 'openedAt', 'progress', 'updatedAt', 'storageMode', 'size', 'originalName'] as const;
export type LibrarySortColumn = (typeof LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS)[number];

/** The columns shown, as a bitmask over LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS (bit i = the i-th id): the reported command context carries no arrays. */
export function columnsMask(ids: Iterable<LibraryColumnId>): number {
  let mask = 0;
  for (const id of ids) {
    const i = LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS.indexOf(id);
    if (i >= 0) mask |= 1 << i;
  }
  return mask;
}

/** The ids a mask names, in catalogue order; a bit past the catalogue names nothing. */
export const columnsOfMask = (mask: number): LibraryColumnId[] => LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS.filter((_, i) => (mask & (1 << i)) !== 0);
```
`D/settings.ts` — 4행 `import { COLUMN_WIDTH_MAX } from './library-columns';`를 `import { COLUMN_WIDTH_MAX, LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS } from './library-columns';`로 바꾸고 6–7행
```ts
/** Sortable fields. openedAt / progress have no column until M7; the rest are LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS (spec §3.1). */
export const LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS = ['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt', 'openedAt', 'progress', 'updatedAt', 'storageMode', 'size', 'originalName'] as const;
```

```ts
  it('is 정렬 기준 ▸ in 보기, a value submenu of the shown columns, with no key and no palette entry', () => {
    const c = commandById('library.sortBy');
    expect(c).toMatchObject({ label: '정렬 기준', menu: { menu: 'view', group: 2, order: 3 }, contexts: ['library'], submenu: 'sortColumns', palette: false });
    expect(c.accelerator).toBeUndefined();
    expect(c.key).toBeUndefined();
    expect(inPalette(c)).toBe(false); // a palette run would carry no column: a fake control
  });
  it('runs in the library view while the library has items, never in the reader, an empty library or a blocked window', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('library.sortBy', LIB)).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('library.sortBy', { ...LIB, libraryCount: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('library.sortBy', { ...LIB, view: 'viewer' })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('library.sortBy', { ...LIB, blocked: true })).toBe(false);
    expect(availableMenuCommands(LIB)).toContain('library.sortBy');
    expect(availableMenuCommands({ ...LIB, libraryCount: 0 })).not.toContain('library.sortBy');
  });
});

describe('a value names a menu row (Q-24)', () => {
  it('sorts the keys, leaves out undefined values and gives a command without a value its own id', () => {
    expect(argsKey({ direction: 'asc', column: 'year' })).toBe('column=year&direction=asc');
    expect(argsKey({ collectionId: 'c1', column: undefined })).toBe('collectionId=c1');
    expect(argsKey({ addSelection: true })).toBe('addSelection=true');
    expect(menuItemId('library.sortBy', { direction: 'asc', column: 'year' })).toBe('library.sortBy?column=year&direction=asc');
    expect(menuItemId('library.sortBy')).toBe('library.sortBy');
    expect(menuItemId('library.sortBy', {})).toBe('library.sortBy');
  });
});

describe('submenu invariants (P-3, Q-25)', () => {
  it('the real registry has none to check: no grouped submenu before its commands exist, and its value submenus are placed and kept out of the palette', () => {
    expect(SUBMENUS).toEqual([]);
    expect(submenuProblems(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS)).toEqual([]);
    for (const c of COMMANDS.filter((x) => x.submenu !== undefined)) expect(inPalette(c), c.id).toBe(false);
  });
  it('accepts a group whose members are commands of their own with no placement', () => {
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [group()])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('names each way a group goes wrong', () => {
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [group({ commands: ['tag.color1', 'tag.color9' as CommandId] })])).toEqual(['colorTags: tag.color9 is not a command']);
    expect(submenuProblems([{ ...members[0]!, menu: { menu: 'file', group: 2, order: 1 } }, members[1]!], [group()])).toEqual(['tag.color1: a member of colorTags with a placement of its own']);
    expect(submenuProblems([{ ...members[0]!, contextMenu: { kinds: ['item'], group: 1, order: 1 } }, members[1]!], [group()])).toEqual(['tag.color1: a member of colorTags with a placement of its own']);
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [group(), group()])).toEqual(['colorTags: listed twice', 'tag.color1: in two submenus', 'tag.color2: in two submenus']);
    const bare: SubmenuSpec = { id: 'colorTags', label: '색 태그', commands: members.map((m) => m.id) };
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [bare])).toEqual(['colorTags: no placement']);
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [group({ label: 'colors' })])).toEqual(['colorTags: the label is not Korean']);
    expect(submenuProblems(members, [group({ commands: [] })])).toEqual(['colorTags: no members']);
    expect(submenuProblems([...members, cmd('x.sort', { submenu: 'sortColumns', menu: { menu: 'view', group: 2, order: 9 } })], [group()])).toEqual([
      'x.sort: a value submenu listed in the palette (a palette run carries no value)',
    ]);
  });
  it('names each way a value submenu goes wrong: no placement, a menu its rows cannot fill', () => {
    const quiet = { palette: false } as const;
    expect(submenuProblems([cmd('x.sort', { submenu: 'sortColumns', ...quiet })], [])).toEqual(['x.sort: a value submenu with no placement']);
    expect(submenuProblems([cmd('x.sort', { submenu: 'sortColumns', ...quiet, contextMenu: { kinds: ['item'], group: 1, order: 1 } })], [])).toEqual(['x.sort: sortColumns does not build an item menu']);
    expect(submenuProblems([cmd('x.colors', { submenu: 'tagColors', ...quiet, menu: { menu: 'file', group: 1, order: 1 } })], [])).toEqual(['x.colors: tagColors has no menu-bar form']);
    expect(submenuProblems([cmd('x.add', { submenu: 'collections', ...quiet, menu: { menu: 'file', group: 1, order: 1 }, contextMenu: { kinds: ['item', 'collection'], group: 1, order: 1 } })], [])).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('a menu-bar group counts its members in the menu bar judgement (they carry no placement of their own)', () => {
    const one: CommandContextState = { ...LIB, selectionCount: 1, selectionAvailable: 1 };
    expect(availableMenuCommands(one, members, [])).toEqual([]); // no group on the menu bar: members are no menu items
    expect(availableMenuCommands(one, members, [group()])).toEqual(['tag.color1', 'tag.color2']);
    expect(availableMenuCommands(LIB, members, [group()])).toEqual([]); // nothing selected: item commands are off
    expect(availableMenuCommands(one, members, [group({ menu: undefined })])).toEqual([]); // a context-menu-only group
  });
});

describe('target kinds (P-4)', () => {
  it('the item rules read the item targets and no others', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.open', LIB, [COLLECTION])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.open', LIB, [FILE, COLLECTION, TAG])).toBe(true); // one item among the targets
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.open', LIB, [FILE, FILE, TAG])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.exportCopy', LIB, [TAG, FILE])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('item.relink', LIB, [{ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'linked', availability: 'missing' }, COLLECTION])).toBe(true);
  });
  it('a collection or tag command needs a target of its kind, and is not in the palette by default', () => {
    const rename = cmd('collection.rename', { contexts: ['collection'] });
    const recolor = cmd('tag.clearColor', { contexts: ['tag'] });
    expect(commandAvailable(rename, LIB, [COLLECTION])).toBe(true);
    expect(commandAvailable(rename, LIB, [])).toBe(false);
    expect(commandAvailable(rename, LIB, [TAG, FILE])).toBe(false);
    expect(commandAvailable(recolor, LIB, [TAG])).toBe(true);
    expect(commandAvailable(recolor, LIB, [COLLECTION])).toBe(false);
    expect(commandAvailable(rename, { ...LIB, blocked: true }, [COLLECTION])).toBe(false);
    expect(inPalette(rename)).toBe(false);
    expect(inPalette({ ...rename, palette: true })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('copies only the availability facts of an item', () => {
    expect(itemTarget({ storageMode: 'linked', availability: 'missing', title: '제목' } as never)).toEqual({ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'linked', availability: 'missing' });
  });
});

describe('the view fields of a context (spec 9.4)', () => {
  it('starts as the default library view: all, no collections or tags, the default sort and the five default columns (frozen)', () => {
    expect(NO_LIBRARY_VIEW).toMatchObject({ scope: 'all', collectionCount: 0, tagPositions: 0, tagFilterCount: 0, searchActive: false, sortColumn: 'createdAt', sortDirection: 'desc' });
    expect(columnsOfMask(NO_LIBRARY_VIEW.columnsShown)).toEqual(DEFAULT_COLUMN_CONFIG.visible);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(NO_LIBRARY_VIEW)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('keeps the colour slots in use as a bitmask: bit n−1 for slot n; null and slots outside 1–8 count for nothing', () => {
    expect(tagPositionsMask([])).toBe(0);
    expect(tagPositionsMask([1, 3, null, 9, 0])).toBe(0b101);
    expect(tagPositionsMask([8])).toBe(0b10000000);
    expect(hasTagPosition(0b101, 1)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasTagPosition(0b101, 2)).toBe(false);
    expect(hasTagPosition(0b101, 3)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasTagPosition(0b101, 9)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(commandContextInput.parse(ctx)).toEqual(ctx);
```

③ 36행 `export type ContextMenuKind = (typeof CONTEXT_MENU_KINDS)[number];` 바로 뒤에 더한다:
```ts

/**
 * The value a menu row gives a command beyond its target (spec 9.1): a value submenu is one command with a row per
 * value, and the row's value travels with the pick to the handler as `target.args`.
 */
export interface CommandArgs {
  /** collection.addItems: the collection to file the selection into. */
  collectionId?: string;
  /** tag.setColor: the colour slot 1–8 (colour N = slot N = key N). */
  position?: number;
  /** library.sortBy: the column and/or the direction. */
  column?: LibrarySortColumn;
  direction?: 'asc' | 'desc';
  /** collection.addItems without a collectionId: a new collection that takes the selection. */
  addSelection?: true;
}
/** What a native menu answers, and what a menu-bar click sends the renderer. */
export interface PickedCommand {
  commandId: CommandId;
  args?: CommandArgs;
}

/** `k=v` pairs, keys sorted: one name for a value, so a menu item's id and a test name a row the same way. */
export const argsKey = (args: CommandArgs): string =>
  Object.entries(args)
    .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined)
    .sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))
    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${String(v)}`)
    .join('&');
/** The id of a menu item: the command's, with its value when the row carries one (`library.sortBy?column=year`). */
export const menuItemId = (id: CommandId, args?: CommandArgs): string => {
  const key = args ? argsKey(args) : '';
  return key === '' ? id : `${id}?${key}`;
};

/** Where a value submenu's rows come from: main builds them from the library (collections, colours) or the reported context (columns). */
export type SubmenuSource = 'collections' | 'tagColors' | 'sortColumns';
/** Which menus each source can fill: `submenuProblems` checks a command's placement against it. */
export const SUBMENU_SOURCES: Readonly<Record<SubmenuSource, { menuBar: boolean; contextKinds: readonly ContextMenuKind[] }>> = {
  collections: { menuBar: true, contextKinds: ['item', 'collection'] },
  tagColors: { menuBar: false, contextKinds: ['tag'] },
  sortColumns: { menuBar: true, contextKinds: [] },
};
```

⑦ 191행 `export const MAIN_OWNED_COMMANDS …;` 다음에 더한다:
```ts

/**
 * Commands grouped into one submenu (spec 9.1, P-3): "색 태그 ▸" lists `tag.color1`–`tag.color8`. The members stay commands
 * of their own (the key map, the ⌘/ sheet and the palette need each one), so they carry no placement; the group does.
 * Empty until the first handler for a member exists (a row without a handler cannot exist).
 */
export interface SubmenuSpec {
  id: 'colorTags';
  /** Korean, as the menu shows it. */
  label: string;
  /** The members, in menu order. */
  commands: readonly CommandId[];
  menu?: { menu: MenuName; group: number; order: number };
  contextMenu?: { kinds: readonly ContextMenuKind[]; group: number; order: number };
}
export const SUBMENUS: readonly SubmenuSpec[] = [];

/** What is wrong with the submenus of a registry (empty: nothing). The real registry must give []. */
export function submenuProblems(commands: readonly CommandSpec[], submenus: readonly SubmenuSpec[]): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  const byId = new Map(commands.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  for (const c of commands) {
    if (c.submenu === undefined) continue;
    const source = SUBMENU_SOURCES[c.submenu];
    if (!c.menu && !c.contextMenu) problems.push(`${c.id}: a value submenu with no placement`);
    if (inPalette(c)) problems.push(`${c.id}: a value submenu listed in the palette (a palette run carries no value)`);
    if (c.menu && !source.menuBar) problems.push(`${c.id}: ${c.submenu} has no menu-bar form`);
    for (const kind of c.contextMenu?.kinds ?? []) if (!source.contextKinds.includes(kind)) problems.push(`${c.id}: ${c.submenu} does not build a${kind === 'item' ? 'n' : ''} ${kind} menu`);
  }
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const members = new Set<CommandId>();
  for (const s of submenus) {
    if (seen.has(s.id)) problems.push(`${s.id}: listed twice`);
    seen.add(s.id);
    if (!s.menu && !s.contextMenu) problems.push(`${s.id}: no placement`);
    if (!/[가-힣]/.test(s.label)) problems.push(`${s.id}: the label is not Korean`);
    if (s.commands.length === 0) problems.push(`${s.id}: no members`);
    for (const id of s.commands) {
      const c = byId.get(id);
      if (!c) {
        problems.push(`${s.id}: ${id} is not a command`);
        continue;
      }
      if (members.has(id)) problems.push(`${id}: in two submenus`);
      members.add(id);
      if (c.menu || c.contextMenu) problems.push(`${id}: a member of ${s.id} with a placement of its own`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}
```
(`does not build a… menu` 문장은 `does not build an item menu`/`a collection menu`/`a tag menu` — 영어 관사 처리가 번거로우면 테스트가 쓰는 `an item menu` 하나만 맞으면 된다. 위 삼항이 그것을 낸다.)

⑧ 193–212행의 `CommandContextState` 끝, `selectionRelinkable: number;` 줄 뒤에 더하고 인터페이스 다음에 상수·도우미를 더한다:
```ts
  /** The kind of view the table shows (spec 3.1). */
  scope: LibraryScope['kind'];
  /** Live collections (0: nothing to file into). */
  collectionCount: number;
  /** The colour slots 1–8 that have a tag, bit n−1 for slot n (0–255): the 1–8 keys and the palette need to know. */
  tagPositions: number;
  /** Tags in the sidebar's filter. */
  tagFilterCount: number;
  /** The quick search has a query. */
  searchActive: boolean;
  /** The sort of the view shown (the recent view has its own) and the columns drawn, for 보기 › 정렬 기준 (spec 5.2). */
  sortColumn: LibrarySortColumn;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
  /** The columns drawn, forced ones included: a bitmask over LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS (columnsMask). */
  columnsShown: number;
}

/** The view fields of a context with no library view yet: the first report, the fatal screen, a test's fixture. */
export const NO_LIBRARY_VIEW = Object.freeze({
  scope: 'all',
  collectionCount: 0,
  tagPositions: 0,
  tagFilterCount: 0,
  searchActive: false,
  sortColumn: 'createdAt',
  sortDirection: 'desc',
  columnsShown: columnsMask(DEFAULT_COLUMN_CONFIG.visible),
} as const satisfies Pick<CommandContextState, 'scope' | 'collectionCount' | 'tagPositions' | 'tagFilterCount' | 'searchActive' | 'sortColumn' | 'sortDirection' | 'columnsShown'>);

/** The colour slots with a tag as a bitmask (bit n−1 = slot n); `null` and slots outside 1–8 count for nothing. */
export function tagPositionsMask(positions: Iterable<number | null>): number {
  let mask = 0;
  for (const p of positions) if (p !== null && p >= 1 && p <= 8) mask |= 1 << (p - 1);
  return mask;
}
export const hasTagPosition = (mask: number, position: number): boolean => position >= 1 && position <= 8 && (mask & (1 << (position - 1))) !== 0;
```
(원래의 `}` 한 줄 — 인터페이스를 닫는 211행의 다음 줄 — 이 위 코드의 첫 `}`로 바뀐다. 즉 `selectionRelinkable: number;` 와 `}` 사이에 필드들을 넣는다.)

⑨ 220–290행(`/** A command target, as far as availability goes …` 부터 파일 끝까지)을 다음으로 **통째로** 바꾼다:
```ts
/** An item as a command target, as far as availability goes (fresh from disk in main's context menus). */
export interface ItemTargetInfo {
  kind: 'item';
  storageMode: StorageMode;
  availability: Availability;
}
export interface CollectionTargetInfo {
  kind: 'collection';
  id: string;
}
/** `hasColor`: 색 해제 needs a colour to clear. */
export interface TagTargetInfo {
  kind: 'tag';
  id: string;
  hasColor: boolean;
}
/** What a command acts on, by kind: the item rules read the item ones only. */
export type CommandTargetInfo = ItemTargetInfo | CollectionTargetInfo | TagTargetInfo;

/** The availability facts of an item (a list row, a freshly read item) as a target. */
export const itemTarget = (item: { storageMode: StorageMode; availability: Availability }): ItemTargetInfo => ({
  kind: 'item',
  storageMode: item.storageMode,
  availability: item.availability,
});

/**
 * What only the renderer knows, beside the reported context (never reported, so main's `blocked` stays as it is).
 * `modal`: a modal surface owns the keyboard — a sheet, the ⌘K palette, the drop overlay. `blocked` without it is work
 * in progress (an import), which stops every command but focus movement (`duringWork`).
 */
export interface CommandSurface {
  modal: boolean;
}

const AVAILABLE: ItemTargetInfo = Object.freeze({ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' });
const RELINKABLE: ItemTargetInfo = Object.freeze({ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'linked', availability: 'missing' });
const MISSING: ItemTargetInfo = Object.freeze({ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'missing' });

/** Targets by kind: a rule reads the kind it is about. A split array is never changed afterwards. */
export interface Targets {
  items: readonly ItemTargetInfo[];
  collections: readonly CollectionTargetInfo[];
  tags: readonly TagTargetInfo[];
}
const NO_TARGETS: Targets = Object.freeze({ items: [], collections: [], tags: [] });
/** One split per array: the menu bar judges every command on the same selection array. */
const split = new WeakMap<readonly CommandTargetInfo[], Targets>();
function targetsByKind(targets: readonly CommandTargetInfo[]): Targets {
  if (targets.length === 0) return NO_TARGETS;
  let found = split.get(targets);
  if (!found) {
    const items: ItemTargetInfo[] = [];
    const collections: CollectionTargetInfo[] = [];
    const tags: TagTargetInfo[] = [];
    for (const t of targets) {
      if (t.kind === 'item') items.push(t);
      else if (t.kind === 'collection') collections.push(t);
      else tags.push(t);
    }
    found = { items, collections, tags };
    split.set(targets, found);
  }
  return found;
}

/**
 * Synthetic targets for the menu bar: `selectionAvailable` available, then `selectionRelinkable` linked+missing, the
 * rest managed+missing. Main has only the reported counts; no rule reads the storage mode of an available target.
 * Counts that do not add up are clamped to `selectionCount`.
 */
export function selectionTargets(ctx: CommandContextState): ItemTargetInfo[] {
  const available = Math.min(ctx.selectionAvailable, ctx.selectionCount);
  const relinkable = Math.min(ctx.selectionRelinkable, ctx.selectionCount - available);
  const targets = Array.from({ length: ctx.selectionCount }, (_, i) => (i < available ? AVAILABLE : i < available + relinkable ? RELINKABLE : MISSING));
  split.set(targets, { items: targets, collections: [], tags: [] }); // items only: no pass over a selection of the whole library
  return targets;
}

type Rule = (ctx: CommandContextState, targets: Targets) => boolean;
const RULES: Partial<Record<CommandId, Rule>> = {
  'library.find': (c) => c.libraryCount > 0,
  // An empty library has no panel (design-spec 2.4).
  'view.toggleInspector': (c) => c.libraryCount > 0,
  // The sort acts on the table, which the empty library does not have (its first-run screen replaces it).
  'library.sortBy': (c) => c.libraryCount > 0,
  // Any availability: for a missing file the reader shows its 원본 없음 notice, which is where 다시 연결… lives.
  'item.open': (_ctx, t) => t.items.length === 1,
  'item.relink': (_ctx, t) => t.items.length === 1 && t.items[0]!.storageMode === 'linked' && t.items[0]!.availability === 'missing',
  'item.showInFolder': (_ctx, t) => t.items.length === 1 && t.items[0]!.availability === 'available',
  'item.openExternally': (_ctx, t) => t.items.length === 1 && t.items[0]!.availability === 'available',
  'item.exportCopy': (_ctx, t) => t.items.length === 1 && t.items[0]!.availability === 'available',
  'item.editInfo': (c, t) => t.items.length === 1 && c.view === 'library',
  'view.textBigger': (c) => c.textSize < 15,
  'view.textSmaller': (c) => c.textSize > 12,
  'view.textReset': (c) => c.textSize !== 13,
};

/**
 * The single availability predicate, for a spec: main (menu bar, context menus) and the renderer (palette, toolbar, keymap).
 * `surface` is the renderer's: with it, a `duringWork` command is stopped by a modal surface only; without it (main),
 * by `blocked` like every other command. A command that lists `item`, `collection` or `tag` needs a target of that kind.
 */
export function commandAvailable(spec: CommandSpec, ctx: CommandContextState, targets: readonly CommandTargetInfo[] = [], surface?: CommandSurface): boolean {
  if (MAIN_OWNED_COMMANDS.has(spec.id)) return true;
  if ((spec.duringWork && surface !== undefined) ? surface.modal : ctx.blocked) return false;
  const t = targetsByKind(targets);
  const needed = spec.contexts.includes('item') ? t.items : spec.contexts.includes('collection') ? t.collections : spec.contexts.includes('tag') ? t.tags : null;
  const inContext = needed ? needed.length > 0 : spec.contexts.includes('app') || spec.contexts.includes(ctx.view);
  return inContext && (RULES[spec.id]?.(ctx, t) ?? true);
}

/** `commandAvailable` for a registry command by id. */
export function isCommandAvailable(id: CommandId, ctx: CommandContextState, targets: readonly CommandTargetInfo[] = [], surface?: CommandSurface): boolean {
  const spec = COMMANDS.find((c) => c.id === id);
  return spec !== undefined && commandAvailable(spec, ctx, targets, surface);
}

/**
 * Menu-bar commands available in `ctx`: the placed ones, and the members of a group that is placed (they carry no
 * placement of their own). An item command is judged on the selection's synthetic targets (selectionTargets), in the
 * library view only: the renderer runs it on the selected items. `commands` and `submenus` are the registry; tests pass
 * variants (availability is the same predicate).
 */
export function availableMenuCommands(ctx: CommandContextState, commands: readonly CommandSpec[] = COMMANDS, submenus: readonly SubmenuSpec[] = SUBMENUS): CommandId[] {
  // Spec 6: the menu bar's item commands act on the library table's selection, so the reader has none.
  const targets = ctx.view === 'library' ? selectionTargets(ctx) : [];
  const grouped = new Set<CommandId>(submenus.flatMap((s) => (s.menu ? s.commands : [])));
  return commands.filter((c) => (c.menu !== undefined || grouped.has(c.id)) && commandAvailable(c, ctx, targets)).map((c) => c.id);
}
```

```ts
import type { MenuItemConstructorOptions } from 'electron';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { CommandId } from '@learn/domain';
import { entriesToTemplate, entryItemId, isSubmenu, type MenuEntries } from './entries';

const id = (s: string) => s as CommandId;
/** Electron calls click(menuItem, window, event); the menuItem carries the template's `enabled`. */
const click = (t: MenuItemConstructorOptions) => t.click!({ enabled: t.enabled ?? true } as never, undefined, {} as never);

const ENTRIES: MenuEntries = [
  { id: id('library.sortBy'), label: '연도', enabled: true, args: { column: 'year' }, type: 'radio', checked: true },
  { id: id('library.sortBy'), label: '오름차순', enabled: false, args: { direction: 'asc' }, type: 'radio', checked: false },
  'separator',
  { id: 'submenu.colorTags', label: '색 태그', enabled: true, submenu: [{ id: id('tag.color1'), label: '중요', enabled: true, hint: '1', type: 'checkbox', checked: true }] },
  { label: '분자생물학', enabled: true, submenu: [{ id: id('collection.addItems'), label: '분자생물학', enabled: true, args: { collectionId: 'c1' } }] },
  { id: id('tag.setColor'), label: '3 초록', enabled: true, args: { position: 3 }, dot: '#5fb236' },
  { id: id('item.open'), label: '열기', enabled: true },
];

describe('menu entries as a native template', () => {
  it('names a row by its command and its value, and keeps only what the row carries', () => {
    const t = entriesToTemplate(ENTRIES, vi.fn(), { dotIcon: (hex) => `icon:${hex}` as never });
    expect(t).toEqual([
      { id: 'library.sortBy?column=year', label: '연도', enabled: true, type: 'radio', checked: true, click: expect.any(Function) },
      { id: 'library.sortBy?direction=asc', label: '오름차순', enabled: false, type: 'radio', checked: false, click: expect.any(Function) },
      { type: 'separator' },
      // A shortcut only shown: the renderer's key map owns the key, a registered accelerator would take it from a text field.
      {
        id: 'submenu.colorTags', label: '색 태그', enabled: true,
        submenu: [{ id: 'tag.color1', label: '중요', enabled: true, type: 'checkbox', checked: true, accelerator: '1', registerAccelerator: false, click: expect.any(Function) }],
      },
      { label: '분자생물학', enabled: true, submenu: [{ id: 'collection.addItems?collectionId=c1', label: '분자생물학', enabled: true, click: expect.any(Function) }] },
      { id: 'tag.setColor?position=3', label: '3 초록', enabled: true, icon: 'icon:#5fb236', click: expect.any(Function) },
      { id: 'item.open', label: '열기', enabled: true, click: expect.any(Function) },
    ]);
  });
  it('draws no icon when none can be made (the template stays free of the Electron runtime)', () => {
    expect(entriesToTemplate([ENTRIES[5]!], vi.fn())[0]).not.toHaveProperty('icon');
  });
  it('a click answers the command, with its value only when the row has one; a disabled row answers null', () => {
    const pick = vi.fn();
    const t = entriesToTemplate(ENTRIES, pick);
    click(t[0]!);
    click(t[6]!);
    click((t[3]!.submenu as MenuItemConstructorOptions[])[0]!);
    click((t[4]!.submenu as MenuItemConstructorOptions[])[0]!);
    click(t[1]!); // enabled: false
    expect(pick.mock.calls).toEqual([
      [{ commandId: 'library.sortBy', args: { column: 'year' } }],
      [{ commandId: 'item.open' }],
      [{ commandId: 'tag.color1' }],
      [{ commandId: 'collection.addItems', args: { collectionId: 'c1' } }],
      [null],
    ]);
    expect(pick.mock.calls[1]![0]).not.toHaveProperty('args');
  });
  it('tells a submenu from a command, and names a row the way menuItemId does', () => {
    expect(isSubmenu(ENTRIES[3] as never)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSubmenu(ENTRIES[0] as never)).toBe(false);
    expect(entryItemId({ id: id('library.sortBy'), label: '연도', enabled: true, args: { direction: 'asc', column: 'year' } })).toBe('library.sortBy?column=year&direction=asc');
  });
});
```

**`M/menu/submenus.test.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { COMMANDS, NO_LIBRARY_VIEW, columnsMask, type CommandContextState, type CommandId, type CommandSpec } from '@learn/domain';
import { isSubmenu, type CommandEntry, type MenuEntries } from './entries';
import { colorTagGroup, collectionRows, menuNeedsOrganize, menuText, sortColumnRows, tagColorRows, valueRows, type SubmenuInput } from './submenus';
import { ADD_TO_COLLECTION, COLOR_GROUP, FUTURE_COMMANDS, FUTURE_SUBMENUS, LIBRARY, SET_TAG_COLOR, organize } from './testing';

const CTX: CommandContextState = { view: 'library', blocked: false, textSize: 13, libraryCount: 9, selectionCount: 0, selectionAvailable: 0, selectionRelinkable: 0, ...NO_LIBRARY_VIEW };
const input = (over: Partial<SubmenuInput> = {}): SubmenuInput => ({ organize: LIBRARY, itemIds: [], context: CTX, enabledOf: () => true, ...over });
/** A menu as readable lines: "라벨" (✓ checked, ○ radio on, ✗ disabled), a submenu as { 라벨: [...] }. */
type Line = string | { [label: string]: Line[] };
const lines = (entries: MenuEntries): Line[] =>
  entries.map((e): Line => {
    if (e === 'separator') return '-';
    if (isSubmenu(e)) return { [`${e.label}${e.enabled ? '' : ' ✗'}`]: lines(e.submenu) };
    return `${e.label}${e.hint ? ` [${e.hint}]` : ''}${e.type === 'radio' && e.checked ? ' ○' : ''}${e.type === 'checkbox' && e.checked ? ' ✓' : ''}${e.enabled ? '' : ' ✗'}`;
  });
const rows = (entries: MenuEntries) => entries.filter((e): e is CommandEntry => e !== 'separator' && !isSubmenu(e));
const SORT = COMMANDS.find((c) => c.id === 'library.sortBy')!;
const NEW = '새\u00a0컬렉션';

describe('정렬 기준 ▸ (sortColumns)', () => {
  it('lists the shown columns in catalogue order, then the two directions; the sort in force is the radio that is on', () => {
    expect(lines(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, CTX, true))).toEqual(['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일 ○', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
  });
  it('carries the column or the direction as the row\'s value', () => {
    expect(rows(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, CTX, true)).map((r) => r.args)).toEqual([
      { column: 'title' }, { column: 'creators' }, { column: 'year' }, { column: 'type' }, { column: 'createdAt' }, { direction: 'asc' }, { direction: 'desc' },
    ]);
    expect(rows(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, CTX, true)).every((r) => r.id === 'library.sortBy' && r.type === 'radio')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('follows the columns drawn and the reported sort', () => {
    const ctx = { ...CTX, sortColumn: 'size' as const, sortDirection: 'asc' as const, columnsShown: columnsMask(['title', 'size', 'originalName']) };
    expect(lines(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, ctx, true))).toEqual(['제목', '크기 ○', '원래 이름', '-', '오름차순 ○', '내림차순']);
  });
  it('the title is always listed; a sort by a hidden column still shows its row, checked, so the menu never contradicts the table', () => {
    expect(lines(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, { ...CTX, columnsShown: 0, sortColumn: 'title' }, true))).toEqual(['제목 ○', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
    expect(lines(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, { ...CTX, columnsShown: columnsMask(['title']), sortColumn: 'updatedAt' }, true))).toEqual(['제목', '수정일 ○', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
    // progress has no column (M7): nothing is on, and nothing is invented.
    expect(lines(sortColumnRows(SORT.id, { ...CTX, sortColumn: 'progress' }, true))).toEqual(['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
  });
  it('is dispatched by the command\'s source, and every row is disabled with its command', () => {
    expect(lines(valueRows(SORT, input(), false))).toEqual(['제목 ✗', '저자 ✗', '연도 ✗', '종류 ✗', '추가일 ○ ✗', '-', '오름차순 ✗', '내림차순 ○ ✗']);
  });
});

describe('컬렉션에 추가 ▸ (collections)', () => {
  const rowsOf = (itemIds: readonly string[] = [], enabled = true) => collectionRows(ADD_TO_COLLECTION.id, LIBRARY, itemIds, enabled);
  it('is 새 컬렉션, a separator, then the tree by name (numbers by value); a collection with children is a submenu whose first row is itself', () => {
    expect(lines(rowsOf())).toEqual([
      NEW, '-',
      { 분자생물학: ['분자생물학', '-', '2장', '10장', '유전학'] },
      '시험',
    ]);
  });
  it('gives each row the collection (the first row, a new one for the selection)', () => {
    const [first, , tree] = rowsOf();
    expect((first as CommandEntry).args).toEqual({ addSelection: true });
    const parent = (tree as { submenu: MenuEntries }).submenu;
    expect(rows(parent).map((r) => r.args)).toEqual([{ collectionId: 'c-mb' }, { collectionId: 'c-2' }, { collectionId: 'c-10' }, { collectionId: 'c-gen' }]);
  });
  it('a collection that holds every selected item is checked and cannot be picked again; a partial one can', () => {
    expect(lines(rowsOf(['i1', 'i2']))).toEqual([
      NEW, '-',
      { 분자생물학: ['분자생물학 ✓ ✗', '-', '2장', '10장', '유전학'] },
      '시험',
    ]);
    expect(lines(rowsOf(['i1']))).toEqual([NEW, '-', { 분자생물학: ['분자생물학 ✓ ✗', '-', '2장', '10장', '유전학'] }, '시험 ✓ ✗']);
    expect(lines(rowsOf(['i1', 'i9']))[2]).toEqual({ 분자생물학: ['분자생물학', '-', '2장', '10장', '유전학'] }); // i9 is in none of them
  });
  it('is just 새 컬렉션 when there is none yet, and disabled with its command', () => {
    expect(lines(collectionRows(ADD_TO_COLLECTION.id, organize(), [], true))).toEqual([NEW]);
    expect(lines(rowsOf([], false))).toEqual([`${NEW} ✗`, '-', { '분자생물학 ✗': ['분자생물학 ✗', '-', '2장 ✗', '10장 ✗', '유전학 ✗'] }, '시험 ✗']);
  });
  it('doubles an ampersand in a name (Windows and Linux read it as a mnemonic)', () => {
    expect(menuText('R&D')).toBe('R&&D');
    const snap = organize({ collections: [{ id: 'c', name: 'R&D', parentId: null, createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }] });
    expect(lines(collectionRows(ADD_TO_COLLECTION.id, snap, [], true))).toEqual([NEW, '-', 'R&&D']);
  });
  it('lifts a collection whose parent is gone to the top, and sorts the roots by name', () => {
    const snap = organize({ collections: [
      { id: 'b', name: '나', parentId: 'gone', createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' },
      { id: 'a', name: '가', parentId: null, createdAt: '2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z' },
    ] });
    expect(lines(collectionRows(ADD_TO_COLLECTION.id, snap, [], true))).toEqual([NEW, '-', '가', '나']);
  });
  it('without the library read there is nothing to list', () => {
    expect(valueRows(ADD_TO_COLLECTION, input({ organize: null }), true)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('색 지정 ▸ (tagColors)', () => {
  it('lists the eight colours "N 이름" with a dot; the tag\'s own slot is on, and a slot another tag holds names that tag', () => {
    expect(lines(tagColorRows(SET_TAG_COLOR.id, LIBRARY, 't-key', true))).toEqual([
      '1 노랑 — 시험 범위', '2 빨강', '3 초록 ○', '4 파랑', '5 보라', '6 자홍', '7 주황', '8 회색',
    ]);
    expect(rows(tagColorRows(SET_TAG_COLOR.id, LIBRARY, 't-key', true)).map((r) => [r.args, r.dot])).toEqual([
      [{ position: 1 }, '#ffd400'], [{ position: 2 }, '#ff6666'], [{ position: 3 }, '#5fb236'], [{ position: 4 }, '#2ea8e5'],
      [{ position: 5 }, '#a28ae5'], [{ position: 6 }, '#e56eee'], [{ position: 7 }, '#f19837'], [{ position: 8 }, '#aaaaaa'],
    ]);
  });
  it('a tag without a colour has none on; a name keeps its ampersand doubled', () => {
    expect(lines(tagColorRows(SET_TAG_COLOR.id, LIBRARY, 't-plain', true))[2]).toBe('3 초록 — 중요');
    expect(lines(tagColorRows(SET_TAG_COLOR.id, LIBRARY, 't-plain', true)).some((l) => typeof l === 'string' && l.includes('○'))).toBe(false);
    const snap = organize({ tags: [{ id: 't', name: 'Q&A', color: 'red', position: 2 }, { id: 'u', name: '다른', color: null, position: null }] });
    expect(lines(tagColorRows(SET_TAG_COLOR.id, snap, 'u', true))[1]).toBe('2 빨강 — Q&&A');
  });
  it('needs the library and the tag', () => {
    expect(valueRows(SET_TAG_COLOR, input({ organize: null, tagId: 't-key' }), true)).toEqual([]);
    expect(valueRows(SET_TAG_COLOR, input(), true)).toEqual([]);
    expect(valueRows(SET_TAG_COLOR, input({ tagId: 't-key' }), true)).toHaveLength(8);
  });
});

describe('색 태그 ▸ (a group of commands)', () => {
  const group = (over: Partial<SubmenuInput> = {}) => colorTagGroup(COLOR_GROUP, FUTURE_COMMANDS, input(over));
  it('lists the colour tags in slot order by name, with the slot shown at the right and never registered; the rest of the slots are left out', () => {
    expect(lines([group()!])).toEqual([{ '색 태그': ['시험 범위 [1]', '중요 [3]'] }]);
    expect(rows(group()!.submenu).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(['tag.color1', 'tag.color3']);
    expect(group()!.id).toBe('submenu.colorTags');
  });
  it('marks a tag that every selected item has', () => {
    expect(lines([group({ itemIds: ['i1', 'i2'] })!])).toEqual([{ '색 태그': ['시험 범위 [1]', '중요 [3] ✓'] }]);
    expect(lines([group({ itemIds: ['i1'] })!])).toEqual([{ '색 태그': ['시험 범위 [1] ✓', '중요 [3] ✓'] }]);
    expect(lines([group({ itemIds: ['i2', 'i9', 'i-new'] })!])).toEqual([{ '색 태그': ['시험 범위 [1]', '중요 [3]'] }]); // i-new has no tag
  });
  it('each member is judged on its own, and the group is off when none can run', () => {
    const only3 = (c: CommandSpec) => c.id === ('tag.color3' as CommandId);
    expect(lines([group({ enabledOf: only3 })!])).toEqual([{ '색 태그': ['시험 범위 [1] ✗', '중요 [3]'] }]);
    expect(group({ enabledOf: () => false })!.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(group({ enabledOf: only3 })!.enabled).toBe(true);
  });
  it('is left out when no tag has a slot, when the library was not read, or when a member is not a command', () => {
    expect(group({ organize: organize({ tags: [{ id: 't', name: '복습', color: null, position: null }] }) })).toBeNull();
    expect(group({ organize: null })).toBeNull();
    expect(colorTagGroup(COLOR_GROUP, COMMANDS, input())).toBeNull(); // the real registry has none of the members yet
  });
});

describe('which menus read the library', () => {
  it('none of the real registry\'s do: nothing is read until a command that needs it exists', () => {
    for (const where of ['menu', 'item', 'collection', 'tag', 'column'] as const) expect(menuNeedsOrganize(COMMANDS, [], where), where).toBe(false);
  });
  it('a collections or colour source, or a group, makes the menu that holds it read the library', () => {
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize(FUTURE_COMMANDS, FUTURE_SUBMENUS, 'menu')).toBe(true);
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize(FUTURE_COMMANDS, FUTURE_SUBMENUS, 'item')).toBe(true);
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize(FUTURE_COMMANDS, FUTURE_SUBMENUS, 'tag')).toBe(true);
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize(FUTURE_COMMANDS, FUTURE_SUBMENUS, 'collection')).toBe(false);
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize(FUTURE_COMMANDS, [], 'menu')).toBe(true); // 컬렉션에 추가 ▸ is in 파일
    expect(menuNeedsOrganize([...COMMANDS, SET_TAG_COLOR], [], 'menu')).toBe(false); // the colours are the tag menu's only
  });
});
```

```ts
import { crc32, inflateSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DOT_POINTS, DOT_SCALE, dotPng } from './dot-png';

/** The chunks of a PNG, with whether each CRC holds. */
function chunks(png: Buffer): Array<{ type: string; data: Buffer; crcOk: boolean }> {
  expect(png.subarray(0, 8)).toEqual(Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]));
  const out: Array<{ type: string; data: Buffer; crcOk: boolean }> = [];
  for (let at = 8; at < png.length; ) {
    const length = png.readUInt32BE(at);
    const data = png.subarray(at + 8, at + 8 + length);
    out.push({ type: png.toString('ascii', at + 4, at + 8), data, crcOk: png.readUInt32BE(at + 8 + length) === crc32(png.subarray(at + 4, at + 8 + length)) });
    at += 12 + length;
  }
  return out;
}
/** RGBA of every pixel, from a PNG of filter-0 rows. */
function pixels(png: Buffer): { size: number; at(x: number, y: number): number[] } {
  const parts = chunks(png);
  const size = parts[0]!.data.readUInt32BE(0);
  const raw = inflateSync(Buffer.concat(parts.filter((c) => c.type === 'IDAT').map((c) => c.data)));
  const stride = 1 + size * 4;
  return { size, at: (x, y) => [...raw.subarray(y * stride + 1 + x * 4, y * stride + 1 + x * 4 + 4)] };
}

describe('a menu colour dot', () => {
  const png = dotPng('#5fb236');
  const px = pixels(png);
  it('is a valid 32 px RGBA PNG (16 pt at 2×): IHDR, IDAT, IEND with true checksums', () => {
    const parts = chunks(png);
    expect(parts.map((c) => c.type)).toEqual(['IHDR', 'IDAT', 'IEND']);
    expect(parts.every((c) => c.crcOk)).toBe(true);
    expect(DOT_POINTS * DOT_SCALE).toBe(32);
    expect([parts[0]!.data.readUInt32BE(0), parts[0]!.data.readUInt32BE(4), parts[0]!.data[8], parts[0]!.data[9]]).toEqual([32, 32, 8, 6]);
  });
  it('is a filled circle 8 pt across in the colour: opaque in the middle, clear at the corners, soft at the rim', () => {
    expect(px.at(16, 16)).toEqual([0x5f, 0xb2, 0x36, 255]);
    expect(px.at(0, 0)[3]).toBe(0);
    expect(px.at(31, 31)[3]).toBe(0);
    let area = 0;
    let soft = 0;
    for (let y = 0; y < 32; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < 32; x++) {
        const a = px.at(x, y)[3]!;
        area += a / 255;
        if (a > 0 && a < 255) soft++;
        expect(a, `mirrored at ${x},${y}`).toBe(px.at(31 - x, y)[3]); // the same left and right
      }
    }
    expect(soft).toBeGreaterThan(0); // anti-aliased
    expect(Math.abs(area - Math.PI * 8 * 8)).toBeLessThan(6); // radius 8 px
  });
  it('refuses anything but #rrggbb', () => {
    for (const bad of ['red', '#fff', '5fb236', '#5fb23g']) expect(() => dotPng(bad), bad).toThrow();
  });
});
```

**`M/menu/entries.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
import type { MenuItemConstructorOptions, NativeImage } from 'electron';
import { menuItemId, type CommandArgs, type CommandId, type PickedCommand } from '@learn/domain';

/** A row that runs a registry command, with a value when it is one row of a value submenu (spec 9.1). */
export interface CommandEntry {
  id: CommandId;
  label: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  args?: CommandArgs;
  /** 'radio': one of a set (정렬 기준); 'checkbox': a mark that may stand alone (색 태그 ✓, a collection that has the items). */
  type?: 'radio' | 'checkbox';
  checked?: boolean;
  /** A shortcut shown at the right edge and never registered ("1"…"8": the renderer's key map owns the key). */
  hint?: string;
  /** A colour dot (#rrggbb) before the label. */
  dot?: string;
}
/** A row that opens a submenu. It has no command of its own: the first row inside may be the thing itself. */
export interface SubmenuEntry {
  /** The menu item's id when something must find it (a group's head, to switch it in place). */
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  submenu: MenuEntries;
  dot?: string;
}
export type ContextEntry = CommandEntry | SubmenuEntry;
export type MenuEntries = ReadonlyArray<ContextEntry | 'separator'>;

export const isSubmenu = (entry: ContextEntry): entry is SubmenuEntry => 'submenu' in entry;
/** The menu item id of a command row (menuItemId: the command's, with its value). */
export const entryItemId = (entry: CommandEntry): string => menuItemId(entry.id, entry.args);

export interface TemplateOptions {
  /** The native image of a colour dot; injected so this module stays free of the Electron runtime. */
  dotIcon?: (hex: string) => NativeImage;
}

/**
 * The native menu template of some rows. A click answers the row's command and value through `pick`; a disabled row
 * answers null (a stubbed popup clicks without asking Electron whether the row is on).
 */
export function entriesToTemplate(entries: MenuEntries, pick: (picked: PickedCommand | null) => void, opts: TemplateOptions = {}): MenuItemConstructorOptions[] {
  return entries.map((entry): MenuItemConstructorOptions => {
    if (entry === 'separator') return { type: 'separator' };
    const icon = entry.dot !== undefined && opts.dotIcon ? { icon: opts.dotIcon(entry.dot) } : {};
    if (isSubmenu(entry)) {
      return { ...(entry.id ? { id: entry.id } : {}), label: entry.label, enabled: entry.enabled, submenu: entriesToTemplate(entry.submenu, pick, opts), ...icon };
    }
    const picked: PickedCommand = { commandId: entry.id, ...(entry.args ? { args: entry.args } : {}) };
    return {
      id: entryItemId(entry),
      label: entry.label,
      enabled: entry.enabled,
      ...(entry.type ? { type: entry.type, checked: entry.checked === true } : {}),
      ...(entry.hint ? { accelerator: entry.hint, registerAccelerator: false } : {}),
      ...icon,
      click: (item) => pick(item.enabled ? picked : null),
    };
  });
}
```

**`M/menu/submenus.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
import {
  LIBRARY_COLUMNS, TAG_COLORS, columnsOfMask,
  type CommandArgs, type CommandContextState, type CommandId, type CommandSpec, type ContextMenuKind, type OrganizeSnapshot, type SubmenuSource, type SubmenuSpec,
} from '@learn/domain';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import type { CommandEntry, ContextEntry, MenuEntries, SubmenuEntry } from './entries';

/** A user's name as a menu label: Windows and Linux read "&" as a mnemonic marker, so it is doubled (macOS drops the doubling). */
export const menuText = (name: string): string => name.replaceAll('&', '&&');

/** What the rows of a submenu are built from. */
export interface SubmenuInput {
  /** Collections, tags and who has what; null when the caller did not read them (the rows that need them are left out). */
  organize: OrganizeSnapshot | null;
  /** The items the menu acts on, for marks (empty in the menu bar: it marks nothing, spec 9.3). */
  itemIds: readonly string[];
  /** The tag a tag menu is for. */
  tagId?: string;
  /** The reported context: the sort and the columns drawn. */
  context: CommandContextState;
  /** Whether a command can run now: each member of a group is judged on its own. */
  enabledOf(command: CommandSpec): boolean;
}

/** 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸: the columns drawn (and the one in force, whatever it is), then the two directions, as radios. */
export function sortColumnRows(id: CommandId, state: Pick<CommandContextState, 'sortColumn' | 'sortDirection' | 'columnsShown'>, enabled: boolean): MenuEntries {
  const shown = new Set(columnsOfMask(state.columnsShown));
  const columns = LIBRARY_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.required === true || shown.has(c.id) || c.id === state.sortColumn);
  const radio = (label: string, args: CommandArgs, checked: boolean): CommandEntry => ({ id, label, enabled, args, type: 'radio', checked });
  return [
    ...columns.map((c) => radio(c.label, { column: c.id }, c.id === state.sortColumn)),
    'separator',
    radio(mainStrings.menu.sort.asc, { direction: 'asc' }, state.sortDirection === 'asc'),
    radio(mainStrings.menu.sort.desc, { direction: 'desc' }, state.sortDirection === 'desc'),
  ];
}

interface CollectionNode {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  children: CollectionNode[];
}
const collator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });

/** The live collections as a tree, siblings by name (numbers by value). A parent that is not live lifts the child to the top. */
function collectionTree(collections: OrganizeSnapshot['collections']): CollectionNode[] {
  const nodes = new Map(collections.map((c) => [c.id, { id: c.id, name: c.name, children: [] as CollectionNode[] }]));
  const roots: CollectionNode[] = [];
  for (const c of collections) {
    const node = nodes.get(c.id)!;
    const parent = c.parentId === null ? undefined : nodes.get(c.parentId);
    (parent ? parent.children : roots).push(node);
  }
  const sort = (list: CollectionNode[]): void => {
    list.sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.name, b.name));
    for (const n of list) sort(n.children);
  };
  sort(roots);
  return roots;
}

/**
 * 컬렉션에 추가 ▸ (spec 9.2): 새 컬렉션, a separator, then the tree. A collection with children is a submenu whose first
 * row is itself (Zotero), a separator, then the children. One that already holds every item of the selection is checked
 * and cannot be picked again.
 */
export function collectionRows(id: CommandId, organize: OrganizeSnapshot, itemIds: readonly string[], enabled: boolean): MenuEntries {
  const selected = new Set(itemIds);
  const holdsAll = (collectionId: string): boolean => {
    if (selected.size === 0) return false;
    let inside = 0;
    for (const member of organize.members[collectionId] ?? []) if (selected.has(member)) inside++;
    return inside === selected.size;
  };
  const row = (node: CollectionNode): CommandEntry => {
    const all = holdsAll(node.id);
    return { id, label: menuText(node.name), enabled: enabled && !all, args: { collectionId: node.id }, ...(all ? { type: 'checkbox' as const, checked: true } : {}) };
  };
  const walk = (node: CollectionNode): ContextEntry =>
    node.children.length === 0 ? row(node) : { label: menuText(node.name), enabled, submenu: [row(node), 'separator', ...node.children.map(walk)] };
  const tree = collectionTree(organize.collections);
  const out: Array<ContextEntry | 'separator'> = [{ id, label: mainStrings.menu.newCollection, enabled, args: { addSelection: true } }];
  if (tree.length > 0) out.push('separator', ...tree.map(walk));
  return out;
}

/** 색 지정 ▸ (spec 9.2): "N 이름" with a colour dot; this tag's slot is on, and a slot another tag holds names that tag. */
export function tagColorRows(id: CommandId, organize: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, enabled: boolean): MenuEntries {
  return TAG_COLORS.map((color, i): CommandEntry => {
    const position = i + 1;
    const holder = organize.tags.find((t) => t.position === position);
    const own = holder?.id === tagId;
    return {
      id,
      label: `${position} ${color.label}${holder && !own ? ` — ${menuText(holder.name)}` : ''}`,
      enabled,
      args: { position },
      type: 'radio',
      checked: own,
      dot: color.hex,
    };
  });
}

/** The slot a colour command stands for: the digit its id ends with (tag.color3). */
const slotOf = (id: string): number | null => {
  const m = /(\d)$/.exec(id);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) : null;
};

/**
 * 색 태그 ▸ (spec 9.2, P-3): a group of commands, one per slot that has a tag, named by the tag with the slot at the right
 * edge. A tag that every selected item has is checked. Left out when no tag has a slot (or the library was not read).
 */
export function colorTagGroup(spec: SubmenuSpec, commands: readonly CommandSpec[], input: SubmenuInput): SubmenuEntry | null {
  const { organize } = input;
  if (!organize) return null;
  const selected = new Set(input.itemIds);
  const rows: CommandEntry[] = [];
  for (const id of spec.commands) {
    const command = commands.find((c) => c.id === id);
    const slot = slotOf(id);
    const tag = slot === null ? undefined : organize.tags.find((t) => t.position === slot);
    if (!command || !tag) continue;
    let has = 0;
    for (const item of organize.tagged[tag.id] ?? []) if (selected.has(item)) has++;
    const all = selected.size > 0 && has === selected.size;
    rows.push({ id, label: menuText(tag.name), enabled: input.enabledOf(command), hint: String(slot), ...(all ? { type: 'checkbox' as const, checked: true } : {}) });
  }
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;
  return { id: `submenu.${spec.id}`, label: spec.label, enabled: rows.some((r) => r.enabled), submenu: rows };
}

/**
 * The rows of a value-submenu command. `rowsEnabled`: the context menu greys the rows with their command; the menu bar
 * leaves them on and greys the head (the head is switched in place, the rows are not).
 */
export function valueRows(command: CommandSpec, input: SubmenuInput, rowsEnabled: boolean): MenuEntries {
  const source: SubmenuSource | undefined = command.submenu;
  switch (source) {
    case 'sortColumns':
      return sortColumnRows(command.id, input.context, rowsEnabled);
    case 'collections':
      return input.organize ? collectionRows(command.id, input.organize, input.itemIds, rowsEnabled) : [];
    case 'tagColors':
      return input.organize && input.tagId !== undefined ? tagColorRows(command.id, input.organize, input.tagId, rowsEnabled) : [];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

/** Whether the menu bar (`where` = 'menu') or the context menu of a kind lists a submenu that is read from the library. */
export function menuNeedsOrganize(commands: readonly CommandSpec[], submenus: readonly SubmenuSpec[], where: ContextMenuKind | 'menu'): boolean {
  const placedHere = (at: { kinds: readonly ContextMenuKind[] } | undefined): boolean => where !== 'menu' && at?.kinds.includes(where) === true;
  const fromSource = commands.some(
    (c) => (c.submenu === 'collections' || c.submenu === 'tagColors') && (where === 'menu' ? c.menu !== undefined : placedHere(c.contextMenu)),
  );
  return fromSource || submenus.some((s) => (where === 'menu' ? s.menu !== undefined : placedHere(s.contextMenu)));
}
```

```ts
import { crc32, deflateSync } from 'node:zlib';

/** A menu icon is 16 pt square; macOS draws it at 2× from a 32 px image. */
export const DOT_POINTS = 16;
export const DOT_SCALE = 2;
/** The dot itself is 8 pt across, as the chips' (design-spec 6 태그 칩). */
const DIAMETER_POINTS = 8;

const SIGNATURE = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);

function chunk(type: string, data: Buffer): Buffer {
  const body = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(type, 'ascii'), data]);
  const length = Buffer.alloc(4);
  length.writeUInt32BE(data.length);
  const crc = Buffer.alloc(4);
  crc.writeUInt32BE(crc32(body));
  return Buffer.concat([length, body, crc]);
}

/**
 * A filled anti-aliased circle in `hex` (#rrggbb) on a transparent 32 px square, as a PNG. Hand-encoded (a menu icon is
 * the only image main draws): the same bytes on every platform, where a raw bitmap's channel order is the platform's.
 */
export function dotPng(hex: string): Buffer {
  const m = /^#([0-9a-f]{2})([0-9a-f]{2})([0-9a-f]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
  if (!m) throw new Error(`not a colour: ${hex}`);
  const [r, g, b] = [m[1]!, m[2]!, m[3]!].map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)) as [number, number, number];
  const size = DOT_POINTS * DOT_SCALE;
  const radius = (DIAMETER_POINTS * DOT_SCALE) / 2;
  const middle = size / 2;
  const stride = 1 + size * 4;
  const raw = Buffer.alloc(size * stride); // each row: filter byte 0, then RGBA
  for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      const distance = Math.hypot(x + 0.5 - middle, y + 0.5 - middle);
      const coverage = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, radius - distance + 0.5));
      const at = y * stride + 1 + x * 4;
      raw[at] = r;
      raw[at + 1] = g;
      raw[at + 2] = b;
      raw[at + 3] = Math.round(coverage * 255);
    }
  }
  const header = Buffer.alloc(13);
  header.writeUInt32BE(size, 0);
  header.writeUInt32BE(size, 4);
  header[8] = 8; // bit depth
  header[9] = 6; // colour type: RGBA
  return Buffer.concat([SIGNATURE, chunk('IHDR', header), chunk('IDAT', deflateSync(raw)), chunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}
```
**`M/menu/dot-icon.ts`**(새 파일; Electron 런타임이 필요해 단위 시험이 없고, Task 6의 태그 색 메뉴 증거가 눈으로 확인한다):
```ts
import { nativeImage, type NativeImage } from 'electron';
import { DOT_SCALE, dotPng } from './dot-png';

const cache = new Map<string, NativeImage>();

/** The native image of a colour dot for a menu row; one per colour. */
export function dotIcon(hex: string): NativeImage {
  let icon = cache.get(hex);
  if (!icon) {
    icon = nativeImage.createFromBuffer(dotPng(hex), { scaleFactor: DOT_SCALE });
    cache.set(hex, icon);
  }
  return icon;
}
```

**`M/menu/context-menu.ts`** 전체를 바꾼다:
```ts
import { Menu, type BaseWindow } from 'electron';
import { SUBMENUS, commandAvailable, commandLabel, type CommandContextState, type CommandSpec, type CommandTargetInfo, type ContextMenuKind, type OrganizeSnapshot, type PickedCommand, type SubmenuSpec } from '@learn/domain';
import { dotIcon } from './dot-icon';
import { entriesToTemplate, type ContextEntry, type MenuEntries } from './entries';
import { colorTagGroup, valueRows } from './submenus';

export type { CommandEntry, ContextEntry, MenuEntries, SubmenuEntry } from './entries';

/** What a menu is built from beside the registry and the reported context. */
export interface MenuExtras {
  /** Collections, tags and who has what; null when it was not read (the rows that need it are left out). */
  organize?: OrganizeSnapshot | null;
  /** The items the menu is for, in table order: what the marks of 컬렉션에 추가 ▸ and 색 태그 ▸ are judged on. */
  itemIds?: readonly string[];
  /** The tag a tag menu is for (색 지정 ▸). */
  tagId?: string;
  /** The grouped submenus; the registry's by default. */
  submenus?: readonly SubmenuSpec[];
}

/** Whether some registry command (or group) lists this kind: a kind nothing lists answers null without a database read. */
export function kindHasMenu(kind: ContextMenuKind, commands: readonly CommandSpec[], submenus: readonly SubmenuSpec[] = SUBMENUS): boolean {
  return commands.some((c) => c.contextMenu?.kinds.includes(kind)) || submenus.some((s) => s.contextMenu?.kinds.includes(kind));
}

interface Placed {
  group: number;
  order: number;
  entry: ContextEntry | null;
}

/**
 * Registry commands (and grouped submenus) for one kind of native context menu, grouped and ordered, enabled by the
 * shared predicate. `onlyWhenAvailable` commands (다시 연결…) are left out instead of shown disabled (design-spec 7.3). A
 * value submenu (컬렉션에 추가 ▸, 색 지정 ▸) and a group (색 태그 ▸) are rows that open a submenu; one with nothing to
 * list is left out together with the separator it would have needed.
 */
export function contextMenuEntries(
  kind: ContextMenuKind,
  commands: readonly CommandSpec[],
  ctx: CommandContextState,
  targets: readonly CommandTargetInfo[],
  platform: string,
  extras: MenuExtras = {},
): MenuEntries {
  const input = {
    organize: extras.organize ?? null,
    itemIds: extras.itemIds ?? [],
    ...(extras.tagId !== undefined ? { tagId: extras.tagId } : {}),
    context: ctx,
    enabledOf: (c: CommandSpec) => commandAvailable(c, ctx, targets),
  };
  const fromCommands = commands.flatMap((c): Placed[] => {
    const at = c.contextMenu;
    if (!at?.kinds.includes(kind)) return [];
    const enabled = commandAvailable(c, ctx, targets);
    if (!enabled && at.onlyWhenAvailable) return [];
    const label = commandLabel(c, platform);
    if (c.submenu === undefined) return [{ group: at.group, order: at.order, entry: { id: c.id, label, enabled } }];
    const rows = valueRows(c, input, enabled);
    return [{ group: at.group, order: at.order, entry: rows.length === 0 ? null : { label, enabled, submenu: rows } }];
  });
  const fromGroups = (extras.submenus ?? SUBMENUS).flatMap((s): Placed[] =>
    s.contextMenu?.kinds.includes(kind) ? [{ group: s.contextMenu.group, order: s.contextMenu.order, entry: colorTagGroup(s, commands, input) }] : [],
  );
  const placed = [...fromCommands, ...fromGroups]
    .filter((p): p is Placed & { entry: ContextEntry } => p.entry !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => a.group - b.group || a.order - b.order);
  const out: Array<ContextEntry | 'separator'> = [];
  let group: number | null = null;
  for (const p of placed) {
    if (group !== null && p.group !== group) out.push('separator');
    group = p.group;
    out.push(p.entry);
  }
  return out;
}

/** Menus stay referenced while open so they can't be collected mid-popup. */
const open = new Set<Menu>();

/**
 * Shows a native menu and resolves the picked command and its row's value, or null when dismissed.
 * Resolution goes through each item's `click` (so a stubbed `Menu.prototype.popup` can drive it);
 * the close callback resolves null one task later, so a click delivered after the close still wins.
 */
export function popupCommandMenu(entries: MenuEntries, at: { window: BaseWindow; x: number; y: number }): Promise<PickedCommand | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const menu = Menu.buildFromTemplate(entriesToTemplate(entries, (picked) => settle(picked), { dotIcon }));
    function settle(value: PickedCommand | null): void {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      open.delete(menu);
      resolve(value);
    }
    open.add(menu);
    menu.popup({ window: at.window, x: Math.round(at.x), y: Math.round(at.y), callback: () => setTimeout(() => settle(null), 0) });
  });
}
```

**`M/menu/rebuild.test.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { REBUILD_DELAY_MS, createMenuRebuilder } from './rebuild';

beforeEach(() => vi.useFakeTimers());
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());

describe('the menu bar rebuild (debounced, never under an open menu)', () => {
  it('rebuilds once, 100 ms after the last request', () => {
    const rebuild = vi.fn();
    const r = createMenuRebuilder(rebuild);
    expect(REBUILD_DELAY_MS).toBe(100);
    r.request();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(60);
    r.request(); // a burst of notices: the clock starts over
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(99);
    expect(rebuild).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('waits while a native menu is open, and rebuilds 100 ms after it closes', () => {
    const rebuild = vi.fn();
    const r = createMenuRebuilder(rebuild);
    r.menuOpenChanged(true);
    r.request();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(5000);
    expect(rebuild).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    r.menuOpenChanged(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(99); // AppKit sends the clicked item's action after the menu closes: the item must still exist
    expect(rebuild).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('a close before the clock ran out changes nothing: one rebuild, when the clock does', () => {
    const rebuild = vi.fn();
    const r = createMenuRebuilder(rebuild);
    r.request();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(50);
    r.menuOpenChanged(true);
    r.menuOpenChanged(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(50);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('a menu that opens and closes with nothing asked for rebuilds nothing', () => {
    const rebuild = vi.fn();
    const r = createMenuRebuilder(rebuild);
    r.menuOpenChanged(true);
    r.menuOpenChanged(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    expect(rebuild).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('a request during the wait after a close starts the clock again; cancel drops what is pending', () => {
    const rebuild = vi.fn();
    const r = createMenuRebuilder(rebuild);
    r.menuOpenChanged(true);
    r.request();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(200);
    r.menuOpenChanged(false);
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(60);
    r.request();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(99);
    expect(rebuild).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    r.request();
    r.cancel();
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000);
    expect(rebuild).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

**`M/events.test.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

const sent: Array<[string, unknown]> = [];
vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  BrowserWindow: {
    getAllWindows: () => [{ isDestroyed: () => false, webContents: { isDestroyed: () => false, send: (channel: string, payload: unknown) => sent.push([channel, payload]) } }],
  },
}));
const { broadcast, onBroadcast } = await import('./events');

beforeEach(() => {
  sent.length = 0;
  vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
});

describe('broadcast', () => {
  it('reaches every window, and main\'s own observers hear it first with the name and the payload', () => {
    const heard: unknown[] = [];
    const off = onBroadcast((e) => heard.push([e.name, e.payload, sent.length]));
    broadcast('libraryChanged', { reason: 'collections' });
    expect(heard).toEqual([['libraryChanged', { reason: 'collections' }, 0]]);
    expect(sent).toEqual([['evt:library-changed', { reason: 'collections' }]]);
    off();
    broadcast('libraryChanged', { reason: 'tags' });
    expect(heard).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(2);
  });
  it('an observer that throws neither stops the windows nor the other observers', () => {
    const second = vi.fn();
    const offA = onBroadcast(() => {
      throw new Error('boom');
    });
    const offB = onBroadcast(second);
    broadcast('nativeMenu', { open: true });
    expect(second).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(sent).toEqual([['evt:native-menu', { open: true }]]);
    offA();
    offB();
  });
});
```

**`M/menu/rebuild.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
export const REBUILD_DELAY_MS = 100;

export interface MenuRebuilder {
  /** Something the menu bar lists changed: rebuild once the notices stop, and no menu is open. */
  request(): void;
  /** A menu-bar menu opened or closed (`nativeMenu { open }`). */
  menuOpenChanged(open: boolean): void;
  /** Drops a pending rebuild (the app is going away). */
  cancel(): void;
}

/**
 * Debounces rebuilds of the application menu. A rebuild never happens while a native menu is open (it would pull the
 * open menu out from under the pointer), and one that waited for a menu to close still waits the delay once more: AppKit
 * sends the clicked item's action after the menu has closed, so the item must still be there when it does.
 */
export function createMenuRebuilder(rebuild: () => void, delayMs: number = REBUILD_DELAY_MS): MenuRebuilder {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  let open = false;
  let waiting = false;
  const arm = (): void => {
    if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(fire, delayMs);
  };
  function fire(): void {
    timer = null;
    if (open) {
      waiting = true;
      return;
    }
    waiting = false;
    rebuild();
  }
  return {
    request: arm,
    menuOpenChanged(next) {
      open = next;
      if (!next && waiting) {
        waiting = false;
        arm();
      }
    },
    cancel() {
      if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = null;
      waiting = false;
    },
  };
}
```
**`M/events.ts`** — 전체를 바꾼다:
```ts
import { BrowserWindow, type WebContents } from 'electron';
import { EventChannels, type LearnEventMap } from '@learn/domain';

/** Main -> renderer push to one renderer. Only names in EventChannels exist; the preload drops the IPC event object. */
export function sendEvent<K extends keyof LearnEventMap>(contents: WebContents, name: K, payload: LearnEventMap[K]): void {
  if (!contents.isDestroyed()) contents.send(EventChannels[name], payload);
}

/** One broadcast, as main's own observers hear it. */
export type BroadcastEvent = { [K in keyof LearnEventMap]: { name: K; payload: LearnEventMap[K] } }[keyof LearnEventMap];
const observers = new Set<(event: BroadcastEvent) => void>();

/** Main's own code hears what it broadcasts (the menu bar follows the collections and tags that main announces). Returns the unsubscribe. */
export function onBroadcast(observer: (event: BroadcastEvent) => void): () => void {
  observers.add(observer);
  return () => void observers.delete(observer);
}

/** Main -> renderer push to every window. */
export function broadcast<K extends keyof LearnEventMap>(name: K, payload: LearnEventMap[K]): void {
  for (const observer of observers) {
    try {
      observer({ name, payload } as BroadcastEvent);
    } catch {
      console.warn(`[events] an observer of ${name} failed`); // the event name only
    }
  }
  for (const win of BrowserWindow.getAllWindows()) {
    if (!win.isDestroyed()) sendEvent(win.webContents, name, payload);
  }
}
```

③ 80–113행(`placement`부터 `registryItems`의 끝까지)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/** Where a command or a group lands on this platform: "app" items move to the end of 파일 off macOS. */
function placement(at: CommandSpec['menu'], platform: NodeJS.Platform): { menu: MenuName; group: number; order: number } | null {
  if (!at) return null;
  if (at.menu === 'app' && platform !== 'darwin') return { menu: 'file', group: 90 + at.group, order: at.order };
  return at;
}

const DEFAULT_CONTEXT: CommandContextState = Object.freeze({
  view: 'library', blocked: false, textSize: 13, libraryCount: 0, selectionCount: 0, selectionAvailable: 0, selectionRelinkable: 0, ...NO_LIBRARY_VIEW,
});

/** A pick from a row of a submenu is a command with the row's value. */
const picker = (opts: AppMenuOptions) => (picked: PickedCommand | null): void => {
  if (picked) opts.onCommand(picked.commandId, picked.args);
};

/** What the submenus are built from: the reported context and the library read for the menu bar (no selection, so no marks). */
function submenuInput(opts: AppMenuOptions): SubmenuInput {
  return { organize: opts.organize ?? null, itemIds: [], context: opts.context ?? DEFAULT_CONTEXT, enabledOf: (c) => isEnabled(c.id, opts.enabled) };
}

function commandItems(c: CommandSpec, opts: AppMenuOptions): Item[] {
  const enabled = isEnabled(c.id, opts.enabled);
  const label = commandLabel(c, opts.platform, opts.labels);
  if (c.submenu !== undefined) {
    // The head is the command and is switched in place; its rows are always on (they are reachable only through it).
    // A submenu with nothing to list is left out rather than drawn empty.
    const rows = valueRows(c, submenuInput(opts), true);
    return rows.length === 0 ? [] : [{ id: c.id, label, enabled, submenu: entriesToTemplate(rows, picker(opts)) }];
  }
  const click = () => opts.onCommand(c.id);
  const [id, ...twinIds] = menuItemIds(c);
  const item: Item = { id, label, enabled, click };
  if (c.accelerator) item.accelerator = platformAccelerator(c.accelerator, opts.platform);
  return [item, ...twinAccelerators(c).map((acc, i): Item => ({ id: twinIds[i], label, enabled, visible: false, accelerator: platformAccelerator(acc, opts.platform), click }))];
}

/** A group's head with its members, as one item; nothing when it has no member to show. */
function groupItems(s: SubmenuSpec, opts: AppMenuOptions): Item[] {
  const entry = colorTagGroup(s, opts.commands, submenuInput(opts));
  return entry ? entriesToTemplate([entry], picker(opts)) : [];
}

/** Registry commands and groups for one menu, merged by group then order (separator between groups) and built. */
function registryItems(name: MenuName, opts: AppMenuOptions): Item[] {
  interface Placed {
    at: { group: number; order: number };
    build(): Item[];
  }
  const commands = opts.commands.flatMap((c): Placed[] => {
    const at = placement(c.menu, opts.platform);
    return at?.menu === name ? [{ at, build: () => commandItems(c, opts) }] : [];
  });
  const groups = (opts.submenus ?? SUBMENUS).flatMap((s): Placed[] => {
    const at = placement(s.menu, opts.platform);
    return at?.menu === name ? [{ at, build: () => groupItems(s, opts) }] : [];
  });
  const built = [...commands, ...groups]
    .sort((a, b) => a.at.group - b.at.group || a.at.order - b.at.order)
    .map((p) => ({ at: p.at, items: p.build() }))
    .filter((p) => p.items.length > 0);
  const out: Item[] = [];
  let group: number | null = null;
  for (const { at, items } of built) {
    if (group !== null && at.group !== group) out.push(SEP);
    group = at.group;
    out.push(...items);
  }
  return out;
}
```
④ `applyMenuEnabled`(174–188행, 위의 doc 주석 포함)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * Applies a reported context to an already-built menu by flipping `enabled` in place on every registry item and its
 * hidden twins, on the members of a placed group and on the group's head. No rebuild: an open dropdown stays open, no
 * window gets setMenu again, and it stays cheap when reports come quickly. Commands without a menu-bar placement are not
 * looked up; ids the menu lacks are skipped.
 */
export function applyMenuEnabled(
  menu: MenuItemLookup,
  enabled: ReadonlySet<CommandId>,
  commands: readonly CommandSpec[] = COMMANDS,
  submenus: readonly SubmenuSpec[] = SUBMENUS,
): void {
  const grouped = new Set<CommandId>(submenus.flatMap((s) => (s.menu ? s.commands : [])));
  for (const c of commands) {
    if (!c.menu && !grouped.has(c.id)) continue;
    const on = isEnabled(c.id, enabled);
    for (const id of menuItemIds(c)) {
      const item = menu.getMenuItemById(id);
      if (item) item.enabled = on;
    }
  }
  for (const s of submenus) {
    if (!s.menu) continue;
    const head = menu.getMenuItemById(`submenu.${s.id}`);
    if (head) head.enabled = s.commands.some((id) => isEnabled(id, enabled));
  }
}

/**
 * What the menu bar's value submenus are drawn from in a reported context. A change is a different menu (the rows are
 * the columns drawn, the radios the sort in force), so main rebuilds it; every other part of a report flips `enabled`.
 */
export const submenuShapeKey = (ctx: Pick<CommandContextState, 'sortColumn' | 'sortDirection' | 'columnsShown'>): string =>
  `${ctx.sortColumn}|${ctx.sortDirection}|${ctx.columnsShown}`;
```

③ 149–197행(`installAppMenu`의 주석부터 `setUiContext`의 끝까지)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/** Whether any menu-bar item is read from the library (collections, colour tags): only then are its notices heard and its snapshot read. */
const menuUsesOrganize = menuNeedsOrganize(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS, 'menu');
/** Collections and tags for the menu bar's submenus; null when no item uses them, the library is not open, or reading failed. */
function menuOrganize(): OrganizeSnapshot | null {
  if (!menuUsesOrganize || !ctx) return null;
  try {
    return readOrganizeSnapshot(ctx.db);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(`[menu] reading the library for the menu bar failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`); // the code only: no names in a log
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Builds and installs the application menu: once at startup, and again when what its submenus list changes — the sort
 * and the columns drawn (the reported context) and the collections and tags (main's own notices). Everything else in a
 * report flips `enabled` in place (setUiContext), so an open dropdown stays open.
 */
function installAppMenu(): void {
  appMenu = Menu.buildFromTemplate(
    buildAppMenu({
      isDev: isDevBuild,
      platform: process.platform,
      commands: COMMANDS,
      enabled: new Set(availableMenuCommands(uiContext)),
      onCommand: dispatchMenuCommand,
      labels: menuLabelState(uiContext),
      context: uiContext,
      organize: menuOrganize(),
      fullScreenState: mainWindow !== null && !mainWindow.isDestroyed() && mainWindow.isFullScreen(),
      fullScreenAvailable: mainWindow !== null && !mainWindow.isDestroyed() && !isSheetOpen(mainWindow),
      onToggleFullScreen: () => {
        if (!mainWindow || mainWindow.isDestroyed()) return;
        const fullscreen = mainWindow.isFullScreen();
        demoShortcut('Ctrl+Cmd+F', FULL_SCREEN.stateLabels[fullscreen ? 'fullscreen' : 'windowed']);
        mainWindow.setFullScreen(!fullscreen);
      },
    }),
  );
  Menu.setApplicationMenu(appMenu);
  // macOS reports a menu opening on the application menu's root model; the submenus are watched too in case.
  for (const m of [appMenu, ...appMenu.items.flatMap((i) => (i.submenu ? [i.submenu] : []))]) {
    m.on('menu-will-show', () => setNativeMenuOpen(true));
    m.on('menu-will-close', () => setNativeMenuOpen(false));
  }
}

/** The menu bar is rebuilt debounced, and never under an open menu (menu/rebuild.ts). */
const menuRebuild = createMenuRebuilder(() => {
  try {
    installAppMenu();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn(`[menu] rebuilding the menu bar failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`);
  }
});
// The collections and tags main announces change the menu bar's submenus, when it has any that list them.
onBroadcast((e) => {
  if (menuUsesOrganize && e.name === 'libraryChanged' && (e.payload.reason === 'collections' || e.payload.reason === 'tags')) menuRebuild.request();
});

let nativeMenuOpen = false;
/** Tells the main window's renderer a menu-bar menu is open, so no tooltip stays under it; a rebuild waits for it to close. */
function setNativeMenuOpen(open: boolean): void {
  if (open === nativeMenuOpen) return;
  nativeMenuOpen = open;
  menuRebuild.menuOpenChanged(open);
  if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) sendEvent(mainWindow.webContents, 'nativeMenu', { open });
}

/** Records the main window's context and updates the registry items in place (no rebuild, open menus stay open) — except where the submenus' rows change. */
function setUiContext(next: CommandContextState): void {
  if (sameCommandContext(uiContext, next)) return;
  const relabel = menuLabelsChanged(uiContext, next);
  const reshape = submenuShapeKey(uiContext) !== submenuShapeKey(next);
  uiContext = next;
  if (!appMenu) return;
  applyMenuEnabled(appMenu, new Set(availableMenuCommands(next)));
  if (relabel) applyMenuLabels(appMenu, process.platform, menuLabelState(next));
  if (reshape) menuRebuild.request();
}
```

**`M/ipc/ui.ts`** — 1–33행(import부터 `showContextMenu` 핸들러 끝까지)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
import path from 'node:path';
import { BrowserWindow, type WebContents } from 'electron';
import { readOrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/db';
import {
  COMMANDS, Channels, LearnError, SUBMENUS, commandContextInput, confirmDuplicateInput, emptyInput, itemTarget, showColumnMenuInput, showContextMenuInput, themeShownInput, toLearnError,
  type CommandTargetInfo,
} from '@learn/domain';
import { refreshItemAvailability } from '../item-availability';
import { columnMenuEntries, popupColumnMenu } from '../menu/column-menu';
import { contextMenuEntries, kindHasMenu, popupCommandMenu } from '../menu/context-menu';
import { menuNeedsOrganize } from '../menu/submenus';
import { windowStateOf } from '../window-state';
import type { Handle, IpcDeps } from './register';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';

export function registerUiIpc(handle: Handle, deps: IpcDeps): void {
  // Resolves when the native menu closes: the picked command with its row's value (the renderer runs it with runPicked) or null.
  handle(Channels.ui.showContextMenu, showContextMenuInput, async (input, event) => {
    const window = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
    if (!window) return null;
    // A kind no registry command lists has no menu: answered before anything is read (collections and tags, until theirs exist).
    if (!kindHasMenu(input.kind, COMMANDS, SUBMENUS)) return null;
    const ctx = deps.getContext();
    // Collections, tags and who has what: one read, and only when this menu has a submenu built from them or needs its targets.
    const organize = input.kind !== 'item' || menuNeedsOrganize(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS, 'item') ? readOrganizeSnapshot(ctx.db) : null;
    let targets: CommandTargetInfo[];
    let itemIds: string[] = [];
    let tagId: string | undefined;
    if (input.kind === 'item') {
      // One query for the whole selection, in the order asked (the old read per id made ⌘A on 10 000 rows 10 000 reads).
      let items = ctx.repo.getItems(input.itemIds);
      if (items.length === 0) return null;
      if (items.length === 1) {
        // Same check as library.get, so "다시 연결…" shows for a linked file that went missing this session.
        try {
          items = [await refreshItemAvailability(ctx, items[0]!.id)];
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`[ui] availability check failed: ${toLearnError(e).code}`); // fall back to the stored state
        }
      }
      targets = items.map((i) => itemTarget(i));
      itemIds = items.map((i) => i.id);
    } else if (input.kind === 'collection') {
      const live = new Set(organize!.collections.map((c) => c.id));
      targets = input.collectionIds.filter((id) => live.has(id)).map((id) => ({ kind: 'collection', id }));
    } else {
      const known = new Map(organize!.tags.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
      const asked = input.tagIds.flatMap((id) => known.get(id) ?? []);
      targets = asked.map((t) => ({ kind: 'tag', id: t.id, hasColor: t.color !== null }));
      tagId = asked[0]?.id;
    }
    if (targets.length === 0) return null;
    const entries = contextMenuEntries(input.kind, COMMANDS, deps.uiContext.current(), targets, process.platform, {
      organize,
      itemIds,
      ...(tagId !== undefined ? { tagId } : {}),
    });
    if (entries.length === 0) return null;
    return popupCommandMenu(entries, { window, x: input.x, y: input.y });
  });
```
(`LibraryItem` import는 쓰이지 않으니 지운다. Task 3이 고친 `showColumnMenu` 핸들러(`locked`)는 이 범위 밖이라 그대로 둔다.)
