```ts
import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { LibraryItem, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { commandTargets } from './targets';

const item = (id: string, availability: 'available' | 'missing', storageMode: 'managed' | 'linked' = 'managed') => ({ id, storageMode, availability }) as LibraryItem;
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [],
  tags: [
    { id: 't1', name: '중요', color: 'green', position: 3 },
    { id: 't2', name: '복습', color: null, position: null },
  ],
  members: {},
  tagged: {},
  duplicates: [],
};
const LIST = [item('a', 'available'), item('b', 'missing', 'linked')];

describe('the targets a command is judged on (P-4)', () => {
  it('gives items by their freshest facts, collections by id, and tags with whether they have a colour — in that order', () => {
    const client = new QueryClient();
    client.setQueryData(keys.organize, SNAPSHOT);
    expect(commandTargets(client, LIST, { itemIds: ['b', 'a'], collectionIds: ['c1'], tagIds: ['t1', 't2'] })).toEqual([
      { kind: 'item', storageMode: 'linked', availability: 'missing' },
      { kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' },
      { kind: 'collection', id: 'c1' },
      { kind: 'tag', id: 't1', hasColor: true },
      { kind: 'tag', id: 't2', hasColor: false },
    ]);
  });
  it('leaves out an item the list does not have and a tag the snapshot does not know', () => {
    const client = new QueryClient();
    client.setQueryData(keys.organize, SNAPSHOT);
    expect(commandTargets(client, LIST, { itemIds: ['gone'], tagIds: ['gone'] })).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('knows no tag before the snapshot has arrived, and an empty target has no targets', () => {
    const client = new QueryClient();
    expect(commandTargets(client, LIST, { tagIds: ['t1'] })).toEqual([]);
    expect(commandTargets(client, LIST, {})).toEqual([]);
    expect(commandTargets(client, LIST, { args: { column: 'year' } })).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { isContextMenuKey, menuPointFor } from './contextMenuKey';

const key = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof isContextMenuKey>[0]>): Parameters<typeof isContextMenuKey>[0] => ({
  key: '', code: '', shiftKey: false, altKey: false, ctrlKey: false, metaKey: false, isComposing: false, keyCode: 0, ...over,
});

describe('the keys that open a context menu (spec 9.1)', () => {
  it('⇧F10 and the menu key', () => {
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F10', code: 'F10', shiftKey: true }))).toBe(true);
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'ContextMenu', code: 'ContextMenu' }))).toBe(true);
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ code: 'ContextMenu' }))).toBe(true); // a layout that names the key only by position
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'ContextMenu', shiftKey: true }))).toBe(true);
  });
  it('also takes a React keyboard event, whose composition flag is on its native event', () => {
    const react = (composing: boolean) => ({ key: 'F10', code: 'F10', shiftKey: true, altKey: false, ctrlKey: false, metaKey: false, keyCode: 121, nativeEvent: { isComposing: composing } });
    expect(isContextMenuKey(react(false))).toBe(true);
    expect(isContextMenuKey(react(true))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('not F10 alone (the menu bar\'s on some systems), not with another chord held, not while composing', () => {
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F10', code: 'F10' }))).toBe(false);
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F9', shiftKey: true }))).toBe(false);
    for (const held of [{ ctrlKey: true }, { metaKey: true }, { altKey: true }] as const) {
      expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F10', shiftKey: true, ...held })), JSON.stringify(held)).toBe(false);
      expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'ContextMenu', ...held })), JSON.stringify(held)).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F10', shiftKey: true, isComposing: true }))).toBe(false);
    expect(isContextMenuKey(key({ key: 'F10', shiftKey: true, keyCode: 229 }))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('where the menu opens for a focused element', () => {
  const at = (left: number, bottom: number, width: number) => ({ getBoundingClientRect: () => ({ left, bottom, width }) });
  it('under the element, a little in from its left edge (half a narrow one)', () => {
    expect(menuPointFor(at(100, 300, 900), { height: 800 })).toEqual({ x: 148, y: 300 });
    expect(menuPointFor(at(100, 300, 40), { height: 800 })).toEqual({ x: 120, y: 300 });
    expect(menuPointFor(at(100.4, 300.4, 900), { height: 800 })).toEqual({ x: 148, y: 300 });

    expect(menuPointFor(at(0, -20, 400), { height: 800 })).toEqual({ x: 48, y: 0 });
  });
});
```

① 1행을
```ts
import { COMMANDS, isCommandAvailable, type CommandArgs, type CommandContextState, type CommandId, type CommandTargetInfo, type PickedCommand } from '@learn/domain/commands';
```
로. ② 7–9행(`CommandEnv`의 `targetsOf`와 그 주석)을
```ts
  /** The availability facts of a target: its items (the library list, the file re-checked), its collections and tags. */
  targetsOf(target: CommandTarget): CommandTargetInfo[];
```

```ts
  /** 보기 › 정렬 기준: sets the sort of the view shown from a column and/or a direction (the other stays as it is). */

```
③ 56–84행(`CommandTarget`부터 `COMMAND_HANDLERS`의 끝까지)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * What a command acts on: the table's items, a sidebar collection, a tag chip, and the value of the menu row that ran it.
 * Every way in (the menu bar, the palette, the key map, a context menu, the buttons) hands a handler this one shape.
 */
export interface CommandTarget {
  itemIds?: readonly string[];
  collectionIds?: readonly string[];
  tagIds?: readonly string[];
  args?: CommandArgs;
}

type Handler = (env: CommandEnv, target: CommandTarget) => void;

/** The one item an item command acts on (its availability rule asks for exactly one). */
const itemOf = (target: CommandTarget): string => target.itemIds![0]!;

/** Renderer side of the registry: exactly one handler per command id (menus can only show handled commands). */
export const COMMAND_HANDLERS: Record<CommandId, Handler> = {
  'file.importManaged': (env) => env.importFiles('managed'),
  'file.importLinked': (env) => env.importFiles('linked'),
  'library.find': (env) => env.focusSearch(),
  'nav.back': (env) => env.back(),
  'item.open': (env, t) => env.open(itemOf(t)),
  'item.showInFolder': (env, t) => env.showInFolder(itemOf(t)),
  'item.openExternally': (env, t) => env.openExternally(itemOf(t)),
  'item.exportCopy': (env, t) => env.exportCopy(itemOf(t)),
  'item.editInfo': (env, t) => env.editInfo(itemOf(t)),
  'item.relink': (env, t) => env.relink(itemOf(t)),
  'view.toggleSidebar': (env) => env.toggleSidebar(),
  'view.toggleInspector': (env) => env.toggleInspector(),
  'app.shortcuts': (env) => env.showShortcuts(),
  'app.palette': (env) => env.openPalette(),
  'app.settings': (env) => env.openSettings(),
  'view.textBigger': (env) => env.setTextSize((size) => clampTextSize(size + 1)),
  'view.textSmaller': (env) => env.setTextSize((size) => clampTextSize(size - 1)),
  'view.textReset': (env) => env.setTextSize(() => 13),
  'view.nextPane': (env) => env.focusPane(1),
  'view.previousPane': (env) => env.focusPane(-1),
  // A value submenu's head is not a row: with no value there is nothing to sort by.
  'library.sortBy': (env, t) => {
    if (t.args) env.sortBy(t.args);
  },
};
```

⑤ 116–137행(`isCommandEnabled`, `runCommand`, `runPicked`)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
export function isCommandEnabled(id: CommandId, env: CommandEnv, target: CommandTarget = {}): boolean {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(COMMAND_HANDLERS, id)) return false;
  return isCommandAvailable(id, contextOf(env), env.targetsOf(target), { modal: env.modal });
}

/** Runs a command if it is available now; returns whether it ran. */
export function runCommand(id: CommandId, env: CommandEnv, target: CommandTarget = {}): boolean {
  if (!isCommandEnabled(id, judged(env), target)) return false;
  COMMAND_HANDLERS[id](env, target);
  return true;
}

/**
 * A command picked from a native menu (a context menu): main enabled it with fresh file state (the renderer's list may lag
 * one libraryChanged behind), so only the window-level block is checked here. The row's value joins the target the menu
 * was opened for.
 */
export function runPicked(picked: PickedCommand, env: CommandEnv, target: CommandTarget): boolean {
  const { commandId, args } = picked;
  if (!Object.hasOwn(COMMAND_HANDLERS, commandId) || judged(env).blocked) return false; // COMMAND_HANDLERS has exactly the registry ids
  COMMAND_HANDLERS[commandId](env, args ? { ...target, args } : target);
  return true;
}
```

```ts
import type { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { itemTarget, type CommandTargetInfo, type LibraryItem, type OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { freshTargets } from '../data/targets';
import type { CommandTarget } from './registry';

/**
 * The facts a command is judged on, by kind (P-4): items from the freshest read (data/targets.ts), collections by id,
 * tags with whether they have a colour (from the organize snapshot; a tag it does not know is no target).
 */
export function commandTargets(client: QueryClient, list: readonly LibraryItem[], target: CommandTarget): CommandTargetInfo[] {
  const tags = (target.tagIds ?? []).length > 0 ? client.getQueryData<OrganizeSnapshot>(keys.organize)?.tags : undefined;
  return [
    ...freshTargets(client, list, target.itemIds ?? []).map((i) => itemTarget(i)),
    ...(target.collectionIds ?? []).map((id): CommandTargetInfo => ({ kind: 'collection', id })),
    ...(target.tagIds ?? []).flatMap((id): CommandTargetInfo[] => {
      const tag = tags?.find((t) => t.id === id);
      return tag ? [{ kind: 'tag', id, hasColor: tag.color !== null }] : [];
    }),
  ];
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The sort a 보기 › 정렬 기준 row asks for (spec 5.2): its column and/or its direction, the other staying as it is — the
 * column list and the direction list are two sets of radios, unlike a header press (which picks the column's first
 * direction). Null when there is nothing to do.
 */
export function sortFromArgs(current: LibrarySort, args: Pick<CommandArgs, 'column' | 'direction'> | undefined): LibrarySort | null {
  if (!args || (args.column === undefined && args.direction === undefined)) return null;
  const next: LibrarySort = { column: args.column ?? current.column, direction: args.direction ?? current.direction };
  return next.column === current.column && next.direction === current.direction ? null : next;
}
```

**`R/ui/contextMenuKey.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
/** A DOM keyboard event, or a React one (whose `isComposing` lives on its native event). */
type KeyLike = Pick<KeyboardEvent, 'key' | 'code' | 'shiftKey' | 'altKey' | 'ctrlKey' | 'metaKey' | 'keyCode'> & {
  isComposing?: boolean;
  nativeEvent?: { isComposing: boolean };
};

/**
 * ⇧F10 and the menu key (Linux and Windows keyboards): open the context menu of the focused element (spec 9.1). Nothing
 * during a Korean composition and nothing with ⌘ ⌃ ⌥ held; F10 alone is not it. VoiceOver's VO-⇧-M comes as a
 * `contextmenu` event of its own.
 */
export function isContextMenuKey(e: KeyLike): boolean {
  if ((e.isComposing ?? e.nativeEvent?.isComposing ?? false) || e.keyCode === 229) return false;
  if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return false;
  if (e.key === 'ContextMenu' || e.code === 'ContextMenu') return true;
  return e.key === 'F10' && e.shiftKey;
}

/**
 * Where a menu opened by the keyboard goes: under the element, a little in from its left edge, kept inside the window (a
 * row scrolled out of view still opens its menu at the edge). Window coordinates, like a click's `clientX/Y`.
 */
export function menuPointFor(
  el: { getBoundingClientRect(): { left: number; bottom: number; width: number } },
  viewport: { height: number } = { height: innerHeight },
): { x: number; y: number } {
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  return { x: Math.round(r.left + Math.min(r.width / 2, 48)), y: Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(r.bottom, viewport.height - 1))) };
}
```

③ `runMenuCommand`(576–585행)를 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * Click an application-menu item the way Electron does for a mouse click: the MenuItem's own `click()` with the focused
 * window. `args` names a row of the command's submenu (보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ 연도 = `{ column: 'year' }`); the command's own
 * item (the submenu's head) is what must be on. Waits up to 5 s for it to become clickable (the renderer reports its
 * context asynchronously), then throws when the item is missing, hidden or disabled (a user couldn't click it).
 */
export async function runMenuCommand(app: ElectronApplication, id: CommandId, args?: CommandArgs): Promise<void> {
  await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, id), { timeout: 5_000, message: `menu item ${id} never became clickable` }).toBe(true);
  const itemId = menuItemId(id, args);
  await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow, Menu, webContents }, itemId) => {
    const item = Menu.getApplicationMenu()?.getMenuItemById(itemId);
    if (!item) throw new Error(`no application menu item with id ${itemId}`);
    if (!item.enabled || !item.visible) throw new Error(`menu item ${itemId} is not clickable`);
    item.click(undefined, BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow() ?? undefined, webContents.getFocusedWebContents() ?? undefined);
  }, itemId);
}
```
④ `menuItemEnabled`(760행)의 서명 `id: CommandId`를 `id: string`으로(하위 메뉴 줄 id도 묻는다).

⑤ `PopupItem`(768–775행)에 `type: string;` 다음 줄로

를 더하고, `stubContextMenu`(782–796행)와 그 doc 주석을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * Replace native popups in main for the rest of the session: every `Menu.prototype.popup` records its items (submenus
 * too) and the point it opened at, then (one task later, like a user) clicks the enabled row `pick` names through its
 * own `click()` and closes the menu. `pick` is a label, or a path of labels down the submenus (`['컬렉션에 추가', '학회']`);
 * a path that ends on a submenu's head, a null `pick`, or no enabled row with that label only closes the menu (dismissed).
 */
export async function stubContextMenu(app: ElectronApplication, pick: string | readonly string[] | null): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ Menu }, pick) => {
    interface LiveItem { id?: string; label: string; enabled: boolean; visible: boolean; checked: boolean; type: string; submenu?: { items: LiveItem[] }; click(): void }
    interface Recorded { id: string | null; label: string; enabled: boolean; checked: boolean; type: string; submenu?: Recorded[] }
    const g = globalThis as { __learnPopups?: Recorded[][]; __learnPopupAt?: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> };
    g.__learnPopups = [];
    g.__learnPopupAt = [];
    const record = (items: LiveItem[]): Recorded[] =>
      items.map((i) => ({ id: i.id ?? null, label: i.label, enabled: i.enabled, checked: i.checked, type: i.type, ...(i.submenu ? { submenu: record(i.submenu.items) } : {}) }));
    Menu.prototype.popup = function popup(this: { items: LiveItem[] }, options?: { x?: number; y?: number; callback?: () => void }) {
      g.__learnPopups!.push(record(this.items));
      g.__learnPopupAt!.push({ x: options?.x ?? Number.NaN, y: options?.y ?? Number.NaN });
      const path = pick === null ? [] : typeof pick === 'string' ? [pick] : pick;
      let level: LiveItem[] = this.items;
      let found: LiveItem | undefined;
      for (const label of path) {
        found = level.find((i) => i.label === label && i.enabled && i.visible);
        if (!found) break;
        level = found.submenu?.items ?? [];
      }
      const target = path.length > 0 && found && !found.submenu ? found : undefined;
      setTimeout(() => {
        target?.click();
        options?.callback?.();
      }, 0);
    };
  }, pick);
}

/** The point (window coordinates) each popup menu recorded since `stubContextMenu` opened at, oldest first. */
export const recordedPopupPoints = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<Array<{ x: number; y: number }>> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnPopupAt?: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> }).__learnPopupAt ?? []);
```
(기존 `recordedPopups`는 그대로 `PopupItem[][]`를 돌려준다.)

**`E/menus.spec.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
// The menu machinery of M5 (spec 9.1) end to end: 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ in the real menu bar (the keyboard-only sort), the
// menu bar's rebuild that waits for an open menu, the row menu opened from the keyboard, and the kinds of context menu
// that have no commands yet.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, menuSnapshot, recordedPopupPoints, recordedPopups, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, selectRows, stubContextMenu, type MenuNode } from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

/** Copies of the sample PDF with distinct content, imported one by one: 추가일 orders them, the last newest. */
async function importInOrder(page: Page, dir: string, names: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  for (const [i, name] of names.entries()) {
    const file = path.join(dir, `${name}.pdf`);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
    await importPaths(page, [file]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(i + 1);
  }
}
const header = (page: Page, col: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="${col}"]`);
/** Titles in the table's order (data-index), whatever the DOM order. */
const order = (page: Page) =>
  page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').evaluateAll((rows) =>
    rows.sort((a, b) => Number(a.getAttribute('data-index')) - Number(b.getAttribute('data-index'))).map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-title')),
  );
const setting = (page: Page, key: string) => page.evaluate((k) => window.learn.settings.get({ key: k }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.data : 'failed')), key);
const flatten = (nodes: readonly MenuNode[]): MenuNode[] => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flatten(n.submenu ?? [])]);
/** The rows of 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ as "라벨" ("○" when on), separators as "-". */
const radios = async (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<string[]> => {
  const head = flatten(await menuSnapshot(app)).find((n) => n.id === 'library.sortBy');
  return (head?.submenu ?? []).map((n) => (n.type === 'separator' ? '-' : `${n.label}${n.checked ? ' ○' : ''}`));
};
const DEFAULT_RADIOS = ['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일 ○', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○'];

test('보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ sorts the table by a shown column and a direction; its radios follow the sort and the columns, whoever changed them', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['beta', 'delta', 'alpha', 'gamma']);
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(DEFAULT_RADIOS);
    expect(await order(page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'alpha', 'delta', 'beta']); // 추가일, newest first

    // A column row keeps the direction (a header press would start A→Z): 제목, still 내림차순.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.sortBy', { column: 'title' });
    await expect(header(page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    expect(await order(page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'delta', 'beta', 'alpha']);
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(['제목 ○', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);

    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.sortBy', { direction: 'asc' });
    await expect(header(page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'ascending');
    expect(await order(page)).toEqual(['alpha', 'beta', 'delta', 'gamma']);
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(['제목 ○', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '-', '오름차순 ○', '내림차순']);
    await expect.poll(() => setting(page, 'library.sort')).toEqual({ column: 'title', direction: 'asc' });

    // The header sorts too (dates start newest first): the radios follow it.
    await header(page, 'createdAt').click();
    await expect(header(page, 'createdAt')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(DEFAULT_RADIOS);

    // A column shown through the header menu becomes a row, in catalogue order; sorted by it, and then hidden again, its row stays (on).
    await stubContextMenu(app, '크기');
    await header(page, 'year').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(header(page, 'size')).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일 ○', '크기', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.sortBy', { column: 'size' });
    await expect(header(page, 'size')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    await header(page, 'year').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(header(page, 'size')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '크기 ○', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the menu bar is not rebuilt under an open menu: the radios wait for it to close, and a row clicked meanwhile still lands', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta']);
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(DEFAULT_RADIOS);
    // A menu-bar menu opens (macOS and Linux both announce it on the menu): main marks it open until it closes.
    await app.evaluate(({ Menu }) => void Menu.getApplicationMenu()!.emit('menu-will-show'));
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.sortBy', { column: 'title' });
    await expect(header(page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending'); // the click landed at once
    await page.waitForTimeout(500); // five rebuild delays
    expect(await radios(app)).toEqual(DEFAULT_RADIOS); // the open menu was not touched
    await app.evaluate(({ Menu }) => void Menu.getApplicationMenu()!.emit('menu-will-close'));
    await expect.poll(() => radios(app)).toEqual(['제목 ○', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순 ○']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('⇧F10 and the menu key open the focused row\'s menu under it, once, for the whole selection', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma']);
    await stubContextMenu(app, null);
    const opened = async (count: number) => {
      await expect.poll(async () => (await recordedPopups(app)).length).toBe(count);
      await page.waitForTimeout(600); // longer than the browser's echo of the key would take: a second menu would be here by now
      expect((await recordedPopups(app)).length).toBe(count);
    };

    await rowByTitle(page, 'beta').click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F10');
    await opened(1);
    const labels = (items: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof recordedPopups>>[number]) => items.filter((i) => i.type !== 'separator').map((i) => [i.label, i.enabled]);
    expect(labels((await recordedPopups(app))[0]!)).toEqual([['열기', true], [process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기', true], ['사본 내보내기…', true]]);
    // Under the row, a little in from its left edge.
    const box = (await rowByTitle(page, 'beta').boundingBox())!;
    const [at] = await recordedPopupPoints(app);
    expect(Math.abs(at!.y - (box.y + box.height))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(at!.x).toBeGreaterThan(box.x);
    expect(at!.x).toBeLessThan(box.x + box.width);

    await page.keyboard.press('ContextMenu');
    await opened(2);

    // Two rows selected: the menu judges both (열기 needs exactly one).
    await selectRows(page, ['alpha', 'gamma']);
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F10');
    await opened(3);
    expect((await recordedPopups(app))[2]!.find((i) => i.label === '열기')?.enabled).toBe(false);

    // A pick runs on the row: 열기 opens the one that had the key.
    await stubContextMenu(app, '열기');
    await rowByTitle(page, 'gamma').click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F10');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveText('gamma');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

**`V/capture.ts`** — `captureOpenMenu`(397–446행) 뒤에 더한다:
```ts
/**
 * The rows of the submenu `label` of menu-bar menu `index` as System Events sees them, each with its check mark
 * (AXMenuItemMarkChar; empty when unchecked). Null when the submenu is not open or System Events refuses.
 */
export async function submenuItems(target: string | number, index: number, label: string): Promise<Array<{ name: string; mark: string }> | null> {
  const script = [
    'set out to {}',
    'tell application "System Events"',
    `tell ${processRef(target)}`,
    `set sub to menu 1 of menu item "${label}" of menu 1 of menu bar item ${index} of menu bar 1`,
    'repeat with i in (menu items of sub)',
    'set n to name of i',
    'if n is missing value then set n to "-"',
    'set m to ""',
    'try',
    'set mark to value of attribute "AXMenuItemMarkChar" of i',
    'if mark is not missing value then set m to mark',
    'end try',
    'set end of out to n & "|" & m',
    'end repeat',
    'end tell',
    'end tell',
    "set AppleScript's text item delimiters to linefeed",
    'return out as text',
  ];
  const r = await tryExec('osascript', script.flatMap((l) => ['-e', l]), 20_000);
  if (!r.ok || r.stdout.trim() === '') return null;
  return r.stdout.trim().split('\n').map((line) => {
    const at = line.lastIndexOf('|');
    return { name: line.slice(0, at), mark: line.slice(at + 1) };
  });
}

/**
 * Menu-bar menu `index` opened by the keyboard (⌃F2, → ×(index−1), ↓), then ↓ × `rowsDown` and → to open the submenu
 * `label` on the row reached; captures the screen and reads the submenu's rows. Rows a key cannot reach (separators,
 * disabled ones) are skipped by AppKit, so `rowsDown` counts the reachable rows above the submenu's head.
 */
export async function captureOpenSubmenu(app: ElectronApplication, target: string | number, index: number, label: string, rowsDown: number, prefix: string, what: string) {
  await focusApp(app);
  const keys = ['tell application "System Events"', 'key code 120 using control down', 'delay 0.4'];
  for (let i = 1; i < index; i++) keys.push('key code 124', 'delay 0.15');
  keys.push('key code 125', 'delay 0.4');
  for (let i = 0; i < rowsDown; i++) keys.push('key code 125', 'delay 0.15');
  keys.push('key code 124', 'end tell');
  const typed = await tryExec('osascript', keys.flatMap((l) => ['-e', l]), 20_000);
  await sleep(1200);
  const rows = await submenuItems(target, index, label);
  const shot = await fullScreenShot(`${prefix}-keyboard`, `${what}: ⌃F2, → ×${index - 1}, ↓ ×${rowsDown + 1}, → via System Events`);
  await pressEscape();
  await pressEscape();
  await pressEscape();
  return { shot: shot.file, ok: typed.ok, stderr: typed.stderr.trim(), rowsDown, rows };
}
```
**`V/menus.evidence.ts`**(새 파일):
```ts
// @evidence — M5 Task 4: the native menu bar's 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ open on macOS (the Mac suite `evidence`); Linux runs the
// launch and the JSON checks and records the captures as skipped.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, menuItemEnabled, menuSnapshot, runMenuCommand, type Session } from '../e2e/helpers';
import { IS_MAC, captureOpenSubmenu, menuItemNames, writeJson } from './capture';

const TAG = { tag: '@evidence' };
const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const results: Record<string, unknown> = {};

test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
let s: Session;
let tmp = '';

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-m5-menus-'));
  s = await launch(path.join(tmp, 'library'), path.join(tmp, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  const files = ['a', 'b', 'c'].map((name) => {
    const file = path.join(tmp, `${name}.pdf`);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
    return file;
  });
  await importPaths(s.page, files);
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  writeJson('m5-menus.json', { ...results, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, at: new Date().toISOString() }, 'M5 menu measurements');
  await s?.app.close().catch(() => {});
  if (tmp) fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

/** The sort submenu's rows as the menu bar's JSON has them: on rows by name. */
const marked = async () => {
  const flat = (nodes: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof menuSnapshot>>): typeof nodes => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flat(n.submenu ?? [])]);
  const head = flat(await menuSnapshot(s.app)).find((n) => n.id === 'library.sortBy');
  return (head?.submenu ?? []).filter((n) => n.checked).map((n) => n.label);
};

test('M5 menus: 보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ open — the sort in force on, then the direction changed from the menu', TAG, async () => {
  await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'library.sortBy')).toBe(true);
  expect(await marked()).toEqual(['추가일', '내림차순']);
  if (!IS_MAC) {
    results['skipped'] = 'native menu captures are macOS only';
    return;
  }
  const pid = s.app.process().pid!;
  const names = (await menuItemNames(pid, 5)) ?? [];
  const at = names.indexOf('정렬 기준');
  expect(at, `정렬 기준 is in 보기: ${JSON.stringify(names)}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  const reachable = names.slice(0, at).filter((n) => n !== '-').length;
  // Whether the first ↓ only opens the menu or also lands on its first row depends on the system: try both counts.
  const open = async (prefix: string, what: string) => {
    for (const rowsDown of [reachable - 1, reachable]) {
      const captured = await captureOpenSubmenu(s.app, pid, 5, '정렬 기준', rowsDown, prefix, what);
      if (captured.rows !== null) return captured;
    }
    return captureOpenSubmenu(s.app, pid, 5, '정렬 기준', reachable - 1, prefix, what);
  };
  const on = (rows: Array<{ name: string; mark: string }> | null) => (rows ?? []).filter((r) => r.mark !== '').map((r) => r.name);

  const first = await open('m5-04-menu-view-sort', '보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ open: 추가일 and 내림차순 on');
  results['first'] = first;
  expect.soft((first.rows ?? []).map((r) => r.name), 'the rows').toEqual(['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일', '-', '오름차순', '내림차순']);
  expect.soft(on(first.rows), 'the marks').toEqual(['추가일', '내림차순']);

  await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'library.sortBy', { direction: 'asc' });
  await expect.poll(marked).toEqual(['추가일', '오름차순']);
  const second = await open('m5-04b-menu-view-sort-asc', '보기 › 정렬 기준 ▸ open after 오름차순: 추가일 and 오름차순 on');
  results['second'] = second;
  expect.soft(on(second.rows), 'the marks after the change').toEqual(['추가일', '오름차순']);
});
```

### Task 5: 사이드바와 컬렉션 — 특수 보기, 컬렉션 트리(RAC `Tree` + `Virtualizer`), 만들기·이름 바꾸기·삭제와 실행 취소, 컬렉션 메뉴, 빈 상태, 컬렉션으로 가져오기, `ui:confirm`, 상태 보드

#### 제안 판정 (Q-50 … Q-59)

뼈대·명세·스파이크 인계가 코드와 어긋나거나 정하지 않은 곳이다. 아래 모양대로 구현하고, 컨트롤러가 거부하면 해당 단계만 고친다.

1. **Q-50 (`[data-sidebar]`는 이미 쓰인다 — 오버레이 규칙의 표식은 `data-sidebar-area`).** 스파이크는 사이드바 요소에 `data-sidebar=""`를 달고 오버레이가 `closest('[data-sidebar]')`로 사이드바 안의 끌기를 무시하게 했다. 제품의 `Shell.tsx`는 이미 `.window`에 `data-sidebar="shown|hidden"`을 단다(CSS `.window[data-sidebar='hidden']`, E2E `toHaveAttribute('data-sidebar', 'hidden')`가 쓴다). 그대로 `closest('[data-sidebar]')`를 쓰면 **모든 요소**가 맞아 오버레이가 영영 안 뜬다. 제안: 사이드바 열 전체(`nav.sidebar-inner`, 위 88px 포함)에 `data-sidebar-area=""`를 달고 Task 8은 `closest('[data-sidebar-area]')`를 쓴다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 속성 이름 하나(Shell 한 줄 + Task 8의 선택자).
2. **Q-51 (트리의 구조: RAC `Tree` 하나에 `TreeSection` 둘, "라이브러리" 글자는 트리 밖).** 명세 3.3은 ↑↓가 특수 보기와 트리를 이어서 움직이고 Tab 정거장이 하나라고 한다. 그래서 특수 보기 4행과 컬렉션을 **한 `Tree`**에 둔다: 첫 `TreeSection`(머리 없음, `aria-label="라이브러리"`) = 특수 보기, 둘째 `TreeSection`(머리 `TreeHeader` = "컬렉션" + 새 컬렉션 단추) = 컬렉션 트리. "라이브러리" 구역 글자는 트리 위의 일반 요소다(`aria-hidden`, 구역이 이름을 가진다). 이유: 머리 높이를 **고정 36**(= 구역 사이 간격 12 + 글자 24)으로 두려고 — 머리가 둘이고 높이가 다르면 `ListLayout`이 머리를 재야 하고(`estimatedHeadingSize`), 첫 머리의 위 간격 0과 둘째의 12를 한 값으로 못 맞춘다. 컬렉션이 하나도 없으면 둘째 구역을 그리지 않고 트리를 행 수만큼의 높이로 줄이며(`data-fit`), "컬렉션" 머리와 빈 안내(`.sidebar-empty-hint`, 여러 줄이라 고정 높이 행이 될 수 없다)는 트리 아래 일반 요소로 같은 모양으로 그린다. **스파이크가 재지 않은 것**: `TreeSection`/`TreeHeader`가 `Virtualizer`+`ListLayout` 아래에서 키보드·측정·구역 건너뛰기를 지키는지(RAC 소스에는 "virtualized inside a section"을 위한 코드가 있다). Step 12가 **게이트**다 — 키보드·기하 E2E가 실패하면 멈추고 컨트롤러 판정을 받는다(대안: 구역 없이 최상위 항목만 두고 머리를 비활성 항목으로). 틀렸을 때 비용: Step 12의 컴포넌트 한 파일.
3. **Q-52 (↩·더블클릭·키는 감싸는 요소의 캡처 처리기가 맡는다; 리더에서는 선택이 포커스를 따르지 않는다).** `TreeItem`의 `onAction`은 ↩와 더블클릭을 모두 부르고 구별은 150ms 타이머(스파이크 `lastEnterAt`)에 기댄다. 제품은 `onAction`을 쓰지 않는다: 캡처 처리기가 ↩(컬렉션 행 = 이름 바꾸기, 특수 보기 = 없음)를 직접 처리하고, 더블클릭은 `onDoubleClick`(펼침)이다. 순수 함수 `treeKeyAction`이 결정하고(단위 테스트), → 첫 하위로·← 상위로는 DOM이 아니라 **정리 모델**의 첫 하위·상위 id로 정해 `TreeState.selectionManager.setFocusedKey`로 옮긴다(스파이크 인계 16a: 가상화에서 다음 행이 DOM에 없을 수 있다). 리더 보기(`view.kind === 'reader'`)에서는 사이드바가 "돌아가는 길"이다: 행을 누르거나 ↩하면 `nav.back` 뒤 그 범위로 가고, 화살표로 커서를 옮겨도 보기는 바뀌지 않는다(`onSelectionChange`·`onFocus` 무시). 틀렸을 때 비용: 키 처리 한 곳.
4. **Q-53 (컬렉션 행의 오른쪽 클릭은 먼저 선택한다).** 디자인 명세 7.1("오른쪽 클릭은 먼저 선택한다 — 표·트리 공통")을 트리에도 적용한다: 오른쪽 클릭 → 그 컬렉션으로 보기가 옮겨 가고 → 메뉴. 그래서 컬렉션 메뉴의 대상은 늘 지금 보는 컬렉션이고(팔레트와 같다) 이름 바꾸기·삭제가 보이지 않는 행에 일어나지 않는다. 특수 보기 행에는 메뉴가 없다(명세 9.2). 틀렸을 때 비용: 오른쪽 클릭 처리기의 `setScope` 한 줄.
5. **Q-54 (이름 칸의 끝맺음 규칙).** 명세 3.4가 정한 ↩/esc/빈 이름/200자 위에 정한 것: 칸 밖 클릭(blur)은 만들기·이름 바꾸기 **둘 다** 저장한다(Finder와 같다; 창이 비활성이 되어 생긴 blur는 무시한다); 빈 이름이나 공백만이면 새 컬렉션은 기본 이름 "새 컬렉션"으로 만들고 이름 바꾸기는 원래 이름을 지킨다(오류 없음); 200자를 넘으면 칸 아래에 "컬렉션 이름은 200자까지 쓸 수 있습니다."를 띄우고 ↩는 아무것도 안 하며 blur는 취소로 본다; 편집 중인 행이 스크롤로 가상화 창 밖으로 나가 입력이 사라지면 그때까지 친 이름으로 저장한다(입력이 사라진 편집이 보이지 않게 남지 않도록); 조합 중의 ↩·esc는 조합만 끝낸다(`isComposing`·keyCode 229). 틀렸을 때 비용: 순수 함수 `finishName`과 `finish` 한 곳.
6. **Q-55 (머리의 "새 컬렉션" 단추는 Tab 순서에 없다).** 명세 3.3의 Tab 순서는 "특수 보기·트리(하나의 포커스 정거장) → 태그 필터 칸 → 태그 칩"이다. 단추는 `excludeFromTabOrder`이고 키보드 길은 ⇧⌘N·팔레트다. F6이 사이드바에 내릴 곳은 트리의 정거장 행이어야 하므로 `shell/panes.ts`의 `landsOn`이 `treegrid`도 표처럼 다룬다(`tabindex=0`인 행만). 틀렸을 때 비용: 두 줄.
7. **Q-56 (팔레트: `CommandSpec.paletteLabel`과 대상으로서의 지금 컬렉션).** 명세 9.3은 `collection.rename`을 컨텍스트 메뉴에서 "이름 바꾸기", 팔레트에서 "컬렉션 이름 바꾸기"로 부른다(`tag.rename`과 팔레트에서 헷갈리지 않도록). 레지스트리 이름은 하나라서 `CommandSpec.paletteLabel?: string`과 `paletteLabel(c, platform, state)`를 더하고 팔레트의 글자·순위가 그것을 읽는다. 팔레트의 컬렉션 명령(새 하위·이름 바꾸기·가져오기·삭제)은 지금 보는 컬렉션을 대상으로 판정하고 돌린다(컬렉션 범위가 아니면 꺼져 목록에서 빠진다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 도메인 필드 하나와 팔레트 두 줄.
8. **Q-57 (`ui:confirm`의 모양).** P-5를 이렇게 굳힌다: 입력 `{ message(1–300), detail?(≤600), confirm(1–40) }`, 결과 `boolean`. 메인 창에서만(`['main']`), `deps.windows.asSheet(창, () => dialog.showMessageBox(창, …))` — 단추 `[confirm, 취소]`, `defaultId: 0`, `cancelId: 1`, `type: 'warning'`, `noLink: true`. "취소"는 `mainStrings.confirmSheet.cancel`(main 문구). 문구(메시지·상세·확인 단추)는 렌더러 `strings/`가 만든다(조사 함수가 렌더러에 있다). Task 6(태그 합치기·삭제)이 같은 채널을 쓴다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 없음.
9. **Q-58 (항목 16의 나눔: (a)(b)(g)는 여기서, (c)(d)(e)(f)는 Task 8이).** 스파이크 인계 16이 `Virtualizer` 아래에서 다시 확인하라는 일곱 가지 중 (c) 키보드 끌기 단추와 리프 행 →, (d) 스프링 펼침·가장자리 자동 스크롤, (e) 사이 표시 없음·행 높이 전체 대상, (f) 끄는 중 원본 행이 언마운트돼도 드롭·`onDragEnd`는 모두 `dragAndDropHooks`가 있어야 존재하는 동작이다. 이 작업은 끌기를 만들지 않으므로(`<Button slot="drag">`도 훅 없이는 RAC가 오류를 낸다) **(a) → 첫 하위(모델), (b) 이름 칸 입력의 언마운트·포커스 복귀, (g) 더블클릭·↩·선택이 포커스를 따름·type-ahead 차단**을 제품 E2E로 확인하고, (c)(d)(e)(f)는 Task 8의 E2E가 같은 `Virtualizer` 트리에서 확인한다. 트리가 그것을 받을 준비는 이렇다: `SidebarTree`가 `dragAndDropHooks?`를 `Tree`에 그대로 넘기고, 행 id·`data-testid`·`data-key`가 정해져 있고, "컬렉션" 머리(`CollectionsHeading`, `data-testid="collections-heading"`)가 따로 있어 루트 드롭을 받을 수 있고, `.nav-row[data-drop-target]`·`ForcedState 'drop'`의 모양이 있다. 끌기 단추는 Task 8이 `TreeItemContent`에 더한다. 또 빈 컬렉션의 설명에는 명세 3.6 그대로 "끌어 놓거나"가 들어가는데 끌기는 Task 8에서 생긴다(M5 안에서는 한 마일스톤이라 그대로 둔다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 없음(기록).
10. **Q-59 (가져오기 결과의 모양과 조사 함수의 구두점).** Q-1(Task 2)을 이렇게 쓴다: `ImportReport`에 `filed`(소속이 실제로 든 새 자료 수 — 결과의 `collectionId`)와 `filedExisting`(가져오지 않음을 고른 기존 자료 중 그 컬렉션에 새로 든 수 — `collections.addItems`의 반환)을 더하고 `settleImport(outcomes, mode, deps, collectionId = null)`가 받는다. 토스트는 `filed === imported`일 때만 "‘이름’에 자료 N개를 가져왔습니다"로 쓰고(아니면 평소 문구), `filedExisting > 0`이면 "이미 있는 자료 N개를 ‘이름’에 넣었습니다"를 한 줄 덧붙인다(가져온 게 없으면 그 문장이 제목). 조사 함수는 이름 끝의 닫는 따옴표·괄호·구두점을 건너뛰고 판단한다(`‘논문 (모음)’` → 음 → 과): M4의 `waGwa`도 같은 도우미를 쓰게 고친다(지금은 `)`에서 항상 와). 틀렸을 때 비용: 도우미 한 곳.

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

사이드바를 M3의 임시 한 줄 목록에서 명세 3.2–3.7의 것으로 바꾼다. 눈에 보이는 변화: 사이드바 전체(투어 기준 PNG 대부분이 바뀐다 — 어느 PNG든 사이드바 열만), 컬렉션을 보는 중의 빈 몸통과 항목 패널, ⌘O·창 드롭이 보는 컬렉션에 넣는 것과 그 토스트·오버레이 제목, 상태 보드의 사이드바 행.

- 도메인: 명령 5개(`collection.new`·`newChild`·`rename`·`importInto`·`delete`)와 `paletteLabel`, `ui:confirm` 채널.
- 순수 모듈: `R/sidebar/{rows,treeKeys,nameEdit,importTarget,organizeCache,collectionActions}.ts`와 단위 테스트, 조사 함수(을/를·이/가·(으)로), 가져오기 결과·토스트(`import-flow.ts`).
- 화면: `R/sidebar/*`(트리·행·이름 칸·머리·빈 몸통·항목 패널), CSS, `Shell`의 표식, 팔레트의 대상, 상태 보드 행과 투어 장면.
- 시험: `E/sidebar.spec.ts`·`E/collections.spec.ts`(항목 16 (a)(b)(g) 포함), `V/organize.evidence.ts`와 suite `organize`.
- 한 규칙: 열린 컬렉션 목록(`sidebar.expanded`)은 읽을 때 스냅샷에 있는 id만 남기고, 쓸 때도 그것만 쓴다 — 삭제한 컬렉션을 실행 취소로 되살리면 닫힌 채 돌아온다.

```ts
    expect(waGwa(3)).toBe('과');
    expect(waGwa('bayes')).toBe('와');

    expect(euroRo('논문')).toBe('으로');

    expect(euroRo('분자생물학')).toBe('으로');
    expect(euroRo(1)).toBe('로'); // 일: final ㄹ
    expect(euroRo(3)).toBe('으로'); // 삼
    expect(euroRo(6)).toBe('으로'); // 육
```

Expected: FAIL — `eulReul is not a function`(그리고 `waGwa('논문 (모음)')`이 와를 낸다).

`R/strings/josa.ts` 전체:
```ts
/** Does each digit's Korean reading end in a final consonant (영 일 이 삼 사 오 육 칠 팔 구)? */
const DIGIT_FINAL = [true, true, false, true, false, false, true, true, true, false];
/** Which of those end in ㄹ (일 칠 팔): 으로 is 로 after it. */
const DIGIT_RIEUL = [false, true, false, false, false, false, false, true, true, false];

/**
 * What a particle after `word` depends on: whether its last letter ends in a final consonant, and whether that is ㄹ.
 * Closing quotes, brackets and other punctuation are read past (‘논문 (모음)’ ends in 음); digits are read as Korean
 * numbers; any other ending (Latin letters, 초성) has no final consonant, as it is usually read.
 */
function ending(word: string | number): { final: boolean; rieul: boolean } {
  const text = String(word).normalize('NFC').trim().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+$/u, '');
  const c = text.charCodeAt(text.length - 1);
  if (c >= 0xac00 && c < 0xd7a4) {
    const jong = (c - 0xac00) % 28;
    return { final: jong !== 0, rieul: jong === 8 };
  }
  if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) return { final: DIGIT_FINAL[c - 0x30]!, rieul: DIGIT_RIEUL[c - 0x30]! };
  return { final: false, rieul: false };
}

/** 와 or 과 after `word` (‘증폭’과, ‘효소 억제제’와): 과 when its last syllable has a final consonant. */
export function waGwa(word: string | number): '와' | '과' {
  return ending(word).final ? '과' : '와';
}
/** 을 or 를 (‘학회 준비’를). */
export function eulReul(word: string | number): '을' | '를' {
  return ending(word).final ? '을' : '를';
}
/** 이 or 가. */
export function iGa(word: string | number): '이' | '가' {
  return ending(word).final ? '이' : '가';
}
/** 으로 or 로 — 로 after a vowel and after ㄹ (‘연구실’로, ‘논문’으로). */
export function euroRo(word: string | number): '으로' | '로' {
  const e = ending(word);
  return e.final && !e.rieul ? '으로' : '로';
}
```

```ts
describe('ui.confirm (a question as a sheet on the main window, in the renderer\'s words)', () => {
  const ask = { message: '‘학회 준비’를 삭제하겠습니까?', detail: '자료는 내 라이브러리에 남습니다.', confirm: '삭제' };
  beforeEach(() => messageBox.mockClear());

  it('shows the message with the confirming button first and the default, 취소 after it, and answers whether the first was chosen', async () => {
    expect(await invoke('ui:confirm', MAIN, ask)).toEqual({ ok: true, data: true });
    expect(messageBox).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(fakeWindow, { type: 'warning', message: ask.message, detail: ask.detail, buttons: ['삭제', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1, noLink: true });
    messageBox.mockResolvedValueOnce({ response: 1, checkboxChecked: false });
    expect(await invoke('ui:confirm', MAIN, { message: ask.message, confirm: '삭제' })).toEqual({ ok: true, data: false });
    expect(messageBox.mock.lastCall?.[1]).not.toHaveProperty('detail');
  });
  it('is refused from any other window and for input it is not meant to take', async () => {
    for (const from of [SHEET, SETTINGS]) expect(await invoke('ui:confirm', from, ask)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' });
    expect(await invoke('ui:confirm', MAIN, { message: '', confirm: '삭제' })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    expect(await invoke('ui:confirm', MAIN, { ...ask, extra: 1 })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' });
    expect(messageBox).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

`D/ipc.ts` — 89행 `export type ConfirmDuplicateInput = z.input<typeof confirmDuplicateInput>;` 다음에 더한다:

```ts
/** A native question with the renderer's words (collection delete, tag merge and delete): spec 3.4, P-5. */
export const confirmInput = z.object({ message: z.string().min(1).max(300), detail: z.string().max(600).optional(), confirm: z.string().min(1).max(40) }).strict();
export type ConfirmInput = z.input<typeof confirmInput>;
```
그리고 `LearnApi.ui`의 `confirmDuplicate(input: ConfirmDuplicateInput): Promise<Result<{ choice: DuplicateChoice }>>;`(210행) 다음에 더한다:
```ts
    /** A sheet on the main window with the confirming button first (the default) and 취소: true when it was chosen. */
    confirm(input: ConfirmInput): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
```
(다른 입력 스키마가 `.strict()`가 아니면 이 줄의 `.strict()`는 그 파일 관례에 맞춘다 — `ui:windowState`처럼 추가 키를 `VALIDATION_FAILED`로 막는 테스트가 위에 있다.)

`M/ipc/channel-kinds.ts` — `'ui:confirmDuplicate': MAIN,` 다음 줄에 `'ui:confirm': MAIN,`. `P/main.ts` — `ui:` 배열에서 `'confirmDuplicate',` 다음에 `'confirm',`.

`M/strings.ts` — `settingsWindow: { title: '설정' },` 다음 줄에 더한다:
```ts
  /** The sheets ui:confirm shows: the confirming button's text comes from the page, the cancel button is main's. */

```

`M/ipc/ui.ts` — 맨 위 import `import { BrowserWindow, type WebContents } from 'electron';`를 `import { BrowserWindow, dialog, type MessageBoxOptions, type WebContents } from 'electron';`로, `@learn/domain` import에 `confirmInput,`를 더하고(`commandContextInput,` 다음), `confirmDuplicate` 핸들러 다음(`Channels.ui.showShortcuts` 앞)에 더한다:
```ts
  // A native question in the renderer's words (deleting a collection, merging or deleting a tag): a sheet on the main
  // window, the confirming button first and the default, 취소 after it (esc).
  handle(Channels.ui.confirm, confirmInput, async ({ message, detail, confirm }, event) => {
    const parent = mainWindowOf(event.sender);
    if (!parent) return false;
    const ask: MessageBoxOptions = {
      type: 'warning',
      message,
      ...(detail ? { detail } : {}),
      buttons: [confirm, mainStrings.confirmSheet.cancel],
      defaultId: 0,
      cancelId: 1,
      noLink: true,
    };
    const { response } = await deps.windows.asSheet(parent, () => dialog.showMessageBox(parent, ask));
    return response === 0;
  });
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { item } from '../organize/testing';
import { DRAFT_KEY, SCOPE_KEYS, ancestorIds, descendantIds, keyOfScope, scopeOfKey, visibleCollectionKeys, visibleSpecials } from './rows';

const AT = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const ITEMS = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd1', 'd2'].map((id) => item(id));
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c10', name: '10장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c7', name: '7장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'lab', name: '실험', parentId: 'c6', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'stats', name: '통계', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
  ],
  tags: [],
  members: { c6: ['a'], stats: ['b'] },
  tagged: {},
  duplicates: [['d1', 'd2']],
};
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ITEMS);

describe('the tree\'s keys', () => {
  it('a collection is its id; a special view has a key no id can have', () => {
    expect(keyOfScope({ kind: 'all' })).toBe('scope:all');
    expect(keyOfScope({ kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' })).toBe('bio');
    for (const kind of ['all', 'recent', 'unfiled', 'duplicates'] as const) expect(scopeOfKey(SCOPE_KEYS[kind])).toEqual({ kind });
    expect(scopeOfKey('bio')).toEqual({ kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' });
  });
});

describe('which special views are drawn (spec 3.2)', () => {
  const rows = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof visibleSpecials>[0]> = {}) =>
    visibleSpecials({ itemCount: 5, hasRecent: false, model, current: 'all', ...over }).map((r) => [r.kind, r.count]);

  it('내 라이브러리 always, with its count (none when empty); the others only with content, 최근 연 자료 without a count', () => {
    expect(rows()).toEqual([['all', 5], ['unfiled', 3], ['duplicates', 2]]);
    expect(rows({ hasRecent: true })).toEqual([['all', 5], ['recent', null], ['unfiled', 3], ['duplicates', 2]]);
    expect(visibleSpecials({ itemCount: 0, hasRecent: false, model: undefined, current: 'all' })).toEqual([{ kind: 'all', count: null }]);
  });
  it('미분류 needs a collection to exist: with none, every item is in none', () => {
    const none = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, collections: [], members: {}, duplicates: [] }, ITEMS);
    expect(rows({ model: none }).map(([kind]) => kind)).toEqual(['all']);
  });
  it('the one being looked at stays when it has no content any more, with no number', () => {
    const filed = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, members: { c6: ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd1', 'd2'] }, duplicates: [] }, ITEMS);
    expect(rows({ model: filed })).toEqual([['all', 5]]);
    expect(rows({ model: filed, current: 'unfiled' })).toEqual([['all', 5], ['unfiled', null]]);
    expect(rows({ model: filed, current: 'recent' })).toEqual([['all', 5], ['recent', null]]);
    expect(rows({ model: filed, current: 'duplicates' })).toEqual([['all', 5], ['duplicates', null]]);
  });
});

describe('walking the tree', () => {
  it('ancestors root first, descendants all the way down', () => {
    expect(ancestorIds(model, 'lab')).toEqual(['bio', 'c6']);
    expect(ancestorIds(model, 'bio')).toEqual([]);
    expect(descendantIds(model, 'bio').sort()).toEqual(['c10', 'c6', 'c7', 'lab']);
    expect(descendantIds(model, 'stats')).toEqual([]);
    expect(descendantIds(model, 'nope')).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('the visible rows are in the tree\'s order (6장 < 7장 < 10장) and only under open parents', () => {
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, new Set())).toEqual(['bio', 'stats']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, new Set(['bio']))).toEqual(['bio', 'c6', 'c7', 'c10', 'stats']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, new Set(['bio', 'c6']))).toEqual(['bio', 'c6', 'lab', 'c7', 'c10', 'stats']);
  });
  it('a row being created goes first among its siblings; a closed parent hides it, a leaf parent shows it', () => {
    const open = new Set(['bio']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, open, null)).toEqual([DRAFT_KEY, 'bio', 'c6', 'c7', 'c10', 'stats']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, open, 'bio')).toEqual(['bio', DRAFT_KEY, 'c6', 'c7', 'c10', 'stats']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, new Set(), 'bio')).toEqual(['bio', 'stats']);
    expect(visibleCollectionKeys(model, new Set(['stats']), 'stats')).toEqual(['bio', 'stats', DRAFT_KEY]);
  });
});
```

`R/sidebar/treeKeys.test.ts`:
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { treeKeyAction, type TreeKeyInput, type TreeKeyRow } from './treeKeys';

const OPEN: TreeKeyRow = { key: 'bio', collection: true, expanded: true, hasChildren: true, firstChild: 'c6', parent: null };
const CLOSED: TreeKeyRow = { ...OPEN, expanded: false };
const LEAF: TreeKeyRow = { key: 'lab', collection: true, expanded: false, hasChildren: false, firstChild: null, parent: 'c6' };
const CHILD: TreeKeyRow = { key: 'c6', collection: true, expanded: false, hasChildren: true, firstChild: 'lab', parent: 'bio' };
const ALL: TreeKeyRow = { key: 'scope:all', collection: false, expanded: false, hasChildren: false, firstChild: null, parent: null };
const press = (key: string, over: Partial<TreeKeyInput> = {}) =>
  treeKeyAction({ key, shiftKey: false, altKey: false, ctrlKey: false, metaKey: false, composing: false, target: 'row', contextMenuKey: false, reader: false, row: OPEN, ...over });
const NONE = { do: 'none' };

describe('the name field inside a row (spec 3.4: IME-safe)', () => {
  const field = (key: string, over: Partial<TreeKeyInput> = {}) => press(key, { target: 'rename', row: null, ...over });
  it('↩ finishes the edit and esc drops it', () => {
    expect(field('Enter')).toEqual({ do: 'commit' });
    expect(field('Escape')).toEqual({ do: 'cancel' });
  });
  it('during a composition ↩ and esc are the IME\'s: nothing finishes', () => {
    expect(field('Enter', { composing: true })).toEqual({ do: 'swallow' });
    expect(field('Escape', { composing: true })).toEqual({ do: 'swallow' });
  });
  it('every other key stays in the field: the row\'s own handling (arrows, Home/End, Space) must never see it', () => {
    for (const key of ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown', 'Home', 'End', ' ', 'a', '가', 'Backspace', 'Tab']) expect(field(key), key).toEqual({ do: 'swallow' });
  });
});

describe('a collection row', () => {
  it('↩ renames it; on a special view it does nothing', () => {
    expect(press('Enter')).toEqual({ do: 'rename', key: 'bio' });
    expect(press('Enter', { row: ALL })).toEqual(NONE);
  });
  it('→ on an open row goes to its first child — named by the model, not by the next row in the DOM', () => {
    expect(press('ArrowRight')).toEqual({ do: 'goto', key: 'c6' });
    expect(press('ArrowRight', { row: CLOSED })).toEqual(NONE); // RAC opens it
    expect(press('ArrowRight', { row: LEAF })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('ArrowRight', { row: ALL })).toEqual(NONE);
  });
  it('← on a closed row or a leaf goes to the parent; on an open row RAC folds it; a top-level row has no parent', () => {
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { row: LEAF })).toEqual({ do: 'goto', key: 'c6' });
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { row: CHILD })).toEqual({ do: 'goto', key: 'bio' }); // closed, with children
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { row: { ...CHILD, expanded: true } })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { row: CLOSED })).toEqual(NONE); // no parent
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { row: ALL })).toEqual(NONE);
  });
  it('typing is not type-ahead (design-spec 7.1): letters, digits, Hangul and the IME\'s Process key are held back; Space, arrows, Home/End are not', () => {
    for (const key of ['a', 'Z', '3', '과', '.', 'Process']) expect(press(key), key).toEqual({ do: 'block' });
    expect(press('가', { composing: true })).toEqual({ do: 'block' });
    for (const key of [' ', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Home', 'End', 'PageDown', 'Tab']) expect(press(key), key).toEqual(NONE);
  });
  it('keys with ⌘ ⌃ ⌥ or ⇧ are RAC\'s or the menu\'s', () => {
    for (const over of [{ metaKey: true }, { ctrlKey: true }, { altKey: true }, { shiftKey: true }]) {
      expect(press('Enter', over), JSON.stringify(over)).toEqual(NONE);
      expect(press('ArrowRight', over), JSON.stringify(over)).toEqual(NONE);
      expect(press('a', over), JSON.stringify(over)).toEqual(NONE);
    }
  });
  it('⇧F10 or the menu key opens a collection\'s menu and nothing for a special view', () => {
    expect(press('F10', { shiftKey: true, contextMenuKey: true })).toEqual({ do: 'menu', key: 'bio' });
    expect(press('ContextMenu', { contextMenuKey: true, row: LEAF })).toEqual({ do: 'menu', key: 'lab' });
    expect(press('F10', { shiftKey: true, contextMenuKey: true, row: ALL })).toEqual({ do: 'ignoreMenu' });
  });
  it('a key that is not on a row (a button inside it, the heading) is not ours', () => {
    expect(press('Enter', { target: 'other', row: null })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('a', { target: 'other', row: null })).toEqual(NONE);
  });
  it('in the reader the sidebar is a way back: ↩ and the arrows are RAC\'s (press, move), typing is still held back', () => {
    expect(press('Enter', { reader: true })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('ArrowRight', { reader: true })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('ArrowLeft', { reader: true, row: LEAF })).toEqual(NONE);
    expect(press('a', { reader: true })).toEqual({ do: 'block' });
    expect(press('F10', { shiftKey: true, contextMenuKey: true, reader: true })).toEqual({ do: 'menu', key: 'bio' });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { NAME_MAX, NEW_COLLECTION_NAME, finishName, tooLong } from './nameEdit';

describe('what a finished name means (spec 3.4)', () => {
  it('starts a new collection as 새 컬렉션 (U+00A0), Finder\'s new folder', () => {

    expect(finishName('가'.repeat(201), 'x')).toEqual({ tooLong: true });
```

```ts
import type { LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import type { CollectionNode, OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';

/** The keys of the special views in the tree: a prefix no collection id (a uuid) has. */
export const SCOPE_KEYS = { all: 'scope:all', recent: 'scope:recent', unfiled: 'scope:unfiled', duplicates: 'scope:duplicates' } as const;
export type SpecialKind = keyof typeof SCOPE_KEYS;
/** The key of the row being created (it is not a collection yet). */
export const DRAFT_KEY = 'draft:new';

export const keyOfScope = (scope: LibraryScope): string => (scope.kind === 'collection' ? scope.id : SCOPE_KEYS[scope.kind]);

export function scopeOfKey(key: string): LibraryScope {
  const kind = (Object.keys(SCOPE_KEYS) as SpecialKind[]).find((k) => SCOPE_KEYS[k] === key);
  return kind ? ({ kind } as LibraryScope) : { kind: 'collection', id: key };
}

export interface SpecialRow {
  kind: SpecialKind;
  /** The number on the row, or null: 최근 연 자료 has none (the mockup), and an empty view says nothing. */
  count: number | null;
}

/**
 * The special views that are drawn (spec 3.2): 내 라이브러리 always, the others only with content — and the one being
 * looked at stays while it is, even after its last item has gone (it is left by choosing another view).
 */
export function visibleSpecials(input: { itemCount: number; hasRecent: boolean; model: OrganizeModel | undefined; current: LibraryScope['kind'] }): SpecialRow[] {
  const { model, current } = input;
  const unfiled = model?.unfiled.size ?? 0;
  const duplicates = model?.duplicates.size ?? 0;
  const rows: SpecialRow[] = [{ kind: 'all', count: input.itemCount > 0 ? input.itemCount : null }];
  if (input.hasRecent || current === 'recent') rows.push({ kind: 'recent', count: null });
  if ((model !== undefined && model.collectionCount > 0 && unfiled > 0) || current === 'unfiled') rows.push({ kind: 'unfiled', count: unfiled > 0 ? unfiled : null });
  if (duplicates > 0 || current === 'duplicates') rows.push({ kind: 'duplicates', count: duplicates > 0 ? duplicates : null });
  return rows;
}

/** The collections above `id`, root first (not `id` itself). */
export const ancestorIds = (model: OrganizeModel, id: string): string[] => model.path(id).slice(0, -1).map((n) => n.id);

/** Every collection below `id`. */
export function descendantIds(model: OrganizeModel, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (n: CollectionNode) => {
    for (const c of n.children) {
      out.push(c.id);
      walk(c);
    }
  };
  const node = model.node(id);
  if (node) walk(node);
  return out;
}

/**
 * The keys of the collection rows in the order they are drawn: the tree's order, only below open parents. A row being
 * created (`draftParent` is its parent, null for the top) goes first among its siblings; below a closed parent it is not
 * drawn, so it is not listed.
 */
export function visibleCollectionKeys(model: OrganizeModel, expanded: ReadonlySet<string>, draftParent?: string | null): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (nodes: readonly CollectionNode[], parent: string | null) => {
    if (draftParent !== undefined && draftParent === parent) out.push(DRAFT_KEY);
    for (const n of nodes) {
      out.push(n.id);
      if (expanded.has(n.id)) walk(n.children, n.id);
    }
  };
  walk(model.roots, null);
  return out;
}
```

`R/sidebar/treeKeys.ts`:
```ts
/** What the tree knows about the row a key went to: from the model, never from the DOM (the next row may not be mounted). */
export interface TreeKeyRow {
  key: string;
  collection: boolean;
  expanded: boolean;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  firstChild: string | null;
  parent: string | null;
}

export interface TreeKeyInput {
  key: string;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  altKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
  /** isComposing, or the keyCode 229 macOS IMEs send. */
  composing: boolean;
  /** The row itself, the name field inside a row, or anything else (a button in a row, the heading). */
  target: 'row' | 'rename' | 'other';
  /** ⇧F10 or the menu key (ui/contextMenuKey.ts). */
  contextMenuKey: boolean;
  /** The reader is showing: the sidebar is a way back, and moving the cursor changes no view. */
  reader: boolean;
  row: TreeKeyRow | null;
}

export type TreeKeyAction =
  | { do: 'none' } // not ours: React Aria's row handling and the browser go on
  | { do: 'swallow' } // stop it before the row sees it; the browser's default (typing) stays
  | { do: 'block' } // held back from type-ahead (design-spec 7.1)
  | { do: 'commit' }
  | { do: 'cancel' }
  | { do: 'rename'; key: string }
  | { do: 'menu'; key: string }
  | { do: 'ignoreMenu' }
  | { do: 'goto'; key: string }; // select this row and move the cursor there

const NONE: TreeKeyAction = { do: 'none' };

/**
 * One decision for a key in the sidebar (spec 3.3, 3.4), made from facts only so it is testable and does not depend on
 * what the virtualizer has mounted. The tree's wrapper runs it in the capture phase, before React Aria's row does:
 * a row handles Home/End/arrows/Space in the capture phase, which would take them from the name field inside it.
 */
export function treeKeyAction(i: TreeKeyInput): TreeKeyAction {
  if (i.target === 'rename') {
    if (i.composing) return { do: 'swallow' };
    if (i.key === 'Enter') return { do: 'commit' };
    if (i.key === 'Escape') return { do: 'cancel' };
    return { do: 'swallow' };
  }
  const row = i.row;
  if (i.target !== 'row' || row === null) return NONE;
  if (i.contextMenuKey) return row.collection ? { do: 'menu', key: row.key } : { do: 'ignoreMenu' };
  if (i.metaKey || i.ctrlKey || i.altKey || i.shiftKey) return NONE;
  if (i.key === 'Enter') return row.collection && !i.reader ? { do: 'rename', key: row.key } : NONE;
  if (!i.reader && row.collection) {
    if (i.key === 'ArrowRight' && row.hasChildren && row.expanded && row.firstChild !== null) return { do: 'goto', key: row.firstChild };
    if (i.key === 'ArrowLeft' && !(row.hasChildren && row.expanded) && row.parent !== null) return { do: 'goto', key: row.parent };
  }
  if (i.composing || i.key === 'Process' || (i.key.length === 1 && i.key !== ' ')) return { do: 'block' };
  return NONE;
}
```

```ts
import { t } from '../strings';

/** The longest name the database takes (collections-repository cleanName). */
export const NAME_MAX = 200;
/** What a new collection starts as, and what an empty name falls back to — Finder's new folder. */
export const NEW_COLLECTION_NAME = t.organize.sidebar.newName;

export type NameResult = { name: string } | { tooLong: true };

/**
 * A finished name (spec 3.4): normalized and trimmed the way the database does, so the count is the same; empty or blank
 * is `original` (no error); over the limit is refused.
 */
export function finishName(raw: string, original: string): NameResult {
  const name = raw.normalize('NFC').trim();
  if (name.length > NAME_MAX) return { tooLong: true };
  return { name: name === '' ? original : name };
}

/** Whether the name typed so far is over the limit (the field's note). */
export const tooLong = (raw: string): boolean => raw.normalize('NFC').trim().length > NAME_MAX;
```

```ts
  name: string;
}

/**
 * The collection an import files into (spec 3.7): `into` undefined = the one being viewed, null = none, an id = that one
 * (a menu row's choice). Anything that is not a live collection of the snapshot is none — the library and the special
 * views never take imports.
 */
export function importTarget(model: OrganizeModel | undefined, scope: LibraryScope, into: string | null | undefined): ImportTarget | null {
```

```ts
import type { Collection, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';

/** A created collection, as the snapshot has it (the notice that follows brings the real snapshot; this is the frame between). */
export function withCollection(s: OrganizeSnapshot, c: Pick<Collection, 'id' | 'name' | 'parentId' | 'createdAt'>): OrganizeSnapshot {
  if (s.collections.some((x) => x.id === c.id)) return s;
  return { ...s, collections: [...s.collections, { id: c.id, name: c.name, parentId: c.parentId, createdAt: c.createdAt }] };
}

export function withRenamed(s: OrganizeSnapshot, id: string, name: string): OrganizeSnapshot {
  if (!s.collections.some((x) => x.id === id)) return s;
  return { ...s, collections: s.collections.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, name } : x)) };
}

/** Collections removed with their memberships (their items stay in the library). */
export function withoutCollections(s: OrganizeSnapshot, ids: ReadonlySet<string>): OrganizeSnapshot {
  return {
    ...s,
    collections: s.collections.filter((x) => !ids.has(x.id)),
    members: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(s.members).filter(([id]) => !ids.has(id))),
  };
}
```

`R/library/import-flow.ts` — 맨 위 두 줄(`import type … ; import { t } …`)과 `ImportReport`·`ImportFlowDeps`·`settleImport`(원문 1–45행)를 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
import type { DuplicateChoice, ImportOutcome, StorageMode } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';

export type { DuplicateChoice } from '@learn/domain';

export interface ImportReport {
  imported: number;
  /** Of `imported`, the items that went into the collection asked for (the outcome carries `collectionId` only then). */
  filed: number;
  /** Existing items put into that collection because 가져오지 않음 was chosen for their duplicates: the ones it did not have yet. */
  filedExisting: number;
  failed: Array<{ name: string; message: string }>;
  /** The user chose 기존 자료 열기 for this existing item (the last such choice wins). */
  openItemId: string | null;
}

export interface ImportFlowDeps {
  /** Ask about one duplicate (the native duplicate sheet, ui.confirmDuplicate). */
  confirm(dup: { path: string; existingItemId: string }): Promise<DuplicateChoice>;
  /** Import one path again with allowDuplicate (새 자료로 추가), into the collection when one was asked for. */
  importAgain(path: string, mode: StorageMode, collectionId: string | null): Promise<ImportOutcome[]>;
  /** collections.addItems: how many of these items the collection did not have yet. */
  fileExisting(collectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<number>;
}

const fileName = (p: string) => p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || p;

/**
 * One import's outcomes → questions about duplicates (in order) → a report for the toasts. With a collection asked for, an
 * existing item whose duplicate was left out ("가져오지 않음") goes into it too, in one call after the questions.
 */
export async function settleImport(outcomes: readonly ImportOutcome[], mode: StorageMode, deps: ImportFlowDeps, collectionId: string | null = null): Promise<ImportReport> {
  const report: ImportReport = { imported: 0, filed: 0, filedExisting: 0, failed: [], openItemId: null };
  const take = (list: readonly ImportOutcome[]) => {
    for (const o of list) {
      if (o.status === 'imported') {
        report.imported++;
        if (o.collectionId !== undefined) report.filed++;
      } else if (o.status === 'failed') report.failed.push({ name: fileName(o.path), message: o.message });
    }
  };
  take(outcomes);
  const left: string[] = [];
  for (const o of outcomes) {
    if (o.status !== 'duplicate') continue;
    const choice = await deps.confirm({ path: o.path, existingItemId: o.existingItemId });
    if (choice === 'open') report.openItemId = o.existingItemId;
    if (choice === 'skip') left.push(o.existingItemId);
    if (choice !== 'add') continue;
    try {
      take(await deps.importAgain(o.path, mode, collectionId));
    } catch (e) {
      // One failed re-import is one failed file: what was imported before it is still reported.
      report.failed.push({ name: fileName(o.path), message: (e as Error).message });
    }
  }
  if (collectionId !== null && left.length > 0) {
    try {
      report.filedExisting = await deps.fileExisting(collectionId, left);
    } catch (e) {
      // The files were handled as asked; only the sentence about the collection is left unsaid.
      console.warn(`[import] filing the existing items failed: ${(e as { code?: string }).code ?? 'INTERNAL'}`);
    }
  }
  return report;
}

/**
 * The success toast of an import (spec 3.7): the plain sentence, or — when every imported item went into the collection asked
 * for — the sentence naming it, and under it the existing items 가져오지 않음 put there. Null when there is nothing to say.
 */
export function importToast(report: ImportReport, mode: StorageMode, into: { name: string } | null): ToastData | null {
  const filedInto = into !== null && report.imported > 0 && report.filed === report.imported ? into : null;
  const title =
    report.imported === 0
      ? null
      : filedInto
        ? (mode === 'linked' ? t.toast.linkedInto : t.toast.importedInto)(filedInto.name, report.imported)
        : (mode === 'linked' ? t.toast.linked : t.toast.imported)(report.imported);
  const existing = into !== null && report.filedExisting > 0 ? t.toast.filedExisting(into.name, report.filedExisting) : null;
  if (title === null && existing === null) return null;
  return { kind: 'success', title: title ?? existing!, ...(title !== null && existing !== null ? { lines: [existing] } : {}), testId: 'import-done' };
}
```

`R/ui/toasts.tsx` — `closeToast` 함수(`export function closeToast … }`) 다음에 더한다:
```ts
/**
 * A result toast that can be taken back (spec 3.4, 8.2): one verb, 실행 취소, which runs `undo` and closes the toast. A
 * refused undo is an error toast with the cause main gave (cause + next step), so the user is never left thinking it worked.
 */
export function showUndoToast(title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>, opts: { testId?: string } = {}): string {
  return showToast({
    kind: 'success',
    title,
    testId: opts.testId ?? 'undo-toast',
    action: {
      label: t.toast.undo,
      testId: 'undo-action',
      onAction: () =>
        void undo().catch((e: unknown) => showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.undoFailed, body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, testId: 'undo-failed' })),
    },
  });
}
```

`R/sidebar/sidebarEdit.ts`:
```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';

/** What the sidebar is naming: a collection being created (under `parentId`, null = the top) or one being renamed. */
export type Edit =
  | { kind: 'new'; parentId: string | null; text: string; onCreated?: (collectionId: string) => void }
  | { kind: 'rename'; id: string; text: string };

export interface SidebarEditState {
  edit: Edit | null;
  /** What had the focus when the edit began: it gets the focus back when the edit ends. */
  opener: Element | null;
  /** The create or rename call is out: the field is read-only and nothing else finishes the edit. */
  busy: boolean;
  /** Set by `end`: the sidebar gives the focus back (to `opener` when it can) and clears this. */
  restoreTo: { opener: Element | null } | null;
  begin(edit: Edit, opener?: Element | null): void;
  setText(text: string): void;
  setBusy(busy: boolean): void;
  /** Ends the edit. `restore` (default): the sidebar gives the focus back to the opener; not after a click elsewhere, which already put it somewhere. */
  end(restore?: boolean): void;
  clearRestore(): void;
}

export const useSidebarEdit = create<SidebarEditState>()((set, get) => ({
  edit: null,
  opener: null,
  busy: false,
  restoreTo: null,
  begin: (edit, opener = null) => set({ edit, opener, busy: false, restoreTo: null }),
  setText: (text) => {
    const edit = get().edit;
    if (edit && edit.text !== text) set({ edit: { ...edit, text } });
  },
  setBusy: (busy) => set({ busy }),
  end: (restore = true) => {
    const { edit, opener } = get();
    if (edit) set({ edit: null, opener: null, busy: false, restoreTo: restore ? { opener } : null });
  },
  clearRestore: () => set({ restoreTo: null }),
}));
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Collection, LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { createCollectionActions, type ActionDeps } from './collectionActions';
import { useSidebarEdit } from './sidebarEdit';

const AT = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const collection = (id: string, name: string, parentId: string | null = null): Collection => ({ id, name, parentId, itemCount: 0, createdAt: AT, updatedAt: null });
const BASE: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'lab', name: '실험', parentId: 'c6', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c7', name: '7장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'stats', name: '통계', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
  ],
  tags: [], members: {}, tagged: {}, duplicates: [],
};
const NEW = '새\u00a0컬렉션';

function setup(over: Partial<ActionDeps> = {}, startAt: LibraryScope = { kind: 'all' }) {
  let snapshot = BASE;

  const deps: ActionDeps = {
    collections: {
      create: vi.fn(async ({ name, parentId }) => collection('new1', name, parentId)),
      rename: vi.fn(async ({ collectionId, name }) => collection(collectionId, name)),
      remove: vi.fn(async () => {}),
      restore: vi.fn(async ({ collectionId }) => collection(collectionId, '되살림')),
    },
    confirm: vi.fn(async () => true),
    model: () => buildOrganizeModel(snapshot, []),
    scope: () => scope,
    setScope: vi.fn((s: LibraryScope) => void (scope = s)),
    patch: vi.fn((update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot) => void (snapshot = update(snapshot))),
    expand: vi.fn(),
    showSidebar: vi.fn(),
    opener: () => null,
    failed: vi.fn(),
    undoToast: vi.fn(),
    ...over,
  };
  return { deps, actions: createCollectionActions(deps), snapshot: () => snapshot, scope: () => scope };
}
const editNow = () => useSidebarEdit.getState().edit;
beforeEach(() => useSidebarEdit.setState({ edit: null, opener: null, busy: false, restoreTo: null }));

describe('a new collection (spec 3.4)', () => {
  it('shows the sidebar and starts a row named 새 컬렉션; ↩ creates it with the name typed and leaves the view where it was', async () => {
    const { actions, deps, snapshot, scope } = setup();
    actions.startNew();
    expect(deps.showSidebar).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(editNow()).toEqual({ kind: 'new', parentId: null, text: NEW });
    await actions.finish('  논문 읽기 ', 'enter');
    expect(deps.collections.create).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ name: '논문 읽기', parentId: null });
    expect(snapshot().collections.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ id: 'new1', name: '논문 읽기', parentId: null });
    expect(editNow()).toBeNull();
    expect(useSidebarEdit.getState().restoreTo).not.toBeNull();
    expect(deps.setScope).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(scope()).toEqual({ kind: 'all' });
  });
  it('under a parent: the parent is opened first, and whoever asked is told the id', async () => {
    const onCreated = vi.fn();
    const { actions, deps } = setup();
    actions.startNew({ parentId: 'bio', onCreated });
    expect(deps.expand).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('bio');
    await actions.finish('8장', 'blur');
    expect(deps.collections.create).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ name: '8장', parentId: 'bio' });
    expect(onCreated).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('new1');
    expect(useSidebarEdit.getState().restoreTo).toBeNull(); // the click that left the field put the focus somewhere: not taken back
  });
  it('a parent that is not there starts nothing', () => {
    const { actions, deps } = setup();
    actions.startNew({ parentId: 'gone' });
    expect(editNow()).toBeNull();
    expect(deps.showSidebar).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('an empty or blank name creates the default name (no error); esc creates nothing', async () => {
    const { actions, deps } = setup();
    actions.startNew();
    await actions.finish('   ', 'enter');
    expect(deps.collections.create).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ name: NEW, parentId: null });
    actions.startNew();

    expect(editNow()).toBeNull();
    expect(deps.collections.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
  it('over 200 characters: ↩ changes nothing and the field stays; leaving the field drops the edit', async () => {

  it('a second finish while the call is out is ignored; a refused create is told and the edit ends', async () => {
```

`R/sidebar/collectionActions.ts`:
```ts
import type { Collection, LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { NEW_COLLECTION_NAME, finishName } from './nameEdit';
import { withCollection, withRenamed, withoutCollections } from './organizeCache';
import { descendantIds } from './rows';
import { useSidebarEdit } from './sidebarEdit';

/** Everything the collection actions touch outside themselves, so they run in a test without a window. */
export interface ActionDeps {
  collections: {
    create(input: { name: string; parentId: string | null }): Promise<Collection>;
    rename(input: { collectionId: string; name: string }): Promise<Collection>;
    remove(input: { collectionId: string }): Promise<void>;
    restore(input: { collectionId: string }): Promise<Collection>;
  };
  /** ui.confirm: the native sheet. */
  confirm(input: { message: string; detail?: string; confirm: string }): Promise<boolean>;
  model(): OrganizeModel | undefined;
  /** The scope shown. */
  scope(): LibraryScope;
  setScope(scope: LibraryScope): void;
  /** Changes the organize snapshot in the cache (the notice that follows brings the real one). */
  patch(update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot): void;
  /** Opens a collection's row in the tree and remembers it. */
  expand(collectionId: string): void;
  /** The sidebar is shown (it may be hidden when ⇧⌘N is pressed). */
  showSidebar(): void;
  /** What has the focus now (given back when the edit ends). */
  opener(): Element | null;
  failed(e: unknown): void;
  undoToast(title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>): void;
}

export interface CollectionActions {
  /** ⇧⌘N, 새 하위 컬렉션, 컬렉션에 추가 › 새 컬렉션: a row at the top (or under `parentId`), named in place. */
  startNew(opts?: { parentId?: string | null; onCreated?: (collectionId: string) => void }): void;
  startRename(collectionId: string): void;
  /**
   * Ends the edit with the text in the field: `enter` (↩), `blur` (a click elsewhere) or `scroll` (the row left the
   * virtual window). A name over the limit keeps the edit open on ↩ and drops it on the others.
   */
  finish(text: string, how: 'enter' | 'blur' | 'scroll'): Promise<void>;
  cancel(): void;
  remove(collectionId: string): Promise<void>;
}

export function createCollectionActions(deps: ActionDeps): CollectionActions {
  const edit = () => useSidebarEdit.getState();
  return {
    startNew(opts = {}) {
      const parentId = opts.parentId ?? null;
      if (parentId !== null && deps.model()?.node(parentId) === undefined) return;
      deps.showSidebar();
      if (parentId !== null) deps.expand(parentId);
      edit().begin({ kind: 'new', parentId, text: NEW_COLLECTION_NAME, ...(opts.onCreated ? { onCreated: opts.onCreated } : {}) }, deps.opener());
    },

    startRename(collectionId) {
      const node = deps.model()?.node(collectionId);
      if (!node) return;
      deps.showSidebar();
      edit().begin({ kind: 'rename', id: collectionId, text: node.name }, deps.opener());
    },

    async finish(text, how) {
      const s = edit();
      const current = s.edit;
      if (!current || s.busy) return;
      const original = current.kind === 'new' ? NEW_COLLECTION_NAME : (deps.model()?.node(current.id)?.name ?? '');
      const verdict = finishName(text, original);
      if ('tooLong' in verdict) {
        if (how !== 'enter') s.end(false);
        return;
      }
      s.setBusy(true);
      try {
        if (current.kind === 'new') {
          const made = await deps.collections.create({ name: verdict.name, parentId: current.parentId });
          deps.patch((snap) => withCollection(snap, made));
          current.onCreated?.(made.id);
        } else if (verdict.name !== original) {
          const renamed = await deps.collections.rename({ collectionId: current.id, name: verdict.name });
          deps.patch((snap) => withRenamed(snap, renamed.id, renamed.name));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      } finally {
        edit().end(how === 'enter'); // a click elsewhere or a scroll has put the focus where the user wants it
      }
    },

    cancel() {
      const s = edit();
      if (s.edit && !s.busy) s.end();
    },

    async remove(collectionId) {
      const model = deps.model();
      const node = model?.node(collectionId);
      if (!model || !node) return;
      const below = descendantIds(model, collectionId);
      const sure = await deps.confirm({ message: t.organize.remove.message(node.name), detail: t.organize.remove.detail(below.length), confirm: t.organize.remove.confirm });
      if (!sure) return;
      const scope = deps.scope();
      const viewed = scope.kind === 'collection' && (scope.id === collectionId || below.includes(scope.id));
      try {
        await deps.collections.remove({ collectionId });
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      deps.patch((snap) => withoutCollections(snap, new Set([collectionId, ...below])));
      if (viewed) deps.setScope(node.parentId === null ? { kind: 'all' } : { kind: 'collection', id: node.parentId });
      deps.undoToast(t.organize.remove.done(node.name), async () => {
        await deps.collections.restore({ collectionId });
      });
    },
  };
}
```
