`E/helpers.ts` 맨 끝에 더한다(`Locator`·`Page`·`ElectronApplication`은 이미 import돼 있다):
```ts
// ---- M5 sidebar and collections (Task 5) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** A special view's row (spec 3.2): 내 라이브러리, 최근 연 자료, 미분류, 중복 항목. */
export const specialRow = (page: Page, kind: 'all' | 'recent' | 'unfiled' | 'duplicates'): Locator => page.getByTestId(`nav-scope-${kind}`);
/** A collection's row in the tree. */
export const treeRow = (page: Page, collectionId: string): Locator => page.getByTestId(`nav-collection-${collectionId}`);

/**
 * dialog.showMessageBox replaced in main for the rest of the session (the ui.confirm sheet): it answers `answer` — 'confirm'
 * is the first button — and records every question. Calling it again resets the record.
 */
export async function stubConfirm(app: ElectronApplication, answer: 'confirm' | 'cancel'): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ dialog }, answer) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnConfirms?: unknown[]; __learnRealMessageBox?: typeof dialog.showMessageBox };
    g.__learnConfirms = [];
    g.__learnRealMessageBox ??= dialog.showMessageBox;
    dialog.showMessageBox = (async (...args: unknown[]) => {
      const o = (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : args[0]) as { message: string; detail?: string; buttons?: string[]; defaultId?: number; cancelId?: number };
      g.__learnConfirms!.push({ message: o.message, detail: o.detail ?? '', buttons: o.buttons ?? [], defaultId: o.defaultId ?? null, cancelId: o.cancelId ?? null });
      return { response: answer === 'confirm' ? 0 : 1, checkboxChecked: false };
    }) as typeof dialog.showMessageBox;
  }, answer);
}
export interface ConfirmCall {
  message: string;
  detail: string;
  buttons: string[];
  defaultId: number | null;
  cancelId: number | null;
}
/** The questions the stubbed sheet was asked since `stubConfirm`, oldest first. */
export const confirmCalls = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<ConfirmCall[]> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnConfirms?: ConfirmCall[] }).__learnConfirms ?? []);

/** A made-up tree of collections: ids in creation order, each one's parent (null at the top) and children (in creation order). */
export interface CollectionTree {
  ids: string[];
  parent: Record<string, string | null>;
  children: Record<string, string[]>;
}
/**
 * `count` collections named 과목 000, 과목 001 … (so creation order is name order), eight at the top and then breadth first
 * with four children each, at most four levels deep (200 fit). Made through the page's own API, one call each.
 */
export async function createCollectionTree(page: Page, count: number): Promise<CollectionTree> {
  return page.evaluate(async (count) => {
    const ids: string[] = [];
    const parent: Record<string, string | null> = {};
    const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    const depth: Record<string, number> = {};
    const queue: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let parentId: string | null = null;
      if (i >= 8) {
        while ((children[queue[0]!] ?? []).length >= 4 || depth[queue[0]!]! >= 4) queue.shift();
        parentId = queue[0]!;
      }
      const made = await window.learn.collections.create({ name: `과목 ${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}`, parentId });
      if (!made.ok) throw new Error(`collections.create failed: ${made.code}`);
      const id = made.data.id;
      ids.push(id);
      parent[id] = parentId;
      children[id] = [];
      depth[id] = parentId === null ? 1 : depth[parentId]! + 1;
      if (parentId !== null) children[parentId]!.push(id);
      queue.push(id);
    }
    return { ids, parent, children };
  }, count);
}
/** Every collection that has children stored as open (sidebar.expanded), then the page reloaded so the tree starts that way. */
export async function expandAll(page: Page, tree: CollectionTree): Promise<void> {
  const open = tree.ids.filter((id) => tree.children[id]!.length > 0);
  await page.evaluate((ids) => window.learn.settings.set({ key: 'sidebar.expanded', value: ids }), open);
  await page.reload();
  await page.getByTestId('app-ready').waitFor({ state: 'attached' });
}
/** ⌘K, the query, and the row of `commandId` (the palette closes and the command runs from where the focus was). */
export async function runPalette(page: Page, app: ElectronApplication, query: string, commandId: CommandId): Promise<void> {
  await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
  await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill(query);
  await page.locator(`[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="${commandId}"]`).click();
}
```

`E/sidebar.spec.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
// The sidebar (M5 spec 3.2, 3.3): the special views, the collection tree under React Aria's Virtualizer, its keys and its menu.
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Locator, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
import { commandById, type CommandId } from '../../packages/domain/src/commands';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, createCollection, createCollectionTree, expandAll, importPaths, launch, openItem, organizeSnapshot, recordedPopupPoints, recordedPopups, runMenuCommand,
  specialRow, stubContextMenu, treeRow, type CollectionTree,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const dirs = (testInfo: TestInfo) => [testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata')] as const;
const L = (id: CommandId) => commandById(id).label;
const title = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('toolbar-title');
/** The key of the tree row that has the focus (a collection's id, or scope:…), or null. */
const focusedKey = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[role="row"][data-key]')?.getAttribute('data-key') ?? null);
const nameOf = (tree: CollectionTree, id: string) => `과목 ${String(tree.ids.indexOf(id)).padStart(3, '0')}`;
/** The rows of an everything-open tree, top to bottom: depth first, children in name (= creation) order. */
function visibleOrder(tree: CollectionTree): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (id: string) => {
    out.push(id);
    for (const child of tree.children[id]!) walk(child);
  };
  for (const id of tree.ids) if (tree.parent[id] === null) walk(id);
  return out;
}
/** The row is wholly inside the tree's scroll area. */
async function inView(tree: Locator, row: Locator): Promise<boolean> {
  const [t, r] = [await tree.boundingBox(), await row.boundingBox()];
  return t !== null && r !== null && r.y >= t.y - 0.5 && r.y + r.height <= t.y + t.height + 0.5;
}

test('special views appear with content and 내 라이브러리 always; the one being viewed stays until another is chosen (spec 3.2)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [pdf, ko] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'all').locator('.count')).toHaveText('2');
    for (const kind of ['recent', 'unfiled', 'duplicates'] as const) await expect(specialRow(page, kind), kind).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('sidebar-hint')).toHaveText('컬렉션이 없습니다. 자료를 묶으려면 새\u00a0컬렉션을 만드세요.');

    // 최근 연 자료: once an item was opened (the reader reports it); no number on its row.
    await openItem(page, pdf!.title);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toBeVisible();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'nav.back');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'recent')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'recent').locator('.count')).toHaveCount(0);

    // 미분류: needs a collection, and the items in none of them.
    const a = await createCollection(page, '가');
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'unfiled').locator('.count')).toHaveText('2');
    await addToCollection(page, a, [pdf!.id]);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'unfiled').locator('.count')).toHaveText('1');
    await specialRow(page, 'unfiled').click();
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('미분류');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);
    await addToCollection(page, a, [ko!.id]);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'unfiled')).toBeVisible(); // being viewed: the row stays after its last item went
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'unfiled').locator('.count')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('scope-empty-unfiled')).toContainText('모든 자료가 컬렉션에 들어 있습니다');
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'an empty special view');
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'unfiled')).toHaveCount(0);

    // 중복 항목: items that share a file.
    await page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'managed', allowDuplicate: true }), PDF);
    await expect(specialRow(page, 'duplicates').locator('.count')).toHaveText('2');
    await specialRow(page, 'duplicates').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'the special views');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

    await treeRow(page, bio).dblclick();

    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('6장');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);

    await app.close();
  }
});

test('200 collections: the tree is virtual and its keys follow the model — Home/End, →/← by first child and parent, no type-ahead, one Tab stop', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const tree = await createCollectionTree(page, 200);
    await expandAll(page, tree);
    const scroller = page.getByTestId('sidebar-tree');
    expect(await page.locator('[data-testid="sidebar-tree"] [role="row"][data-key]').count(), 'rows in the DOM').toBeLessThan(90);
    // The "컬렉션" heading is 36 px, starting where the special views end (12 gap + 24 label), whatever the density.
    const g = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const specials = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="nav-scope-"]')];
      const heading = document.querySelector('.sidebar-tree .tree-heading')!.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { lastSpecialBottom: specials.at(-1)!.getBoundingClientRect().bottom, headingTop: heading.top, headingHeight: heading.height };
    });
    expect(g.headingTop).toBeCloseTo(g.lastSpecialBottom, 0);
    expect(g.headingHeight).toBe(36);

    // F6 lands on the selected row; ↑↓ run on through the special views into the tree and the view follows.
    await page.keyboard.press('F6');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe('scope:all');
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('미분류');
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    const first = tree.ids[0]!;
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(first);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('과목 000');

    // → on an open row: its first child, named by the model. ← folds an open row, then goes to the parent.
    const child = tree.children[first]![0]!;
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(child);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText(nameOf(tree, child));
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft');
    await expect(treeRow(page, child)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(child);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(first);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('과목 000');

    // No type-ahead: a letter or a Hangul syllable moves nothing.
    for (const key of ['a', '과']) {
      await page.keyboard.press(key);
      expect(await focusedKey(page), key).toBe(first);
      await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('과목 000');
    }

    // End is the last row of the tree and scrolls to it; Home goes back to 내 라이브러리 and to the top.
    const last = visibleOrder(tree).at(-1)!;
    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(last);
    await expect(treeRow(page, last)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await inView(scroller, treeRow(page, last))).toBe(true);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText(nameOf(tree, last));
    await page.keyboard.press('Home');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe('scope:all');
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('내 라이브러리');
    expect(await scroller.evaluate((e) => e.scrollTop)).toBe(0);

    // The tree is one Tab stop: Tab leaves it.
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement?.closest('[data-testid="sidebar-tree"]') ?? null) !== null)).toBe(false);

    // → at the bottom edge: the open row is the last one fully in view, so its first child may not be mounted yet.
    const order = visibleOrder(tree);
    const parentId = tree.ids.filter((id) => tree.parent[id] === null)[5]!;
    const firstChild = tree.children[parentId]![0]!;
    const specials = await page.locator('[data-testid^="nav-scope-"]').count();
    const rowHeight = (await specialRow(page, 'all').boundingBox())!.height;
    const clientHeight = await scroller.evaluate((e) => e.clientHeight);
    const rowTop = specials * rowHeight + 36 + order.indexOf(parentId) * rowHeight;
    await scroller.evaluate((e, top) => void (e.scrollTop = top), rowTop + rowHeight - clientHeight);
    await expect(treeRow(page, parentId)).toBeVisible();
    test.info().annotations.push({ type: 'first child mounted before →', description: String(await treeRow(page, firstChild).count()) });
    await treeRow(page, parentId).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    expect(await focusedKey(page)).toBe(firstChild);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText(nameOf(tree, firstChild));
    await expect(treeRow(page, firstChild)).toBeFocused();
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

`E/collections.spec.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
// Collections (M5 spec 3.4–3.7): naming a row in place, renaming, deleting with the sheet and 실행 취소, the empty states,
// and imports into the collection being viewed.
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page, type TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
import { platformAccelerator } from '../../packages/domain/src/accelerator';
import { commandById, type CommandId } from '../../packages/domain/src/commands';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, closeSheet, confirmCalls, createCollection, createCollectionTree, drag, dropSource, expandAll, expectWindow, importFiles, importPaths, launch, menuSnapshot,
  menuItemEnabled, organizeSnapshot, rowAt, runMenuCommand, runPalette, specialRow, stubConfirm, stubContextMenu, stubOpenDialog, treeRow, type MenuNode,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const NEW = '새\u00a0컬렉션';
const dirs = (testInfo: TestInfo) => [testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata')] as const;
const L = (id: CommandId) => commandById(id).label;
const title = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('toolbar-title');
const field = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('rename-input');
/** The collections' names in the snapshot, in creation order. */
const names = async (page: Page) => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections.map((c) => c.name);

test('⇧⌘N makes a row in the tree and names it in place; ↩ creates it and the view stays where it was (spec 3.4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await rowAt(page, 0).click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    expect(await field(page).inputValue()).toBe(NEW);
    expect(await field(page).evaluate((e: HTMLInputElement) => [e.selectionStart, e.selectionEnd])).toEqual([0, NEW.length]); // the whole name is selected
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'a collection being named');
    await page.keyboard.insertText('논문 읽기');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => names(page)).toEqual(['논문 읽기']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('sidebar-tree').getByText('논문 읽기')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('내 라이브러리'); // Finder's new folder: the table that was there stays
    await expect(rowAt(page, 0)).toBeFocused(); // and so does the focus

    // The header button does the same through the same command; it is not a Tab stop (the keys are ⇧⌘N and the palette).
    await expect(page.getByTestId('new-collection')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    await page.getByTestId('new-collection').click();
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await names(page)).toEqual(['논문 읽기']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('esc creates nothing, a click elsewhere creates it, an empty name makes the default one, and over 200 characters is held back', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await names(page)).toEqual([]);

    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await page.keyboard.insertText('가');
    await title(page).click(); // a click elsewhere finishes it
    await expect.poll(() => names(page)).toEqual(['가']);

    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await page.keyboard.press('Delete'); // the selected default name is gone: an empty field
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(() => names(page)).toEqual(['가', NEW]);

    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await page.keyboard.insertText('나'.repeat(201));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rename-note')).toHaveText('컬렉션 이름은 200자까지 쓸 수 있습니다.');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeVisible(); // ↩ did nothing
    expect(await names(page)).toEqual(['가', NEW]);
    await field(page).fill('나'.repeat(200));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('rename-note')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await names(page)).map((n) => n.length)).toEqual([1, NEW.length, 200]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('during a Korean composition ↩ and esc belong to the IME: nothing is created or dropped; after the commit ↩ creates (spec 3.4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'collection.new');
    await page.keyboard.press('Delete'); // the selected default name is gone: the composition starts in an empty field
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: '신호', selectionStart: 2, selectionEnd: 2 });
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await names(page)).toEqual([]);
    // The macOS IME sends keyCode 229 without isComposing: the same.
    for (const key of ['Enter', 'Escape'] as const) {
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyDown', key, code: key, windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyUp', key, code: key, windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(200);
    await expect(field(page)).toBeVisible();
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: '신호' }); // commits the composition
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveValue('신호');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(() => names(page)).toEqual(['신호']);
    // Renaming is the same field: arrows and Home/End inside it do not move the tree.
    await treeRow(page, (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections[0]!.id).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    for (const key of ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End', 'ArrowDown', 'Space']) await page.keyboard.press(key);
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('new sub-collection from the menu and the palette: the parent opens and the child is named under it', async ({}, testInfo) => {

    const c6 = (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections.find((c) => c.name === '6장')!.id;
    await expect(treeRow(page, c6)).toBeVisible(); // the parent is open
    await expect(treeRow(page, bio)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await treeRow(page, c6).click();
    await runPalette(page, app, '하위', 'collection.newChild');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('rename by the ↩ key, the menu and the palette keeps the tree in name order and allows equal names', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '분자생물학');
    const c10 = await createCollection(page, '10장', bio);
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '6장', bio);
    const c7 = await createCollection(page, '7장', bio);
    await treeRow(page, bio).locator('.disclosure').click();
    const labels = () => page.locator('[data-testid^="nav-collection-"] .label').allTextContents();
    await expect.poll(labels).toEqual(['분자생물학', '6장', '7장', '10장']); // numeric: 6 < 7 < 10

    await treeRow(page, c7).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); // ↩ renames
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    expect(await field(page).inputValue()).toBe('7장');
    await page.keyboard.insertText('8장');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(labels).toEqual(['분자생물학', '6장', '8장', '10장']);
    await expect(treeRow(page, c7)).toBeFocused(); // the focus comes back to the row

    await stubContextMenu(app, L('collection.rename'));
    await treeRow(page, c6).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.insertText('5장');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(labels).toEqual(['분자생물학', '5장', '8장', '10장']);

    // From the palette it is called by the longer name and acts on the collection being viewed (6장 → 5장).
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('컬렉션 이름');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="collection.rename"] .p-title')).toHaveText('컬렉션 이름 바꾸기');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await runPalette(page, app, '컬렉션 이름', 'collection.rename');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.insertText('10장'); // the same name as a sibling's: allowed
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(labels).toEqual(['분자생물학', '8장', '10장', '10장']);
    expect((await names(page)).filter((n) => n === '10장')).toHaveLength(2);

    // A blank name keeps the old one without a word.
    await treeRow(page, c10).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await field(page).fill('   ');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await names(page)).toContain('10장');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('delete asks in the sheet words, the view moves to the parent, and 실행 취소 brings it back without what was deleted before it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '분자생물학');
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '6장', bio);
    await createCollection(page, '7장', bio);
    await addToCollection(page, c6, [pdf!.id]);
    await stubConfirm(app, 'confirm');
    await stubContextMenu(app, L('collection.delete'));
    await treeRow(page, bio).locator('.disclosure').click();

    // 6장 goes first (it is deleted before its parent).
    await treeRow(page, c6).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(app)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]).toEqual({ message: '‘6장’을 삭제하겠습니까?', detail: '자료는 내 라이브러리에 남습니다.', buttons: ['삭제', '취소'], defaultId: 0, cancelId: 1 });
    await expect(treeRow(page, c6)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('분자생물학'); // the view that was inside it moved to the parent
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast').last()).toContainText('‘6장’을 삭제했습니다');
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1); // the item stays in the library

    // The parent has one live child left; the sheet says so and the view goes to 내 라이브러리 (it was top level).
    await treeRow(page, bio).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(app)).length).toBe(2);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[1]).toMatchObject({ message: '‘분자생물학’을 삭제하겠습니까?', detail: '하위 컬렉션 1개도 함께 삭제합니다.\n자료는 내 라이브러리에 남습니다.' });
    await expect.poll(() => names(page)).toEqual([]);
    await expect(title(page)).toHaveText('내 라이브러리');

    await page.getByTestId('undo-toast').last().getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    // 분자생물학 and 7장 are back; 6장 stays deleted — it was deleted by its own act, before its parent.
    await expect.poll(async () => (await names(page)).sort()).toEqual(['7장', '분자생물학']);
    await expect(treeRow(page, bio)).toBeVisible();

    // Cancelling the sheet changes nothing; a name ending in a vowel takes 를.
    const stats = await createCollection(page, '통계');
    await stubConfirm(app, 'cancel');
    await treeRow(page, stats).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(app)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]!.message).toBe('‘통계’를 삭제하겠습니까?');
    await expect(treeRow(page, stats)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await names(page)).toContain('통계');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('an empty collection says so in the table and the item panel, and its button brings files into it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const conf = await createCollection(page, '학회 준비');
    await treeRow(page, conf).click();
    const empty = page.getByTestId('collection-empty');
    await expect(empty).toContainText('이\u00a0컬렉션은 비어 있습니다');
    await expect(empty).toContainText('다른\u00a0컬렉션의 자료를 사이드바의 ‘학회 준비’로 끌어\u00a0놓거나, 파일을 바로 이\u00a0컬렉션으로 가져오세요.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('collection-empty-import')).toHaveText('이\u00a0컬렉션으로 가져오기…');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-collection').locator('.pe-title')).toHaveText('학회 준비');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('collection-empty-meta')).toHaveText(/^자료 0개 · 오늘\s(오전|오후)\s\d{1,2}:\d{2} 만듦$/);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('0개');
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'an empty collection');

    // A collection whose items are all in a sub-collection is not empty.
    const parent = await createCollection(page, '논문');
    const sub = await createCollection(page, '2024', parent);
    await addToCollection(page, sub, [pdf!.id]);
    await treeRow(page, parent).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('collection-empty')).toHaveCount(0);

    // The button files the open panel's pick into this collection.
    await treeRow(page, conf).click();
    await stubOpenDialog(app, [KO_PDF]);
    await page.getByTestId('collection-empty-import').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('‘학회 준비’에 자료 1개를 가져왔습니다');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(treeRow(page, conf).locator('.count')).toHaveText('1');
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('imports go into the collection being viewed: ⌘O, a window drop with the overlay naming it, and a duplicate left out is filed there too (spec 3.7)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const { app, page } = s;
  try {
    const a = await createCollection(page, '논문');
    await treeRow(page, a).click();
    await stubOpenDialog(app, [PDF]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'file.importManaged');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done')).toHaveText('‘논문’에 자료 1개를 가져왔습니다');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[a]?.length).toBe(1);

    // In 내 라이브러리 nothing is filed.
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await stubOpenDialog(app, [KO_PDF]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'file.importManaged');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: /^자료 1개를 가져왔습니다$/ })).toBeVisible();
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[a]).toHaveLength(1);

    // A window drop: the overlay names the collection, and the file goes into it.
    await treeRow(page, a).click();
    await dropSource(page, [MP4]);
    await drag(page, 'dragenter', 'source');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('drop-overlay').getByRole('heading')).toHaveText('‘논문’으로 가져오기');
    await drag(page, 'dragover', 'source');
    await drag(page, 'drop', 'source');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: '‘논문’에 자료 1개를 가져왔습니다' }).last()).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[a]?.length).toBe(2);

    // 가져오지 않음 for a duplicate files the item that is already in the library into this collection.
    const b = await createCollection(page, '발표');
    await treeRow(page, b).click();
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => importFiles(s, [PDF]));
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape'); // esc = leave it out
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: '이미 있는 자료 1개를 ‘발표’에 넣었습니다' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[b]?.length).toBe(1);
    // A second time there is nothing new to file: no such sentence.
    const again = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => importFiles(s, [PDF]));
    await closeSheet(again, 'Escape');
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: '이미 있는 자료 1개를 ‘발표’에 넣었습니다' })).toHaveCount(1);
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[b]).toHaveLength(1);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the menu bar has 새 컬렉션 in 파일; the collection commands are offered by the palette only while a collection is viewed', async ({}, testInfo) => {

    expect(item).toMatchObject({ label: '새\u00a0컬렉션', accelerator: platformAccelerator('Shift+CmdOrCtrl+N', process.platform), enabled: true });
    for (const id of ['collection.newChild', 'collection.rename', 'collection.importInto', 'collection.delete'] as const) expect(flat(await menuSnapshot(app)).some((n) => n.id === id), id).toBe(false);

test('a name being typed survives a small scroll and is saved when its row scrolls out of the virtual window', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const tree = await createCollectionTree(page, 60);
    await expandAll(page, tree);
    const first = tree.ids[0]!;
    await treeRow(page, first).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.insertText('첫째');
    const scroller = page.getByTestId('sidebar-tree');
    await scroller.evaluate((e) => void (e.scrollTop = 20));
    await expect(field(page)).toBeFocused(); // still mounted: a small scroll changes nothing
    await scroller.evaluate((e) => void (e.scrollTop = e.scrollHeight));
    await expect(field(page)).toHaveCount(0); // the row left the window; the edit ended
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections.find((c) => c.id === first)?.name).toBe('첫째');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```


를 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
  const itemTarget = useMemo(() => ({ itemIds: env.view === 'library' ? env.selection() : [] }), [env]);
  // The collection commands act on the collection being viewed (spec 9.3): the palette hands it over as their target, and
  // they are off — so not listed — while none is.
  const scope = useLibrary((s) => s.scope);
  const { model } = useOrganize();
  const collectionTarget = useMemo(() => (scope.kind === 'collection' && model?.node(scope.id) ? { collectionIds: [scope.id] } : {}), [scope, model]);
  const targetFor = (c: CommandSpec): CommandTarget => (c.contexts.includes('item') ? itemTarget : c.contexts.includes('collection') ? collectionTarget : {});
  const needsTarget = (c: CommandSpec) => c.contexts.includes('item') || c.contexts.includes('collection');
  const targeted = useMemo(
    () => new Set(COMMANDS.filter((c) => needsTarget(c) && inPalette(c) && isEnabled(c.id, targetFor(c))).map((c) => c.id)),
    [isEnabled, itemTarget, collectionTarget], // targetFor reads exactly these two
  );
  const targetOf = (id: CommandId) => targetFor(commandById(id));
```
그리고 목록 줄(원문 `COMMANDS.filter((c) => inPalette(c) && (c.contexts.includes('item') ? itemCommands.has(c.id) : isEnabled(c.id))),`)을 `COMMANDS.filter((c) => inPalette(c) && (needsTarget(c) ? targeted.has(c.id) : isEnabled(c.id))),`로. import에 `type CommandSpec`(`@learn/domain`)·`type CommandTarget`(`../commands/registry`)·`useLibrary`(`../state/library-store`)·`useOrganize`(`../organize/useOrganize`)를 더한다.

`R/sidebar/useExpanded.ts`:
```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { SIDEBAR_EXPANDED_MAX } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { saveSetting } from '../data/saveSetting';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { parseExpanded } from '../organize/viewSettings';

/** The stored list of open collections (`sidebar.expanded`), read once; writes go through the same cache entry (saveSetting). */
export function useExpandedRead() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: keys.expanded, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'sidebar.expanded' })), staleTime: Infinity });
}

/**
 * The open collections the tree draws, and whether they are known: the read has answered (a failed read is "none open") and
 * the snapshot is there to tell which stored ids still exist. Derived from the cache entry, so a change saved at once shows.
 */
export function useExpanded(model: OrganizeModel | undefined): { expanded: ReadonlySet<string>; settled: boolean } {
  const read = useExpandedRead();
  const expanded = useMemo(() => new Set(parseExpanded(read.data, (id) => model?.node(id) !== undefined)), [read.data, model]);
  return { expanded, settled: model !== undefined && (read.isSuccess || read.isError) };
}

/** Writes the open collections (at most as many as the setting takes). */
export function saveExpanded(ids: ReadonlySet<string>): void {
  saveSetting('sidebar.expanded', [...ids].slice(0, SIDEBAR_EXPANDED_MAX));
}
```

`R/sidebar/actions.ts`:
```ts
import type { LibraryItem, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { organizeModelFor, type OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { parseExpanded } from '../organize/viewSettings';
import { sidebarHidden, toggledSidebar } from '../shell/layout';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { showToast, showUndoToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { createCollectionActions } from './collectionActions';
import { saveExpanded } from './useExpanded';

/** The model of the snapshot and the list the cache holds now (the same instance while neither changed). */
export function currentModel(): OrganizeModel | undefined {
  const snapshot = queryClient.getQueryData<OrganizeSnapshot>(keys.organize);
  const items = queryClient.getQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items);
  return snapshot && items ? organizeModelFor(snapshot, items) : undefined;
}

/** Changes the organize snapshot in the cache; the notice main sends next brings the real one. */
export function patchOrganize(update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot): void {
  queryClient.setQueryData<OrganizeSnapshot>(keys.organize, (s) => (s ? update(s) : s));
}

/** Opens these collections' rows (and remembers it): the stored list plus the new ones. */
export function addExpanded(ids: readonly string[]): void {
  const model = currentModel();
  const known = (id: string) => model?.node(id) !== undefined;
  const open = new Set(parseExpanded(queryClient.getQueryData(keys.expanded), known));
  if (ids.every((id) => open.has(id))) return;
  saveExpanded(new Set([...open, ...ids.filter(known)]));
}

function showSidebar(): void {
  const { sidebar, setSidebar } = useShell.getState();
  if (sidebarHidden(sidebar, innerWidth)) setSidebar(toggledSidebar(sidebar, innerWidth));
}

/** The window's collection actions (the sidebar and the command registry share them). */
export const collectionActions = createCollectionActions({
  collections: {
    create: (input) => unwrap(api().collections.create(input)),
    rename: (input) => unwrap(api().collections.rename(input)),
    remove: (input) => unwrap(api().collections.remove(input)),
    restore: (input) => unwrap(api().collections.restore(input)),
  },
  confirm: (input) => unwrap(api().ui.confirm(input)),
  model: currentModel,
  scope: () => useLibrary.getState().scope,
  setScope: (scope) => useLibrary.getState().setScope(scope),
  patch: patchOrganize,
  expand: (id) => addExpanded([id]),
  showSidebar,
  opener: () => document.activeElement,
  failed: (e) => showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.actionFailed, body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, testId: 'action-error' }),
  undoToast: showUndoToast,
});
```
(`scope()`는 *고른* 범위를 읽는다 — 컬렉션이 막 지워져 `resolveScope`가 `all`로 보여 주는 순간이 아니라 사용자가 있던 곳으로 "안에 있었는가"를 판정하려는 것이다.)

```tsx
import { FolderPlus } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/Button';

/**
 * The "컬렉션" label with its one button (spec 3.3): the heading of the tree's second section while there are collections,
 * and — with none, when the tree has no such section — the same two elements on their own above the hint. The button is not
 * a Tab stop (the sidebar's Tab order is the tree, then the tag filter): its keys are ⇧⌘N and the palette.
 */
export function CollectionsHeading() {
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  return (
    <>
      <span className="heading-label" data-testid="collections-heading">
        {t.organize.sidebar.collections}
      </span>
      <span className="spacer" />
      <IconButton
        icon={FolderPlus}
        size="small"
        label={t.organize.sidebar.newTip}
        accelerator={commandById('collection.new').accelerator}
        excludeFromTabOrder
        isDisabled={!isEnabled('collection.new')}
        testId="new-collection"
        onPress={() => void run('collection.new')}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { collectionActions } from './actions';
import { tooLong } from './nameEdit';
import { useSidebarEdit } from './sidebarEdit';

/**
 * The name being typed inside a row (spec 3.4): the whole name selected when it appears. Its keys (↩, esc, and every other
 * key kept from the row) are decided above the tree (SidebarTree.onKeyDownCapture): a row handles Home/End and the arrows in
 * the capture phase, so the field's own handlers would never see them. Leaving it with a click saves the name, as ↩ does; the
 * window going to the background (a blur that is not the user's) does not.
 */
export function NameField({ initial }: { initial: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const busy = useSidebarEdit((s) => s.busy);
  const over = useSidebarEdit((s) => (s.edit ? tooLong(s.edit.text) : false));
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const input = ref.current;
    if (!input) return;
    input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    input.select();
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      <input
        ref={ref}
        className="name-field"
        data-testid="rename-input"
        data-rename-input=""
        aria-label={t.organize.sidebar.nameLabel}
        aria-invalid={over || undefined}
        defaultValue={initial}
        readOnly={busy}
        spellCheck={false}
        autoComplete="off"
        onChange={(e) => useSidebarEdit.getState().setText(e.currentTarget.value)}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          if (!document.hasFocus()) return;
          void collectionActions.finish(e.currentTarget.value, 'blur');
        }}
      />
      {over && (
        <span className="rename-note" role="status" data-testid="rename-note">
          {t.organize.sidebar.nameTooLong}
        </span>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

`R/sidebar/SidebarTree.tsx`:
```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, type CSSProperties, type FocusEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Clock, Copy, Folder, FolderOpen, Inbox, LibraryBig, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Button, ListLayout, Tree, TreeHeader, TreeItem, TreeItemContent, TreeSection, Virtualizer, type Key, type Selection, type TreeProps, type TreeState,
} from 'react-aria-components';
import type { LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { runPicked } from '../commands/registry';
import type { CollectionNode, OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { isContextMenuKey, menuPointFor } from '../ui/contextMenuKey';
import { showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { addExpanded, collectionActions } from './actions';
import { CollectionsHeading } from './CollectionsHeading';
import { HEADING_HEIGHT } from './layout';
import { NameField } from './NameField';
import { DRAFT_KEY, SCOPE_KEYS, ancestorIds, keyOfScope, scopeOfKey, visibleCollectionKeys, type SpecialKind, type SpecialRow } from './rows';
import { useSidebarEdit } from './sidebarEdit';
import { treeKeyAction } from './treeKeys';
import { saveExpanded } from './useExpanded';

const SPECIAL: Record<SpecialKind, { icon: LucideIcon; label: string }> = {
  all: { icon: LibraryBig, label: t.shell.myLibrary },
  recent: { icon: Clock, label: t.organize.scopes.recent },
  unfiled: { icon: Inbox, label: t.organize.scopes.unfiled },
  duplicates: { icon: Copy, label: t.organize.scopes.duplicates },
};

export interface SidebarTreeProps {
  model: OrganizeModel | undefined;
  /** The view shown (resolveScope of the one chosen). */
  scope: LibraryScope;
  specials: readonly SpecialRow[];
  /** The collections are known: the snapshot and the stored open rows have both arrived. */
  settled: boolean;
  expanded: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** The reader is showing: a row is the way back to the library, and moving the cursor changes no view. */
  reader: boolean;
  /** A row's height in px (the density). */
  rowSize: number;
  /** Drag and drop is Task 8's: handed to the Tree as it is. */
  dragAndDropHooks?: TreeProps<object>['dragAndDropHooks'];
}

interface RowContext {
  model: OrganizeModel;
  reader: boolean;
  tap: { current: TreeState<unknown> | null };
  onReaderPress(key: string): void;
}

/** Hands the tree's state (its selection manager) out of a row: the keys that move the cursor to a row that may be unmounted need it. */
function StateTap({ tap, state }: { tap: RowContext['tap']; state: TreeState<unknown> }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    tap.current = state;
  });
  return null;
}

const indent = ({ level }: { level: number }) => ({ '--indent': level - 1 }) as CSSProperties;

function SpecialItem({ row, tap, reader, onReaderPress }: { row: SpecialRow; tap: RowContext['tap']; reader: boolean; onReaderPress(key: string): void }) {
  const { icon, label } = SPECIAL[row.kind];
  const key = SCOPE_KEYS[row.kind];
  return (
    <TreeItem id={key} textValue={label} className="nav-row" data-testid={`nav-scope-${row.kind}`} {...(reader ? { onPress: () => onReaderPress(key) } : {})}>
      <TreeItemContent>
        {({ state }) => (
          <>
            <StateTap tap={tap} state={state} />
            <Icon icon={icon} />
            <span className="label ellipsis">{label}</span>
            {row.count !== null && <span className="count num">{row.count}</span>}
          </>
        )}
      </TreeItemContent>
    </TreeItem>
  );
}

/** The row of a collection being created: not a collection yet, so nothing can select, drag or open it. */
function DraftItem({ text }: { text: string }) {
  return (
    <TreeItem id={DRAFT_KEY} textValue={t.organize.sidebar.newName} isDisabled className="nav-row" style={indent} data-testid="draft-row">
      <TreeItemContent>
        {() => (
          <>
            <Icon icon={Folder} />
            <NameField initial={text} />
          </>
        )}
      </TreeItemContent>
    </TreeItem>
  );
}

function CollectionItem({ node, ctx }: { node: CollectionNode; ctx: RowContext }) {
  const edit = useSidebarEdit((s) => s.edit);
  const renaming = edit?.kind === 'rename' && edit.id === node.id ? edit : null;
  const draftBelow = edit?.kind === 'new' && edit.parentId === node.id ? edit : null;
  const count = ctx.model.count(node.id);
  const path = ctx.model.path(node.id).map((n) => n.name).join(t.organize.pathSeparator);
  return (
    <TreeItem
      id={node.id}
      textValue={node.name}
      isDisabled={renaming !== null}
      className="nav-row"
      style={indent}
      data-testid={`nav-collection-${node.id}`}
      {...(ctx.reader ? { onPress: () => ctx.onReaderPress(node.id) } : {})}
    >
      <TreeItemContent>
        {({ hasChildItems, isExpanded, state }) => (
          <>
            <StateTap tap={ctx.tap} state={state} />
            {hasChildItems && (
              <Button slot="chevron" className="disclosure">
                <Icon icon={isExpanded ? ChevronDown : ChevronRight} size="xs" />
              </Button>
            )}
            <Icon icon={isExpanded ? FolderOpen : Folder} />
            {renaming ? (
              <NameField initial={renaming.text} />
            ) : (
              <span className="label ellipsis" title={path}>
                {node.name}
              </span>
            )}
            {count > 0 && <span className="count num">{count}</span>}
          </>
        )}
      </TreeItemContent>
      {draftBelow && <DraftItem text={draftBelow.text} />}
      {node.children.map((child) => (
        <CollectionItem key={child.id} node={child} ctx={ctx} />
      ))}
    </TreeItem>
  );
}

/**
 * The sidebar's navigator (spec 3.2, 3.3): React Aria's Tree inside its Virtualizer, in two sections — the special views, then
 * the collections under their "컬렉션" heading. Selection is the view and follows the cursor. What React Aria does not do is
 * done by the wrapper above the tree, in the capture phase, from facts (treeKeys.ts): no type-ahead, ↩ renames, → goes to the
 * first child and ← to the parent by the model (a row may not be mounted), and the name field keeps its own keys.
 */
export function SidebarTree(props: SidebarTreeProps) {
  const { model, scope, specials, settled, expanded, reader, rowSize } = props;
  const { env, run } = useCommands();
  const edit = useSidebarEdit((s) => s.edit);
  const restoreTo = useSidebarEdit((s) => s.restoreTo);
  const treeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tap = useRef<TreeState<unknown> | null>(null);
  const selectedKey = keyOfScope(scope);
  const selectedKeys = useMemo(() => new Set<Key>([selectedKey]), [selectedKey]);
  const hasCollections = settled && model !== undefined && (model.collectionCount > 0 || edit?.kind === 'new');
  const fit = !hasCollections;
  const layoutOptions = useMemo(() => ({ rowSize, headingSize: HEADING_HEIGHT }), [rowSize]);
  const latest = useRef({ model, expanded });
  latest.current = { model, expanded };

  const selectScope = useCallback((key: string) => useLibrary.getState().setScope(scopeOfKey(key)), []);
  const toggle = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      const next = new Set(expanded);
      if (!next.delete(id)) next.add(id);
      saveExpanded(next);
    },
    [expanded],
  );
  /** The cursor to a row, mounted or not: React Aria mounts it (the focused key is kept) and focuses it. */
  const focusRow = useCallback((key: string) => {
    const manager = tap.current?.selectionManager;
    if (manager) {
      manager.setFocused(true);
      manager.setFocusedKey(key);
    } else treeRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[role="row"][data-key="${CSS.escape(key)}"]`)?.focus();
  }, []);
  const onReaderPress = useCallback((key: string) => void (run('nav.back') && selectScope(key)), [run, selectScope]);
  const openMenu = useCallback(
    async (id: string, at: { x: number; y: number }) => {
      try {
        const picked = await unwrap(api().ui.showContextMenu({ kind: 'collection', collectionIds: [id], x: at.x, y: at.y }));
        if (picked) runPicked(picked, env, { collectionIds: [id] });
      } catch (e) {
        showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.actionFailed, body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, testId: 'action-error' });
      }
    },
    [env],
  );
  const ctx = useMemo<RowContext | null>(() => (model ? { model, reader, tap, onReaderPress } : null), [model, reader, onReaderPress]);

  // ---- keys (capture phase, before the row's own) -------------------------------------------------------------------
  const onKeyDownCapture = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    const field = target instanceof HTMLInputElement && target.dataset['renameInput'] !== undefined;
    const rowEl = !field && target.matches('[role="row"][data-key]') ? target : null;
    const key = rowEl?.dataset['key'] ?? null;
    const node = key !== null ? model?.node(key) : undefined;
    const action = treeKeyAction({
      key: e.key,
      shiftKey: e.shiftKey,
      altKey: e.altKey,
      ctrlKey: e.ctrlKey,
      metaKey: e.metaKey,
      composing: e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229,
      target: field ? 'rename' : rowEl ? 'row' : 'other',
      contextMenuKey: isContextMenuKey(e),
      reader,
      row:
        key === null
          ? null
          : { key, collection: node !== undefined, expanded: expanded.has(key), hasChildren: (node?.children.length ?? 0) > 0, firstChild: node?.children[0]?.id ?? null, parent: node?.parentId ?? null },
    });
    if (action.do === 'none') return;
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (action.do === 'swallow' || action.do === 'block') return; // kept from the row; the browser's default (typing) stays
    e.preventDefault();
    switch (action.do) {
      case 'commit':
        void collectionActions.finish((target as HTMLInputElement).value, 'enter');
        break;
      case 'cancel':
        collectionActions.cancel();
        break;
      case 'rename':
        collectionActions.startRename(action.key);
        break;
      case 'menu':
        if (!reader) selectScope(action.key);
        void openMenu(action.key, menuPointFor(rowEl!));
        break;
      case 'goto':
        selectScope(action.key);
        focusRow(action.key);
        break;
      case 'ignoreMenu':
        break;
    }
  };

  const onContextMenu = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('input')) return; // the field keeps the browser's own
    const key = target.closest<HTMLElement>('[role="row"][data-key]')?.dataset['key'];
    if (key === undefined) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!model?.node(key)) return; // a special view has no menu (spec 9.2)
    if (!reader) selectScope(key); // a right click selects first (design-spec 7.1)
    void openMenu(key, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
  };

  const onDoubleClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('.disclosure, input')) return;
    const key = target.closest<HTMLElement>('[role="row"][data-key]')?.dataset['key'];
    if (key !== undefined && (model?.node(key)?.children.length ?? 0) > 0) toggle(key);
  };

  /** Selection follows the cursor, whichever key moved it (React Aria's ← to the parent moves only the focus). */
  const onFocus = (e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (reader) return;
    const el = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (!el.matches('[role="row"][data-key]')) return;
    const key = el.dataset['key']!;
    if (key !== DRAFT_KEY && key !== selectedKey) selectScope(key);
  };

  const onSelectionChange = (selection: Selection) => {
    if (reader || selection === 'all') return;
    const key = [...selection][0];
    if (key !== undefined && String(key) !== DRAFT_KEY) selectScope(String(key));
  };

  // ---- effects --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // The keyboard cursor follows the view when something else moved it (an item panel path, the palette): tabbing into the
  // tree then lands on the view's row and does not move the view to where the cursor was.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!reader) tap.current?.selectionManager.setFocusedKey(selectedKey);
  }, [selectedKey, reader]);

  // A view inside a closed collection opens the way to its row — when the view changes, not whenever the user folds a parent.
  useEffect(() => {
    const { model: m, expanded: open } = latest.current;
    if (scope.kind !== 'collection' || !m) return;
    const closed = ancestorIds(m, scope.id).filter((id) => !open.has(id));
    if (closed.length > 0) addExpanded(closed);
  }, [selectedKey]); // the latest model and open rows are read on purpose: only a change of view opens the way

  // The row being named is brought into view (once per edit); the virtualizer then mounts it and its field takes the focus.
  const revealed = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const editKey = edit === null ? null : edit.kind === 'new' ? DRAFT_KEY : edit.id;
  const editParent = edit?.kind === 'new' ? edit.parentId : undefined;
  useEffect(() => {
    const tree = treeRef.current;
    if (editKey === null) {
      revealed.current = null;
      return;
    }
    const signature = `${editKey}|${editParent ?? ''}`;
    if (!tree || !model || revealed.current === signature) return;
    const index = visibleCollectionKeys(model, expanded, editParent).indexOf(editKey);
    if (index < 0) return;
    revealed.current = signature;
    const top = specials.length * rowSize + HEADING_HEIGHT + index * rowSize;
    if (top < tree.scrollTop || top + rowSize > tree.scrollTop + tree.clientHeight) tree.scrollTop = Math.max(0, Math.round(top - (tree.clientHeight - rowSize) / 2));
  }, [editKey, editParent, model, expanded, specials.length, rowSize]);

  // A row that scrolled out of the virtual window takes its field along: the edit ends with the text typed so far.
  useEffect(() => {
    const tree = treeRef.current;
    if (editKey === null || !tree) return;
    let seen = tree.querySelector('[data-rename-input]') !== null;
    let frame = 0;
    const check = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const s = useSidebarEdit.getState();
      if (!s.edit || s.busy) return;
      if (tree.querySelector('[data-rename-input]')) seen = true;
      else if (seen) void collectionActions.finish(s.edit.text, 'scroll');
    };
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (frame === 0) frame = requestAnimationFrame(check);
    };
    tree.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
    return () => {
      tree.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      if (frame !== 0) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [editKey]);

  // After an edit the focus goes back to where it was (the table, say); from inside the tree, to the cursor row.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (restoreTo === null) return;
    useSidebarEdit.getState().clearRestore();
    const tree = treeRef.current;
    const opener = restoreTo.opener;
    if (opener instanceof HTMLElement && opener.isConnected && opener !== document.body && !tree?.contains(opener)) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    else tree?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [restoreTo]);

  return (
    <div className="sidebar-body" onKeyDownCapture={onKeyDownCapture} onContextMenu={onContextMenu} onDoubleClick={onDoubleClick} onFocus={onFocus}>
      <div className="section-label" aria-hidden="true">
        {t.shell.libraryHeading}
      </div>
      <Virtualizer layout={ListLayout} layoutOptions={layoutOptions}>
        <Tree
          ref={treeRef}
          aria-label={t.organize.sidebar.tree}
          className="nav-list sidebar-tree"
          data-testid="sidebar-tree"
          data-fit={fit || undefined}
          style={fit ? { height: specials.length * rowSize } : undefined}
          selectionMode="single"
          selectionBehavior="replace"
          disallowEmptySelection
          selectedKeys={selectedKeys}
          onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
          expandedKeys={expanded}
          onExpandedChange={(keys) => saveExpanded(new Set([...keys].map(String)))}
          dragAndDropHooks={props.dragAndDropHooks}
        >
          <TreeSection aria-label={t.shell.libraryHeading}>
            {specials.map((row) => (
              <SpecialItem key={row.kind} row={row} tap={tap} reader={reader} onReaderPress={onReaderPress} />
            ))}
          </TreeSection>
          {hasCollections && ctx && model && (
            <TreeSection aria-label={t.organize.sidebar.collections}>
              <TreeHeader className="section-label tree-heading">
                <CollectionsHeading />
              </TreeHeader>
              {edit?.kind === 'new' && edit.parentId === null && <DraftItem text={edit.text} />}
              {model.roots.map((node) => (
                <CollectionItem key={node.id} node={node} ctx={ctx} />
              ))}
            </TreeSection>
          )}
        </Tree>
      </Virtualizer>
      {fit && settled && (
        <>
          <div className="section-label">
            <CollectionsHeading />
          </div>
          <div className="sidebar-empty-hint" data-testid="sidebar-hint">
            {t.organize.sidebar.emptyHint}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
`R/sidebar/LibrarySidebar.tsx`:
```tsx
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useItems, usePrefs } from '../data/queries';
import { defaultDensity, density as ROW_HEIGHT } from '../design/tokens';
import { recentItems, resolveScope } from '../organize/scope';
import { useOrganize } from '../organize/useOrganize';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { useNow } from '../useNow';
import { SidebarTree } from './SidebarTree';
import { visibleSpecials } from './rows';
import { useExpanded } from './useExpanded';

const NO_ITEMS: readonly never[] = [];

/** The library's navigator in the sidebar (spec 3.2–3.4): the special views and the collection tree, one tree. */
export function LibrarySidebar() {
  const items = useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS;
  const { model } = useOrganize();
  const chosen = useLibrary((s) => s.scope);
  const scope = useMemo(() => resolveScope(model, chosen), [model, chosen]);
  const reader = useShell((s) => s.view.kind === 'reader');
  const now = useNow().getTime();
  const hasRecent = useMemo(() => recentItems(items, now).length > 0, [items, now]);
  const specials = useMemo(() => visibleSpecials({ itemCount: items.length, hasRecent, model, current: scope.kind }), [items.length, hasRecent, model, scope.kind]);
  const { expanded, settled } = useExpanded(model);
  const rowSize = ROW_HEIGHT[usePrefs().data?.density ?? defaultDensity];
  return <SidebarTree model={model} scope={scope} specials={specials} settled={settled} expanded={expanded} reader={reader} rowSize={rowSize} />;
}
```

**CSS.** `R/styles/components/list.css`를 고친다.
① `.nav-row {` 규칙(20행)에 `position: relative;`를 더한다(`min-width: 0;` 다음 줄).
② 32–34행 `.nav-row > .icon {` → `.nav-row .icon {`. ③ 67행 `:root[data-window-inactive] .nav-list:focus-within .nav-row:is([data-current], [data-selected]) > .icon {` → `… ) .icon {`.
④ `.nav-row .count {` 규칙(38–42행) 바로 다음에 더한다:
```css
  /* Tree rows (design-spec 6 트리; mockup .disclosure): every row has the 16 px gutter, so icons line up level by level; the
     12 px chevron sits in the gutter of its own level. Leaves draw none, the gutter stays. */
  .nav-row .disclosure {
    position: absolute;
    left: calc(var(--indent, 0) * 16px); /* local: one level is 16 px (design-spec 6 트리) */
    top: 0;
    width: 16px; /* local: the disclosure gutter */
    height: 100%;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    outline: none;
  }
  .nav-row .disclosure .icon {
    color: inherit;
  }
  /* The name being typed in a row (spec 3.4): the field of design-spec 6 (1 px focus border, 3 px halo), 22 px high. */
  .nav-row .name-field {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 22px; /* local: a field inside a 24–32 px row */
    padding: 0 var(--space-6);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--bg-field);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--focus), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 28%, transparent);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font: var(--type-body);
    outline: none;
  }
  .nav-row .rename-note {
    position: absolute;
    left: calc(var(--space-16) + var(--indent, 0) * 16px + 16px + var(--space-6)); /* local: under the field: past the gutter and the icon */
    top: 100%;
    z-index: 2;
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-8);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--bg-raised);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-e1);
    color: var(--danger-text);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
```

```css
@layer screens {
  /* The sidebar's body (the rows are components/list.css): the "라이브러리" label, the tree taking the rest of the height, and —
```

**게이트 — 트리의 키보드·기하가 `Virtualizer` 아래에서 도는지 먼저 본다** (이 단계에서 가장 큰 불확실성이다: `TreeSection`·`TreeHeader`는 스파이크가 재지 않았다):
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build && pnpm fixtures && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24" pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/sidebar.spec.ts -g "200 collections|counts include"
```
Expected: PASS(두 시험). 실패하면 원인을 아래로 가른다 — **공개 API로 안 되는 동작이면 멈추고 컨트롤러 판정을 받는다**(다른 우회로 덮지 않는다):
  - 행 수가 90 이상 = 가상화가 구역 안에서 꺼졌다(`Virtualizer`가 `TreeSection` 아래 행을 다 그린다) → 멈춘다.
  - 머리 위치·높이가 어긋남 = `headingSize`가 `TreeHeader`에 안 먹는다 → `layoutOptions`의 이름(`rowSize`/`headingSize` ↔ 폐기된 `rowHeight`/`headingHeight`)부터 확인하고, 안 되면 멈춘다.
  - ↑↓가 구역 경계에서 멈춘다 / End가 마지막 행에 안 간다 / →가 첫 하위로 안 간다 = 멈춘다.
  - `Button`에서 "slot" 오류 = `CollectionsHeading`의 단추가 `ButtonContext` 안에 들어갔다 → `<ButtonContext.Provider value={null}>`로 감싸 보고 그래도 안 되면 멈춘다.
  - **멈추기 전에(컨트롤러 판정 Q-51)**: 위 실패가 구역 때문이면(행 수 90 이상, 머리 위치·높이, 구역 경계의 ↑↓·End) 멈추지 말고 Q-51의 대안으로 바꾼다 — 특수 보기는 트리 위의 별도 RAC `ListBox`, 컬렉션은 `Virtualizer` 안의 `Tree`(구역 없음, "컬렉션" 머리는 트리 밖의 일반 요소), 경계를 넘는 ↑↓는 래퍼의 캡처 처리기, Tab 정거장은 래퍼가 하나로 지킨다. 같은 두 spec을 다시 돌리고, 대안에서도 실패할 때만 멈추고 컨트롤러 판정을 받는다. 어느 쪽으로 갔는지 커밋 본문에 적는다.

`R/sidebar/ScopeEmpty.tsx`:
```tsx
import { Clock, Copy, FolderOpen, Inbox } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel, type LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { PaneEmpty } from '../ui/PaneEmpty';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';

const ICONS = { recent: Clock, unfiled: Inbox, duplicates: Copy } as const;

/**
 * The table body of a view with nothing in it (spec 3.6): an empty collection offers the import into it; the special views
 * only say so (and are on screen only while viewed). Nothing is drawn for 내 라이브러리 — an empty library has its own screen.
 */
export function ScopeEmpty({ scope, name }: { scope: LibraryScope; name: string }) {
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  if (scope.kind === 'all') return null;
  if (scope.kind === 'collection') {
    const target = { collectionIds: [scope.id] };
    return (
      <PaneEmpty
        icon={FolderOpen}
        title={t.organize.empty.collectionTitle}
        top
        testId="collection-empty"
        action={
          <Button testId="collection-empty-import" isDisabled={!isEnabled('collection.importInto', target)} onPress={() => void run('collection.importInto', target)}>
            {commandLabel(commandById('collection.importInto'), currentPlatform())}
          </Button>
        }
      >
        {t.organize.empty.collectionBody(name)}
      </PaneEmpty>
    );
  }
  return <PaneEmpty icon={ICONS[scope.kind]} title={t.organize.empty[scope.kind]} top testId={`scope-empty-${scope.kind}`} />;
}
```

**`E/visual/tour.spec.ts`** — 맨 위 `../helpers` import 묶음에 `addToCollection, createCollection, specialRow, treeRow,`를 더하고 파일 끝에 더한다:
```ts
// M5 Task 5: the sidebar. Pairs for the critic: library.html (tree open with a selection; the three special views),
// library.html?state=empty-collection, and the unpaired row being named (design-spec 6 field, 3.1).
test('organize: the sidebar tree with a selection, a row being named, an empty collection, the special views', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  try {
    const items = await importPaths(s.page, library(testInfo.outputPath('videos')));
    const bio = await createCollection(s.page, '분자생물학');
    const c6 = await createCollection(s.page, '6장 · 신호 전달', bio);
    const c7 = await createCollection(s.page, '7장 · 세포 주기', bio);
    await createCollection(s.page, '실험 노트', bio); // empty: its row shows no number
    const stats = await createCollection(s.page, '통계');
    await createCollection(s.page, '회귀분석', stats);
    const conf = await createCollection(s.page, '학회 준비');
    await addToCollection(s.page, bio, items.map((i) => i.id));
    await addToCollection(s.page, c6, [items[0]!.id, items[1]!.id]);
    await addToCollection(s.page, c7, [items[2]!.id]);
    await addToCollection(s.page, stats, [items[3]!.id]);

    // The tree open, 6장 viewed, the table focused: the sidebar's selection is the neutral one, as library.html draws it.
    await treeRow(s.page, bio).locator('.disclosure').click();
    await treeRow(s.page, c6).click();
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    await expect(rowAt(s.page, 0)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('info-section')).toBeVisible();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `sidebar-tree-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
    }

    // A new collection being named: the field with the default name selected, at the top of the tree.
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'collection.new');
    const field = s.page.getByTestId('rename-input');
    await expect(field).toBeFocused();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await expect(field).toBeFocused();
      await shoot(s.page, `sidebar-edit-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
    }
    await s.page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(field).toHaveCount(0);

    // An empty collection: the table body and the item panel; the panel's day is masked.
    await treeRow(s.page, conf).click();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('collection-empty')).toBeVisible();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `collection-empty-${theme}`, { mask: [s.page.getByTestId('collection-empty-meta')] });
    }

    // The special views: 최근 연 자료 (an item was opened), 미분류 and 중복 항목 (the same file imported again, in no collection).
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    await specialRow(s.page, 'all').click();
    await openItem(s.page, 'sample');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toBeVisible();
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'nav.back');
    await s.page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'managed', allowDuplicate: true }), path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'));
    for (const kind of ['recent', 'unfiled', 'duplicates'] as const) await expect(specialRow(s.page, kind)).toBeVisible();
    await specialRow(s.page, 'unfiled').click();
    await shoot(s.page, 'sidebar-special-light', { mask: dates() });
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

```bash
pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts --update-snapshots=all
git status --short tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts-snapshots
```
저장소 밖 임시 폴더에 `sidebar-only.mjs`를 만들어(커밋하지 않는다) 바뀐 PNG가 사이드바 열(x < 241)에서만 달라졌는지 본다:
```js
// node --experimental-strip-types sidebar-only.mjs   (run from the worktree root)
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const { decodePng } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(process.cwd(), 'tests/evidence/png.ts')).href);
const dir = 'tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts-snapshots';
const changed = execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--name-only', '--', dir], { encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
for (const file of changed) {
  const before = decodePng(execFileSync('git', ['show', `HEAD:${file}`], { maxBuffer: 1 << 26 }));
  const after = decodePng(readFileSync(file));
  if (before.width !== after.width || before.height !== after.height) {
    console.log(`SIZE ${file}`);
    continue;
  }
  let inside = 0;
  let outside = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < after.height; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < after.width; x++) {
      const i = (y * after.width + x) * 4;
      if (before.data[i] !== after.data[i] || before.data[i + 1] !== after.data[i + 1] || before.data[i + 2] !== after.data[i + 2]) (x < 241 ? inside++ : outside++);
    }
  }
  console.log(`${outside === 0 ? 'ok ' : 'OUT'} ${file}: ${inside} px in the sidebar column, ${outside} outside`);
}
```
