`V/organize.evidence.ts`(새 파일 — Task 9 이후의 M5 작업이 이 위에 시험을 더한다):
```ts
// @organize — M5 collections, tags, drag and drop and context menus on macOS (the Mac suite `organize`); Linux runs the file
// too, with the macOS-only captures recorded as skipped.
//
// One shared session in serial mode. As in library.evidence.ts no check stops the run: each is recorded in m5-organize.json
// (`checks`) as it is measured, and the last test asserts them all with expect.soft. Later M5 tasks add their tests above
// the verdict and their measurements to `results`.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, NativeInputNotPermitted, addToCollection, createCollection, importPaths, launch, rowAt, runMenuCommand, treeRow, type Session } from '../e2e/helpers';
import { IS_MAC, allShots, focusApp, fullScreenShot, movePointer, pressEscape, writeJson } from './capture';

const TAG = { tag: '@organize' };
const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const results: Record<string, unknown> = {};
/** Every check's verdict and the value it was judged on, in the order measured (asserted by the last test). */
const checks: Record<string, { ok: boolean; value: unknown }> = {};
const save = () => writeJson('m5-organize.json', { ...results, checks, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, at: new Date().toISOString() }, 'M5 organize measurements');

/** Record one check (judged later, never here). */
function check(name: string, ok: boolean, value: unknown): void {
  checks[name] = { ok, value };
}
const errorText = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? `${e.name}: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}` : String(e));
/** Run a carried check; a throw becomes a failed check with the error (codes and messages only, never a path). */
async function guard(name: string, run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await run();
  } catch (e) {
    check(name, false, { error: errorText(e), notPermitted: e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted });
  }
}
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
/** The colour a token resolves to here (light-dark() resolved by the page's scheme), as getComputedStyle writes it. */
const tokenColor = (page: Page, token: string) =>
  page.evaluate((t) => {
    const probe = document.createElement('div');
    probe.style.background = `var(${t})`;
    document.body.append(probe);
    const c = getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor;
    probe.remove();
    return c;
  }, token);
const setTheme = async (page: Page, theme: 'light' | 'dark') => {
  await page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), theme);
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', theme);
};

test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
let s: Session;
let tmp = '';
let bio = '';
let c6 = '';

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-m5-organize-'));
  s = await launch(path.join(tmp, 'library'), path.join(tmp, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  const items = await importPaths(s.page, [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4]);
  bio = await createCollection(s.page, '분자생물학');
  c6 = await createCollection(s.page, '6장 · 신호 전달', bio);
  await createCollection(s.page, '학회 준비');
  await addToCollection(s.page, bio, items.map((i) => i.id));
  await addToCollection(s.page, c6, [items[0]!.id]);
  if (IS_MAC) await movePointer(512, 620);
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  save();
  await s?.app.close().catch(() => {});
  if (tmp) fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

test('M5 sidebar: rows, gutter and chevron, selection neutral and accent — light and dark', TAG, async () => {
  await treeRow(s.page, bio).locator('.disclosure').click();
  await treeRow(s.page, c6).click();
  await rowAt(s.page, 0).click(); // the table has the focus: the sidebar's selection is the neutral one
  if (IS_MAC) await movePointer(512, 620);
  await guard('sidebar rows: 28 px high, a level indents 16 px, the chevron is 12 px in a 16 px gutter, a leaf has none', async () => {
    const v = await s.page.evaluate(({ a, b }) => {
      const row = (id: string) => document.querySelector(`[data-testid="nav-collection-${id}"]`)!;
      const label = (id: string) => row(id).querySelector('.label')!.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      return {
        rowHeight: row(a).getBoundingClientRect().height,
        levelDx: label(b) - label(a),
        chevron: row(a).querySelector('.disclosure svg')!.getBoundingClientRect().width,
        gutter: row(a).querySelector('.disclosure')!.getBoundingClientRect().width,
        leafChevrons: row(b).querySelectorAll('.disclosure').length,
      };
    }, { a: bio, b: c6 });
    results['tree'] = v;
    check('sidebar rows: 28 px high, a level indents 16 px, the chevron is 12 px in a 16 px gutter, a leaf has none', v.rowHeight === 28 && v.levelDx === 16 && v.chevron === 12 && v.gutter === 16 && v.leafChevrons === 0, v);
  });
  await guard('selection: the neutral fill while the table has the focus, the accent fill once the sidebar has it', async () => {
    const fill = () => treeRow(s.page, c6).evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor);
    const neutral = await fill();
    await treeRow(s.page, c6).focus();
    const accent = await fill();
    const v = { neutral, accent, fillSelected: await tokenColor(s.page, '--fill-selected'), accentToken: await tokenColor(s.page, '--accent') };
    check('selection: the neutral fill while the table has the focus, the accent fill once the sidebar has it', v.neutral === v.fillSelected && v.accent === v.accentToken, v);
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    if (IS_MAC) await movePointer(512, 620);
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(s.page, theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, `m5-05-sidebar-tree-${theme}`, `sidebar: tree open with 6장 selected, table focused (${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
});

test('M5 sidebar: the row being named — the field and the whole default name selected', TAG, async () => {
  await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'collection.new');
  const input = s.page.getByTestId('rename-input');
  await expect(input).toBeFocused();
  await guard('name field: 22 px high, the focus border and halo, the whole default name selected', async () => {
    const v = await input.evaluate((e: HTMLInputElement) => ({ height: e.getBoundingClientRect().height, shadow: getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow, from: e.selectionStart, to: e.selectionEnd, length: e.value.length }));
    const focus = await tokenColor(s.page, '--focus');
    results['field'] = { ...v, focus };
    check('name field: 22 px high, the focus border and halo, the whole default name selected', v.height === 22 && v.shadow.includes(focus) && v.from === 0 && v.to === v.length && v.length > 0, { ...v, focus });
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(s.page, theme);
    await expect(input).toBeFocused();
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, `m5-05-sidebar-edit-${theme}`, `sidebar: a new collection being named, the default name selected (${theme})`);
  }
  await s.page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(input).toHaveCount(0);
  await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
});

test('M5 sidebar: the hint under 컬렉션 when there are none, and the special views', TAG, async () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-m5-hint-'));
  const t = await launch(path.join(dir, 'library'), path.join(dir, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  try {
    await importPaths(t.page, [PDF]);
    await expect(t.page.getByTestId('sidebar-hint')).toBeVisible();
    await guard('hint: footnote in the tertiary colour, "새 컬렉션" on one line', async () => {
      const v = await t.page.getByTestId('sidebar-hint').evaluate((e) => ({ color: getComputedStyle(e).color, size: getComputedStyle(e).fontSize, text: e.textContent }));
      const tertiary = await t.page.evaluate(() => {
        const probe = document.createElement('div');
        probe.style.color = 'var(--text-tertiary)';
        document.body.append(probe);
        const c = getComputedStyle(probe).color;
        probe.remove();
        return c;
      });
      results['hint'] = { ...v, tertiary };
      check('hint: footnote in the tertiary colour, "새 컬렉션" on one line', v.color === tertiary && v.size === '12px' && (v.text ?? '').includes('새\u00a0컬렉션'), { ...v, tertiary });
    });
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      await setTheme(t.page, theme);
      if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(t.app);
      await allShots(t.app, t.page, `m5-05-sidebar-hint-${theme}`, `sidebar: no collections, the hint (${theme})`);
    }
  } finally {
    await t.app.close().catch(() => {});
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('M5 sidebar: the collection menu open and the delete sheet open (macOS only)', TAG, async () => {
  if (!IS_MAC) {
    results['menus'] = { skipped: 'native menus and sheets are macOS only' };
    return;
  }
  await focusApp(s.app);
  await treeRow(s.page, c6).click({ button: 'right' }); // a right click selects first, then the native menu opens
  await sleep(1200);
  const menuShot = await fullScreenShot('m5-05-menu-collection', 'the collection context menu open on 6장');
  await pressEscape();
  await sleep(500);
  // The sheet: the product's own ui.confirm with the words 컬렉션 삭제… sends, left open for the capture.
  const answer = s.page.evaluate(() => window.learn.ui.confirm({ message: '‘학회 준비’를 삭제하겠습니까?', detail: '자료는 내 라이브러리에 남습니다.', confirm: '삭제' }));
  await sleep(1500);
  const sheetShot = await fullScreenShot('m5-05-sheet-delete', '컬렉션 삭제… sheet over the main window');
  await pressEscape();
  const result = await answer;
  results['menus'] = { menu: menuShot.file, sheet: sheetShot.file };
  check('delete sheet: esc cancels it — the answer is no', result.ok && result.data === false, result);
});

test('M5 organize: verdict of every check above (m5-organize.json checks)', TAG, async () => {
  save();
  for (const [name, c] of Object.entries(checks)) expect.soft(c.ok, `${name}: ${JSON.stringify(c.value)}`).toBe(true);
});
```
`.github/workflows/macos-evidence.yml` 11행 `options: [baseline, e2e, evidence, perf, demo, mockups, library, all]`을 `options: [baseline, e2e, evidence, perf, demo, mockups, library, organize, all]`로. `scripts/evidence.sh` 7행 주석 `#   suite     baseline | e2e | evidence | perf | demo | mockups | library | all`에 `| organize`를 `library` 뒤에 더하고, 25행 `case $SUITE in baseline|e2e|evidence|perf|demo|mockups|library|all) ;;`에 `organize|`를 `library|` 뒤에 더한다.

Run(Linux에서 하네스가 도는지만): `xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1440x900x24" pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.evidence.config.ts tests/evidence/organize.evidence.ts`
Expected: PASS(Linux: 메뉴·시트 캡처는 건너뜀, `evidence-results/m5-organize.json`에 `checks`와 `menus.skipped`).

컨트롤러의 확인(CI 녹색 뒤, 구현자는 하지 않는다 — P-17): `scripts/evidence.sh m5-organize organize m5-t5`. 받은 `evidence/m5-t5/<run>/evidence/`에서:
  - `m5-organize.json`의 `checks`가 모두 `ok`(다섯: 행 치수, 선택 채움, 이름 칸, 안내 글자, 시트 esc). `tree`의 `levelDx`가 16, `field.height`가 22, `field.shadow`에 `--focus` 색이 있다.
  - PNG: `m5-05-sidebar-tree-{light,dark}.{page,window,screen}.png` — 사이드바가 비브런시 위에 있다: 선택 행 중립 채움과 개수 색(`--sidebar-count-selected`), 시스템 글꼴에서 구역 글자·행 글자의 기준선, 12px 펼침 화살표. `m5-05-sidebar-edit-*` — 이름 칸이 SF 글꼴·macOS 선택 하이라이트(Mac은 시스템 하이라이트)에서 읽히는지. `m5-05-sidebar-hint-*` — 안내의 줄바꿈. `m5-05-menu-collection.screen.png` — 네이티브 컨텍스트 메뉴가 행 옆에 열려 있고 새 하위 컬렉션 · 이름 바꾸기 | 이 컬렉션으로 가져오기… | 컬렉션 삭제… 순서에 구분선 둘. `m5-05-sheet-delete.screen.png` — 메인 창에 붙은 시트, 메시지·상세·"삭제"(기본)·"취소", 앱 아이콘.
  - Step 15의 짝 비평을 Mac PNG로 한 번 더. 실행은 `docs/mac-verification.md` 실행 기록에 한 줄(컨트롤러). 실기 목록에 추가(Task 12): 실제 한글 IME로 새 컬렉션 이름 쓰기(조합 중 ↩가 조합만 끝내는지), VoiceOver로 트리 읽기(구역·수준·펼침), ⇧F10과 VO-⇧-M으로 컬렉션 메뉴.

### Task 6: 태그 — 선택기(칩·AND 필터·"…" 메뉴·태그 필터 칸), 칩 메뉴(이름·색 지정·색 해제·삭제·합치기), 1–8 키와 "색 태그 ▸", 표의 색 점, 필터 결과 없음

#### 제안 판정 (Q-60 … Q-69)

뼈대·명세·앞 작업의 인계가 코드와 어긋나거나 정하지 않은 곳이다. 아래 모양대로 구현하고, 컨트롤러가 거부하면 해당 단계만 고친다.

1. **Q-60 (태그 선택기의 Tab 순서와 DOM 순서는 목업의 시각 순서 — 칩 → 필터 칸).** 명세 3.3은 "트리 → 태그 필터 칸 → 태그 칩"이라 쓰고 Task 5의 Q-55가 그대로 옮겼다. 그런데 목업 `.tag-selector`(`views.js:71-78`)는 머리 → 칩 구름 → 필터 칸 순으로 그린다(필터 칸이 맨 아래). 필터 칸을 DOM에서 앞에 두고 CSS `order`로 아래에 그리면 시각 순서와 초점 순서가 어긋난다(WCAG 2.4.3). 제안: DOM·Tab 순서 = 시각 순서 = **트리 → "…" 단추 → 칩(한 정거장) → 태그 필터 칸**. "…" 단추는 Tab 순서에 둔다(표시·정렬에 닿는 유일한 길이다 — 머리 "새 컬렉션" 단추와 달리 키보드 대체가 팔레트에 없다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 컴포넌트 안에서 두 요소의 JSX 순서와 CSS `order` 한 줄(`TagSelector.tsx`, `tags.css`), E2E 한 시험의 Tab 순서 단언.
2. **Q-61 (색 점의 자리 — overruled: mockup order).** 명세 5.1은 "제목 뒤, 외부 연결 표시 앞"이라 쓰지만 승인된 목업 `tableRow`(`views.js:104-117`)는 `아이콘, 제목, 연결 표시, 색 점, 파일 없음 플래그` 순이다. 컨트롤러 판정: 목업이 이긴다 — 제목 셀 = 제목 · 연결 표시 · 색 점 · 상태 플래그(파일 없음). 그래서 `ItemMarks`를 `LinkMark`·`StatusFlags` 둘로 쪼개고(`ItemMarks`는 둘을 이어 붙이는 얇은 조합으로 남겨 항목 패널 머리가 그대로 쓴다, 시험 id 모두 그대로), 표의 `TitleCell`이 둘 사이에 `TagDots`를 끼운다. 명세 5.1의 문장은 Task 12가 고친다.
3. **Q-62 (팔레트의 "자리에 태그가 있을 때만"은 `commandAvailable`이 아니라 팔레트 전용 술어 `paletteListed`다).** 뼈대 P-13은 "`surface`가 있는 가용성 판정에서 `tagPositions` 비트"를 말한다. 그러나 렌더러 키맵도 `runCommand → isCommandAvailable(…, { modal })`로 `surface`를 늘 넘기고(`registry.ts`의 `isCommandEnabled`), 빈 자리를 누르면 명령이 **실행되어 토스트를 띄워야** 한다(명세 4.2). 가용성 규칙에 비트를 넣으면 키가 조용히 무시된다. 제안: 가용성은 "라이브러리 보기, 자료 ≥ 1"만(뼈대·명세 그대로), 팔레트가 목록을 만들 때만 `paletteListed(spec, ctx)`(도메인의 순수 함수: 색 키 명령은 `hasTagPosition(ctx.tagPositions, 자리)`, 나머지는 늘 참)를 더 본다. 팔레트 줄의 이름은 "색 태그 N · <이름>"으로 이름만 바꾼 명세 복사본이 만든다(`R/tags/paletteTags.ts`) — `rankCommands`·행 그리기는 그대로다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 술어 한 곳과 팔레트의 한 줄.
4. **Q-63 (⌘/ 시트의 "1–8 · 색 태그 붙이기/떼기"는 새 묶음 "정리"의 한 줄이다; 레지스트리의 여덟 줄은 접는다).** 명세 4.2·9.3은 새 묶음 "정리"와 한 줄을 말하는데 시트는 명령의 첫 맥락(`contexts[0]`)으로 묶는다(`sheets/shortcuts.ts`) — 색 키 여덟은 `item` 묶음에 여덟 줄로 들어가고 묶음 이름 표(`t.sheets.groups`)에 "정리"가 없다. 제안: `shortcuts.ts`가 `tagSlot(id) !== null`인 명령을 자기 묶음에서 빼고, 레지스트리의 첫 자리·끝 자리의 키로 만든 한 줄(`keys: ['1–8']`, 소리 내어 읽기 "1부터 8", 이름 "색 태그 붙이기/떼기")을 "자료" 묶음 다음의 "정리" 묶음에 둔다. ⇧⌘N(새 컬렉션)은 Task 5가 이미 "라이브러리" 묶음에 두었고 그대로다 — "정리" 묶음은 지금 이 한 줄뿐이다. 틀렸을 때 비용: `shortcuts.ts`의 한 곳과 시험 한 줄(Task 12의 키보드 여정이 이 묶음 이름을 읽는다).
5. **Q-64 (`colorTags` 묶음의 자리와 앞·뒤 작업에 주는 인계).** Task 4의 인계 문장은 파일 메뉴 `{ group: 2, order: 3 }`인데 `item.openExternally`가 이미 그 자리(2·3)다. 명세 9.3의 순서는 컬렉션에 추가 ▸ → 이 컬렉션에서 빼기 → 색 태그 ▸다. 제안: `SUBMENUS`의 `colorTags` = `menu: { menu: 'file', group: 2, order: 6 }`, `contextMenu: { kinds: ['item'], group: 3, order: 3 }`, 그리고 Task 7(컨트롤러 확인)은 `collection.addItems`를 `menu` 2·4 / 컨텍스트 메뉴 3·1, `collection.removeItems`를 `menu` 2·5 / 컨텍스트 메뉴 3·2로 둔다(Task 4의 `testing.ts` 대역이 컬렉션에 추가를 `menu` 2·5 / 3·0에 두었으므로 이 작업은 그 대역을 지우고 색 태그 쪽만 진짜로 바꾼다 — 7이 컬렉션 쪽을 같은 식으로 바꾼다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 숫자 둘.
6. **Q-65 (`TagChip`의 구조 — 알약 안에 단추 하나, 시험 id는 그 단추에; 뼈대의 props에 선택 props 몇 개를 더한다).** 뼈대 계약(`tag`·`role`·`on`·`dim`·`onToggle`·`onRemove`·`dragProps`, `TagDots`, `tagColorVar`, `ChipGroup({ label, children })`)은 그대로 구현한다. 더하는 것은 모두 선택이다: `TagChip`에 `editing`(이름 칸으로 바뀐 상태)·`onRename`(↩)·`onMenu(at)`(컨텍스트 메뉴 또는 ⇧F10)·`force`(상태 보드), `ChipGroup`에 `role`(기본 `toolbar`, 항목 패널은 `list`)·`className`·`testId`. 구조는 `span.chip > button.chip-main[data-testid="tag-chip-<id>"][data-chip-id]`(+ `assigned`에서는 `button.x`). 시험 id를 단추에 두는 까닭: 눌림 상태(`aria-pressed`)와 포커스가 그 요소에 있고, 알약 가운데를 누르면 단추를 맞힌다. `role="assigned"`의 주 요소는 눌러도 일이 없으므로 단추가 아니라 `role="listitem"`(포커스는 받는다 — ⌫ 때문에)이고, ×만 단추다(동작하지 않는 컨트롤을 그리지 않는다). `data-chip-id`를 가진 요소는 `ChipGroup`의 롤링 정거장이 된다 — Task 7의 "태그 추가" 칩이 정거장이 되려면 같은 속성을 단다. 틀렸을 때 비용: Task 7·8이 읽는 props 이름은 그대로라 컴포넌트 안쪽만 고친다.
7. **Q-66 (이름 바꾸기·색·삭제·붙임은 스냅샷 캐시를 먼저 고친다; 합치기는 렌더러가 확인한다; 필터에서 사라진 태그를 정리한다).** DB의 `rename`은 같은 이름이 있으면 소리 없이 합친다. 명세 4.1의 확인 시트를 띄우려면 렌더러가 먼저 알아야 하므로 스냅샷의 태그 이름(NFC·소문자)으로 다른 태그와 겹치는지 보고 `ui.confirm`을 묻는다(렌더러의 소문자 접기는 DB의 ASCII `NOCASE`를 포함하므로 시트 없이 합쳐지는 일은 없다). 알림이 오기 전 한 프레임 동안 옛 이름이 보이지 않도록(칸이 사라지는 순간) `patchOrganize`로 스냅샷을 먼저 고친다(`R/tags/organizeCache.ts` 순수 함수). 패치는 IPC가 성공한 **뒤**에만 적용한다 — 실패하면 캐시는 그대로고 오류 토스트(`failed`)가 뜬다(컨트롤러 조건: 실패 시 되돌림. 시험이 "거절된 호출 → 스냅샷 그대로"를 못박는다). 삭제·합치기로 사라진 태그 id가 `useLibrary.tagFilter`에 남으면 필터가 영원히 빈 결과를 낸다 → 저장소에 `dropFromTagFilter(tagId, replaceWith?)`를 더한다(합치기는 남은 태그가 그 자리를 잇는다). Task 3의 저장소에 더하는 것이며 기존 이름·모양은 그대로다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 패치 함수와 저장소 메서드 하나.
8. **Q-67 (1–8 키가 5,000개를 넘는 선택에서도 동작한다).** `tags:togglePosition`·`tags:assign`·`tags:unassign`의 zod는 `itemIds` ≤ 5,000이다(`D/ipc.ts:46-48`). 1만 항목 ⌘A 뒤 "1"이 검증 오류가 되면 안 된다. 제안: ≤ 5,000이면 `togglePosition` 한 번(DB가 판정), 넘으면 렌더러가 모델의 `tagItems`로 "모두 가졌는가"를 판정해 `assign`/`unassign`을 5,000개씩 나눠 부른다. 틀렸을 때 비용: `togglePosition` 한 함수.
9. **Q-68 (표 행의 접근성 설명은 색 점이 있는 태그만 말한다).** 명세 5.1: "행의 접근성 설명에 '태그: 중요, 시험 범위'". 점이 있는 태그는 색 태그뿐이라 보이는 것과 같은 정보를 읽어 주도록 색 태그만, 점과 같은 자리 순으로 말한다(색 없는 태그는 항목 패널이 말한다). 숨긴 요소(`hidden`)에 설명을 두고 행의 `aria-describedby`가 가리킨다 — 행의 이름(`rowheader`의 내용)에는 들어가지 않는다. 틀렸을 때 비용: `tagDots.ts`의 필터 한 줄.
10. **Q-69 (상태 보드에 4번째 쪽 "태그").** 칩의 상태·8색 견본·표의 색 점·선택기 전체는 기존 보드(1–2)에 더하면 1440×900에 안 맞고(보드는 넘침 검사를 한다) 모든 기준 PNG가 바뀐다. 제안: 보드 쪽 `part=4`(`readWindowParams`의 `part`를 `1 | 2 | 3 | 4`로)를 새로 두고 투어가 `gallery4-{light,dark}`를 찍는다. Task 7의 "태그 추가" 칩·입력 행은 이 쪽의 "태그 칩" 구역에 더한다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 쪽 번호와 투어 장면 하나.

**단순히 따르는 것(판정 아님)**: 선택기는 라이브러리 보기에서 자료가 있을 때만 그린다(리더는 사이드바가 "돌아가는 길"이라 거를 대상이 없고, 빈 라이브러리는 명세 3.6이 선택기 없음) · 합치기 시트를 취소하면 이름 칸을 닫고 옛 이름으로 돌아간다 · 삭제 시트의 상세는 붙은 자료가 0개면 "붙어 있는 자료가 없습니다." · 칩 이름이 한국어 조합 중이면 ↩·esc는 조합만 끝낸다(IME 검사 사본이 `TagNameField.tsx` 한 곳에 있다 — Task 10의 Step 1 소스 훑기가 이 파일을 더 찾으면 `isComposingKey`로 바꾼다).

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

사이드바 맨 아래의 태그 선택기와 그 둘레를 만든다. 눈에 보이는 변화: 태그가 하나라도 있으면 사이드바 아래에 선택기(머리 "태그" + "…" 메뉴, 칩 구름, "태그 필터" 칸), 표의 제목 셀에 색 점, 색 태그가 있을 때 파일 메뉴·자료 메뉴의 "색 태그 ▸", 필터 결과가 없을 때의 표 몸통, ⌘/ 시트의 "정리" 한 줄. 태그가 없는 라이브러리의 화면은 한 픽셀도 바뀌지 않는다(투어의 기존 PNG는 그대로 통과해야 한다).

- 도메인: 명령 열세 개(`tag.color1`–`8`, `tag.rename`, `tag.setColor`, `tag.clearColor`, `tag.delete`, `tags.clearFilter`), `SUBMENUS`의 `colorTags`, `tagSlot`·`paletteListed`.
- main: 코드는 그대로다 — Task 4가 만든 묶음 구성기·`tagColors` 값 줄·점 아이콘·태그 컨텍스트 메뉴 길이 이제 실제 레지스트리의 줄을 읽는다. 이 작업은 `M/menu/testing.ts`의 색 대역을 실제 항목으로 바꾸고, "아직 없다"를 못박은 시험 넷을 뒤집는다.
- 순수 모듈 `R/tags/{tagColor,tagName,tagCloud,tagDots,organizeCache,chipKeys,paletteTags}.ts`와 단위 시험, 동작 `tagActions.ts`(주입식, 시험은 가짜 의존으로), 저장소의 `dropFromTagFilter`.
- 화면 `R/tags/{TagChip,ChipGroup,TagDots,TagNameField,TagSelector,TagFilterEmpty}.tsx`, CSS 둘, `MenuIconButton`, `Shell`의 `sidebarFoot` 슬롯, 표·팔레트·⌘/ 시트·키맵 배선, 상태 보드 4쪽.
- 시험: `E/tags.spec.ts`, 명령 전수 실행 장부, 투어 장면 셋, axe, Mac `organize` suite 시험 둘.

|---|---|
| 태그 IPC는 M2에 있다: `tags.rename`(같은 이름이면 DB가 합치고 남은 태그를 돌려준다)·`setColor(id, color, position)`·`remove`·`assign`·`unassign`·`togglePosition(position, itemIds)` → `{ tagId, assigned } \| null`, `itemIds` ≤ 5,000 | `DB/tags-repository.ts`, `M/ipc/organize.ts`(tags 핸들러), `D/ipc.ts:43-48` |
| 태그 이름은 NFC·앞뒤 공백 정리·1–200자, 대소문자를 가리지 않고 하나(SQLite `NOCASE`는 ASCII만) | `DB/tags-repository.ts`(`cleanName`, `findByName`) |
| 렌더러 키맵은 `event.code`로 맞추고 조합 중(`isComposing`·229)·⌘⌃⌥와 함께·글자 칸 안에서는 `inText`가 아닌 키를 무시한다 — `Digit1`…은 이 규칙만 필요하다 | `R/commands/keymap.ts:15-23` |

| 제목 셀은 `TitleCell` = 아이콘, 제목, `ItemMarks`(연결 표시 + 파일 없음 플래그를 한 조각으로 항목 패널 머리 `InfoHead.tsx:42`와 나눠 쓴다); 행은 `memo`이고 이름은 `rowheader` 내용이다 | `R/library/LibraryTable.tsx:86-96`, `:119-159` |

  ```ts
  // R/tags/tagColor.ts
  export function tagColorVar(position: number): string;                                    // 'var(--tag-N)'

  // R/tags/TagChip.tsx — data-testid `tag-chip-<tagId>` on the main element
  export interface TagChipProps {
    tag: OrganizeTag; role: 'filter' | 'assigned'; on?: boolean; dim?: boolean; onToggle?: () => void; onRemove?: () => void;
    dragProps?: Record<string, unknown>;

  }
  export function TagChip(props: TagChipProps): React.JSX.Element;
  // R/tags/ChipGroup.tsx — every focusable child with `data-chip-id` is a roving stop

  // R/tags/TagDots.tsx

  // R/tags/tagActions.ts — the window's one instance is R/tags/actions.ts `tagActions`

    startRename(tagId: string): void;
    finishRename(text: string, how: 'enter' | 'blur'): Promise<void>;
    cancelRename(): void;

    clearColor(tagId: string): Promise<void>;

    togglePosition(position: number, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;   // 1–8
  }
  // R/commands/registry.ts — CommandEnv gains
  toggleTagPosition(position: number, itemIds: readonly string[]): void;   renameTag(tagId: string): void;   setTagColor(tagId: string, position: number): void;
  clearTagColor(tagId: string): void;   deleteTag(tagId: string): void;   clearTagFilter(): void;
  // R/state/library-store.ts — LibraryState gains
  dropFromTagFilter(tagId: string, replaceWith?: string): void;
  // R/ui/MenuButton.tsx
  export function MenuIconButton<K extends string>(props: { label: string; icon: LucideIcon; items: readonly MenuEntry<K>[]; onAction(id: K): void; placement?: 'bottom start' | 'bottom end'; size?: 'regular' | 'small'; testId?: string }): JSX.Element;
  ```

- 이후 작업이 기대는 것: **Task 7** — `TagChip role="assigned"`(×·⌫)·`ChipGroup role="list"`(줄바꿈 flex 컨테이너, 칩만 담는다 — "태그 추가" 칩은 그 밖 바로 뒤)·`tagColorVar`·`dotTags`를 항목 패널의 태그 절이 쓰고, "태그 추가" 칩은 `.chip.add`(이 작업의 CSS에 있다)와 `data-chip-id`로 정거장이 된다; 상태 보드 4쪽의 "태그 칩" 구역에 그 칩·입력 행을 더한다; 단일 이름 바꾸기·합치기는 `tagActions`(`R/tags/actions.ts`)를 쓴다; `collection.addItems`는 `menu` 2·4 / 컨텍스트 메뉴 3·1, `collection.removeItems`는 `menu` 2·5 / 3·2(Q-64, 컨트롤러 확인); `M/menu/testing.ts`의 `ADD_TO_COLLECTION` 대역을 같은 식으로 실제 명령으로 바꾼다. **Task 8** — `TagChip.dragProps`(RAC `useDrag` 속성을 주 요소에 펼친다, 키 처리기는 합성한다)·`data-chip-id`·시험 id; 칩을 표 행에 놓으면 `tagActions`가 아니라 Task 8이 `tags.assign`을 부른다. **Task 10** — 시험 id `tag-chip-<tagId>`, 검색 색인의 태그 필드는 `model.tagsOfItem`(이 작업이 건드리지 않는다), `LibraryView`의 `empty` 분기는 Task 5·6의 모양(`noResults ? … : scopeEmpty ? … : tagEmpty ? … : undefined`)에서 이어 고친다; `R/tags/TagNameField.tsx`의 조합 검사 사본을 `isComposingKey`로 바꾼다. **Task 11** — 태그를 더한 1만 항목 픽스처에서 선택기의 `cloudChips`·`viewCounts`는 `scoped` 집합 하나와 태그별 집합의 작은 쪽 순회뿐이다. **Task 12** — 장부·키보드 여정·axe 모음이 이 작업의 시험 제목과 시험 id를 읽는다; 디자인 명세 6 "태그 칩"에 옮길 판정(칩의 `×`는 호버·포커스에서만 자리를 차지한다, 편집 중인 칩의 모양)과 명세 3.3의 Tab 순서(Q-60)·5.1의 점 자리(Q-61)를 정리한다.

- [ ] **Step 2: 도메인 — 실패하는 시험**

`packages/domain/test/tag-commands.test.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  COLOR_SLOTS, COMMANDS, NO_LIBRARY_VIEW, SUBMENUS, availableMenuCommands, commandById, inPalette, isCommandAvailable, paletteListed, submenuProblems, tagPositionsMask, tagSlot,
  type CommandContextState, type CommandId, type CommandTargetInfo,
} from '../src/commands';

const LIB: CommandContextState = { view: 'library', blocked: false, textSize: 13, libraryCount: 9, selectionCount: 0, selectionAvailable: 0, selectionRelinkable: 0, ...NO_LIBRARY_VIEW };
const VIEWER: CommandContextState = { ...LIB, view: 'viewer' };
const ITEM: CommandTargetInfo = { kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' };
const tagTarget = (hasColor: boolean): CommandTargetInfo => ({ kind: 'tag', id: 't1', hasColor });
const colorKey = (n: number) => `tag.color${n}` as CommandId;
const isColorKey = (id: CommandId) => tagSlot(id) !== null;

describe('the eight colour keys (spec 4.2)', () => {
  it('are 1–8 of the top row, one command each, named by their slot, with no placement of their own and no key while a field has the focus', () => {
    expect(COLOR_SLOTS).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);
    for (const n of COLOR_SLOTS) {
      const c = commandById(colorKey(n));
      expect(c, `tag.color${n}`).toMatchObject({ label: `색 태그 ${n}`, key: { code: `Digit${n}` }, contexts: ['item'], palette: true });
      expect(c.accelerator).toBeUndefined(); // an accelerator would take the digit from every text field (ADR-0005 §3)
      expect(c.menu).toBeUndefined();
      expect(c.contextMenu).toBeUndefined();
      expect(c.key?.inText).toBeUndefined();
      expect(c.key?.shift).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });
  it('run in the library view on at least one selected item, also on a slot no tag holds (the handler says so); never in the reader, blocked, or on nothing', () => {
    for (const n of COLOR_SLOTS) {
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), LIB, [ITEM]), `${n}`).toBe(true);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), LIB, [ITEM, ITEM, ITEM]), `${n} several`).toBe(true);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), LIB, []), `${n} none`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), VIEWER, [ITEM]), `${n} reader`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), { ...LIB, blocked: true }, [ITEM]), `${n} blocked`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(colorKey(n), LIB, [tagTarget(true)]), `${n} a tag is no item`).toBe(false);
    }
    // What slots hold never gates the key: the user who presses 2 with no tag at 2 is told so.
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tag.color2', { ...LIB, tagPositions: 0 }, [ITEM])).toBe(true);
  });
  it('are listed in the palette only while a tag holds their slot; every other command always is', () => {
    const ctx = { tagPositions: tagPositionsMask([1, 3]) };
    expect(COLOR_SLOTS.filter((n) => paletteListed(commandById(colorKey(n)), ctx))).toEqual([1, 3]);
    expect(paletteListed(commandById('app.settings'), ctx)).toBe(true);
    expect(paletteListed(commandById('tags.clearFilter'), { tagPositions: 0 })).toBe(true);
    for (const n of COLOR_SLOTS) expect(inPalette(commandById(colorKey(n))), `${n}`).toBe(true);
  });
  it('tagSlot reads the digit a colour key ends with, and nothing else is a colour key', () => {
    expect(COLOR_SLOTS.map((n) => tagSlot(colorKey(n)))).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);
    for (const id of ['tag.rename', 'tag.setColor', 'tags.clearFilter', 'tag.color9', 'tag.color0', 'tag.color'] as CommandId[]) expect(tagSlot(id), id).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('색 태그 ▸ (spec 9.2, P-3)', () => {
  it('is one group of the eight keys in slot order: in 파일 after the item commands and in the item menu after 컬렉션에 추가 ▸', () => {
    expect(SUBMENUS).toEqual([
      {
        id: 'colorTags',
        label: '색 태그',
        commands: COLOR_SLOTS.map(colorKey),
        menu: { menu: 'file', group: 2, order: 6 },
        contextMenu: { kinds: ['item'], group: 3, order: 3 },
      },
    ]);
    expect(submenuProblems(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('counts its members in the menu bar judgement: on with a selection in the library, off without one and in the reader', () => {
    const one: CommandContextState = { ...LIB, selectionCount: 1, selectionAvailable: 1 };
    expect(availableMenuCommands(one).filter(isColorKey)).toEqual(COLOR_SLOTS.map(colorKey));
    expect(availableMenuCommands(LIB).filter(isColorKey)).toEqual([]);
    expect(availableMenuCommands({ ...one, view: 'viewer' }).filter(isColorKey)).toEqual([]);
    expect(availableMenuCommands({ ...one, blocked: true }).filter(isColorKey)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('the tag chip\'s menu (spec 9.2, 9.3)', () => {
  it('lists 이름 바꾸기 · 색 지정 ▸ · 색 해제 | 태그 삭제… in that order, and is in neither the palette nor the menu bar', () => {
    const menu = COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.contextMenu?.kinds.includes('tag')).sort((a, b) => a.contextMenu!.group - b.contextMenu!.group || a.contextMenu!.order - b.contextMenu!.order);
    expect(menu.map((c) => [c.label, c.contextMenu!.group])).toEqual([['이름 바꾸기', 1], ['색 지정', 1], ['색 해제', 1], ['태그 삭제…', 2]]);
    expect(menu.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual(['tag.rename', 'tag.setColor', 'tag.clearColor', 'tag.delete']);
    for (const c of menu) {
      expect(c.contexts, c.id).toEqual(['tag']);
      expect(c.menu, c.id).toBeUndefined();
      expect(inPalette(c), c.id).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(commandById('tag.setColor')).toMatchObject({ submenu: 'tagColors', palette: false });
  });
  it('act on exactly one tag; 색 해제 needs a colour to clear', () => {
    for (const id of ['tag.rename', 'tag.setColor', 'tag.delete'] as const) {
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, LIB, [tagTarget(false)]), id).toBe(true);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, LIB, []), `${id} none`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, LIB, [tagTarget(false), tagTarget(true)]), `${id} two`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, LIB, [ITEM]), `${id} an item`).toBe(false);
      expect(isCommandAvailable(id, { ...LIB, blocked: true }, [tagTarget(false)]), `${id} blocked`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tag.clearColor', LIB, [tagTarget(true)])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tag.clearColor', LIB, [tagTarget(false)])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tag.rename', VIEWER, [tagTarget(false)])).toBe(true); // the selector is not in the reader, but a tag command does not need the table
  });
});

describe('태그 선택 해제 (spec 4.3)', () => {
  it('is a palette command and the selector\'s menu row; it runs only while a filter is set, in the library view', () => {
    const c = commandById('tags.clearFilter');
    expect(c).toMatchObject({ label: '태그 선택 해제', contexts: ['library'], palette: true });
    expect(c.menu).toBeUndefined();
    expect(c.keywords?.some((k) => /[가-힣]/.test(k))).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tags.clearFilter', LIB)).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tags.clearFilter', { ...LIB, tagFilterCount: 2 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tags.clearFilter', { ...LIB, tagFilterCount: 2, view: 'viewer' })).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('tags.clearFilter', { ...LIB, tagFilterCount: 2, blocked: true })).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

⑤ `inPalette`(Task 4가 `needsTargets`를 두었다) 정의 다음에 더한다:
```ts
/** The slot (1–8) a colour key stands for, or null for any other command. */
export function tagSlot(id: CommandId): number | null {
  const m = /^tag\.color([1-8])$/.exec(id);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) : null;
}

/**
 * Whether the palette lists a command now, beside inPalette and availability: a colour key only while a tag holds its slot
 * (spec 4.2) — a row for an empty slot could not do what its name says. The key itself still runs (it tells the user).
 */
export function paletteListed(spec: CommandSpec, ctx: Pick<CommandContextState, 'tagPositions'>): boolean {
  const slot = tagSlot(spec.id);
  return slot === null || hasTagPosition(ctx.tagPositions, slot);
}
```

```ts
describe('the tag menu from the real registry (spec 9.2)', () => {
```

`R/tags/tagColor.test.ts`:
```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TAG_COLORS } from '@learn/domain';
import { tagColorId, tagColorVar } from './tagColor';

const tokens = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../design/tokens.css'), 'utf8');

describe('tag colours (design-spec 4)', () => {
  it('slot N is the var of token --tag-N', () => {
    expect([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map(tagColorVar)).toEqual(['var(--tag-1)', 'var(--tag-2)', 'var(--tag-3)', 'var(--tag-4)', 'var(--tag-5)', 'var(--tag-6)', 'var(--tag-7)', 'var(--tag-8)']);
  });
  it('colour N is the domain\'s colour N, and the token has its value (the same in both themes)', () => {
    TAG_COLORS.forEach((c, i) => {
      expect(tagColorId(i + 1)).toBe(c.id);
      expect(tokens, `--tag-${i + 1}`).toMatch(new RegExp(`--tag-${i + 1}:\\s*${c.hex};`));
    });
  });
  it('refuses a slot there is no colour for', () => {
    expect(() => tagColorId(0)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => tagColorId(9)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('a tag name (spec 4.1)', () => {
  it('is NFC and trimmed, as the database stores it', () => {
    expect(cleanTagName('  \u1112\u1161\u11ab  ')).toBe('한');
    expect(cleanTagName('  중요 ')).toBe('중요');

  });
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { TAG_COLORS, type OrganizeSnapshot, type OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { withTagColor, withTagMerged, withTagRemoved, withTagRenamed, withTagged } from './organizeCache';

const tag = (id: string, name: string, position: number | null = null): OrganizeTag => ({ id, name, color: position === null ? null : TAG_COLORS[position - 1]!.id, position });
const BASE: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [],
  tags: [tag('a', '중요', 1), tag('b', '복습'), tag('c', '질문')],
  members: {},
  tagged: { a: ['i1', 'i2'], b: ['i2', 'i3'] },
  duplicates: [],
};
const frozen = JSON.stringify(BASE);
const byId = (s: OrganizeSnapshot, id: string) => s.tags.find((x) => x.id === id);

describe('the organize snapshot patched before the notice brings the real one (tags)', () => {
  it('renames a tag in place', () => {
    const next = withTagRenamed(BASE, 'b', '다시 보기');
    expect(byId(next, 'b')?.name).toBe('다시 보기');
    expect(next.tags.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c']);
    expect(next.tagged).toBe(BASE.tagged);
  });
  it('colours a tag by slot, and the tag that held the slot loses colour and slot with it — one change', () => {
    const next = withTagColor(BASE, 'b', 'yellow', 1);
    expect(byId(next, 'b')).toMatchObject({ color: 'yellow', position: 1 });
    expect(byId(next, 'a')).toMatchObject({ color: null, position: null });
    expect(next.tags.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['b', 'a', 'c']); // coloured first, as the database lists them
  });
  it('colours into a free slot without touching the others, and clears a colour with a null slot', () => {
    const next = withTagColor(BASE, 'c', 'green', 3);
    expect(next.tags.map((x) => [x.id, x.position])).toEqual([['a', 1], ['c', 3], ['b', null]]);
    const cleared = withTagColor(BASE, 'a', null, null);
    expect(byId(cleared, 'a')).toMatchObject({ color: null, position: null });
    expect(cleared.tags.filter((x) => x.position !== null)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('removes a tag and its items', () => {
    const next = withTagRemoved(BASE, 'a');
    expect(next.tags.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['b', 'c']);
    expect(next.tagged).toEqual({ b: ['i2', 'i3'] });
  });
  it('merges one tag into another: the items are the union without repeats, the other stays as it is, this one is gone', () => {
    const next = withTagMerged(BASE, 'a', 'b');
    expect(next.tags.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual(['b', 'c']);
    expect(next.tagged).toEqual({ b: ['i2', 'i3', 'i1'] });
    expect(byId(next, 'b')).toEqual(byId(BASE, 'b'));
    expect(withTagMerged(BASE, 'c', 'a').tagged).toEqual({ a: ['i1', 'i2'], b: ['i2', 'i3'] }); // nothing to move
  });
  it('puts a tag on items or takes it off, keeping only the keys that have items (Q-2)', () => {
    expect(withTagged(BASE, 'c', ['i1', 'i1', 'i4'], true).tagged.c).toEqual(['i1', 'i4']);
    expect(withTagged(BASE, 'a', ['i3'], true).tagged.a).toEqual(['i1', 'i2', 'i3']);
    expect(withTagged(BASE, 'a', ['i1'], false).tagged.a).toEqual(['i2']);
    expect('a' in withTagged(BASE, 'a', ['i1', 'i2', 'i9'], false).tagged).toBe(false);
  });
  it('never changes the snapshot it was given', () => {
    withTagColor(BASE, 'b', 'yellow', 1);
    withTagMerged(BASE, 'a', 'b');
    withTagRemoved(BASE, 'a');
    withTagged(BASE, 'a', ['i1'], false);
    expect(JSON.stringify(BASE)).toBe(frozen);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { TAG_COLORS, type TagColorId } from '@learn/domain';

/** The colour of slot N as a CSS value: the token tokens.css defines (the same in both themes). */
export function tagColorVar(position: number): string {
  return `var(--tag-${position})`;
}

/** Colour N is slot N (Zotero's order, design-spec 4): the domain colour a slot stands for. */
export function tagColorId(position: number): TagColorId {
  const color = TAG_COLORS[position - 1];
  if (!color) throw new RangeError(`no tag colour at slot ${position}`);
  return color.id;
}
```

```ts
export const MAX_TAG_NAME = 200;

/** NFC and trimmed, as the database stores a tag name. */
export const cleanTagName = (raw: string): string => raw.normalize('NFC').trim();

const fold = (raw: string): string => cleanTagName(raw).toLowerCase();
/** The same name by the database's rule (case-insensitive, SQLite folds ASCII only) or a wider one: the sheet is asked at least when the database would merge. */
export const sameTagName = (a: string, b: string): boolean => fold(a) === fold(b);

/** Over the limit as the database counts it: UTF-16 units of the cleaned name. */
export const tooLongTagName = (raw: string): boolean => cleanTagName(raw).length > MAX_TAG_NAME;

export type TagNameVerdict = { kind: 'unchanged' } | { kind: 'tooLong' } | { kind: 'rename'; name: string };

/** What the name field held, against the tag's name: blank or the same keeps it, too long is refused, else a rename (a case change is one). */
export function tagNameVerdict(text: string, original: string): TagNameVerdict {
  const name = cleanTagName(text);
  if (name === '' || name === cleanTagName(original)) return { kind: 'unchanged' };
  if (name.length > MAX_TAG_NAME) return { kind: 'tooLong' };
  return { kind: 'rename', name };
}
```

`R/tags/tagCloud.ts`:
```ts
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { matchKorean } from '../palette/hangul';
import type { TagsSelector } from '../organize/viewSettings';

export interface CloudChip {
  tag: OrganizeTag;
  /** In the filter. */
  on: boolean;
  /** The view shown has no item with it (only drawn in 모든 태그; a chip that is on is never dim). */
  dim: boolean;
}

export interface CloudInput {
  /** Every tag, as the model has them. */
  tags: readonly OrganizeTag[];
  /** Per tag, the number of items of the view (the scope, before the tag filter and the search) that have it. */
  counts: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
  filter: ReadonlySet<string>;
  selector: TagsSelector;
  /** The "태그 필터" field. */
  query: string;
}

const collator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true });

/** How many of the view's items each tag has: the common part of its items and the view's, counted from the smaller side. */
export function viewCounts(tags: readonly OrganizeTag[], tagItems: (tagId: string) => ReadonlySet<string>, scoped: ReadonlySet<string>): Map<string, number> {
  const out = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const tag of tags) {
    const items = tagItems(tag.id);
    const [small, big] = items.size <= scoped.size ? [items, scoped] : [scoped, items];
    let n = 0;
    for (const id of small) if (big.has(id)) n++;
    out.set(tag.id, n);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The selector's chips (spec 4.3): the colour tags first by slot, the rest by name or by how many of the view's items they
 * have; the field narrows by name (NFC, case folded, 초성). 현재 보기의 태그만 leaves out a tag the view lacks, unless it is
 * in the filter (so it can be taken out); 모든 태그 keeps it, dim.
 */
export function cloudChips(input: CloudInput): CloudChip[] {
  const { tags, counts, filter, selector } = input;
  const query = input.query.trim();
  const inView = (tag: OrganizeTag) => (counts.get(tag.id) ?? 0) > 0;
  const shown = tags.filter((tag) => {
    if (selector.show === 'view' && !filter.has(tag.id) && !inView(tag)) return false;
    return query === '' || matchKorean(query, tag.name) !== null;
  });
  const coloured = shown.filter((tag) => tag.position !== null).sort((a, b) => a.position! - b.position!);
  const byName = (a: OrganizeTag, b: OrganizeTag) => collator.compare(a.name, b.name);
  const byCount = (a: OrganizeTag, b: OrganizeTag) => (counts.get(b.id) ?? 0) - (counts.get(a.id) ?? 0) || byName(a, b);
  const rest = shown.filter((tag) => tag.position === null).sort(selector.sort === 'count' ? byCount : byName);
  return [...coloured, ...rest].map((tag) => {
    const on = filter.has(tag.id);
    return { tag, on, dim: !on && !inView(tag) };
  });
}
```

```ts
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';

/** The tags a table row draws a dot for: the coloured ones, by slot (the model already lists them so; sorted again for any caller). */
export function dotTags(tags: readonly OrganizeTag[]): readonly OrganizeTag[] {
  const coloured = tags.filter((tag) => tag.position !== null);
  return coloured.every((tag, i) => i === 0 || coloured[i - 1]!.position! <= tag.position!) ? coloured : [...coloured].sort((a, b) => a.position! - b.position!);
}

/** The row's accessible description (spec 5.1): the dots say it by colour, this says it by name. Null when there is no dot. */
export function tagsDescription(tags: readonly OrganizeTag[]): string | null {
  const dots = dotTags(tags);
  return dots.length === 0 ? null : t.organize.tags.description(dots.map((tag) => tag.name));
}
```

`R/tags/organizeCache.ts`:
```ts
import type { OrganizeSnapshot, OrganizeTag, TagColorId } from '@learn/domain';

type Tagged = OrganizeSnapshot['tagged'];

/** The database lists tags with a slot first by slot, then the others: the same here, so a patched snapshot reads like a fresh one. */
function listed(tags: readonly OrganizeTag[]): OrganizeTag[] {
  const slotted = tags.filter((tag) => tag.position !== null).sort((a, b) => a.position! - b.position!);
  return [...slotted, ...tags.filter((tag) => tag.position === null)];
}
const without = (tagged: Tagged, tagId: string): Tagged => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(tagged).filter(([id]) => id !== tagId));

export function withTagRenamed(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, name: string): OrganizeSnapshot {
  return { ...s, tags: s.tags.map((tag) => (tag.id === tagId ? { ...tag, name } : tag)) };
}

/** Colour and slot together (an app-wide pair): the tag that held the slot loses both. */
export function withTagColor(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, color: TagColorId | null, position: number | null): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const tags = s.tags.map((tag): OrganizeTag => {
    if (tag.id === tagId) return { ...tag, color, position };
    return position !== null && tag.position === position ? { ...tag, color: null, position: null } : tag;
  });
  return { ...s, tags: listed(tags) };
}

export function withTagRemoved(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string): OrganizeSnapshot {
  return { ...s, tags: s.tags.filter((tag) => tag.id !== tagId), tagged: without(s.tagged, tagId) };
}

/** `fromId` is merged into `intoId`: its items go to the other tag (no repeats), which keeps its own name, colour and slot. */
export function withTagMerged(s: OrganizeSnapshot, fromId: string, intoId: string): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const union = [...new Set([...(s.tagged[intoId] ?? []), ...(s.tagged[fromId] ?? [])])];
  const tagged = without(s.tagged, fromId);
  if (union.length > 0) tagged[intoId] = union;
  return { ...s, tags: s.tags.filter((tag) => tag.id !== fromId), tagged };
}

/** The tag put on (`assigned`) or taken off these items. A tag with no item has no key (Q-2). */
export function withTagged(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, itemIds: readonly string[], assigned: boolean): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const current = s.tagged[tagId] ?? [];
  const gone = new Set(itemIds);
  const next = assigned ? [...new Set([...current, ...itemIds])] : current.filter((id) => !gone.has(id));
  const tagged = { ...s.tagged };
  if (next.length > 0) tagged[tagId] = next;
  else delete tagged[tagId];
  return { ...s, tagged };
}
```

`R/tags/chipKeys.ts`:
```ts
export interface ChipKey {
  key: string;
  shiftKey: boolean;
  altKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  metaKey: boolean;
}
export type ChipRole = 'filter' | 'assigned';
export type ChipKeyAction = { kind: 'move'; to: 'previous' | 'next' | 'first' | 'last' } | { kind: 'rename' } | { kind: 'remove' } | null;

/**
 * What a key does on a focused chip (spec 4.3, design-spec 6 태그 칩). Space is left to the button (it toggles the filter);
 * the menu key is `isContextMenuKey`'s. A filter chip is renamed with ↩; an assigned chip has no name field and is taken
 * off with ⌫ (or Delete).
 */
export function chipKeyAction(e: ChipKey, role: ChipRole): ChipKeyAction {
  if (e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) return null;
  switch (e.key) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
      return { kind: 'move', to: 'previous' };
    case 'ArrowRight':
      return { kind: 'move', to: 'next' };
    case 'Home':
      return { kind: 'move', to: 'first' };
    case 'End':
      return { kind: 'move', to: 'last' };
    case 'Enter':
      return role === 'filter' ? { kind: 'rename' } : null;
    case 'Backspace':
    case 'Delete':
      return role === 'assigned' ? { kind: 'remove' } : null;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { tagSlot, type CommandSpec } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';

/**
 * The palette's colour keys, each named by the tag at its slot — "색 태그 3 · 중요" (spec 4.2). A slot whose tag is not known
 * (yet) is left out; every other command passes unchanged. The copies keep their ids, so a run, the recent list and the
 * ranking are unaffected, and the registry's own labels stay what the menus and the ⌘/ sheet show.
 */
export function tagPaletteCommands(commands: readonly CommandSpec[], nameAt: (slot: number) => string | undefined): CommandSpec[] {
  return commands.flatMap((c): CommandSpec[] => {
    const slot = tagSlot(c.id);
    if (slot === null) return [c];
    const name = nameAt(slot);
    return name === undefined ? [] : [{ ...c, label: t.organize.tags.paletteName(slot, name) }];
  });
}
```

```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';

export interface TagEditState {
  /** The tag whose chip is its name field, or null. */
  editingId: string | null;
  text: string;
  /** What had the focus when the edit began (kept for the focus to go back to when no chip can take it). */
  opener: Element | null;
  /** The rename call is out (or the merge sheet is up): the field is read-only and nothing else finishes the edit. */
  busy: boolean;
  /** Set by `end`: the selector gives the focus to this tag's chip (else the opener) and clears it. */
  restoreTo: { tagId: string | null; opener: Element | null } | null;
  begin(tagId: string, text: string, opener?: Element | null): void;
  setText(text: string): void;
  setBusy(busy: boolean): void;
  /** Ends the edit. `restore`: the tag whose chip gets the focus (default: this one; a merge hands it to the tag that remains), false after a click elsewhere, which already put it somewhere. */
  end(restore?: string | false): void;
  clearRestore(): void;
}

export const useTagEdit = create<TagEditState>()((set, get) => ({
  editingId: null,
  text: '',
  opener: null,
  busy: false,
  restoreTo: null,
  begin: (tagId, text, opener = null) => set({ editingId: tagId, text, opener, busy: false, restoreTo: null }),
  setText: (text) => {
    if (get().editingId !== null && get().text !== text) set({ text });
  },
  setBusy: (busy) => set({ busy }),
  end: (restore) => {
    const { editingId, opener } = get();
    if (editingId === null) return;
    set({ editingId: null, text: '', opener: null, busy: false, restoreTo: restore === false ? null : { tagId: restore ?? editingId, opener } });
  },
  clearRestore: () => set({ restoreTo: null }),
}));
```

```ts
const row = (id: string, name: string, position: number | null = null): OrganizeTag => ({ id, name, color: position === null ? null : TAG_COLORS[position - 1]!.id, position });
const asTag = (r: OrganizeTag): Tag => ({ ...r, itemCount: 0 });
const BASE: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [],
  tags: [row('rng', '시험 범위', 1), row('imp', '중요', 3), row('rec', '수용체'), row('alpha', 'Alpha'), row('empty', '복습')],
  members: {},

      unassign: vi.fn(async ({ itemIds }) => itemIds.length),
```

`R/tags/tagActions.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { OrganizeSnapshot, Tag, TagColorId } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { withTagColor, withTagMerged, withTagRemoved, withTagRenamed, withTagged } from './organizeCache';
import { tagColorId } from './tagColor';
import { useTagEdit } from './tagEdit';
import { sameTagName, tagNameVerdict } from './tagName';

/** tags:togglePosition, tags:assign and tags:unassign take at most this many items (D/ipc.ts). */
export const TOGGLE_CHUNK = 5000;

/** Everything the tag actions touch outside themselves, so they run in a test without a window. */
export interface TagActionDeps {
  tags: {
    rename(input: { tagId: string; name: string }): Promise<Tag>;
    setColor(input: { tagId: string; color: TagColorId | null; position: number | null }): Promise<Tag>;
    remove(input: { tagId: string }): Promise<void>;
    assign(input: { tagId: string; itemIds: string[] }): Promise<number>;
    unassign(input: { tagId: string; itemIds: string[] }): Promise<number>;
    togglePosition(input: { position: number; itemIds: string[] }): Promise<{ tagId: string; assigned: boolean } | null>;
  };
  /** ui.confirm: the native sheet. */
  confirm(input: { message: string; detail?: string; confirm: string }): Promise<boolean>;
  model(): OrganizeModel | undefined;
  /** Changes the organize snapshot in the cache; the notice main sends next brings the real one. */
  patch(update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot): void;
  /** The tag left the filter (deleted, or merged into `into`, which takes its place). */
  leaveFilter(tagId: string, into?: string): void;
  /** What has the focus now. */
  opener(): Element | null;
  failed(e: unknown): void;
  /** A plain message that is not an error (a colour key with no tag at its slot). */
  notice(message: string): void;
}

export interface TagActions {
  /** ↩ on a chip, 이름 바꾸기 in its menu: the chip becomes its name field. */
  startRename(tagId: string): void;
  /**
   * Ends the edit with the text in the field: `enter` (↩) or `blur` (a click elsewhere). A name another tag has asks
   * first and merges; over the limit keeps the edit open on ↩ and drops it on a click.
   */
  finishRename(text: string, how: 'enter' | 'blur'): Promise<void>;
  cancelRename(): void;
  /** 색 지정 ▸ N: colour N is slot N; the tag that held the slot loses both — one call. */
  setColor(tagId: string, position: number): Promise<void>;
  clearColor(tagId: string): Promise<void>;
  /** 태그 삭제…: the sheet, then the delete. No undo (spec 0). */
  remove(tagId: string): Promise<void>;
  /** 1–8: the tag at the slot goes on the items, or off them when all have it. */
  togglePosition(position: number, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
}

export function createTagActions(deps: TagActionDeps): TagActions {
  const edit = () => useTagEdit.getState();
  const tagOf = (tagId: string) => deps.model()?.tags.find((x) => x.id === tagId);

  return {
    startRename(tagId) {
      const tag = tagOf(tagId);
      if (tag) edit().begin(tagId, tag.name, deps.opener());
    },

    async finishRename(text, how) {
      const s = edit();
      const id = s.editingId;
      if (id === null || s.busy) return;
      const model = deps.model();
      const tag = model?.tags.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!model || !tag) {
        s.end(false);
        return;
      }
      const verdict = tagNameVerdict(text, tag.name);
      if (verdict.kind === 'tooLong') {
        if (how !== 'enter') s.end(false);
        return;
      }
      if (verdict.kind === 'unchanged') {
        s.end(how === 'enter' ? id : false);
        return;
      }
      s.setBusy(true);
      let restore: string | false = how === 'enter' ? id : false;
      try {
        const clash = model.tags.find((x) => x.id !== id && sameTagName(x.name, verdict.name));
        if (clash) {
          const sure = await deps.confirm({
            message: t.organize.tags.mergeMessage(clash.name),
            detail: t.organize.tags.mergeDetail(tag.name, clash.name),
            confirm: t.organize.tags.mergeConfirm,
          });
          if (!sure) return; // the edit ends below, the old name back
        }
        const saved = await deps.tags.rename({ tagId: id, name: verdict.name });
        if (saved.id === id) deps.patch((snap) => withTagRenamed(snap, id, saved.name));
        else {
          // The database merged (the sheet said so, or the cache lagged): this tag is gone, the other has its items.
          deps.patch((snap) => withTagMerged(snap, id, saved.id));
          deps.leaveFilter(id, saved.id);
          if (restore !== false) restore = saved.id;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      } finally {
        if (edit().editingId === id) edit().end(restore);
      }
    },

    cancelRename() {
      const s = edit();
      if (s.editingId !== null && !s.busy) s.end();
    },

    async setColor(tagId, position) {
      const tag = tagOf(tagId);
      if (!tag || tag.position === position) return;
      const color = tagColorId(position);
      try {
        await deps.tags.setColor({ tagId, color, position });
        deps.patch((snap) => withTagColor(snap, tagId, color, position));
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },

    async clearColor(tagId) {
      const tag = tagOf(tagId);
      if (!tag || (tag.position === null && tag.color === null)) return;
      try {
        await deps.tags.setColor({ tagId, color: null, position: null });
        deps.patch((snap) => withTagColor(snap, tagId, null, null));
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },

    async remove(tagId) {
      const model = deps.model();
      const tag = model?.tags.find((x) => x.id === tagId);
      if (!model || !tag) return;
      const sure = await deps.confirm({
        message: t.organize.tags.deleteMessage(tag.name),
        detail: t.organize.tags.deleteDetail(model.tagItems(tagId).size),
        confirm: t.organize.tags.deleteConfirm,
      });
      if (!sure) return;
      try {
        await deps.tags.remove({ tagId });
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
        return;
      }
      deps.patch((snap) => withTagRemoved(snap, tagId));
      deps.leaveFilter(tagId);
    },

    async togglePosition(position, itemIds) {
      const model = deps.model();
      const tag = model?.tagByPosition(position);
      if (!model || !tag) {
        deps.notice(t.organize.tags.noSlot(position));
        return;
      }
      if (itemIds.length === 0) return;
      try {
        if (itemIds.length <= TOGGLE_CHUNK) {
          const done = await deps.tags.togglePosition({ position, itemIds: [...itemIds] });
          if (done === null) {
            deps.notice(t.organize.tags.noSlot(position));
            return;
          }
          deps.patch((snap) => withTagged(snap, done.tagId, itemIds, done.assigned));
        } else {
          // Past what one call takes: the model says whether every item has the tag, and the calls go in pieces.
          const held = model.tagItems(tag.id);
          const assigned = !itemIds.every((id) => held.has(id));
          for (let from = 0; from < itemIds.length; from += TOGGLE_CHUNK) {
            const piece = itemIds.slice(from, from + TOGGLE_CHUNK);
            await (assigned ? deps.tags.assign({ tagId: tag.id, itemIds: piece }) : deps.tags.unassign({ tagId: tag.id, itemIds: piece }));
          }
          deps.patch((snap) => withTagged(snap, tag.id, itemIds, assigned));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { currentModel, patchOrganize } from '../sidebar/actions';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { createTagActions } from './tagActions';

/** The window's tag actions: the selector, the registry's handlers and the 1–8 keys share them. */
export const tagActions = createTagActions({
  tags: {
    rename: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.rename(input)),
    setColor: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.setColor(input)),
    remove: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.remove(input)),
    assign: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.assign(input)),
    unassign: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.unassign(input)),
    togglePosition: (input) => unwrap(api().tags.togglePosition(input)),
  },
  confirm: (input) => unwrap(api().ui.confirm(input)),
  model: currentModel,
  patch: patchOrganize,
  leaveFilter: (tagId, into) => useLibrary.getState().dropFromTagFilter(tagId, into),
  opener: () => document.activeElement,
  failed: (e) => showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.actionFailed, body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, testId: 'action-error' }),
  notice: (title) => showToast({ kind: 'info', title, testId: 'tag-notice' }),
});
```

```ts
    const targetsOf = (t: { itemIds?: readonly string[]; tagIds?: readonly string[] }): CommandTargetInfo[] => [
      ...(t.itemIds ?? []).map((): CommandTargetInfo => ({ kind: 'item', storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available' })),

    const none = env({ targetsOf });

    const reader = env({ view: 'viewer', targetsOf, selection: () => [ID] });
    expect(runCommand('tag.color1', reader, menuTarget('tag.color1', reader))).toBe(false);
    // The chip's commands act on the one tag handed over; 색 해제 needs a colour.

    expect(runCommand('tag.delete', e, { tagIds: ['t1'] })).toBe(true);
    expect(e.deleteTag).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('t1');
    expect(runCommand('tag.clearColor', e, { tagIds: ['plain'] })).toBe(false);
    expect(runCommand('tag.clearColor', e, { tagIds: ['coloured'] })).toBe(true);
    expect(e.clearTagColor).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('coloured');
    // A picked row of 색 지정 ▸ carries its slot; the head without a row does nothing.
    expect(runPicked({ commandId: 'tag.setColor', args: { position: 3 } }, e, { tagIds: ['t1'] })).toBe(true);
    expect(e.setTagColor).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith('t1', 3);
    runPicked({ commandId: 'tag.setColor' }, e, { tagIds: ['t1'] });
    expect(e.setTagColor).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    // 태그 선택 해제 runs only while a filter is set.
    expect(runCommand('tags.clearFilter', e)).toBe(false);
    const filtered = env({ tagFilterCount: 2 });
    expect(runCommand('tags.clearFilter', filtered)).toBe(true);
    expect(filtered.clearTagFilter).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
```

`SYSTEM_APP_ROWS` 정의 다음에 더한다:
```ts
/** The colour keys as one line (spec 4.2): the first and last slot's key, spelled the way the platform spells a key. */
function colorKeysGroup(platform: string): ShortcutGroup {
  const slots = COMMANDS.filter((c) => tagSlot(c.id) !== null && c.key !== undefined);
  const first = keySpecKeys(slots[0]!.key!, platform).at(-1)!;
  const last = keySpecKeys(slots.at(-1)!.key!, platform).at(-1)!;
  return { title: t.sheets.groups.organize, rows: [{ label: t.sheets.colorKeys.label, keys: [`${first}–${last}`], spoken: t.sheets.colorKeys.spoken(first, last) }] };
}
```

```tsx
 * The "…" button of a web pop-up menu (design-spec 7.3 태그 선택기): an icon-only trigger with a tooltip, the same menu
 * (MenuList) in the same popover. For a button inside the content that has no room for a label.
 */
export function MenuIconButton<K extends string>(props: {
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  items: readonly MenuEntry<K>[];
  onAction(id: K): void;
  placement?: 'bottom start' | 'bottom end';
  size?: 'regular' | 'small';
  testId?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <MenuTrigger>
      <IconButton icon={props.icon} label={props.label} size={props.size ?? 'small'} testId={props.testId} />
      <Popover className="menu-popover" placement={props.placement ?? 'bottom end'} offset={4}>
        <MenuList entries={props.items} onAction={props.onAction} aria-label={props.label} />
      </Popover>
    </MenuTrigger>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { chipKeyAction } from './chipKeys';

interface Stops {
  /** The chip the user was last on (the group's one Tab stop), or null. */
  stop: string | null;
  /** The first chip, which is the stop until the user has been on another. */
  first: string | null;
  setStop(id: string): void;
}
const StopsContext = createContext<Stops | null>(null);

/** A chip's place in its group's one Tab stop (roving tabindex). Outside a group (the state board) every chip is a stop. */
export function useChipStop(id: string): { tabIndex: 0 | -1; onFocus(): void } {
  const group = useContext(StopsContext);
  if (!group) return { tabIndex: 0, onFocus: () => {} };
  return { tabIndex: (group.stop ?? group.first) === id ? 0 : -1, onFocus: () => group.setStop(id) };
}

const CHIPS = '[data-chip-id]';
const chipsOf = (root: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement[] => (root ? [...root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(CHIPS)] : []);

/**
 * A group of chips that is one Tab stop (spec 4.3, design-spec 6): ←→ Home End move between the chips, whatever lines they
 * wrap onto, and Tab leaves the group from the chip the user was last on. Every focusable child carrying `data-chip-id` is
 * a stop of the group. `toolbar` is the selector's (its chips toggle a filter), `list` the item panel's.
 */
export function ChipGroup(props: { label: string; children: ReactNode; role?: 'toolbar' | 'list'; className?: string; testId?: string }) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [stop, setStop] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [first, setFirst] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // Who leads, and whether the remembered chip is still there (it may have been deleted or filtered away): read from the DOM
  // after each render of the group. The updates bail out when nothing changed, so this settles in one pass.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const ids = chipsOf(root.current).map((el) => el.dataset['chipId']!);
    const lead = ids[0] ?? null;
    setFirst((prev) => (prev === lead ? prev : lead));
    setStop((prev) => (prev !== null && !ids.includes(prev) ? null : prev));
  });
  const value = useMemo<Stops>(() => ({ stop, first, setStop }), [stop, first]);

  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const chip = e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target.closest<HTMLElement>(CHIPS) : null;
    if (!chip || e.target !== chip || e.defaultPrevented) return;
    const action = chipKeyAction(e, 'filter');
    if (action?.kind !== 'move') return;
    const chips = chipsOf(root.current);
    const at = chips.indexOf(chip);
    const to = action.to === 'first' ? 0 : action.to === 'last' ? chips.length - 1 : at + (action.to === 'next' ? 1 : -1);
    const target = chips[Math.max(0, Math.min(chips.length - 1, to))];
    e.preventDefault();
    if (target && target !== chip) target.focus();
  };

  return (
    <StopsContext.Provider value={value}>
      <div ref={root} role={props.role ?? 'toolbar'} aria-label={props.label} className={cx('chip-group', props.className)} data-testid={props.testId} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        {props.children}
      </div>
    </StopsContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { tagActions } from './actions';
import { tagColorVar } from './tagColor';
import { useTagEdit } from './tagEdit';

/** A key that belongs to a Korean composition: isComposing, or the keyCode 229 macOS IMEs send without it. */
const composing = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>): boolean => e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229;

/**
 * The name being typed inside a tag chip (spec 4.1, 4.3): the whole name selected when it appears. ↩ saves, esc cancels, a
 * click elsewhere saves (as for a collection's name); a key a composition owns only finishes the syllable. The window
 * going to the background (a blur that is not the user's) does not save.
 */
export function TagNameField({ tag, invalid }: { tag: OrganizeTag; invalid?: boolean }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const busy = useTagEdit((s) => s.busy);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const input = ref.current;
    if (!input) return;
    input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    input.select();
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      {tag.position !== null && <i className="dot" style={{ background: tagColorVar(tag.position) }} aria-hidden="true" />}
      <input
        ref={ref}
        className="chip-input"
        data-testid="tag-rename-input"
        aria-label={t.organize.tags.nameLabel}
        aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
        defaultValue={tag.name}
        readOnly={busy}
        spellCheck={false}
        autoComplete="off"
        onChange={(e) => useTagEdit.getState().setText(e.currentTarget.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (composing(e)) return;
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            void tagActions.finishRename(e.currentTarget.value, 'enter');
          } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            tagActions.cancelRename();
          }
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          if (!document.hasFocus()) return;
          void tagActions.finishRename(e.currentTarget.value, 'blur');
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useRef, type FocusEvent, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { ForcedState } from '../ui/Button';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { isContextMenuKey, menuPointFor } from '../ui/contextMenuKey';
import { useChipStop } from './ChipGroup';
import { chipKeyAction, type ChipRole } from './chipKeys';
import { TagNameField } from './TagNameField';
import { tagColorVar } from './tagColor';
import { tooLongTagName } from './tagName';
import { useTagEdit } from './tagEdit';

export interface TagChipProps {
  tag: OrganizeTag;
  /** 'filter': the tag selector's chip (press / Space toggles the filter). 'assigned': a chip on an item (× / ⌫ removes). */
  role: ChipRole;
  on?: boolean;
  dim?: boolean;
  onToggle?: () => void;
  onRemove?: () => void;
  /** Task 8 passes RAC useDrag props here (hasDragButton: true); the keys it wants are composed with ours. */
  dragProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** The chip is its name field (a filter chip being renamed). */
  editing?: boolean;
  /** ↩ on a filter chip. */
  onRename?: () => void;
  /** Right click, the menu key or ⇧F10 on a filter chip: where to open the tag's menu. */
  onMenu?: (at: { x: number; y: number }) => void;
  /** State board only. */
  force?: ForcedState[];
}

type DragSlot = Pick<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'onKeyDown' | 'onFocus'> & Record<string, unknown>;

/** A `contextmenu` this soon after the menu our own key opened is the browser's echo of the same key (Windows sends it on key-up). */
const KEY_MENU_ECHO_MS = 500;

/** The chip while its name is typed: the pill is the field, the "too long" note under it (it takes a line of the cloud). */
function EditingChip({ tag, role }: { tag: OrganizeTag; role: ChipRole }) {
  const over = useTagEdit((s) => tooLongTagName(s.text));
  return (
    <>
      <span className="chip is-editing" data-role={role} data-testid={`tag-chip-editing-${tag.id}`}>
        <TagNameField tag={tag} invalid={over} />
      </span>
      {over && (
        <span className="chip-note" role="status" data-testid="tag-rename-note">
          {t.organize.tags.nameTooLong}
        </span>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * A tag chip (design-spec 6 태그 칩; mockup .chip): a 22 px pill with the 8 px colour dot of a coloured tag and the name.
 * The pill holds the one control that is the chip — a button for a filter chip (aria-pressed), a focusable list item for an
 * assigned one, which does nothing when pressed and has × beside it. Both are stops of their ChipGroup (`data-chip-id`).
 */
export function TagChip(props: TagChipProps) {
  const { tag, role, on, dim, onToggle, onRemove, onRename, onMenu, editing, force, dragProps } = props;
  const stop = useChipStop(tag.id);
  const keyMenuAt = useRef(Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY);
  if (editing) return <EditingChip tag={tag} role={role} />;

  const drag = (dragProps ?? {}) as DragSlot;
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    drag.onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
    if (role === 'filter' && isContextMenuKey(e)) {
      e.preventDefault(); // not the browser's own menu event for the key (it would open the menu twice)
      keyMenuAt.current = performance.now();
      onMenu?.(menuPointFor(e.currentTarget));
      return;
    }
    const action = chipKeyAction(e, role);
    if (action?.kind === 'rename') {
      e.preventDefault(); // ↩ on a button would also press it
      onRename?.();
    } else if (action?.kind === 'remove') {
      e.preventDefault();
      onRemove?.();
    }
  };
  const common = {
    ...drag,
    className: 'chip-main',
    'data-testid': `tag-chip-${tag.id}`,
    'data-chip-id': tag.id,
    tabIndex: stop.tabIndex,
    onFocus: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      drag.onFocus?.(e);
      stop.onFocus();
    },
    onKeyDown,
  };
  const inner = (
    <>
      {tag.position !== null && <i className="dot" style={{ background: tagColorVar(tag.position) }} aria-hidden="true" />}
      <span className="chip-label ellipsis">{tag.name}</span>
      {dim && <span className="visually-hidden">{t.organize.tags.notInView}</span>}
    </>
  );
  return (
    <span className={cx('chip', on && 'is-on', dim && 'is-dim')} data-role={role} data-force={force?.join(' ')}>
      {role === 'filter' ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          {...common}
          aria-pressed={Boolean(on)}
          data-on={on ? '' : undefined}
          data-dim={dim ? '' : undefined}
          onClick={onToggle}
          onContextMenu={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (performance.now() - keyMenuAt.current < KEY_MENU_ECHO_MS) return;
            onMenu?.({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
          }}
        >
          {inner}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <span role="listitem" {...common}>
          {inner}
        </span>
      )}
      {role === 'assigned' && (
        <button type="button" className="x" tabIndex={-1} aria-label={t.organize.tags.removeLabel(tag.name)} data-testid="tag-chip-remove" onClick={onRemove}>
          <Icon icon={X} size="xs" />
        </button>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { tagColorVar } from './tagColor';
import { dotTags } from './tagDots';

/**
 * The colour dots after a table title (spec 5.1; mockup .tag-dots): one 8 px dot per coloured tag, by slot, with a 0.5 px
 * inner border (a white 1 px ring on the accent-filled row — chip.css). Decoration: the row's description says the names.

export function TagDots({ tags }: { tags: readonly OrganizeTag[] }) {

        <i key={tag.id} data-tag-id={tag.id} data-position={tag.position!} style={{ background: tagColorVar(tag.position!) }} />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { saveSetting } from '../data/saveSetting';
import { parseTagsSelector, type TagsSelector } from '../organize/viewSettings';

/**
 * The selector's 표시 and 정렬 (library setting `tags.selector`, spec 4.3): parsed, the defaults when unset, written
 * optimistically. `ready` once the read has answered (success or not), so the chips are not drawn in the default order for a frame.
 */
export function useTagsSelector(): { selector: TagsSelector; update(patch: Partial<TagsSelector>): void; ready: boolean } {
  const read = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.tagsSelector, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'tags.selector' })) });
  const selector = useMemo(() => parseTagsSelector(read.data ?? null), [read.data]);
  const update = useCallback((patch: Partial<TagsSelector>) => {
    // From the newest value in the cache, not the render's: two quick choices both land.
    const current = parseTagsSelector(queryClient.getQueryData(keys.tagsSelector) ?? null);
    saveSetting('tags.selector', { ...current, ...patch });
  }, []);
  return { selector, update, ready: !read.isPending };
}
```

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Ellipsis } from 'lucide-react';
import type { LibraryItem, OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError, api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { runPicked } from '../commands/registry';
import { useItems } from '../data/queries';
import { useScopeView } from '../library/useScopeView';
import type { TagsSelector } from '../organize/viewSettings';
import { useOrganize } from '../organize/useOrganize';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { MENU_SEPARATOR, MenuIconButton, type MenuEntry } from '../ui/MenuButton';
import { SearchField } from '../ui/SearchField';
import { tagActions } from './actions';
import { ChipGroup } from './ChipGroup';
import { TagChip } from './TagChip';
import { cloudChips, viewCounts } from './tagCloud';
import { useTagEdit } from './tagEdit';
import { useTagsSelector } from './useTagsSelector';

const NO_ITEMS: readonly LibraryItem[] = [];
const NO_TAGS: readonly OrganizeTag[] = [];
const NO_COUNTS: ReadonlyMap<string, number> = new Map();

export type SelectorMenuId = 'view' | 'all' | 'name' | 'count' | 'clear';

/**
 * The "…" menu (design-spec 7.3, spec 4.3): 표시 — 현재 보기의 태그만 / 모든 태그, 정렬 — 이름순 / 많이 쓴 순, and, only while
 * a filter is set, 태그 선택 해제 after a separator. Also drawn by the state board.
 */
export function selectorMenu(selector: TagsSelector, filterCount: number): readonly MenuEntry<SelectorMenuId>[] {
  const id = (name: SelectorMenuId) => `tag-menu-${name}`;
  return [
    {
      header: t.organize.tags.show,
      items: [
        { id: 'view', label: t.organize.tags.showView, checked: selector.show === 'view', testId: id('view') },
        { id: 'all', label: t.organize.tags.showAll, checked: selector.show === 'all', testId: id('all') },
      ],
    },
    MENU_SEPARATOR,
    {
      header: t.organize.tags.sort,
      items: [
        { id: 'name', label: t.organize.tags.sortName, checked: selector.sort === 'name', testId: id('name') },
        { id: 'count', label: t.organize.tags.sortCount, checked: selector.sort === 'count', testId: id('count') },
      ],
    },
    ...(filterCount > 0 ? [MENU_SEPARATOR, { id: 'clear' as const, label: t.organize.tags.clearFilter, testId: id('clear') }] : []),
  ];
}

/** The selector's one Tab stop (the chip its roving tabindex points at): where the focus goes when a button that was beside it is gone. */
export function focusTagStop(): void {
  document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="tag-selector"] [data-chip-id][tabindex="0"]')?.focus();
}

/**
 * The tag selector at the sidebar's foot (spec 4.3; mockup .tag-selector): the head with its "…" menu, the chips, the "태그 필터"
 * field. Drawn only while there are tags (the library view's `sidebarFoot`). A chip toggles the filter — the items must have
 * every chosen tag — ↩ renames it in place, the menu key or a right click opens its native menu.
 */
export function TagSelector() {
  const { model } = useOrganize();
  const list = useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS;
  const { scoped } = useScopeView(list);
  const filter = useLibrary((s) => s.tagFilter);
  const toggleTag = useLibrary((s) => s.toggleTagFilter);
  const { selector, update, ready } = useTagsSelector();
  const { env, run } = useCommands();
  const envRef = useRef(env);
  envRef.current = env;
  const editingId = useTagEdit((s) => s.editingId);
  const restoreTo = useTagEdit((s) => s.restoreTo);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  const counts = useMemo(
    () => (model ? viewCounts(model.tags, (id) => model.tagItems(id), new Set(scoped.map((i) => i.id))) : NO_COUNTS),
    [model, scoped],
  );
  const chips = useMemo(() => cloudChips({ tags: model?.tags ?? NO_TAGS, counts, filter, selector, query }), [model, counts, filter, selector, query]);

  // A chip being renamed whose tag is gone (deleted from elsewhere): its edit ends.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editingId !== null && model && !model.tags.some((x) => x.id === editingId)) useTagEdit.getState().end(false);
  }, [editingId, model]);
  // After a name field closes the focus goes back to the chip (or to what had it), unless a click elsewhere already put it somewhere.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!restoreTo) return;
    const chip = restoreTo.tagId === null ? null : document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-chip-id="${CSS.escape(restoreTo.tagId)}"]`);
    (chip ?? (restoreTo.opener instanceof HTMLElement ? restoreTo.opener : null))?.focus();
    useTagEdit.getState().clearRestore();
  }, [restoreTo]);

  const openMenu = useCallback(async (tagId: string, at: { x: number; y: number }) => {
    try {
      const picked = await unwrap(api().ui.showContextMenu({ kind: 'tag', tagIds: [tagId], ...at }));
      if (picked) runPicked(picked, envRef.current, { tagIds: [tagId] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(`[tags] the tag menu failed: ${e instanceof ApiError ? e.code : 'INTERNAL'}`); // the code only: no names in a log
    }
  }, []);

  if (!ready || !model || model.tags.length === 0) return null;
  const typed = query.trim() !== '';
  return (
    <div className="tag-selector" role="group" aria-labelledby="tag-selector-head" data-testid="tag-selector">
      <div className="head">
        <span id="tag-selector-head">{t.organize.tags.heading}</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <MenuIconButton
          label={t.organize.tags.moreLabel}
          icon={Ellipsis}
          testId="tag-selector-more"
          items={selectorMenu(selector, filter.size)}
          onAction={(id) => {
            if (id === 'clear') run('tags.clearFilter');
            else update(id === 'view' || id === 'all' ? { show: id } : { sort: id });
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <ChipGroup label={t.organize.tags.listLabel} className="tag-cloud" testId="tag-cloud">
        {chips.map(({ tag, on, dim }) => (
          <TagChip
            key={tag.id}
            tag={tag}
            role="filter"
            on={on}
            dim={dim}
            editing={editingId === tag.id}
            onToggle={() => toggleTag(tag.id)}
            onRename={() => tagActions.startRename(tag.id)}
            onMenu={(at) => void openMenu(tag.id, at)}
          />
        ))}
        {chips.length === 0 && (
          <span className="tag-none" data-testid="tag-none">
            {typed ? t.organize.tags.noMatch : t.organize.tags.noneInView}
          </span>
        )}
      </ChipGroup>
      <SearchField
        aria-label={t.organize.tags.filterLabel}
        placeholder={t.organize.tags.filterPlaceholder}
        size="small"
        value={query}
        onChange={setQuery}
        onClear={() => setQuery('')}
        testId="tag-filter-field"
        className="tag-field"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
