```tsx
import { Tag } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { PaneEmpty } from '../ui/PaneEmpty';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { focusTagStop } from './TagSelector';

/**
 * The table body when the chosen tags leave no item and nothing is typed in the search (spec 3.6): the registry's
 * 태그 선택 해제 as its one button. The button goes with the state, so the focus moves to the selector's chips.
 */
export function TagFilterEmpty() {
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  return (
    <PaneEmpty
      icon={Tag}
      title={t.organize.tags.filterEmpty}
      top
      testId="tag-filter-empty"
      action={
        <Button
          testId="tag-filter-empty-clear"
          isDisabled={!isEnabled('tags.clearFilter')}
          onPress={() => {
            run('tags.clearFilter');
            requestAnimationFrame(focusTagStop);
          }}
        >
          {commandLabel(commandById('tags.clearFilter'), currentPlatform())}
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

```css
@layer components {
  /* Tag chip (design-spec 6 태그 칩; mockup .chip): a 22 px pill, footnote, --fill-hover. It holds the control that is the chip. */
  /* The chips of a group wrap (the selector's cloud, the item panel's tags). */
  .chip-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-4);
  }
  .chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 22px; /* local: chip height (design-spec 6) */
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    background: var(--fill-hover);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
    white-space: nowrap;
    -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
  }
  .chip-main {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-6);
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0 var(--space-8);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: default;
    outline: none;
  }
  .chip-label {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  /* The colour dot (design-spec 4): 8 px with a 0.5 px inner border, the same on a chip and in the table. */
  .chip .dot,
  .tag-dots i {
    flex: none;
    width: 8px; /* local: colour dot (design-spec 4) */
    height: 8px; /* local: colour dot (design-spec 4) */
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.16); /* local: the dot's 0.5 px inner border (design-spec 4) */
  }
  .chip:is(:hover, [data-force~='hover']) {
    background: var(--fill-pressed);
  }
  .chip:is(:has(> .chip-main:focus-visible), [data-force~='focus']) {
    outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);
  }
  /* Not in the view shown (모든 태그): a hairline ring and tertiary text. */
  .chip.is-dim {
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--fill-hover);
  }
  .chip.is-dim:is(:hover, [data-force~='hover']) {
    background: var(--fill-hover);
  }
  /* In the filter: the accent fill. */
  .chip.is-on {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--text-on-accent);
  }
  .chip.is-on:is(:hover, [data-force~='hover']) {
    background: var(--accent-hover);
  }
  /* 태그 추가 (the item panel's): only a border. */
  .chip.add {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  }
  /* The × of an assigned chip: there while the chip is hovered or has the focus (design-spec 6). */
  .chip .x {
    display: none;
    place-items: center;
    flex: none;
    width: 14px; /* local: the × target */
    height: 14px; /* local: the × target */
    margin-right: -4px; /* local: the × sits 4 px from the pill's edge */
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: none;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    cursor: default;
  }
  .chip:is(:hover, :focus-within, [data-force~='hover'], [data-force~='focus']) .x {
    display: grid;
  }
  .chip .x:is(:hover) {
    background: var(--fill-pressed);
  }
  /* The name being typed: the pill is the field (design-spec 6 field: a 1 px focus border and the 3 px halo). */
  .chip.is-editing {
    gap: var(--space-6);
    padding: 0 var(--space-8);
    background: var(--bg-field);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--focus), 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 28%, transparent);
  }
  .chip-input {
    min-width: 6ch;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    outline: none;
    field-sizing: content;
  }
  :root:not([data-platform='darwin']) .chip-input::selection {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
    color: inherit;
  }
  /* The note about a name that is too long takes a line of its own in the cloud. */
  .chip-note {
    flex: 0 0 100%;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }

  /* The table's colour dots (spec 5.1; mockup .tag-dots): after the title, 4 px apart. */
  .tag-dots {
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    flex: none;
  }
  /* On the accent-filled row the inner border gives way to a 1 px white ring (design-spec 4). */
  :root:not([data-window-inactive]) .library-table:focus-within .table-row[data-selected] .tag-dots i,
  .table-row[data-force~='focused'] .tag-dots i {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--text-on-accent);
  }
}
```

```tsx
/** The link glyph of a linked original (title cell and item panel head alike). */
export function LinkMark({ item }: { item: LibraryItem }) {
  if (item.storageMode !== 'linked') return null;
  return (
    <span className="linked-mark c-tertiary" title={t.library.linked}>
      <Icon icon={Link} size="sm" label={t.library.linked} />

}

/** The 파일 없음 flag of a missing original; `flagTestId` names it where one screen shows it twice. */
export function StatusFlags({ item, flagTestId }: { item: LibraryItem; flagTestId?: string }) {
  if (item.availability !== 'missing') return null;
  return (
    <span className="inline-flag c-warning" title={t.library.missingTitle} data-testid={flagTestId}>
      <Icon icon={TriangleAlert} size="sm" />
      {t.library.missing}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Both, link mark first: the item panel's head (the table's title cell puts the colour dots between them, mockup tableRow). */
export function ItemMarks({ item, flagTestId }: { item: LibraryItem; flagTestId?: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <LinkMark item={item} />
      <StatusFlags item={item} flagTestId={flagTestId} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`E/helpers.ts` — 위쪽 import에 `import { TAG_COLORS } from '../../packages/domain/src/tag-colors';`(Task 3이 `TagColorId` import를 이미 더했다면 같은 줄에 합친다)를 더하고, 파일 끝에 더한다:
```ts
// ---- M5 tags (Task 6) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** A chip of the tag selector (the item panel may show the same tag too, so the selector is named). */
export const tagChip = (page: Page, tagId: string): Locator => page.getByTestId('tag-selector').getByTestId(`tag-chip-${tagId}`);

/** The colour a token resolves to in this page (light-dark() resolved), as getComputedStyle writes it. */
export const tokenColor = (page: Page, token: string): Promise<string> =>
  page.evaluate((name) => {
    const probe = document.createElement('div');
    probe.style.background = `var(${name})`;
    document.body.append(probe);
    const colour = getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor;
    probe.remove();
    return colour;
  }, token);

/**
 * Tags through the page's API, as the screen sets them: the ids in the order given. `slot` is colour N = slot N (colour and
 * slot together, as the screen always sets them); `items` are the ones the tag goes on.
 */
export async function makeTags(page: Page, specs: ReadonlyArray<{ name: string; slot?: number; items?: readonly string[] }>): Promise<string[]> {
  const ids: string[] = [];
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const tagId = await createTag(page, spec.name);
    if (spec.slot !== undefined) await setTagColor(page, tagId, TAG_COLORS[spec.slot - 1]!.id, spec.slot);
    if (spec.items && spec.items.length > 0) await assignTag(page, tagId, spec.items);
    ids.push(tagId);
  }
  return ids;
}
```
`E/tags.spec.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
// Tags (M5 spec 4, 5.1, 9.2; design-spec 6 태그 칩): the selector at the sidebar's foot, the AND filter, renaming in the chip with
// the merge sheet, colours and the 1–8 keys, the table's dots, the chip menu and the item menu's 색 태그 ▸, and what the filter
// leaves of the table. Native menus are the stubbed popups (stubContextMenu records their rows); the sheets are the stubbed
// message box (stubConfirm). Titles are read by commands-coverage.spec.ts's ledger: change them together.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, closeSheet, confirmCalls, createCollection, createTag, expectWindow, importPaths, launch, makeTags, menuSnapshot, openItem, organizeSnapshot,
  recordedPopupPoints, recordedPopups, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, runPalette, setTagColor, stubConfirm, stubContextMenu, tagChip, tokenColor, type MenuNode,
} from './helpers';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const KO = '한글 경로 (테스트) #1';
const VIDEO = 'sample-h264-aac';
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4]) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

/** A library of three items; `id(title)` is an item's id. */
async function start(testInfo: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) {
  const s = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const items = await importPaths(s.page, [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4]);
  return { ...s, items, id: (title: string) => items.find((i) => i.title === title)!.id };
}
const chipIds = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('tag-cloud').locator('[data-chip-id]').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => (e as HTMLElement).dataset['chipId']));
const rowTitles = async (page: Page) => (await page.getByTestId('item-row').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => (e as HTMLElement).dataset['title']!))).sort();
const heldBy = async (page: Page, tagId: string) => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).tagged[tagId] ?? [];
const chooseMenu = async (page: Page, id: 'view' | 'all' | 'name' | 'count') => {
  await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
  await page.getByTestId(`tag-menu-${id}`).click();
};
const flat = (nodes: MenuNode[]): MenuNode[] => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flat(n.submenu ?? [])]);

test('the selector sits at the sidebar foot: absent with no tags, in the reader and in the empty library; at most 40 % of the sidebar with its own scroll', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const selector = page.getByTestId('tag-selector');
    await expect(selector).toHaveCount(0);
    await makeTags(page, [{ name: '수용체', items: [id('sample')] }]);
    await expect(selector).toBeVisible();
    const inner = page.locator('nav.sidebar-inner');
    const [sel, col] = [(await selector.boundingBox())!, (await inner.boundingBox())!];
    expect(Math.abs(sel.y + sel.height - (col.y + col.height)), 'it ends where the sidebar ends').toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    await expect(selector.locator('.head')).toHaveText('태그');
    // The reader's sidebar is the way back: nothing to filter there.
    await openItem(page, 'sample');
    await expect(selector).toHaveCount(0);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'nav.back');
    await expect(selector).toBeVisible();
    // Many tags (모든 태그 shows the ones no item has): capped at 40 %, the chips scroll, the head and the field stay.
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) await window.learn.tags.create({ name: `태그 ${String(i).padStart(3, '0')}` });
    });
    await chooseMenu(page, 'all');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-cloud').locator('[data-chip-id]')).toHaveCount(121);
    const tall = (await selector.boundingBox())!;
    const column = (await inner.boundingBox())!;
    expect(tall.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(column.height * 0.4 + 1);
    expect(tall.height).toBeGreaterThan(column.height * 0.3);
    const cloud = page.getByTestId('tag-cloud');
    expect(await cloud.evaluate((el) => el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight && getComputedStyle(el).overflowY === 'auto')).toBe(true);
    const field = (await page.getByTestId('tag-filter-field').boundingBox())!;
    expect(field.y + field.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(tall.y + tall.height);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
  // Tags in a library with no items: the empty library has no selector (spec 3.6).
  const empty = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library2'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata2'));
  try {
    await createTag(empty.page, '수용체');
    await empty.page.waitForTimeout(400);
    await expect(empty.page.getByTestId('tag-selector')).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await empty.app.close();
  }
});

test('chips: colour tags first by slot with an 8 px dot, the rest by name; 현재 보기의 태그만 / 모든 태그 (the rest dim) and 이름순 / 많이 쓴 순 from the … menu, remembered', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '분자생물학');
    await addToCollection(page, bio, [id('sample'), id(KO)]);
    const [imp, rng, rec, hah, reg] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1, items: [id('sample'), id(KO)] },
      { name: '시험 범위', slot: 2, items: [id('sample')] },
      { name: '수용체', items: [id(KO)] },
      { name: '하하', items: [id('sample'), id(KO)] },
      { name: '회귀분석', items: [id(VIDEO)] },
    ]);
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([imp, rng, rec, hah, reg]);
    const dot = tagChip(page, imp).locator('.dot');
    await expect(dot).toHaveCSS('background-color', await tokenColor(page, '--tag-1'));
    expect(await dot.evaluate((e) => [e.getBoundingClientRect().width, e.getBoundingClientRect().height, getComputedStyle(e).borderRadius])).toEqual([8, 8, '50%']);
    await expect(tagChip(page, rec).locator('.dot')).toHaveCount(0);
    const chipBox = (await tagChip(page, rec).locator('xpath=..').boundingBox())!;
    expect(chipBox.height).toBe(22);

    // 분자생물학 has no item of 회귀분석: 현재 보기의 태그만 leaves it out, 모든 태그 shows it dim.
    await page.getByTestId(`nav-collection-${bio}`).click();
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([imp, rng, rec, hah]);
    await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-view')).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-name')).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-clear')).toHaveCount(0); // only with a filter
    await page.getByTestId('tag-menu-all').click();
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([imp, rng, rec, hah, reg]);
    await expect(tagChip(page, reg)).toHaveAttribute('data-dim', '');
    await expect(tagChip(page, reg)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect(tagChip(page, rec)).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dim', '');
    // 많이 쓴 순: by the items of the view — 하하 (2) before 수용체 (1) before 회귀분석 (0), the colour tags still first.
    await chooseMenu(page, 'count');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([imp, rng, hah, rec, reg]);
    // Remembered: after a reload the same view, the same menu choices.
    await page.reload();
    await page.getByTestId('app-ready').waitFor({ state: 'attached' });
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([imp, rng, hah, rec, reg]);
    await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-all')).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-count')).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('filter: chips narrow the table to the items that have every chosen tag, N개 / M개 counts it, Space toggles, the scope clears it, and a filter that leaves nothing says so', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const [f1, f2, f3] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '가', items: [id('sample'), id(KO)] },
      { name: '나', items: [id(KO), id(VIDEO)] },
      { name: '다' },
    ]);
    await chooseMenu(page, 'all'); // 다 has no item: shown dim, and it can be chosen
    await expect(tagChip(page, f3)).toBeVisible();
    await tagChip(page, f1).click();
    await expect(tagChip(page, f1)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual(['sample', KO].sort());
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('2개 / 3개');
    await tagChip(page, f2).click(); // AND: both tags
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual([KO]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('1개 / 3개');
    await tagChip(page, f2).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Space'); // the keyboard toggles it back
    await expect(tagChip(page, f2)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual(['sample', KO].sort());
    // 태그 선택 해제 in the … menu, only now that a filter is set.
    await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-clear')).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByTestId('tag-menu-clear').click();
    await expect(tagChip(page, f1)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toHaveLength(3);

    // A filter that leaves nothing (다 is on no item): the table body says so; its button clears the filter and the focus goes to the chips.
    await tagChip(page, f3).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toContainText('고른 태그를 모두 가진 자료가 없습니다');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty-clear').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(tagChip(page, f3)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.hasAttribute('data-chip-id'))).toBe(true);
    // A query beside it: the search's own empty state wins (spec 3.6).
    await tagChip(page, f3).click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input').fill('sample');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input').fill('');

    // The palette's 태그 선택 해제; and another view starts with no filter (spec 3.5).
    await runPalette(page, app, '태그 선택 해제', 'tags.clearFilter');
    await expect(tagChip(page, f3)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    const c = await createCollection(page, '묶음');
    await addToCollection(page, c, [id('sample')]);
    await tagChip(page, f1).click();
    await page.getByTestId(`nav-collection-${c}`).click();
    await expect(tagChip(page, f1)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual(['sample']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the 태그 필터 field narrows the chips by NFC, case and 초성, esc empties it, the table is untouched, and a composition is not cut by esc', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const all = [id('sample')];
    const [exam, recept, reg] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '시험 범위', slot: 1, items: all },
      { name: 'Receptor', items: all },
      { name: '회귀분석', items: all },
    ]);
    const field = page.getByTestId('tag-filter-field').locator('input');
    await field.fill('ㅅㅎ');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([exam]);
    await field.fill('recep');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([recept]);
    await field.fill('ㅎㄱ');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([reg]);
    await field.fill('없는 태그');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-none')).toHaveText('일치하는 태그가 없습니다');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3); // rows are never filtered by this field
    await field.press('Escape');
    await expect(field).toHaveValue('');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([exam, recept, reg]);
    // IME: the chips follow the composition; esc during it neither empties the field nor ends the composition.
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await field.focus();
    await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: 'ㅅㅎ', selectionStart: 2, selectionEnd: 2 });
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([exam]);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([exam]);
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: 'ㅅㅎ' });
    await expect(field).toHaveValue('ㅅㅎ');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('keyboard: the chips are one Tab stop, ←→ Home End move it, Space toggles, ↩ renames and gives the focus back, ⇧F10 opens the tag menu under the chip', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const items = [id('sample')];
    const [a, b, c] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '가', slot: 1, items },
      { name: '나', items },
      { name: '다', items },
    ]);
    const focusedChip = () => page.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.dataset['chipId'] ?? null);
    const stops = () => page.locator('[data-testid="tag-selector"] [data-chip-id][tabindex="0"]').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => (e as HTMLElement).dataset['chipId']));
    expect(await stops()).toEqual([a]); // one stop, the first until the user has been elsewhere
    await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(a);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(b);
    expect(await stops()).toEqual([b]);
    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(c);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight'); // at the end it stays
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(c);
    await page.keyboard.press('Home');
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(a);
    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab'); // out of the group: the filter field
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-field').locator('input')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+Tab'); // back to the chip the user left
    expect(await focusedChip()).toBe(c);

    await page.keyboard.press('Space');
    await expect(tagChip(page, c)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await page.keyboard.press('Space');
    await expect(tagChip(page, c)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); // rename, not press
    await expect(tagChip(page, c)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-rename-input')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(tagChip(page, c)).toBeFocused();
    await expect(tagChip(page, c)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');

    // ⇧F10: the native menu under the chip, once.
    await stubContextMenu(app, null);
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F10');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await recordedPopups(app)).length).toBe(1);
    const box = (await tagChip(page, c).boundingBox())!;
    const [at] = await recordedPopupPoints(app);
    expect(at!.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(box.x);
    expect(at!.x).toBeLessThanOrEqual(box.x + box.width);
    expect(Math.abs(at!.y - (box.y + box.height))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3);
    await page.waitForTimeout(700); // the browser's own contextmenu for the key does not open it a second time
    expect((await recordedPopups(app)).length).toBe(1);
    const labels = (await recordedPopups(app))[0]!.map((e) => (e.type === 'separator' ? '-' : e.label));
    expect(labels).toEqual(['이름 바꾸기', '색 지정', '색 해제', '-', '태그 삭제…']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('rename in the chip: ↩ saves, esc cancels, blank keeps, 200 characters stop, a click elsewhere saves, a composition is not cut; a name another tag has asks to merge', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const [alpha, beta] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: 'Alpha', items: [id('sample')] },
      { name: 'beta', items: [id(KO)] },
    ]);
    const input = page.getByTestId('tag-rename-input');
    await tagChip(page, beta).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(input).toBeFocused();
    expect(await input.evaluate((e: HTMLInputElement) => [e.selectionStart, e.selectionEnd, e.value.length])).toEqual([0, 4, 4]); // the whole name selected
    await input.fill('gamma');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('gamma');
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toBeFocused();
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.find((t) => t.id === beta)?.name).toBe('gamma');

    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill('zzz');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); // cancel
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('gamma');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill('   ');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); // blank: the old name, no error
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('gamma');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(0);

    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill('가'.repeat(201));
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(input).toBeVisible(); // stays open
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-rename-note')).toHaveText('태그 이름은 200자까지 쓸 수 있습니다.');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');

    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill('delta');
    await page.getByTestId('library-table').click({ position: { x: 20, y: 200 } }); // a click elsewhere saves
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('delta');

    // IME: ↩ during a composition only ends it; after the commit ↩ saves.
    await tagChip(page, beta).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: '새', selectionStart: 1, selectionEnd: 1 });
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(input).toBeVisible();
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: '새 이름' });
    await expect(input).toHaveValue('새 이름');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('새 이름');

    // A name another tag has (case ignored): the sheet, 합치기 by default. Cancel changes nothing.
    await stubConfirm(app, 'cancel');
    await page.getByTestId('tag-selector').getByTestId(`tag-chip-${beta}`).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill(' ALPHA ');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(app)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]).toMatchObject({ message: '‘Alpha’ 태그가 이미 있습니다. 두 태그를 합치겠습니까?', buttons: ['합치기', '취소'], defaultId: 0 });
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]!.detail).toContain('‘새 이름’ 태그의 자료는 ‘Alpha’');
    await expect(tagChip(page, beta)).toContainText('새 이름');
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.map((t) => t.id)).toContain(beta);

    // Confirm: the filter on the merged tag moves to the one that remains, and the items of both are on it.
    await tagChip(page, beta).click();
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual([KO]);
    await stubConfirm(app, 'confirm');
    await tagChip(page, beta).focus();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await input.fill('ALPHA');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId(`tag-chip-${beta}`)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(tagChip(page, alpha)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual(['sample', KO].sort());
    expect((await heldBy(page, alpha)).sort()).toEqual([id('sample'), id(KO)].sort());
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.map((t) => t.name)).toEqual(['Alpha']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('colour: 색 지정 sets colour N = slot N, the tag that held the slot loses both, 색 해제 clears; the menu names the slot another tag holds and checks the colour', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const items = [id('sample')];
    const [important, review, question] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1, items },
      { name: '복습', items },
      { name: '질문', items },
    ]);
    const rowsOf = async () => (await recordedPopups(app)).at(-1)!;
    await stubContextMenu(app, ['색 지정', '1 노랑 — 중요']);
    await tagChip(page, review).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.find((t) => t.id === review)?.position).toBe(1);
    const menu = await rowsOf();
    expect(menu.map((e) => (e.type === 'separator' ? '-' : e.label))).toEqual(['이름 바꾸기', '색 지정', '색 해제', '-', '태그 삭제…']);
    expect(menu.find((e) => e.label === '색 해제')).toMatchObject({ enabled: false }); // 복습 had no colour
    const colours = menu.find((e) => e.label === '색 지정')!.submenu!;
    expect(colours.map((e) => e.label)).toEqual(['1 노랑 — 중요', '2 빨강', '3 초록', '4 파랑', '5 보라', '6 자홍', '7 주황', '8 회색']);
    expect(colours.every((e) => e.type === 'radio' && !e.checked)).toBe(true);
    const snap = (await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags;
    expect(snap.find((t) => t.id === review)).toMatchObject({ color: 'yellow', position: 1 });
    expect(snap.find((t) => t.id === important)).toMatchObject({ color: null, position: null }); // one call took both away
    await expect(tagChip(page, important).locator('.dot')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(tagChip(page, review).locator('.dot')).toHaveCSS('background-color', await tokenColor(page, '--tag-1'));
    await expect.poll(() => chipIds(page)).toEqual([review, important, question]); // the colour tag leads

    // The same menu for the tag that holds the slot: its own colour is checked, 색 해제 is on; then clear it.
    await stubContextMenu(app, '색 해제');
    await tagChip(page, review).click({ button: 'right' });
    const own = await rowsOf();
    expect(own.find((e) => e.label === '색 해제')).toMatchObject({ enabled: true });
    expect(own.find((e) => e.label === '색 지정')!.submenu!.filter((e) => e.checked).map((e) => e.label)).toEqual(['1 노랑']);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.find((t) => t.id === review)).toMatchObject({ color: null, position: null });
    await expect(tagChip(page, review).locator('.dot')).toHaveCount(0);
    // 3 초록 on 질문, with the menu bar following (파일 › 색 태그 ▸ lists the tag at the slot).
    await stubContextMenu(app, ['색 지정', '3 초록']);
    await tagChip(page, question).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.find((t) => t.id === question)?.position).toBe(3);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await expect
      .poll(async () => flat(await menuSnapshot(app)).find((n) => n.id === 'submenu.colorTags')?.submenu?.map((n) => n.label))
      .toEqual(['질문']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('delete: the sheet says how many items the tag comes off, cancel keeps it, confirm removes it from the chips, the table and the filter', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const [important, review] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1, items: [id('sample'), id(KO)] },
      { name: '복습' },
    ]);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'sample').locator('.tag-dots i')).toHaveCount(1);
    await tagChip(page, important).click(); // the filter holds it
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toEqual(['sample', KO].sort());
    await stubConfirm(app, 'cancel');
    await stubContextMenu(app, '태그 삭제…');
    await tagChip(page, important).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await confirmCalls(app)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]).toMatchObject({ message: '‘중요’ 태그를 삭제하겠습니까?', detail: '자료 2개에서 떼어집니다.', buttons: ['삭제', '취소'], defaultId: 0 });
    await expect(tagChip(page, important)).toBeVisible();
    await stubConfirm(app, 'confirm');
    await tagChip(page, important).click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(page.getByTestId(`tag-chip-${important}`)).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[0]!.message).toBe('‘중요’ 태그를 삭제하겠습니까?');
    expect((await organizeSnapshot(page)).tags.map((t) => t.id)).not.toContain(important);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'sample').locator('.tag-dots')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => rowTitles(page)).toHaveLength(3); // the deleted tag left the filter: the table is whole again
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toHaveCount(0);

    await chooseMenu(page, 'all');

    expect((await confirmCalls(app))[1]!.detail).toBe('붙어 있는 자료가 없습니다.');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('1–8 keys put the tag at that slot on the selection or take it off, tell an empty slot, and are ignored in text fields and while composing; the palette and the ⌘/ sheet show them', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const tags = await makeTags(page, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((n) => ({ name: `태그${n}`, slot: n })));
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    // Each of the eight keys, on the one selected item: on with the key, off with the same key again.
    for (let n = 1; n <= 8; n++) {
      await page.keyboard.press(String(n));
      await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[n - 1]!)).toEqual([id('sample')]);
    }
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).toEqual([]);
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).toEqual([id('sample')]);

    // Several rows: not every row has the tag → all get it; then every row has it → all lose it.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+A');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(3);
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).sort()).toEqual([id('sample'), id(KO), id(VIDEO)].sort());
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).toEqual([]);

    // An empty slot says so (이 / 가 by how the digit is read) and changes nothing.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).toEqual([id('sample')]);
    await setTagColor(page, tags[0]!, null, null);
    await expect(tagChip(page, tags[0]!).locator('.dot')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.keyboard.press('1');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-notice').last()).toHaveText('색 태그 1이 없습니다. 태그의 컨텍스트 메뉴에서 색을 지정하세요.');
    expect(await heldBy(page, tags[0]!)).toEqual([id('sample')]);
    await setTagColor(page, tags[4]!, null, null);
    await expect(tagChip(page, tags[4]!).locator('.dot')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.keyboard.press('5');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-notice').last()).toHaveText('색 태그 5가 없습니다. 태그의 컨텍스트 메뉴에서 색을 지정하세요.');

    // Never in a text field, and never while a composition owns the key (keyCode 229 included).
    const before = await heldBy(page, tags[1]!);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    const search = page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input');
    await expect(search).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.type('2');
    await expect(search).toHaveValue('2');
    await search.fill('');
    await page.getByTestId('tag-filter-field').locator('input').focus();
    await page.keyboard.type('2');
    await page.getByTestId('tag-filter-field').locator('input').fill('');
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyDown', key: '2', code: 'Digit2', windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
    await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyUp', key: '2', code: 'Digit2', windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    expect(await heldBy(page, tags[1]!)).toEqual(before);

    // The palette: one row per slot a tag holds, named by the tag; it acts on the selection.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('색 태그');
    const keyRows = page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id^="tag.color"]');
    await expect(keyRows).toHaveCount(6); // slots 1 and 5 were cleared: six tags hold a slot
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="tag.color3"]')).toContainText('색 태그 3 · 태그3');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="tag.color1"]')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="tag.color2"]').click();
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, tags[1]!)).toEqual([]); // it was on 'sample' (key 2 above): the palette row took it off

    // The ⌘/ sheet: one line, 1–8, under 정리; the registry's eight are not listed apart.
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    const line = sheet.getByTestId('shortcut-row').filter({ hasText: '색 태그 붙이기/떼기' });
    await expect(line).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(line).toContainText('1–8');
    await expect(sheet.getByTestId('shortcut-row').filter({ hasText: /색 태그 \d/ })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(sheet.locator('.group-label', { hasText: '정리' })).toHaveCount(1);
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');

    // The menu bar's 색 태그 ▸ lists the held slots by name (the digit is shown, not registered).
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await expect
      .poll(async () => flat(await menuSnapshot(app)).find((n) => n.id === 'submenu.colorTags')?.submenu?.map((n) => n.label))
      .toEqual(['태그2', '태그3', '태그4', '태그6', '태그7', '태그8']);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'tag.color3');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await heldBy(page, tags[2]!)).includes(id('sample'))).toBe(false);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('table dots: the coloured tags only, by slot, after the title and the link mark; a white ring on the accent row; the row\'s description names them', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const linkedFile = testInfo.outputPath('linked.pdf');
    fs.copyFileSync(PDF, linkedFile);
    const linked = await page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'linked', allowDuplicate: true }), linkedFile);
    if (!linked.ok || linked.data[0]?.status !== 'imported') throw new Error('linked import failed');
    const both = [id('sample'), linked.data[0].item.id];
    const [important, exam] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 3, items: both },
      { name: '시험 범위', slot: 1, items: both },
      { name: '복습', items: both },
    ]);
    const row = rowByTitle(page, 'sample');
    const dots = row.locator('.tag-dots i');
    await expect(dots).toHaveCount(2); // 복습 has no colour: no dot
    expect(await dots.evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => (e as HTMLElement).dataset['position']))).toEqual(['1', '3']);
    await expect(dots.nth(0)).toHaveCSS('background-color', await tokenColor(page, '--tag-1'));
    await expect(dots.nth(1)).toHaveCSS('background-color', await tokenColor(page, '--tag-3'));
    expect(await dots.first().evaluate((e) => [e.getBoundingClientRect().width, e.getBoundingClientRect().height])).toEqual([8, 8]);

    // The mockup's order: title, link mark, dots, then the 파일 없음 flag.
    const order = await rowByTitle(page, 'linked').evaluate((r) => {
      const cell = r.querySelector('[data-col="title"]')!;
      const follows = (a: Element, b: Element) => Boolean(a.compareDocumentPosition(b) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
      return [follows(cell.querySelector('.item-title')!, cell.querySelector('.linked-mark')!), follows(cell.querySelector('.linked-mark')!, cell.querySelector('.tag-dots')!)];
    });
    expect(order).toEqual([true, true]);

    // The inner 0.5 px border on a plain row; a 1 px white ring on the row with the accent fill.
    expect(await dots.first().evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow)).toContain('inset');
    await row.click();
    await expect(row).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    const ring = await dots.first().evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow);
    expect(ring).not.toContain('inset');
    expect(ring).toContain(await tokenColor(page, '--text-on-accent'));

    // The names are the row's description, and not part of its name.
    const described = await row.getAttribute('aria-describedby');
    expect(described).toBeTruthy();
    expect(await page.locator(`[id="${described}"]`).textContent()).toBe('태그: 시험 범위, 중요');
    await expect(row.locator('[role="rowheader"]')).not.toContainText('태그');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'linked').locator('.tag-dots i')).toHaveCount(2);

    // Taking the colour away takes the dot away; the tag stays on the item (the description goes with the dot).
    await setTagColor(page, exam, null, null);
    await expect(dots).toHaveCount(1);
    await setTagColor(page, important, null, null);
    await expect(row.locator('.tag-dots')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await row.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).toBeNull();
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the item menu lists 색 태그 ▸ by slot, checks the tags every selected item has, and the pick toggles it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const [important] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1 },
      { name: '질문', slot: 2, items: [id('sample')] },
    ]);
    await stubContextMenu(app, ['색 태그', '중요']);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click({ button: 'right' }); // a right click selects the row first
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, important)).toEqual([id('sample')]);
    const group = (await recordedPopups(app)).at(-1)!.find((e) => e.label === '색 태그')!;
    expect(group.submenu!.map((e) => [e.label, e.checked])).toEqual([['중요', false], ['질문', true]]);
    // Now every selected item has 중요: it is checked, and picking it takes it off.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(() => heldBy(page, important)).toEqual([]);
    const again = (await recordedPopups(app)).at(-1)!.find((e) => e.label === '색 태그')!;
    expect(again.submenu!.map((e) => [e.label, e.checked])).toEqual([['중요', true], ['질문', true]]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('axe: the tag selector, its menu open and a chip being renamed, light and dark', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page, id } = await start(testInfo);
  try {
    const [first] = await makeTags(page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1, items: [id('sample')] },
      { name: '수용체', items: [id('sample')] },
      { name: '회귀분석', items: [id(VIDEO)] },
    ]);
    await chooseMenu(page, 'all'); // a dim chip too
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      await page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), theme);
      await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, `tag selector, ${theme}`);
      await page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-menu-all')).toBeVisible();
      await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, `tag selector menu, ${theme}`);
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
      await tagChip(page, first!).focus();
      await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
      await expect(page.getByTestId('tag-rename-input')).toBeFocused();
      await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, `tag chip being renamed, ${theme}`);
      await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    }
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

**`R/gallery/Gallery.tsx`** — import에 더한다: `import { TAG_COLORS, commandById, commandLabel, type OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';`(3행의 `@learn/domain` import를 이 줄로 합친다), `import { DEFAULT_TAGS_SELECTOR } from '../organize/viewSettings';`, `import { ChipGroup } from '../tags/ChipGroup';`, `import { tagColorVar } from '../tags/tagColor';`, `import { TagChip } from '../tags/TagChip';`, `import { TagDots } from '../tags/TagDots';`, `import { selectorMenu } from '../tags/TagSelector';`, `import type { ReactNode } from 'react';`(1행의 `useState` import 옆에 합친다). `Part3` 다음, `PARTS` 앞에 더한다:
```tsx
const sample = (name: string, position: number | null = null): OrganizeTag => ({
  id: `g-${name}`,
  name,
  color: position === null ? null : TAG_COLORS[position - 1]!.id,
  position,
});
const G_TAGS = [sample('시험 범위', 1), sample('중요', 3)];

/**
 * Tag chips and colour dots (design-spec 4, 6 태그 칩·색 점; mockup components part 1 and 3): every state of the chip, the eight
 * colours, the table's dots on a plain row and on the accent row, and the selector as the sidebar draws it.
 */
function Part4() {
  const plain = sample('수용체');
  const row = (label: string, ...chips: ReactNode[]) => (
    <div className="g-row">
      <span className="g-label">{label}</span>
      {chips}
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <>
      <section>
        <h2 className="g-title">태그 칩</h2>
        <div data-testid="g-chips">
          {row('기본', <TagChip key="a" tag={plain} role="filter" />)}
          {row('호버', <TagChip key="a" tag={plain} role="filter" force={['hover']} />)}
          {row('포커스', <TagChip key="a" tag={plain} role="filter" force={['focus']} />)}
          {row('선택(필터)', <TagChip key="a" tag={sample('시험 범위')} role="filter" on />)}
          {row('흐린(현재 보기에 없음)', <TagChip key="a" tag={sample('회귀분석')} role="filter" dim />)}
          {row('붙은 칩 · 호버', <TagChip key="a" tag={plain} role="assigned" force={['hover']} />, <TagChip key="b" tag={sample('중요', 3)} role="assigned" force={['focus']} />)}
          {row(
            '이름 칸',
            <span key="a" className="chip is-editing">
              <input className="chip-input" defaultValue="수용체" readOnly aria-label="이름 칸" />
            </span>,
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section>
        <h2 className="g-title">태그 8색</h2>
        <div className="g-swatches" data-testid="g-swatches">
          {TAG_COLORS.map((c, i) => (
            <span key={c.id} className="g-swatch">
              <i style={{ background: tagColorVar(i + 1) }} />
              <span>
                {i + 1} · {c.label}
              </span>
              <code>--tag-{i + 1}</code>
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="g-row">
          <ChipGroup label="색 태그" className="g-chipgroup">
            {TAG_COLORS.map((c, i) => (
              <TagChip key={c.id} tag={sample(`${i + 1} ${c.label}`, i + 1)} role="filter" />
            ))}
          </ChipGroup>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section>
        <h2 className="g-title">표의 색 점</h2>
        <div className="g-table" data-testid="g-dots">
          {(
            [
              ['기본', undefined],
              ['선택(포커스)', 'selected focused'],
            ] as const
          ).map(([name, force]) => (
            <div key={name} className="table-row" data-force={force}>
              <div className="td is-first" data-col="title">
                <Icon icon={FileText} />
                <span className="item-title ellipsis">{name} · 분자생물학 6장</span>
                <span className="linked-mark c-tertiary">
                  <Icon icon={Link} size="sm" />
                </span>
                <TagDots tags={G_TAGS} />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section>
        <h2 className="g-title">태그 선택기</h2>
        <div className="g-list tag-board">
          <div className="tag-selector" data-testid="g-selector">
            <div className="head">
              <span>태그</span>
              <span className="spacer" />
              <IconButton icon={Ellipsis} label="태그 표시" size="small" />
            </div>
            <ChipGroup label="태그 목록" className="tag-cloud">
              {[sample('시험 범위', 1), sample('중요', 3), sample('수용체'), sample('G 단백질')].map((tag) => (
                <TagChip key={tag.id} tag={tag} role="filter" on={tag.name === '수용체'} />
              ))}
              <TagChip tag={sample('회귀분석')} role="filter" dim />
            </ChipGroup>
            <SearchField aria-label="태그 필터" placeholder="태그 필터" size="small" className="tag-field" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="g-row g-top">
          <MenuList aria-label="태그 표시" entries={selectorMenu(DEFAULT_TAGS_SELECTOR, 2)} onAction={noop} />
        </div>
      </section>
    </>
  );
}
```
`lucide-react` import(2행)에 `Ellipsis`를 더한다. `PARTS`를 `const PARTS = { 1: Part1, 2: Part2, 3: Part3, 4: Part4 } as const;`로, 위 doc 주석에 "part=4 for the tags."를 더한다. 보드 전체를 높이 안에 넣으려고 `.g-list.tag-board`는 `R/styles/screens/gallery.css`의 `.gallery .g-list` 규칙 다음에 더한다:
```css
  /* The tag board: the selector inside a sidebar-wide box, the swatches in two columns. */
  .gallery .g-list.tag-board {
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .gallery .g-swatches {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--space-4) var(--space-16);
  }
  .gallery .g-swatch {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-8);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }
  .gallery .g-swatch i {
    width: 16px; /* local: swatch */
    height: 16px; /* local: swatch */
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  }
  .gallery .g-swatch code {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    font: var(--type-caption);
  }
```
Run: `pnpm typecheck && pnpm vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/styles` — Expected: PASS.

**`E/components.spec.ts`** — 보드의 쪽 3만 쓴다; 4쪽의 상태는 투어 장면이 본다. 대신 **`E/tags.spec.ts`에 칩 상태 시험을 더하지 않는다**(보드 PNG가 지킨다).

**`E/visual/tour.spec.ts`** — 맨 위 `../helpers` import 묶음에 `makeTags, tagChip,`를 더하고(Task 5가 `addToCollection, createCollection, specialRow, treeRow`를 이미 더했다), 파일 끝에 더한다:
```ts
// M5 Task 6: the tag selector and the table's dots. Pairs for the critic: library.html (the selector at the sidebar's foot, the
// dots in the title cell, a selected row on the accent fill) and components.html?part=1 (chips, the eight colours).
test('organize: the tag selector with a filter and dim chips, the table dots with a selected row, and the filter that leaves nothing', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  try {
    const items = await importPaths(s.page, library(testInfo.outputPath('videos')));
    const [a, b, c, d] = items.map((i) => i.id) as [string, string, string, string];
    const bio = await createCollection(s.page, '분자생물학');
    await addToCollection(s.page, bio, [a, b, c]);
    const [, , , , receptor, , , regression] = await makeTags(s.page, [
      { name: '중요', slot: 1, items: [a, b] },
      { name: '시험 범위', slot: 2, items: [a] },
      { name: '다시 보기', slot: 4, items: [b] },
      { name: '질문 있음', slot: 5, items: [c] },
      { name: '수용체', items: [a, b] },
      { name: 'G 단백질', items: [a] },
      { name: '인산화', items: [c] },
      { name: '회귀분석', items: [d] },
      { name: '표본 추출', items: [d] },
    ]);
    // A collection, 모든 태그 (the two tags of the item outside it are dim), one chip on, a row selected with the table focused.
    await treeRow(s.page, bio).click();
    await s.page.getByTestId('tag-selector-more').click();
    await s.page.getByTestId('tag-menu-all').click();
    await tagChip(s.page, receptor!).click();
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    await expect(rowAt(s.page, 0)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('info-section')).toBeVisible();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `tags-selector-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
    }
    // A dim chip chosen too: nothing has both. The body says so; the chips keep their state.
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    await tagChip(s.page, regression!).click();
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('tag-filter-empty')).toBeVisible();
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `tags-filter-empty-${theme}`, { mask: [s.page.getByTestId('inspector-panel')] });
    }
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('component state board: tag chips and colour dots (gallery part 4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  try {
    for (const theme of THEMES) {

});
```

`V/organize.evidence.ts`(Task 5가 만든 파일) — import의 `'../e2e/helpers'` 묶음에 `makeTags, tagChip,`를, `'./capture'` 묶음에 `tryExec,`를 더한다(Task 5가 `treeRow`·`rowAt`·`createCollection`·`addToCollection`을 이미 import했다). 파일 끝의 판정 시험(`M5 organize: verdict of every check above`) **바로 위**에 더한다:
```ts
let tagIds: string[] = [];
test('M5 tags: the selector, its chips and the table dots — light and dark', TAG, async () => {
  const list = await s.page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list());
  const ids = list.ok ? list.data.map((i) => i.id) : [];
  tagIds = await makeTags(s.page, [
    { name: '중요', slot: 1, items: ids.slice(0, 2) },
    { name: '시험 범위', slot: 2, items: ids.slice(0, 1) },
    { name: '수용체', items: ids.slice(0, 2) },
    { name: '회귀분석' },
  ]);
  await s.page.getByTestId('nav-scope-all').click();
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('tag-selector')).toBeVisible();
  await tagChip(s.page, tagIds[2]!).click(); // 수용체 in the filter
  await rowAt(s.page, 0).click(); // the table has the focus: the first row on the accent fill
  if (IS_MAC) await movePointer(512, 620);
  await guard('selector: chips 22 px high, dots 8 px, a hairline above, at most 40 % of the sidebar', async () => {
    const v = await s.page.evaluate(({ chip, dotTag }) => {
      const sel = document.querySelector('[data-testid="tag-selector"]')!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const col = document.querySelector('nav.sidebar-inner')!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const pill = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="tag-chip-${chip}"]`)!.parentElement!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dot = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="tag-chip-${dotTag}"] .dot`)!.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { chipHeight: pill.height, dot: [dot.width, dot.height], ratio: sel.height / col.height, border: getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="tag-selector"]')!).borderTopWidth };
    }, { chip: tagIds[2]!, dotTag: tagIds[0]! });
    results['tagSelector'] = v;
    check('selector: chips 22 px high, dots 8 px, a hairline above, at most 40 % of the sidebar', v.chipHeight === 22 && v.dot[0] === 8 && v.dot[1] === 8 && v.ratio <= 0.4 && v.border === '1px', v);
  });
  await guard('dots: the inner border on a plain row, the white ring on the accent row', async () => {
    const dot = s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"] .tag-dots i').first();
    const ring = await dot.evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow);
    const white = await tokenColor(s.page, '--text-on-accent');
    results['tagDots'] = { ring, white };
    check('dots: the inner border on a plain row, the white ring on the accent row', ring.includes(white) && !ring.includes('inset'), { ring, white });
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(s.page, theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, `m5-06-tags-selector-${theme}`, `tags: the selector with 수용체 chosen and the table dots, the first row selected (${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
});

test('M5 tags: the chip menu with 색 지정 ▸ open and the item menu with 색 태그 ▸ open (macOS only)', TAG, async () => {
  if (!IS_MAC) {
    results['tagMenus'] = { skipped: 'native menus are macOS only' };
    return;
  }
  /** ↓ × downs (the first lands on the first row of a menu a mouse opened), then → to open the submenu on that row. */
  const openSubmenu = (downs: number) =>
    tryExec('osascript', ['-e', 'tell application "System Events"', ...Array.from({ length: downs }, () => ['-e', 'key code 125', '-e', 'delay 0.2']).flat(), '-e', 'key code 124', '-e', 'end tell'], 20_000);
  await focusApp(s.app);
  await tagChip(s.page, tagIds[0]!).click({ button: 'right' });
  await sleep(1200);
  const chipTyped = await openSubmenu(2); // 이름 바꾸기, 색 지정
  await sleep(900);
  const chipShot = await fullScreenShot('m5-06-menu-tag-colors', 'the tag chip menu with 색 지정 ▸ open: eight colours with dots, the slot another tag holds named');
  await pressEscape();
  await pressEscape();
  await sleep(500);
  await rowAt(s.page, 0).click({ button: 'right' });
  await sleep(1200);
  const itemTyped = await openSubmenu(5); // 열기, Finder에서 보기, 사본 내보내기…, 컬렉션에 추가, 색 태그
  await sleep(900);
  const itemShot = await fullScreenShot('m5-06-menu-item-color-tags', 'the item menu with 색 태그 ▸ open: the tags by slot, the digits at the right, a check for what every selected item has');
  await pressEscape();
  await pressEscape();
  results['tagMenus'] = { chip: chipShot.file, item: itemShot.file, chipKeys: chipTyped.ok, itemKeys: itemTyped.ok };
  check('tag menus: both keyboard routes ran', chipTyped.ok && itemTyped.ok, { chipTyped: chipTyped.stderr, itemTyped: itemTyped.stderr });
});
```
(`tryExec`는 `{ ok, stdout, stderr, ms }`를 돌려준다. 태그 칩 메뉴의 첫 ↓가 첫 줄에 닿는지는 시스템에 따라 다르다 — Task 4와 같은 이유로, PNG에서 하위 메뉴가 열려 있지 않으면 컨트롤러가 `openSubmenu`의 횟수를 한 칸 바꿔 다시 돌린다.)

### Task 7: 항목 패널과 소속 명령 — 태그 절(추가·제안·떼기), 컬렉션 절(경로로 옮겨 가기), 여럿 선택의 공통 절과 "컬렉션에 추가 ▾", 컬렉션에 추가 ▸·이 컬렉션에서 빼기와 실행 취소, 쪽 수 탐침 디바운스, Linux 역할 칸

#### 제안 판정 (Q-70 … Q-79)

뼈대·명세가 코드나 이웃 작업과 어긋나거나 정하지 않은 곳이다. 아래 모양대로 구현하고, 컨트롤러가 거부하면 해당 단계만 고친다.

1. **Q-70 (메뉴 배치 번호: 파일 메뉴 2묶음의 4·5번, 컨텍스트 메뉴 3묶음의 1·2번 — Task 6의 "색 태그 ▸"는 6번·3번이다).** 명세 9.3은 `collection.addItems`·`collection.removeItems`를 "파일 2묶음"에 놓지만 그 묶음에는 이미 `item.showInFolder`(1)·`item.exportCopy`(2)·`item.openExternally`(3)가 있다(`D/commands.ts:105,112,121`). Task 4의 인계 문장은 `colorTags`에 `menu: { menu: 'file', group: 2, order: 3 }`, `contextMenu: { …, group: 3, order: 1 }`을 적었는데, 앞의 것은 기본 앱으로 열기와 번호가 겹치고 뒤의 것은 내 컬렉션에 추가와 겹친다(같은 번호는 레지스트리 순서로 갈리는데 `SUBMENUS`는 `COMMANDS`와 따로라 순서가 정해지지 않는다). 제안: 메뉴 막대 = 컬렉션에 추가 `order 4`, 이 컬렉션에서 빼기 `order 5`(Task 6의 색 태그 ▸는 `order 6`), 컨텍스트 메뉴 = 사본 내보내기 묶음(2) 다음의 새 묶음 3에 컬렉션에 추가 `order 1`, 이 컬렉션에서 빼기 `order 2`(색 태그 ▸는 `order 3`). 명세 7.3의 줄 순서(컬렉션에 추가 ▸ · 이 컬렉션에서 빼기 · 색 태그 ▸)와 같다. **Task 6은 이 번호로 `colorTags`를 올려야 한다**(`E/platform.spec.ts`의 파일 메뉴 단언이 이 순서를 못 박는다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 번호 네 개와 단언 몇 줄.
2. **Q-71 (overruled by the controller: the IPC returns the changed ids).** 명세 8.2대로 `collections:addItems`·`collections:removeItems`가 **실제로 바뀐 id 배열**(`Result<string[]>`)을 돌려준다 — main에는 `addItemsChanged`·`removeItemsChanged`가 이미 있고 `libraryChanged`의 `itemIds`로 알린다(`M/ipc/organize.ts`). 그래서 `membership.ts`는 스냅샷으로 id를 짐작하지 않고 그 답을 그대로 쓴다: 실행 취소는 답이 비어 있지 않을 때만 주어진다. 이 때문에 Step 3b가 도메인 형·main 처리기·기존 IPC 시험을 고친다(호출처 둘 — Task 5의 `settleImport`가 쓰는 개수와 Task 3의 `E/helpers.ts` `addToCollection`이 돌려주는 개수 — 은 `.length`로).
3. **Q-72 (IME 검사 사본 하나가 더 생긴다 — Task 10이 옮길 목록에 `R/tags/addFieldKeys.ts`를 더한다).** Q-109의 `R/ui/ime.ts`는 Task 10이 만든다. 이 작업의 태그 추가 칸은 그 전에 나오므로 `addFieldKeys.ts`가 `isComposing`·`keyCode 229`·`Process` 검사를 순수 함수 안에 한 번만 두고, Task 10의 소스 훑기 시험이 이 파일을 사본으로 세면 `isComposingKey`로 바꾼다(한 줄). 틀렸을 때 비용: 그 한 줄.
4. **Q-73 (Task 6 인터페이스에 대한 가정 넷 — 어긋나면 이 작업의 해당 한 곳을 맞춘다).** (a) 칩의 떼기 단추(×)는 칩 안의 `data-testid="tag-chip-remove"`다(`E/helpers.ts`의 `removeChip` 한 곳). (b) `ChipGroup`은 줄바꿈하는 flex 묶음이고 롤링 `tabindex`는 자식 칩에만 건다 — "태그 추가" 칩은 묶음 **밖**에 두므로(별개의 Tab 정거장) 묶음 구현과 무관하다. (c) 사이드바 태그 선택기에도 같은 `tag-chip-<id>`가 있어 같은 id가 화면에 둘 생길 수 있다 — 이 작업의 시험은 늘 `tags-section` 안에서 찾는다. (d) 칩에 `onRemove`가 불리면 칩이 사라지고 포커스는 이 작업이 이웃 칩이나 "태그 추가" 칩으로 옮긴다(`focusAfterRemoval`). 틀렸을 때 비용: 각각 한 줄에서 한 함수.
5. **Q-74 (`ui/MenuButton`에 `indent`와 `marked`를 더한다).** 명세 6.2의 웹 메뉴는 트리 순서의 들여쓰기 목록이고, "이미 든 컬렉션"은 체크 + 비활성이다. M4의 `checked`는 한 묶음을 라디오(`menuitemradio`)로 만들어서(`choice()`) 소속 표시에 맞지 않는다. 제안: `MenuButtonItem.indent?: number`(수준 × 12px 왼쪽 여백, `--indent`)와 `marked?: boolean`(체크 칸에 체크, 묶음은 `selectionMode: 'multiple'` → `menuitemcheckbox`, `aria-checked`)를 더하고, `Menu`에 `shouldCloseOnSelect`를 둔다(여러 선택 모드의 메뉴는 기본이 열린 채라서). 기존 `checked` 동작은 그대로다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 한 파일(MenuButton)과 CSS 한 규칙.
6. **Q-75 (쪽 수 탐침 계수: 페이지가 `window.__learnProbes`를 만들었을 때만 센다).** 명세 11절은 "E2E(빠른 ↓ 10번에 탐침 1번)"을 요구한다. pdf.js의 범위 요청은 워커에서 나가 `page.on('request')`로 안정적으로 셀 수 없다. Q-100의 `countRender`와 같은 방식으로 `startProbe`가 `window.__learnProbes`(시험이 만든 배열)가 있을 때만 `{ kind, assetId }`를 넣는다 — 운영에서는 전역이 없어 검사 한 줄뿐이다. 시험은 대조군(느린 ↓ 3번 = 탐침 3번)으로 계수기가 거짓이 아님을 보인다. 서로 다른 파일 11개가 필요하다(같은 리비전은 `knownFacts` 캐시에 걸려 탐침이 안 돈다) — `distinctPdfs`가 꼬리 주석 한 줄이 다른 PDF 사본을 만든다(M4 Task 4 증거가 쓰는 방법). 틀렸을 때 비용: 시험 도우미.
7. **Q-76 (Linux 역할 칸은 `<select>`를 `span.ed-select-wrap`으로 감싸 자체 화살표를 그린다).** `appearance: none`은 Chromium의 화살표를 지우므로 화살표를 그릴 요소가 있어야 한다(`<select>`는 자식을 그리지 않는다). 감싸개가 격자의 88px 칸이 되고 `select`가 그 안을 채운다. Mac은 `appearance: auto` 그대로(감싸개의 화살표는 `display: none`). 틀렸을 때 비용: 감싸개 한 겹.
8. **Q-77 (`SectionId`는 단일·여럿이 같은 `tags`·`collections`를 쓴다).** 여럿을 골랐을 때의 "공통 태그"·"컬렉션" 절도 같은 열림 상태를 따른다(한 자료에서 접어 둔 절이 여럿 선택에서 펼쳐지는 쪽이 더 낯설다). 제목만 다르다. 틀렸을 때 비용: id 둘.
9. **Q-78 (빈 문구는 보조색이다 — 명세 6.1의 "3차색"을 M4 소유자 결정과 맞춘다).** "컬렉션에 없음"·"고른 자료에 함께 붙은 태그가 없습니다."·"고른 자료가 함께 든 컬렉션이 없습니다."는 12px 설명 글자다. M4는 같은 종류의 글자(선택 없음 통계)를 소유자 결정으로 보조색(4.5:1)에 두었다(`E/inspector.spec.ts`가 단언). 같은 이유로 보조색을 쓴다. 경로의 `›`는 장식이라 목업대로 3차색(`aria-hidden`). 디자인 비평이 3차색을 요구하면 CSS 두 줄. 또 태그·컬렉션 절은 정리 스냅샷이 없을 때(읽기 실패) 그리지 않는다 — 동작하지 않는 컨트롤은 그리지 않는다.
10. **Q-79 (빼기 토스트의 N은 서로 다른 자료 수, 빼낼 소속이 없으면 조용히 끝난다).** 한 자료가 컬렉션과 그 하위 둘에 모두 들어 있어 소속 둘을 지워도 N은 1이다("자료 N개를 뺐습니다"). 선택한 자료 중 범위 안에 직접 든 것이 하나도 없으면(스냅샷이 뒤처진 경우뿐이다) 아무 일도 하지 않고 토스트도 없다. 도중에 IPC가 실패하면 그 앞까지 뺀 것은 그대로 두고 오류 토스트만 띄운다(알림이 스냅샷을 새로 가져온다) — 부분 실행 취소는 만들지 않는다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 처리기 한 곳.

#### 이 작업이 하는 일

항목 패널에 **태그**·**컬렉션** 절을 더하고(정보 · 태그 · 컬렉션 · 파일), 여럿을 골랐을 때 **공통 태그**·**컬렉션** 절과 "컬렉션에 추가 ▾" 단추를 더한다. 소속을 바꾸는 명령 둘 — `collection.addItems`(컬렉션에 추가 ▸, 값 하위 메뉴)·`collection.removeItems`(이 컬렉션에서 빼기)를 레지스트리에 올리고, 처리기·실행 취소 토스트·메뉴 막대/컨텍스트 메뉴 배치를 완성한다. 소속을 바꾸는 코드는 한 모듈(`R/organize/membership.ts`)에만 둔다 — Task 8의 끌어 놓기(⌘ 이동)가 같은 함수를 쓴다. M4 잔여 둘(쪽 수 탐침 디바운스, Linux 역할 칸)을 닫는다.

- 도메인: 명령 둘, 규칙, 배치.

`packages/domain/test/commands.test.ts` — 맨 위 `from '../src/commands'` import 묶음에 `submenuProblems, SUBMENUS`가 없으면 더한다. 기존 `defines the registry commands …`의 정렬된 id 배열에 `'collection.addItems'`를 `'collection.delete'` 앞에, `'collection.removeItems'`를 `'collection.rename'` 앞에 더한다(알파벳 순: `addItems < delete < importInto < new < newChild < removeItems < rename`). 파일 끝에 덧붙인다:
```ts
describe('collection.addItems and collection.removeItems (M5 spec 9.2, 9.3)', () => {
  const viewing = (scope: CommandContextState['scope']): CommandContextState => ({ ...LIB, libraryCount: 3, selectionCount: 1, selectionAvailable: 1, scope });

  it('are named as the spec names them: the add is a value submenu with no palette line, the remove a palette command', () => {
    expect(commandById('collection.addItems')).toMatchObject({ label: '컬렉션에 추가', submenu: 'collections', palette: false, contexts: ['item'] });
    expect(commandById('collection.removeItems')).toMatchObject({ label: '이 컬렉션에서 빼기', palette: true, contexts: ['item'] });
    expect(inPalette(commandById('collection.addItems'))).toBe(false);
    expect(inPalette(commandById('collection.removeItems'))).toBe(true);
    expect(submenuProblems(COMMANDS, SUBMENUS)).toEqual([]); // a value submenu has a place and no palette line
  });
  it('컬렉션에 추가 works on any selection in the library — a missing file is filed too — and not in the reader, with no selection or while blocked', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', viewing('all'), [managedOk])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', viewing('unfiled'), [managedOk, linkedMissing])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', viewing('collection'), [managedOk])).toBe(true);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', viewing('all'))).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', { ...viewing('all'), view: 'viewer' }, [managedOk])).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.addItems', { ...viewing('all'), blocked: true }, [managedOk])).toBe(false);
  });
  it('이 컬렉션에서 빼기 needs a collection to be viewed (the scope the owner chose to take out of, with what is below it)', () => {
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.removeItems', viewing('collection'), [managedOk])).toBe(true);
    for (const scope of ['all', 'recent', 'unfiled', 'duplicates'] as const) expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.removeItems', viewing(scope), [managedOk]), scope).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.removeItems', viewing('collection'))).toBe(false);
    expect(isCommandAvailable('collection.removeItems', { ...viewing('collection'), blocked: true }, [managedOk])).toBe(false);
  });
  it('the menu bar judges them on the reported selection: the add everywhere in the library, the remove only inside a collection', () => {
    expect(availableMenuCommands(viewing('all'))).toContain('collection.addItems');
    expect(availableMenuCommands(viewing('all'))).not.toContain('collection.removeItems');
    expect(availableMenuCommands(viewing('collection'))).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['collection.addItems', 'collection.removeItems']));
    expect(availableMenuCommands({ ...viewing('collection'), selectionCount: 0, selectionAvailable: 0 })).not.toContain('collection.addItems');
  });
  it('both follow 기본 앱으로 열기 in 파일, and sit in their own group of the item menu after 사본 내보내기… (7.3 order: 추가 · 빼기)', () => {
    const file = COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.menu?.menu === 'file').sort((a, b) => a.menu!.group - b.menu!.group || a.menu!.order - b.menu!.order).map((c) => c.id);
    expect(file.slice(-5)).toEqual(['item.showInFolder', 'item.exportCopy', 'item.openExternally', 'collection.addItems', 'collection.removeItems']);
    const item = COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.contextMenu?.kinds.includes('item')).sort((a, b) => a.contextMenu!.group - b.contextMenu!.group || a.contextMenu!.order - b.contextMenu!.order);
    expect(item.map((c) => [c.id, c.contextMenu!.group])).toEqual([
      ['item.relink', 0], ['item.open', 1], ['item.showInFolder', 2], ['item.exportCopy', 2], ['collection.addItems', 3], ['collection.removeItems', 3],
    ]);
    expect(commandById('collection.removeItems').contextMenu?.onlyWhenAvailable).toBe(true); // absent outside a collection, not greyed
    expect(commandById('collection.addItems').contextMenu?.onlyWhenAvailable).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

`R/organize/snapshotPatch.test.ts`:
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { withMembers, withTag, withTagged, withoutMembers, withoutTagged } from './snapshotPatch';

const AT = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const BASE: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
  ],
  tags: [{ id: 't1', name: '중요', color: 'yellow', position: 1 }],
  members: { bio: ['a', 'b'] },
  tagged: { t1: ['a'] },
  duplicates: [],
};

describe('patching the organize snapshot before the notice brings the real one', () => {
  it('files ids once each, after the ones already there, and a collection that was empty gets its key', () => {
    const next = withMembers(BASE, 'bio', ['b', 'c', 'c', 'd']);
    expect(next.members['bio']).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']);
    expect(withMembers(BASE, 'c6', ['a']).members).toEqual({ bio: ['a', 'b'], c6: ['a'] });
    expect(BASE.members['bio']).toEqual(['a', 'b']); // never mutates
  });
  it('a collection the snapshot does not have is left alone', () => {
    expect(withMembers(BASE, 'gone', ['a'])).toBe(BASE);
    expect(withoutMembers(BASE, 'gone', ['a'])).toBe(BASE);
  });
  it('takes ids out, and drops the key of a collection that is empty (the snapshot carries non-empty keys only)', () => {
    expect(withoutMembers(BASE, 'bio', ['a']).members).toEqual({ bio: ['b'] });
    expect(withoutMembers(BASE, 'bio', ['a', 'b', 'zz']).members).toEqual({});
    expect(withoutMembers(BASE, 'c6', ['a'])).toBe(BASE); // nothing was there
  });
  it('adds a created tag once, at the end (a new tag has no slot)', () => {
    const made = { id: 't2', name: '수용체', color: null, position: null };
    const next = withTag(BASE, made);
    expect(next.tags.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['t1', 't2']);
    expect(withTag(next, made)).toBe(next);
    expect(withTag(BASE, BASE.tags[0]!)).toBe(BASE);
  });
  it('puts a tag on ids and takes it off again, for tags the snapshot has', () => {
    expect(withTagged(BASE, 't1', ['a', 'b']).tagged).toEqual({ t1: ['a', 'b'] });
    expect(withTagged(BASE, 'nope', ['a'])).toBe(BASE);
    expect(withoutTagged(BASE, 't1', ['a']).tagged).toEqual({});
    expect(withoutTagged(BASE, 'nope', ['a'])).toBe(BASE);
  });
});
```
`R/organize/common.test.ts`:
```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { commonCollections, commonTags } from './common';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from './model';
import { item } from './testing';

const AT = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'stat', name: '통계', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
  ],
  tags: [
    { id: 't2', name: '시험', color: null, position: null },
    { id: 't3', name: '가나', color: null, position: null },
    { id: 't1', name: '중요', color: 'yellow', position: 1 },
  ],
  members: { bio: ['a', 'b', 'c'], c6: ['a', 'b'], stat: ['d'] },
  tagged: { t1: ['a', 'b', 'c'], t2: ['a', 'b'], t3: ['a'] },
  duplicates: [],
};
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'].map((id) => item(id)));

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('the tags a selection has in common (spec 6.2)', () => {
  it('lists the tags every selected item has, coloured slots first and then by name, as an item\'s own chips are', () => {
    expect(commonTags(model, ['a']).map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['t1', 't3', 't2']);
    expect(commonTags(model, ['a', 'b']).map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['t1', 't2']);
    expect(commonTags(model, ['a', 'b', 'c']).map((t) => t.id)).toEqual(['t1']);
  });
  it('is empty when nothing is shared, for no selection, and when one selected id is not in the library', () => {
    expect(commonTags(model, ['a', 'd'])).toEqual([]);
    expect(commonTags(model, [])).toEqual([]);
    expect(commonTags(model, ['a', 'zz'])).toEqual([]);
```

```ts
import type { OrganizeSnapshot, OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';

/** `list`, then the ids of `ids` it lacks, once each. */
function joined(list: readonly string[] | undefined, ids: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const out = list ? [...list] : [];
  const seen = new Set(out);
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (seen.has(id)) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    out.push(id);
  }
  return out;
}

function without(list: readonly string[], ids: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const gone = new Set(ids);
  return list.filter((id) => !gone.has(id));
}

/** The record with `key` set to `list`, or without the key when the list is empty: the snapshot carries non-empty keys only. */
function put(record: Readonly<Record<string, string[]>>, key: string, list: string[]): Record<string, string[]> {
  const next = { ...record };
  if (list.length === 0) delete next[key];
  else next[key] = list;
  return next;
}

/**
 * The snapshot with a change applied before main's notice brings the real one (pure, never mutating): the screen then
 * shows the result at once, and the next calculation — a second 컬렉션에 추가, the "already in" marks — sees it.
 */
export function withMembers(s: OrganizeSnapshot, collectionId: string, ids: readonly string[]): OrganizeSnapshot {
  if (!s.collections.some((c) => c.id === collectionId)) return s;
  return { ...s, members: put(s.members, collectionId, joined(s.members[collectionId], ids)) };
}

export function withoutMembers(s: OrganizeSnapshot, collectionId: string, ids: readonly string[]): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const held = s.members[collectionId];
  return held === undefined ? s : { ...s, members: put(s.members, collectionId, without(held, ids)) };
}

/** A tag just created, at the end of the list (it has no slot yet); a tag the snapshot has is left as it is. */
export function withTag(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tag: OrganizeTag): OrganizeSnapshot {
  return s.tags.some((t) => t.id === tag.id) ? s : { ...s, tags: [...s.tags, tag] };
}

export function withTagged(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, ids: readonly string[]): OrganizeSnapshot {
  if (!s.tags.some((t) => t.id === tagId)) return s;
  return { ...s, tagged: put(s.tagged, tagId, joined(s.tagged[tagId], ids)) };
}

export function withoutTagged(s: OrganizeSnapshot, tagId: string, ids: readonly string[]): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const held = s.tagged[tagId];
  return held === undefined ? s : { ...s, tagged: put(s.tagged, tagId, without(held, ids)) };
}
```

```ts
import type { OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from './model';

/**
 * The tags every one of `ids` has (spec 6.2), in an item's own chip order. Reads the model only: with 10,000 selected it
 * is the first item's tags (a handful) times the selection, a set lookup each — never an IPC call (spec 12).
 */
export function commonTags(model: OrganizeModel, ids: readonly string[]): OrganizeTag[] {
  const first = ids[0];
  if (first === undefined) return [];
  return model.tagsOfItem(first).filter((tag) => {
    const holders = model.tagItems(tag.id);
    return holders.size >= ids.length && ids.every((id) => holders.has(id));
  });
}

/**
 * The collections every one of `ids` is directly in (spec 6.2), in tree order. The same set marks the collections the
 * 컬렉션에 추가 ▾ menu shows as already holding the selection. One pass over the items' own lists.
 */
export function commonCollections(model: OrganizeModel, ids: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const unique = [...new Set(ids)];
  if (unique.length === 0) return [];
  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const id of unique) for (const collectionId of model.directCollectionsOf(id)) seen.set(collectionId, (seen.get(collectionId) ?? 0) + 1);
  return model.flat.filter((node) => seen.get(node.id) === unique.length).map((node) => node.id);
}
```

```ts
/** Bulk membership change: announce the items that changed, if any; answer with their ids (what an undo puts back). */
function changedIds(reason: Reason, itemIds: readonly string[]): string[] {

}
```

```ts
import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';

/** The organize snapshot the cache holds now (undefined before the first read, or after a failed one). */
export const cachedSnapshot = (): OrganizeSnapshot | undefined => queryClient.getQueryData<OrganizeSnapshot>(keys.organize);

/** Changes the snapshot in the cache; the notice main sends next brings the real one. */
export function patchSnapshot(update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot): void {
  queryClient.setQueryData<OrganizeSnapshot>(keys.organize, (s) => (s ? update(s) : s));
}
```
