```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { dragState, setDndGate } from './dragState';

afterEach(() => {
  dragState.end();
  dragState.setFilesOver(false);
  dragState.setAlt(false);
  dragState.setNative(false);
  setDndGate(true);
});

describe('dragState', () => {
  it('holds what is being dragged; a new drag replaces the last and subscribers hear each change', () => {
    const heard = vi.fn();
    const stop = dragState.subscribe(heard);
    dragState.beginItems(['a', 'b']);
    expect(dragState.get()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'items', itemIds: ['a', 'b'], collectionId: null, tagId: null });
    dragState.beginCollection('c1');
    expect(dragState.get()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'collection', itemIds: [], collectionId: 'c1', tagId: null });
    dragState.beginTag('t1');
    expect(dragState.get()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'tag', collectionId: null, tagId: 't1' });
    dragState.end();
    expect(dragState.get().kind).toBeNull();
    expect(heard).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
    stop();
  });

  it('React Aria\'s end counts unless a native drag is running — a drag by keyboard has no native one', () => {
    dragState.beginCollection('c1');
    dragState.setNative(true);
    dragState.endUnlessNative();
    expect(dragState.get().kind).toBe('collection');
    dragState.setNative(false);
    dragState.endUnlessNative();
    expect(dragState.get().kind).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ending a drag that is not there says nothing', () => {
    const heard = vi.fn();
    const stop = dragState.subscribe(heard);
    dragState.end();
    dragState.end();
    expect(heard).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    stop();
  });

  it('keeps Finder files and the ⌥ key apart from a drag of our own', () => {
    dragState.setFilesOver(true);
    dragState.setAlt(true);
    expect(dragState.filesOver()).toBe(true);
    expect(dragState.alt()).toBe(true);
    expect(dragState.get().kind).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the gate starts open, and closing and opening it is heard once each', () => {
    const heard = vi.fn();
    const stop = dragState.subscribe(heard);
    setDndGate(true);
    expect(heard).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    setDndGate(false);
    setDndGate(false);
    setDndGate(true);
    expect(heard).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    stop();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';
import { buildOrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { item } from '../organize/testing';
import { collectionOnCollection, filesOnRow, itemsOnCollection, tagOnRow } from './rules';

const AT = '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z';
const SNAPSHOT: OrganizeSnapshot = {
  collections: [
    { id: 'bio', name: '분자생물학', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c6', name: '6장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'g6', name: '6장 그림', parentId: 'c6', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'c7', name: '7장', parentId: 'bio', createdAt: AT },
    { id: 'stat', name: '통계', parentId: null, createdAt: AT },
  ],
  tags: [
    { id: 'exam', name: '시험', color: null, position: null },
    { id: 'must', name: '중요', color: null, position: null },
  ],
  members: { bio: ['a', 'b'], c6: ['a'], stat: ['c'] },
  tagged: { exam: ['a', 'b'] },
  duplicates: [],
};
const model = buildOrganizeModel(SNAPSHOT, ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'].map((id) => item(id)));
const ALL: LibraryScope = { kind: 'all' };
const IN_BIO: LibraryScope = { kind: 'collection', id: 'bio' };
/** What React Aria allows with no modifier key held (move first), with the move key held, and with Ctrl on Linux. */
const PLAIN = ['move', 'copy'];
const MOVE_KEY = ['move'];

describe('rows onto a collection row (spec 8.2)', () => {
  const ask = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof itemsOnCollection>[0]> = {}) => itemsOnCollection({ target: 'stat', model, scope: ALL, itemIds: ['d'], allowed: PLAIN, ...over });

  it('adds by default', () => {
    expect(ask()).toBe('copy');
    expect(ask({ allowed: ['copy'] })).toBe('copy'); // Ctrl on Linux
  });

  it('shows nothing on a special view, the row being named, an unknown key, or without a model', () => {
    for (const target of ['scope:all', 'scope:recent', 'scope:unfiled', 'scope:duplicates', 'draft:new', 'nope']) expect(ask({ target }), target).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask({ model: undefined })).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask({ allowed: [] })).toBe('cancel');
  });

  it('shows nothing on the collection being viewed, with or without the move key', () => {
    expect(ask({ target: 'bio', scope: IN_BIO })).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask({ target: 'bio', scope: IN_BIO, allowed: MOVE_KEY })).toBe('cancel');
  });

  it('takes the descendants of the viewed collection, the grandchild too', () => {
    expect(ask({ target: 'c6', scope: IN_BIO, itemIds: ['b'] })).toBe('copy');
    expect(ask({ target: 'g6', scope: IN_BIO, itemIds: ['b'] })).toBe('copy');
  });

  it('shows nothing where every dragged item is already held directly — a held ancestor does not count', () => {
    expect(ask({ target: 'c6', itemIds: ['a'] })).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask({ target: 'c6', itemIds: ['a', 'b'] })).toBe('copy'); // b is not in 6장
    expect(ask({ target: 'g6', itemIds: ['a'] })).toBe('copy'); // 6장 holds a, 6장 그림 does not
  });

  it('with the move key inside a collection it moves, also to a descendant that holds them already', () => {
    expect(ask({ target: 'c6', scope: IN_BIO, itemIds: ['a'], allowed: MOVE_KEY })).toBe('move');
    expect(ask({ target: 'stat', scope: IN_BIO, allowed: MOVE_KEY })).toBe('move');
  });

  it('with the move key outside a collection the operation stays move — React Aria drops a copy it did not allow — and the drop adds', () => {
    expect(ask({ allowed: MOVE_KEY })).toBe('move');
    expect(ask({ target: 'c6', itemIds: ['a'], allowed: MOVE_KEY })).toBe('cancel'); // holds them all: nothing to add
  });
});

describe('a collection onto a collection row or the 컬렉션 heading (spec 8.3)', () => {
  const ask = (dragged: string | null, target: string | null) => collectionOnCollection({ dragged, target, model });

  it('moves under another collection', () => {
    expect(ask('c7', 'c6')).toBe('move');
    expect(ask('c7', 'stat')).toBe('move');
    expect(ask('stat', 'g6')).toBe('move');
  });

  it('refuses itself, its descendants (a cycle) and its current parent', () => {
    expect(ask('c6', 'c6')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask('c6', 'g6')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask('bio', 'g6')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask('c6', 'bio')).toBe('cancel'); // already there
  });

  it('the heading is the top level: not for a collection that is there already', () => {
    expect(ask('c6', null)).toBe('move');
    expect(ask('g6', null)).toBe('move');
    expect(ask('bio', null)).toBe('cancel');
  });

  it('refuses what it does not know, and an unknown drag', () => {
    expect(ask('nope', 'c6')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask('c6', 'nope')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(ask(null, 'c6')).toBe('cancel');
    expect(collectionOnCollection({ dragged: 'c6', target: 'stat', model: undefined })).toBe('cancel');
  });
});

describe('a tag onto a table row (spec 8.3)', () => {
  const ask = (over: Partial<Parameters<typeof tagOnRow>[0]> = {}) => tagOnRow({ tagId: 'must', rowId: 'c', selected: new Set(['a', 'b']), model, ...over });

  it('a row outside the selection takes it alone', () => {
    expect(ask()).toEqual(['c']);
  });

  it('a row inside the selection means the whole selection', () => {
    expect(ask({ rowId: 'b' })).toEqual(['a', 'b']);
  });

  it('shows nothing when everything it would reach has the tag', () => {
    expect(ask({ tagId: 'exam', rowId: 'a' })).toBeNull(); // the selection a, b both have 시험
    expect(ask({ tagId: 'exam', rowId: 'a', selected: new Set(['a', 'c']) })).toEqual(['a', 'c']); // c does not
    expect(ask({ tagId: 'exam', rowId: 'a', selected: new Set() })).toBeNull(); // a alone has it
  });

  it('refuses an unknown tag or no tag in the drag', () => {
    expect(ask({ tagId: 'gone' })).toBeNull();
    expect(ask({ tagId: null })).toBeNull();
    expect(ask({ model: undefined })).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('Finder files onto a sidebar row (spec 8.4)', () => {
  it('내 라이브러리 imports without a collection, a collection imports into itself', () => {
    expect(filesOnRow('scope:all', model)).toEqual({ kind: 'library' });
    expect(filesOnRow('c6', model)).toEqual({ kind: 'collection', id: 'c6' });
  });

  it('the other special views, the row being named and unknown keys refuse', () => {
    for (const key of ['scope:recent', 'scope:unfiled', 'scope:duplicates', 'draft:new', 'nope']) expect(filesOnRow(key, model), key).toBeNull();
    expect(filesOnRow('c6', undefined)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`R/dnd/dragState.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

export type DragKind = 'items' | 'collection' | 'tag';

export interface DragSnapshot {
  kind: DragKind | null;
  /** The rows being dragged, in table order. */
  itemIds: readonly string[];
  collectionId: string | null;
  tagId: string | null;
}

const IDLE: DragSnapshot = { kind: null, itemIds: [], collectionId: null, tagId: null };
let snapshot = IDLE;
let gate = true;
let files = false;
let alt = false;
let native = false;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
const emit = () => {
  for (const fn of listeners) fn();
};
const subscribe = (fn: () => void) => {
  listeners.add(fn);
  return () => void listeners.delete(fn);
};

/** `<html data-dnd>` names the drag that is running: the styles and the tests read it, nothing else does. */
function show(kind: DragKind | null): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return; // unit tests have no document
  if (kind === null) delete document.documentElement.dataset['dnd'];
  else document.documentElement.dataset['dnd'] = kind;
}
function replace(next: DragSnapshot): void {
  snapshot = next;
  show(next.kind);
  emit();
}

/**
 * What the drag now running carries. React Aria's drop targets are asked whether they take a drag before anything can be
 * read from it (the data is sealed until the drop), and they are not told which collection or tag it is — so the
 * drag source says so here when it starts. Finder's files and ⌥ are written by the window listeners (events.ts).
 */
export const dragState = {
  get: (): DragSnapshot => snapshot,
  beginItems: (itemIds: readonly string[]) => replace({ ...IDLE, kind: 'items', itemIds }),
  beginCollection: (collectionId: string) => replace({ ...IDLE, kind: 'collection', collectionId }),
  beginTag: (tagId: string) => replace({ ...IDLE, kind: 'tag', tagId }),
  end: () => {
    if (snapshot.kind !== null) replace(IDLE);
  },
  /**
   * React Aria's own end of a drag. A drag by keyboard has no native one, so this is its only end; but when a mouse drag's
   * source row leaves the page, React Aria reports the end (as a cancel) while the drag goes on, and that one is not an end.
   */
  endUnlessNative: () => {
    if (!native) dragState.end();
  },
  native: () => native,
  setNative: (v: boolean) => void (native = v),
  filesOver: () => files,
  setFilesOver: (v: boolean) => void (files = v),
  alt: () => alt,
  setAlt: (v: boolean) => void (alt = v),
  subscribe,
};

/** A tag chip is being dragged: only then do the table's rows take drops (otherwise they would swallow Finder's files). */
export const useTagDragging = (): boolean => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => snapshot.kind === 'tag');

/** Whether the window takes drops at all now: the library shows and nothing holds the window (MainWindow). */
export const useDndGate = (): boolean => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => gate);
export function setDndGate(open: boolean): void {
  if (gate === open) return;
  gate = open;
  emit();
}
```
`R/dnd/rules.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { SCOPE_KEYS } from '../sidebar/rows';

/** What a drop target answers to React Aria: nothing (no marker, no drop), an add (copy) or a move. */
export type DropVerdict = 'cancel' | 'copy' | 'move';

/**
 * Rows onto the collection row `target` (spec 8.2). `allowed` is what React Aria lets through now, which the move key
 * (⌘ on macOS, Shift elsewhere) narrows to `move` alone. Outside a collection the key moves nothing, but the answer
 * stays `move`: React Aria turns an operation it did not allow into `cancel`, and a copy would show no target at all —
 * the drop handler decides by the view, so there it only adds.
 */
export function itemsOnCollection(input: { target: string; model: OrganizeModel | undefined; scope: LibraryScope; itemIds: readonly string[]; allowed: readonly string[] }): DropVerdict {
  const { target, model, scope, itemIds, allowed } = input;
  if (!model?.node(target)) return 'cancel'; // a special view, the row being named, a collection gone since
  if (scope.kind === 'collection' && scope.id === target) return 'cancel'; // where the rows already are
  const moveKey = allowed.length === 1 && allowed[0] === 'move';
  if (moveKey && scope.kind === 'collection') return 'move'; // also into a descendant that holds them: they leave the rest
  if (itemIds.length > 0 && itemIds.every((id) => model.directCollectionsOf(id).includes(target))) return 'cancel'; // nothing to add
  if (moveKey) return 'move';
  return allowed.includes('copy') ? 'copy' : 'cancel';
}

/** A collection onto a collection row, or (target null) onto the 컬렉션 heading, which is the top level (spec 8.3). */
export function collectionOnCollection(input: { dragged: string | null; target: string | null; model: OrganizeModel | undefined }): 'cancel' | 'move' {
  const { dragged, target, model } = input;
  const node = dragged === null ? undefined : model?.node(dragged);
  if (!model || !node) return 'cancel';
  if (target === null) return node.parentId === null ? 'cancel' : 'move';
  if (!model.node(target)) return 'cancel';
  if (node.parentId === target) return 'cancel'; // already there
  if (model.path(target).some((n) => n.id === dragged)) return 'cancel'; // itself or below itself: a cycle
  return 'move';
}

/**
 * The items a tag dropped on the table row `rowId` goes on (spec 8.3): the whole selection when the row is in it, else
 * the row alone — and none, so no marker, when all of them have the tag already.
 */
export function tagOnRow(input: { tagId: string | null; rowId: string; selected: ReadonlySet<string>; model: OrganizeModel | undefined }): string[] | null {
  const { tagId, rowId, selected, model } = input;
  if (tagId === null || !model || !model.tags.some((x) => x.id === tagId)) return null;
  const ids = selected.has(rowId) ? [...selected] : [rowId];
  const held = model.tagItems(tagId);
  return ids.every((id) => held.has(id)) ? null : ids;
}

/** Where Finder's files dropped on a sidebar row go (spec 8.4): none on the other special views. */
export function filesOnRow(target: string, model: OrganizeModel | undefined): { kind: 'library' } | { kind: 'collection'; id: string } | null {
  if (target === SCOPE_KEYS.all) return { kind: 'library' };
  return model?.node(target) ? { kind: 'collection', id: target } : null;
}
```

```ts
    expect(next.collections.find((x) => x.id === 'b')).toEqual({ id: 'b', name: '나', parentId: 'c', createdAt: AT });
    expect(next.collections.filter((x) => x.id !== 'b')).toEqual(BASE.collections.filter((x) => x.id !== 'b'));
    expect(next.members).toBe(BASE.members);
  });
  it('null is the top level', () => {
    expect(withMoved(BASE, 'b', null).collections.find((x) => x.id === 'b')!.parentId).toBeNull();
  });
  it('is the same snapshot when nothing changes or the collection is gone, and never changes its input', () => {
    expect(withMoved(BASE, 'b', 'a')).toBe(BASE);
    expect(withMoved(BASE, 'gone', 'c')).toBe(BASE);
    withMoved(BASE, 'b', 'c');
    expect(BASE.collections[1]!.parentId).toBe('a');
  });
});
```
(`OrganizeSnapshot`은 그 파일에서 이미 import한다 — 없으면 `import type { OrganizeSnapshot } from '@learn/domain';`.)
`R/sidebar/organizeCache.ts` — `withRenamed` 다음에 더한다:
```ts
/** A collection dropped onto another: its new parent (null = the top level). */
export function withMoved(s: OrganizeSnapshot, id: string, parentId: string | null): OrganizeSnapshot {
  const at = s.collections.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!at || at.parentId === parentId) return s;
  return { ...s, collections: s.collections.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, parentId } : x)) };
}
```

**`removeFromScope`의 진행 목록(Q-80).** `R/organize/membership.test.ts` — import의 `./membership` 줄에 `type Removal`을 더하고 파일 끝에 더한다:
```ts
describe('removeFromScope reports its progress, for a caller that has to put things back (a move whose second half failed)', () => {
  const refusal = { ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL', message: '막힘', retryable: false };

  it('fills the list it was given as it goes, so a refusal further on still leaves what was taken out', async () => {
    // Viewing 분자생물학: a is held by it and by 6장 (tree order: it first), c by 6장. The second call is refused.
    removeItems.mockReset();
    removeItems.mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: true, data: ['a'] }).mockResolvedValueOnce(refusal);
    const progress: Removal[] = [];
    await expect(removeFromScope(model, 'bio', ['a', 'c'], progress)).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(progress).toEqual([{ collectionId: 'bio', itemIds: ['a'] }]);
  });

  it('counts a collection\'s first 5,000 ids when its second call is refused', async () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: IDS_PER_CALL + 1 }, (_, i) => `i${i}`);
    const big = buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, members: { bio: ids } }, ids.map((id) => item(id)));
    removeItems.mockReset();
    removeItems.mockImplementationOnce(async (input: { itemIds: string[] }) => ({ ok: true, data: input.itemIds })).mockResolvedValueOnce(refusal);
    const progress: Removal[] = [];
    await expect(removeFromScope(big, 'bio', ids, progress)).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(progress).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(progress[0]!.itemIds).toHaveLength(IDS_PER_CALL);
  });

  it('without a list it answers as before', async () => {
    removeItems.mockReset();
    removeItems.mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, data: ['a'] });
    expect(await removeFromScope(model, 'stat', ['a'])).toEqual([]); // stat holds nothing of a: no call, nothing removed
    expect(removeItems).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

```
(파일 위쪽 `answerFromSnapshot`의 기본 구현은 이 `describe`의 `mockReset` 뒤에 사라진다 — 이 `describe`가 끝에 있으므로 다른 시험에 영향이 없다. `beforeEach`가 `answerFromSnapshot()`을 다시 건다.)
`R/organize/membership.ts` — `removeFromScope`(Task 7이 만든 함수)를 아래로 **통째로** 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * Takes `itemIds` out of the collection and every live collection below it, wherever they are held directly (owner
 * decision: a parent shows its children's items, so taking an item out of the parent takes it out of the view). Resolves
 * to what to put back, collection by collection in tree order. A refusal stops at once: what was taken out before it
 * stays out, and the notice that follows refreshes the snapshot. `progress` is the list that fills as the calls go —
 * a caller that must undo a half-done removal (a move whose second half failed) keeps it and reads it after the throw.
 */
export async function removeFromScope(model: OrganizeModel, scopeCollectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[], progress: Removal[] = []): Promise<Removal[]> {
  const scope = new Set([scopeCollectionId, ...descendantIds(model, scopeCollectionId)]);
  const held = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const id of new Set(itemIds)) {
    for (const collectionId of model.directCollectionsOf(id)) {
      if (!scope.has(collectionId)) continue;
      const list = held.get(collectionId);
      if (list) list.push(id);
      else held.set(collectionId, [id]);
    }
  }
  const order = new Map(model.flat.map((node, i) => [node.id, i]));
  for (const [collectionId, ids] of [...held].sort(([a], [b]) => (order.get(a) ?? 0) - (order.get(b) ?? 0))) {
    const entry: Removal = { collectionId, itemIds: [] };
    for (const chunk of inChunks(ids)) {
      const removed = await unwrap(api().collections.removeItems({ collectionId, itemIds: chunk }));
      if (removed.length > 0) {
        if (entry.itemIds.length === 0) progress.push(entry);
        entry.itemIds.push(...removed);
      }
      patchSnapshot((s) => withoutMembers(s, collectionId, chunk));
    }
  }
  return progress;
}
```
(원문은 컬렉션마다 `removed`를 모아 끝에서 한 번 `patchSnapshot`하고 `done.push`했다. 같은 결과를 조각마다 낸다. 바뀐 시그니처에 맞춰 Task 7의 `membershipCommands.ts`·시험은 고칠 것이 없다 — 인자를 하나 더 받을 뿐이다.)

```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';

/** What the drag image of rows shows: the first row's kind and title, and how many rows go with it. */
export interface PreviewFacts {
  title: string;
  type: LibraryItem['type'];
  count: number;
}

export function previewFacts(itemIds: readonly string[], items: readonly LibraryItem[] | undefined): PreviewFacts {
  const first = items?.find((i) => i.id === itemIds[0]);
  return { title: first?.title ?? t.organize.dnd.plain(itemIds.length), type: first?.type ?? 'pdf', count: itemIds.length };
}
```

`R/dnd/fileDrop.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { FileDropItem } from 'react-aria-components';

/**
 * The location of every dropped file, and how many dropped things have none: a folder, a file that lives in memory. The
 * count goes to the same toast the window overlay uses for them (MainWindow.onDrop).
 */
export async function filesFromDrop(items: ReadonlyArray<{ kind: string }>, pathForFile: (file: File) => string): Promise<{ paths: string[]; unresolved: number }> {
  const files = items.filter((item): item is FileDropItem => item.kind === 'file');
  const found = await Promise.all(files.map((item) => item.getFile()));
  const paths = found.map(pathForFile).filter((p) => p.length > 0);
  return { paths, unresolved: items.length - paths.length };
}
```

`R/dnd/drops.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { LibraryScope, OrganizeSnapshot, OrganizeTag } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Removal } from '../organize/membership';
import type { OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { withMoved } from '../sidebar/organizeCache';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { PerfMark } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import { collectionOnCollection, tagOnRow } from './rules';

/** Everything a drop touches outside itself, so it runs in a test without a window. */
export interface DropDeps {
  model(): OrganizeModel | undefined;
  /** The view shown now (the chosen scope after resolveScope). */
  scope(): LibraryScope;
  selected(): ReadonlySet<string>;
  addItemsTo(collectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[]): Promise<string[]>;
  removeFromScope(model: OrganizeModel, scopeCollectionId: string, itemIds: readonly string[], progress?: Removal[]): Promise<Removal[]>;
  undoRemovals(removals: readonly Removal[]): Promise<void>;
  undoAdds(collectionId: string, added: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
  moveCollection(input: { collectionId: string; parentId: string | null }): Promise<{ parentId: string | null }>;
  /** Changes the organize snapshot in the cache; the notice main sends next brings the real one. */
  patch(update: (s: OrganizeSnapshot) => OrganizeSnapshot): void;
  /** Opens the closed collections above a collection, so its row is on screen. */
  reveal(collectionId: string): void;
  attachTag(itemIds: readonly string[], pick: { tag: OrganizeTag }): Promise<unknown>;
  undoToast(title: string, undo: () => Promise<void>): void;
  failed(e: unknown): void;
  mark(name: Extract<PerfMark, `dnd:${string}`>): void;
}

export interface DropActions {
  /**
   * Rows dropped on a collection row. An add is silent. A move — the move key, in a viewed collection — is two halves:
   * out of the view's collection and everything below it, then into the target, which may be one of those (the order
   * keeps it there). A refusal in either half puts the first back and is one error toast; success offers one undo.
   */
  itemsOn(targetId: string, itemIds: readonly string[], operation: string): Promise<void>;
  /** A collection dropped on a collection row, or (null) on the 컬렉션 heading. */
  collectionOn(collectionId: string, parentId: string | null): Promise<void>;
  /** A tag dropped on the table row `rowId`: on the selection when the row is in it, else on the row. */
  tagOn(tagId: string, rowId: string): Promise<void>;
}

export function createDropActions(deps: DropDeps): DropActions {
  // A put-back that is refused too leaves the first error to tell the user; the notice that follows shows the true state.
  const quietly = (run: () => Promise<void>) => run().catch(() => undefined);

  return {
    async itemsOn(targetId, itemIds, operation) {
      deps.mark('dnd:drop');
      const model = deps.model();
      const target = model?.node(targetId);
      if (!model || !target || itemIds.length === 0) return;
      const scope = deps.scope();
      try {
        if (operation !== 'move' || scope.kind !== 'collection') {
          await deps.addItemsTo(targetId, itemIds);
          deps.mark('dnd:filed');
          return;
        }
        const removals: Removal[] = [];
        try {
          await deps.removeFromScope(model, scope.id, itemIds, removals);
        } catch (e) {
          await quietly(() => deps.undoRemovals(removals));
          throw e;
        }
        let added: string[];
        try {
          added = await deps.addItemsTo(targetId, itemIds);
        } catch (e) {
          await quietly(() => deps.undoRemovals(removals));
          throw e;
        }
        deps.mark('dnd:filed');
        const moved = new Set([...removals.flatMap((r) => r.itemIds), ...added]);
        if (moved.size === 0) return;
        deps.undoToast(t.organize.dnd.moved(moved.size, target.name), async () => {
          await deps.undoAdds(targetId, added);
          await deps.undoRemovals(removals);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },

    async collectionOn(collectionId, parentId) {
      if (collectionOnCollection({ dragged: collectionId, target: parentId, model: deps.model() }) === 'cancel') return;
      try {
        const moved = await deps.moveCollection({ collectionId, parentId });
        deps.patch((s) => withMoved(s, collectionId, moved.parentId));
        deps.reveal(collectionId);
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },

    async tagOn(tagId, rowId) {
      deps.mark('dnd:drop');
      const model = deps.model();
      const tag = model?.tags.find((x) => x.id === tagId);
      const ids = tagOnRow({ tagId, rowId, selected: deps.selected(), model });
      if (!tag || !ids) return;
      try {
        await deps.attachTag(ids, { tag });
        deps.mark('dnd:filed');
      } catch (e) {
        deps.failed(e);
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { LibraryScope } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { attachTag } from '../organize/itemTags';
import { addItemsTo, removeFromScope, undoAdds, undoRemovals } from '../organize/membership';
import { resolveScope } from '../organize/scope';
import { addExpanded, currentModel, patchOrganize } from '../sidebar/actions';
import { ancestorIds } from '../sidebar/rows';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { perfMark } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import { showToast, showUndoToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { dragState } from './dragState';
import { createDropActions } from './drops';
import { tagOnRow } from './rules';

/** The view shown now: what the user chose, or `all` while the chosen collection is gone. */
export const viewedScope = (): LibraryScope => resolveScope(currentModel(), useLibrary.getState().scope);

/** The window's drop actions (the table's rows, the sidebar and its heading share them). */
export const dropActions = createDropActions({
  model: currentModel,
  scope: viewedScope,
  selected: () => useLibrary.getState().selected,
  addItemsTo,
  removeFromScope,
  undoRemovals,
  undoAdds,
  moveCollection: (input) => unwrap(api().collections.move(input)),
  patch: patchOrganize,
  reveal: (collectionId) => {
    const model = currentModel();
    if (model) addExpanded(ancestorIds(model, collectionId));
  },
  attachTag,
  undoToast: showUndoToast,
  failed: (e) => showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.actionFailed, body: e instanceof Error ? e.message : undefined, testId: 'action-error' }),
  mark: perfMark,
});

/** The items a tag being dragged would go on if dropped on this row, or null: the row's marker asks this. */
export function tagDropIds(rowId: string): string[] | null {
  return tagOnRow({ tagId: dragState.get().tagId, rowId, selected: useLibrary.getState().selected, model: currentModel() });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: E2E — 도우미와 시험 먼저 (구현 전이라 모두 실패해야 한다)**

끌기는 스파이크의 방식이다: Playwright의 `page.mouse`가 Chromium의 끌기를 가로채므로 `dragstart`·RAC 처리기·`dragend`가 브라우저의 진짜 이벤트다. Finder 파일은 CDP `Input.dispatchDragEvent`에 진짜 파일을 실어 보낸다(M3의 `drag()` 합성 이벤트는 RAC 대상이 읽을 수 있는 `DataTransferItem`이 아니다). 이동 수정 키는 플랫폼의 것이다(맥 ⌘, 그 밖 Shift — RAC의 판정, Q-34) — Linux 시험은 Shift로 이동을, 아무 키 없이 넣기를 확인한다. 끌기가 도는 동안은 `<html data-dnd>`가 있다(Q-87).

`E/dnd-helpers.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
// Helpers of the drag and drop specs (M5). A drag is a real Chromium drag that Playwright intercepts (mouse down,
// move, up), so dragstart, React Aria's own handlers and dragend are the browser's; Finder's files are CDP drag events
// carrying a real file.
import { expect, type ElectronApplication, type Locator, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/** The platform's move key while dropping (React Aria: ⌘ on macOS, Shift elsewhere). */
export const MOVE_KEY = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Meta' : 'Shift';
export type DragKind = 'items' | 'collection' | 'tag';

/** `count` animation frames: whatever a handled event renders is on screen by then. */
export const frames = (page: Page, count = 2): Promise<void> =>
  page.evaluate(
    (n) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        let left = n;
        const tick = () => (--left <= 0 ? resolve() : void requestAnimationFrame(tick));
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }),
    count,
  );

/** Where to put the pointer on `loc`: its label side (a wide row's left 140 px), `fy` of its height. */
export async function point(loc: Locator, fx = 0.5, fy = 0.5): Promise<{ x: number; y: number }> {
  const box = await loc.boundingBox();
  if (!box) throw new Error('dnd: the element has no box (scrolled out of a virtual list, or not there)');
  return { x: box.x + Math.min(box.width * fx, 140), y: box.y + box.height * fy };
}

/** Presses on `from` and moves a little: the browser starts the drag after the first moves. */
export async function beginDrag(page: Page, from: Locator, kind: DragKind): Promise<void> {
  const p = await point(from);
  await page.mouse.move(p.x, p.y);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(p.x + 8, p.y + 5, { steps: 3 });
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-dnd', kind);
  await frames(page, 2);
}

/** Moves the held pointer over `over` (`fy`: how far down its height) and lets two frames pass. */
export async function hover(page: Page, over: Locator, opts: { fy?: number } = {}): Promise<void> {
  const p = await point(over, 0.5, opts.fy ?? 0.5);
  await page.mouse.move(p.x, p.y, { steps: 8 });
  // Chromium hands the page a dragover only now and then while the pointer moves: a few 1 px moves settle the last one.
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    await frames(page, 1);
    await page.mouse.move(p.x + i, p.y);
  }
  await frames(page, 2);
}

export async function release(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.mouse.up();
  await frames(page, 3);
  await page.waitForTimeout(80);
}

/** Cancels the drag the way a user does (esc), then lets the mouse go. */
export async function cancelDrag(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await frames(page, 2);
  await page.mouse.up();
  await frames(page, 3);
  await page.waitForTimeout(80);
}

/** Press, move over `to`, drop. `key`: a modifier held while over the target (the move key). */
export async function dragTo(page: Page, from: Locator, kind: DragKind, to: Locator, opts: { key?: 'Shift' | 'Meta' } = {}): Promise<void> {
  await beginDrag(page, from, kind);
  if (opts.key) await page.keyboard.down(opts.key);
  await hover(page, to);
  await release(page);
  if (opts.key) await page.keyboard.up(opts.key);
}

/** The drop targets marked now: a table row by its item id, anything else by its test id. */
export const marked = (page: Page): Promise<string[]> =>
  page.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-drop-target]')].map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-item-id') ?? e.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? e.className));

/** The titles in the table, in table order (a virtual body's DOM order need not be the visual one). */
export const tableTitles = (page: Page): Promise<string[]> =>
  page
    .locator('[data-testid="item-row"]')
    .evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((r) => [Number(r.getAttribute('data-index')), r.getAttribute('data-title') ?? ''] as const).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([, title]) => title));

/** Records what each row drag shows as its image (the image node is taken away the tick after it is handed over). */
export async function recordPreviews(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __previews?: Array<{ title: string; badge: string | null }> };
    w.__previews = [];
    new MutationObserver((records) => {
      for (const record of records)
        for (const node of record.addedNodes)
          if (node instanceof HTMLElement && node.classList.contains('dnd-preview-host'))
            w.__previews!.push({ title: node.querySelector('.dnd-preview-title')?.textContent ?? '', badge: node.querySelector('.dnd-preview-badge')?.textContent ?? null });
    }).observe(document.body, { childList: true });
  });
}
export const previews = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __previews: Array<{ title: string; badge: string | null }> }).__previews);

/** The files of a drag from Finder, as the OS sends them (a real file on disk); `alt` is the ⌥ key held. */
export async function finderDrag(page: Page, file: string) {
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
  const data = { items: [], files: [file], dragOperationsMask: 3 };
  return {
    async send(type: 'dragEnter' | 'dragOver' | 'drop', where: Locator | { x: number; y: number }, opts: { alt?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
      const at = 'x' in where ? where : await point(where);
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchDragEvent', { type, x: at.x, y: at.y, modifiers: opts.alt ? 1 : 0, data });
      await frames(page, 2);
    },
    async cancel(): Promise<void> {
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchDragEvent', { type: 'dragCancel', x: 0, y: 0, data });
      await frames(page, 2);
    },
    close: () => cdp.detach(),
  };
}

/** The next call of an IPC channel is refused (an error answer); the calls after it go to the handler that was there. */
export async function failOnce(app: ElectronApplication, channel: string): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ ipcMain }, channel) => {
    const handlers = (ipcMain as unknown as { _invokeHandlers: Map<string, (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>> })._invokeHandlers;
    const original = handlers.get(channel)!;
    let refused = false;
    ipcMain.removeHandler(channel);
    ipcMain.handle(channel, async (...a) => {
      if (!refused) {
        refused = true;
        return { ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL', message: '시험을 위해 거절했습니다.', retryable: false };
      }
      return original(...(a as [unknown, unknown]));
    });
  }, channel);
}
```

`E/dnd.spec.ts`(새 파일). 순서: 표 → 컬렉션(Q-58 이전의 동작) → Finder → 오버레이 → 문 → Q-58 (c)–(f).
```ts
// Drag and drop (M5 spec 8, design-spec 7.2): rows onto collections (add, move, undo, markers), collections onto
// collections, tag chips onto rows, Finder's files onto sidebar rows, the overlay beside the sidebar, and the four
// behaviours of the tree under its Virtualizer that the spike left to the product (spike item 16 c–f).
// A real hand's drag (esc, ⌘, the preview on a Retina screen) is on the real-Mac list.
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, addToCollection, assignTag, closeSheet, createCollection, createCollectionTree, createTag, expandAll, expectWindow, importPaths, launch,
  organizeSnapshot, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, seedLibrary, selectRows, showItemPanel, specialRow, tagChip, treeRow, type Session,
} from './helpers';
import {
  MOVE_KEY, beginDrag, cancelDrag, dragTo, failOnce, finderDrag, frames, hover, marked, point, previews, recordPreviews, release, tableTitles,
} from './dnd-helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const MP4_B = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4');

const count = (page: Page, collectionId: string) => treeRow(page, collectionId).locator('.count');
const open = (page: Page, collectionId: string) => treeRow(page, collectionId).locator('.disclosure').click();
const members = async (page: Page, collectionId: string) => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).members[collectionId] ?? [];
const libraryCount = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(async () => (await window.learn.library.list().then((r) => (r.ok ? r.data.length : -1))));

test.describe('rows, collections and tag chips', () => {
  test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
  let s: Session;
  let ITEMS: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof importPaths>>;

  test.beforeAll(async ({}, testInfo) => {
    s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
    ITEMS = await importPaths(s.page, [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4, MP4_B]);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
  });
  test.afterAll(async () => {
    await s?.app.close();
  });

  test('rows onto collection rows: an unselected row is picked first, an add is silent, and no marker shows on the viewed collection, a special view or a collection that holds them all — a descendant takes them', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const [a, b, c] = ITEMS;
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '끌기 분자생물학');
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '끌기 6장', bio);
    const stat = await createCollection(page, '끌기 통계');
    await addToCollection(page, bio, [a!.id, b!.id, c!.id]);
    await open(page, bio);
    await treeRow(page, bio).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);

    // The row is not selected: pressing it to drag selects it first (the same rule as the right click).
    await beginDrag(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, a!.title)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, bio));
    expect(await marked(page), 'the viewed collection').toEqual([]);
    await hover(page, specialRow(page, 'all'));
    expect(await marked(page), 'a special view').toEqual([]);
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, c6));
    expect(await marked(page), 'a descendant of the viewed collection').toEqual([`nav-collection-${c6}`]);
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, stat));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${stat}`]);
    await release(page);
    await expect(count(page, stat)).toHaveText('1');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast'), 'an add is silent').toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row'), 'nothing left the view').toHaveCount(3);
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([a!.id]);

    // 통계 holds it now: no marker there. The other collection still takes it.
    await beginDrag(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items');
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, stat));
    expect(await marked(page), 'a collection that holds everything dragged').toEqual([]);
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, c6));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${c6}`]);
    await cancelDrag(page);
  });

  test('the drag image is the first row — its kind and title — with a "자료 N개" badge from two rows on, and a press inside a multiple selection keeps it', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const [a, b, c, d] = ITEMS;
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await recordPreviews(page);
    await selectRows(page, [c!.title, a!.title, b!.title]);
    const order = await tableTitles(page);
    const first = order.find((title) => [a!.title, b!.title, c!.title].includes(title))!;

    // Pressing the middle row of the three: all three stay selected and go.
    await beginDrag(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(3);
    expect((await previews(page)).at(-1)).toEqual({ title: first, badge: '자료 3개' });
    const made = await page.evaluate(() => performance.getEntriesByName('learn:dnd:preview', 'measure').at(-1)?.duration ?? null);
    expect(made, 'the image was timed').not.toBeNull();
    expect(made!, 'and quick (the spike measured 6 ms)').toBeLessThan(100);
    await cancelDrag(page);

    // One row: no badge.
    await rowByTitle(page, d!.title).click();
    await beginDrag(page, rowByTitle(page, d!.title), 'items');
    expect((await previews(page)).at(-1)).toEqual({ title: d!.title, badge: null });
    await cancelDrag(page);

    // A press and release without a drag is a click: the selection becomes that row.
    await selectRows(page, [a!.title, b!.title]);
    await rowByTitle(page, b!.title).click();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, b!.title)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
  });

  test('the move key moves out of the viewed collection and everything below it: the toast says where, 실행 취소 puts it back; outside a collection the key only adds', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const [a, b, c] = ITEMS;
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '이동 시험');
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '이동 장', bio);
    const stat = await createCollection(page, '이동 통계');
    await addToCollection(page, bio, [a!.id, b!.id, c!.id]);
    await open(page, bio);
    await treeRow(page, bio).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    const toast = page.getByTestId('undo-toast');

    // Out of the viewed collection, into another top-level one.
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, stat), { key: MOVE_KEY });
    await expect(toast).toContainText('자료 1개를 ‘이동 통계’로 옮겼습니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    expect(await members(page, bio)).not.toContain(a!.id);
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([a!.id]);
    await page.getByTestId('undo-action').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    expect(await members(page, bio)).toContain(a!.id);
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([]);
    await expect(toast).toHaveCount(0);

    // Into a descendant: it leaves 이동 시험 itself and stays in the view through 이동 장.
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, c6), { key: MOVE_KEY });
    await expect(toast).toContainText('자료 1개를 ‘이동 장’으로 옮겼습니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    expect(await members(page, bio)).not.toContain(a!.id);
    expect(await members(page, c6)).toEqual([a!.id]);
    await expect(toast).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 10_000 }); // the toast closes by itself

    // Outside a collection the key moves nothing: the item is added, stays where it was, and nobody is asked.
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, b!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, stat), { key: MOVE_KEY });
    await expect.poll(() => members(page, stat)).toEqual([b!.id]);
    expect(await members(page, bio)).toContain(b!.id);
    await expect(toast).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('esc cancels a drag: no marker stays and nothing changes; a drop on nothing changes nothing either', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const [a] = ITEMS;
    const stat = await createCollection(page, '취소 통계');
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await beginDrag(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items');
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, stat));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${stat}`]);
    await cancelDrag(page);
    await expect(page.locator('[data-drop-target]'), 'the sweep after the drag ended').toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([]);

    const url = page.url();
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', page.locator('.titlebar').first());
    expect(page.url(), 'the window did not navigate').toBe(url);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('a collection onto a collection: itself, its parent and its descendants get no marker; the 컬렉션 heading makes it top-level; the open rows are kept', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const a = await createCollection(page, '옮김 A');
    const a1 = await createCollection(page, '옮김 A-1', a);
    const a2 = await createCollection(page, '옮김 A-2', a);
    const a11 = await createCollection(page, '옮김 A-1-1', a1);
    const b = await createCollection(page, '옮김 B');
    await open(page, a);
    await open(page, a1);
    const parentOf = async (id: string) => (await organizeSnapshot(page)).collections.find((c) => c.id === id)!.parentId;

    await beginDrag(page, treeRow(page, a1), 'collection');
    for (const [why, id] of [['itself', a1], ['its parent', a], ['its child', a11]] as const) {
      await hover(page, treeRow(page, id));
      expect(await marked(page), why).toEqual([]);
    }
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, b));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${b}`]);
    await release(page);
    await expect.poll(() => parentOf(a1)).toBe(b);
    // The row being moved is the view (pressing it chose it): its new parent opens so that it stays on screen; A stays open.
    await expect(treeRow(page, b)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    await expect(treeRow(page, a1)).toBeVisible();
    const stored = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.settings.get({ key: 'sidebar.expanded' }));
    expect(stored.ok && stored.data).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([a, a1]));

    // The heading is the top level: a nested collection can go there, a top-level one gets no marker.
    const heading = page.getByTestId('collections-heading');
    await beginDrag(page, treeRow(page, b), 'collection');
    await hover(page, heading);
    expect(await marked(page), 'already top-level').toEqual([]);
    await cancelDrag(page);
    await beginDrag(page, treeRow(page, a2), 'collection');
    await hover(page, heading);
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual(['collections-heading-drop']);
    await release(page);
    await expect.poll(() => parentOf(a2)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('a tag chip onto rows: a row inside the selection means all of it, outside means that row; no marker where all have the tag; the item panel\'s chips drag too', async () => {
    const { page, app } = s;
    const [a, b, c, d] = ITEMS;
    const exam = await createTag(page, '끌기 시험');
    const must = await createTag(page, '끌기 중요');
    await assignTag(page, exam, [a!.id]);
    await assignTag(page, must, [a!.id]); // so that its chip is in the view
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    const tagged = async (tagId: string) => ((await organizeSnapshot(page)).tagged[tagId] ?? []).slice().sort();
    const sorted = (...ids: string[]) => ids.slice().sort();

    // Inside the selection {b, c}: one marker, on the row under the pointer; the drop reaches both — and a still has it.
    await selectRows(page, [b!.title, c!.title]);
    await beginDrag(page, tagChip(page, exam), 'tag');
    await hover(page, rowByTitle(page, b!.title));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([b!.id]);
    await release(page);
    await expect.poll(() => tagged(exam)).toEqual(sorted(a!.id, b!.id, c!.id));

    // Outside the selection {b, c}: that row alone.
    await dragTo(page, tagChip(page, must), 'tag', rowByTitle(page, d!.title));
    await expect.poll(() => tagged(must)).toEqual(sorted(a!.id, d!.id));
    expect(await tagged(exam), 'the selection was not touched').toEqual(sorted(a!.id, b!.id, c!.id));

    // Everything it would reach has the tag: no marker. The one that lacks it takes the marker.
    await rowByTitle(page, a!.title).click();
    await beginDrag(page, tagChip(page, exam), 'tag');
    await hover(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title));
    expect(await marked(page), 'a has 시험').toEqual([]);
    await hover(page, rowByTitle(page, b!.title));
    expect(await marked(page), 'b has 시험 and is outside the selection {a}: it alone').toEqual([]);
    await hover(page, rowByTitle(page, d!.title));
    expect(await marked(page), 'd lacks it').toEqual([d!.id]);
    await cancelDrag(page);

    // The chip on an item in the item panel is a source as well; the drop goes on the row it is dropped on.
    await showItemPanel(app, page);
    await rowByTitle(page, a!.title).click();
    const own = page.getByTestId('tags-section').getByTestId(`tag-chip-${exam}`);
    await dragTo(page, own, 'tag', rowByTitle(page, d!.title));
    await expect.poll(() => tagged(exam)).toEqual(sorted(a!.id, b!.id, c!.id, d!.id));
  });
});

test('a refused drop is an error toast and changes nothing; a move whose second half is refused puts the first half back', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const t = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { page, app } = t;
    const [a, b] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '거절 분자생물학');
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '거절 장', bio);
    const stat = await createCollection(page, '거절 통계');
    await addToCollection(page, bio, [a!.id, b!.id]);
    await open(page, bio);
    await treeRow(page, bio).click();

    // An add that main refuses: the error toast, and the row is not in the collection.
    await failOnce(app, 'collections:addItems');
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, stat));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(1);
    expect(await members(page, stat)).toEqual([]);

    // A move whose removal main refuses: nothing was taken out, nothing put in.
    await failOnce(app, 'collections:removeItems');
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, c6), { key: MOVE_KEY });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(2);
    expect((await members(page, bio)).sort()).toEqual([a!.id, b!.id].sort());
    expect(await members(page, c6)).toEqual([]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toHaveCount(0);

    // A move whose adding main refuses: the removal is put back (the put-back is the next call, which goes through).
    await failOnce(app, 'collections:addItems');
    await dragTo(page, rowByTitle(page, a!.title), 'items', treeRow(page, c6), { key: MOVE_KEY });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('action-error')).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await members(page, bio)).sort()).toEqual([a!.id, b!.id].sort());
    expect(await members(page, c6)).toEqual([]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('undo-toast')).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await t.app.close();
  }
});

test('Finder\'s files onto sidebar rows: a collection imports into it, 내 라이브러리 without a collection, the other special views refuse, ⌥ links, and a held window ignores it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const t = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { page, app } = t;
    await importPaths(page, [KO_PDF]);
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '가져오기 시험');
    const c6 = await createCollection(page, '가져올 장', bio);
    await open(page, bio);
    await treeRow(page, bio).click();
    const overlay = page.getByTestId('drop-overlay');
    const content = page.getByTestId('content');

    // From the table into the sidebar: the overlay yields, the collection row is the target; the unfiled view takes nothing.
    const mp4 = await finderDrag(page, MP4);
    await mp4.send('dragEnter', content);
    await mp4.send('dragOver', content);
    await expect(overlay).toBeVisible();
    await mp4.send('dragOver', treeRow(page, c6));
    await expect(overlay).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${c6}`]);
    await mp4.send('dragOver', specialRow(page, 'unfiled'));
    expect(await marked(page), 'a special view').toEqual([]);
    await mp4.send('dragOver', specialRow(page, 'all'));
    expect(await marked(page), '내 라이브러리 is a target of its own').toEqual(['nav-scope-all']);
    await mp4.send('dragOver', treeRow(page, c6));
    await mp4.send('drop', treeRow(page, c6));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').last()).toContainText('가져올 장');
    await expect.poll(() => libraryCount(page)).toBe(2);
    expect(await members(page, c6)).toHaveLength(1);
    await mp4.close();

    // 내 라이브러리: imported, and in no collection although a collection is viewed.
    const mp4b = await finderDrag(page, MP4_B);
    await mp4b.send('dragEnter', content);
    await mp4b.send('dragOver', specialRow(page, 'all'));
    await mp4b.send('drop', specialRow(page, 'all'));
    await expect.poll(() => libraryCount(page)).toBe(3);
    expect(await members(page, bio)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(await members(page, c6)).toHaveLength(1);
    await mp4b.close();

    // ⌥ links the original instead of copying it (the cursor badge of ⌥ over a row on macOS is React Aria's, on the real-Mac list).
    const pdf = await finderDrag(page, PDF);
    await pdf.send('dragEnter', content);
    await pdf.send('dragOver', treeRow(page, c6), { alt: true });
    await pdf.send('drop', treeRow(page, c6), { alt: true });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('import-done').filter({ hasText: '연결했습니다' })).toBeVisible();
    const modes = () => page.evaluate(async () => (await window.learn.library.list().then((r) => (r.ok ? r.data.map((i) => i.storageMode).sort() : []))));
    await expect.poll(async () => (await modes()).join()).toBe('linked,managed,managed,managed');
    await pdf.close();

    // A sheet holds the window: no drag starts from a row, and Finder's files get no marker and import nothing.
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    const before = await libraryCount(page);
    const again = await finderDrag(page, KO_PDF);
    await again.send('dragEnter', content);
    await again.send('dragOver', treeRow(page, c6));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([]);
    await again.send('drop', treeRow(page, c6));
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    expect(await libraryCount(page)).toBe(before);
    await again.close();
    // A row cannot be dragged either while the window is held.
    const p = await point(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').first());
    await page.mouse.move(p.x, p.y);
    await page.mouse.down();
    await page.mouse.move(p.x + 8, p.y + 5, { steps: 3 });
    await frames(page, 2);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
    await page.mouse.up();
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  } finally {
    await t.app.close();
  }
});

test('the window overlay covers only the area right of the sidebar, and all of the window when the sidebar is hidden', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const t = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const { page, app } = t;
    await importPaths(page, [KO_PDF]);
    const overlay = page.getByTestId('drop-overlay');
    const content = page.getByTestId('content');
    const finder = await finderDrag(page, MP4);

    await finder.send('dragEnter', content);
    await expect(overlay).toBeVisible();
    const side = (await page.locator('[data-sidebar-area]').boundingBox())!;
    const box = (await overlay.boundingBox())!;
    expect(Math.abs(box.x - (side.x + side.width)), 'starts at the sidebar\'s right edge').toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(box.y).toBe(52);
    expect(box.x + box.width).toBeCloseTo(await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth), 0);
    // The sidebar keeps its own part of the window: over its top (traffic lights, toggle) there is no overlay.
    await finder.send('dragOver', page.getByTestId('sidebar-top'));
    await expect(overlay).toHaveCount(0);
    await finder.send('dragOver', content);
    await expect(overlay).toBeVisible();
    await finder.cancel();
    await expect(overlay).toHaveCount(0);

    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleSidebar');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('shell')).toHaveAttribute('data-sidebar', 'hidden');
    await finder.send('dragEnter', content);
    await expect(overlay).toBeVisible();
    expect((await overlay.boundingBox())!.x, 'with no sidebar it is the whole window as before').toBe(0);
    await finder.cancel();
    await finder.close();
  } finally {
    await t.app.close();
  }
});

// ---- the tree under its Virtualizer (spike item 16 c–f) --------------------------------------------------------

test.describe('a tree of 120 collections under the Virtualizer', () => {
  test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
  let s: Session;
  let tree: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createCollectionTree>>;
  let item: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof importPaths>>[number];
  const parentOf = async (id: string) => (await organizeSnapshot(s.page)).collections.find((c) => c.id === id)!.parentId;
  const treeBox = () => s.page.getByTestId('sidebar-tree');

  test.beforeAll(async ({}, testInfo) => {
    s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
    [item] = await importPaths(s.page, [PDF]);
    await seedLibrary(s.app, { count: 300, from: item! });
    tree = await createCollectionTree(s.page, 120);
    await expandAll(s.page, tree);
    await specialRow(s.page, 'all').click();
    // Sixty rows at most are drawn although 120 collections are open: the tree is virtual.
    expect(await s.page.locator('[data-testid^="nav-collection-"]').count()).toBeLessThan(60);
  });
  test.afterAll(async () => {
    await s?.app.close();
  });

  test('(c) keyboard drag: ⌥→ (or → on a leaf) reaches the row\'s drag button; ↩, ↓…, ↩ moves a collection; esc cancels; the 컬렉션 heading is a stop', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const leaf = tree.ids[40]!; // under 과목 008
    const target = tree.ids[9]!; // 과목 009, a neighbour of its parent
    await treeRow(page, leaf).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight'); // a leaf: React Aria's own → goes into the row's buttons
    await expect(page.getByTestId(`drag-handle-${leaf}`)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-dnd', 'collection');
    let found = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !found; i++) {
      await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
      await frames(page, 2);
      found = (await marked(page)).includes(`nav-collection-${target}`);
    }
    expect(found, 'the arrows reach 과목 009').toBe(true);
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(() => parentOf(leaf)).toBe(target);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');

    // A collection with children: → opens or enters it, ⌥→ is the way to its drag button. esc ends the drag.
    const parent = tree.ids[8]!;
    await treeRow(page, parent).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('Alt+ArrowRight');
    await expect(page.getByTestId(`drag-handle-${parent}`)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-dnd', 'collection');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
    expect(await parentOf(parent)).toBe(tree.ids[0]);

    // The heading is a drop target of the keyboard drag too (it is a plain drop target): a nested collection goes top-level.
    const nested = tree.ids[41]!;
    await treeRow(page, nested).click();
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    let atHeading = false;
    for (const key of ['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown']) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !atHeading; i++) {
        await page.keyboard.press(key);
        await frames(page, 2);
        atHeading = (await marked(page)).includes('collections-heading-drop');
      }
      if (atHeading) break;
    }
    expect(atHeading, 'the arrows reach the 컬렉션 heading').toBe(true);
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect.poll(() => parentOf(nested)).toBeNull();
  });

  test('(d) spring-loading opens a collapsed row after about 800 ms of rest, and the tree scrolls by itself at its top and bottom edge', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const parent = tree.ids[0]!;
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await treeRow(page, parent).locator('.disclosure').click();
    await expect(treeRow(page, parent)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    const [row] = await page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').all();
    await beginDrag(page, row!, 'items');
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, parent));
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    await expect(treeRow(page, parent), 'not yet at 400 ms').toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    await expect(treeRow(page, parent)).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true', { timeout: 1500 });
    await expect(treeRow(page, tree.children[parent]![0]!), 'its children are drawn').toBeVisible();

    // Edge autoscroll: the band is React Aria's 20 px. The pointer rests 10 px inside the edge and moves a pixel now and then.
    const scrollTop = () => treeBox().evaluate((e) => e.scrollTop);
    const box = (await treeBox().boundingBox())!;
    const hold = async (y: number) => {
      await page.mouse.move(box.x + 100, y, { steps: 4 });
      for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
        await page.mouse.move(box.x + 100 + (i % 2) * 4, y);
        await page.waitForTimeout(40);
      }
    };
    const start = await scrollTop();
    await hold(box.y + box.height - 10);
    const down = await scrollTop();
    expect(down, 'scrolled down at the bottom edge').toBeGreaterThan(start);
    await hold(box.y + 10);
    expect(await scrollTop(), 'and back up at the top edge').toBeLessThan(down);
    await cancelDrag(page);
  });

  test('(e) a collection row is one drop target over its whole height, and no between-rows marker is ever drawn', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const rowId = tree.ids[9]!; // one of the first rows: drawn
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    const [first] = await page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').all();
    await beginDrag(page, first!, 'items');
    const row = treeRow(page, rowId);
    const box = (await row.boundingBox())!;
    const samples: Array<{ dy: number; marks: string[] }> = [];
    await page.mouse.move(box.x + 60, box.y - 20, { steps: 3 });
    for (let dy = -6; dy <= box.height + 6; dy += 2) {
      await page.mouse.move(box.x + 60, box.y + dy, { steps: 2 });
      await page.mouse.move(box.x + 61, box.y + dy);
      await frames(page, 2);
      samples.push({ dy, marks: await marked(page) });
      expect(await page.locator('.react-aria-DropIndicator').count(), `no between marker at ${dy}`).toBe(0);
    }
    const inner = samples.filter((p) => p.dy >= 4 && p.dy < box.height - 4);
    const onRow = inner.filter((p) => p.marks.length === 1 && p.marks[0] === `nav-collection-${rowId}`).length;
    expect(onRow / inner.length, 'the row is the target over its inner height').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0.95);
    await cancelDrag(page);
  });

  test('(f) the drag goes on when its source row is scrolled out of the virtual window: the drop is delivered and nothing is left marked', async () => {
    const { page } = s;
    const src = tree.ids[44]!; // under 과목 009, near the top
    await beginDrag(page, treeRow(page, src), 'collection');
    await treeBox().evaluate((e) => void (e.scrollTop = e.scrollHeight));
    await frames(page, 4);
    // A row from the middle of the drawn ones: the last drawn rows are the overscan, below the edge of the view.
    const drawn = page.locator('[data-testid^="nav-collection-"]');
    const targetId = (await drawn.nth(Math.floor((await drawn.count()) / 2)).getAttribute('data-testid'))!.replace('nav-collection-', '');
    expect(targetId).not.toBe(src);
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, targetId));
    expect(await marked(page)).toEqual([`nav-collection-${targetId}`]);
    await release(page);
    await expect.poll(() => parentOf(src)).toBe(targetId);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-drop-target]')).toHaveCount(0);

    // The table's side: 300 rows, the source row far out of the window, the drop on a collection row.
    await specialRow(page, 'all').click();
    await treeBox().evaluate((e) => void (e.scrollTop = 0));
    const row = page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').nth(5);
    const id = (await row.getAttribute('data-item-id'))!;
    await beginDrag(page, row, 'items');
    await page.getByTestId('library-table').evaluate((e) => void (e.scrollTop = 6000));
    await frames(page, 4);
    const to = (await page.locator('[data-testid^="nav-collection-"]').nth(2).getAttribute('data-testid'))!.replace('nav-collection-', '');
    await hover(page, treeRow(page, to));
    await release(page);
    await expect.poll(() => members(page, to)).toContain(id);
    await expect(page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-dnd');
  });
});
```
(`point`는 위 도우미에서 export한다; 사용되지 않으면 import에서 뺀다. `createCollectionTree`·`expandAll`·`treeRow`·`specialRow`는 Task 5, `createTag`·`assignTag`·`organizeSnapshot`·`createCollection`·`addToCollection`은 Task 3, `tagChip`은 Task 6의 `E/helpers.ts`다.)

Run(구현 전): `pnpm build && pnpm fixtures && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24" pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/dnd.spec.ts`
Expected: 모두 FAIL — `data-dnd`가 나타나지 않는다(`beginDrag`의 `toHaveAttribute('data-dnd', …)` 시간 초과), Finder 시험은 오버레이가 사이드바 위에서도 뜬다.

- [ ] **Step 7: 창 이벤트, 끌기 이미지, 행·칩의 끌기 — 구현**

`R/dnd/events.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { dragState } from './dragState';

/**
 * Sends a dragleave to every element of each drop scope that is still marked. The hooks that mark a target count the elements the
 * drag entered and unmark it when each has left; a drag that ends without those events (esc under Playwright, a drag
 * cancelled in the middle) leaves the marker. A tree is one scope: its rows are told together.
 */
export function sweepDropMarks(doc: Document = document): void {
  const scopes = new Set([...doc.querySelectorAll('[data-drop-target]')].map((el) => el.closest('[role="treegrid"]') ?? el));
  for (const scope of scopes) for (const el of [scope, ...scope.querySelectorAll('*')]) el.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragleave', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
}

/**
 * The window's drag bookkeeping (dragState.ts), written in the capture phase before any hook sees an event: Finder's files
 * and ⌥ for the drop targets that cannot read them; whether a native drag runs (React Aria reports a mouse drag's end early
 * when its source row leaves the page); and the end of a drag — on its drop (next tick, after the handlers) and on dragend,
 * which also sweeps the markers a cancelled drag left.
 */
export function installDndEvents(win: Window = window): () => void {
  const track = (e: DragEvent) => {
    dragState.setAlt(e.altKey);
    const files = e.dataTransfer?.types.includes('Files') ?? false;
    dragState.setFilesOver(files);
    if (files) dragState.end(); // Finder's files and a drag of ours never share the pointer
  };
  const started = (e: DragEvent) => {
    // A drag that React Aria turns into its own virtual one prevents the native drag, so it is not a native drag.
    setTimeout(() => dragState.setNative(!e.defaultPrevented), 0);
  };
  const dropped = (e: DragEvent) => {
    dragState.setAlt(e.altKey);
    dragState.setNative(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      dragState.setFilesOver(false);
      dragState.end();
    }, 0);
  };
  const ended = () => {
    dragState.setNative(false);
    dragState.setFilesOver(false);
    sweepDropMarks();
    dragState.end();
  };
  win.addEventListener('dragenter', track, true);
  win.addEventListener('dragover', track, true);
  win.addEventListener('dragstart', started, true);
  win.addEventListener('drop', dropped, true);
  win.addEventListener('dragend', ended, true);
  return () => {
    win.removeEventListener('dragenter', track, true);
    win.removeEventListener('dragover', track, true);
    win.removeEventListener('dragstart', started, true);
    win.removeEventListener('drop', dropped, true);
    win.removeEventListener('dragend', ended, true);
  };
}
```

`R/dnd/rowPreview.tsx`(새 파일):
```tsx
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { timed } from '../ui/perfMarks';
import { DragPreview } from './DragPreview';
import { MIME_ITEMS, parseItemsPayload } from './mime';
import { previewFacts } from './previewFacts';

/** The shape React Aria's `useDrag({ preview })` takes: it gives the drag's items and wants a node (and where the pointer sits on it) back. */
export type DragImageRenderer = (items: Array<Record<string, string>>, done: (node: HTMLElement | null, x?: number, y?: number) => void) => void;

/** Where the pointer sits on the image, from its top left: over the kind icon. */
const GRAB = { x: 12, y: 12 };

/**
 * The image of a row drag. `done` must be called at once (React Aria hands the node to the browser in it), so the preview is
 * rendered synchronously into a node off screen — by a React root of its own, which is why the same component can draw the
 * state board — and taken away the tick after.
 */
export const renderRowPreview: DragImageRenderer = (items, done) => {
  timed('dnd:preview', () => {
    const ids = parseItemsPayload(items[0]?.[MIME_ITEMS] ?? '') ?? [];
    const facts = previewFacts(ids, queryClient.getQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items));
    const host = document.createElement('div');
    host.className = 'dnd-preview-host';
    document.body.append(host);
    const root = createRoot(host);
    flushSync(() => root.render(<DragPreview {...facts} />));
    done(host, GRAB.x, GRAB.y);
    setTimeout(() => {
      root.unmount();
      host.remove();
    }, 0);
  });
};
```
`R/dnd/rowDnd.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useRef, type HTMLAttributes, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { useDrag, useDrop, type TextDropItem } from 'react-aria-components';
import { dropActions, tagDropIds } from './actions';
import { dragState, useDndGate, useTagDragging } from './dragState';
import { MIME_TAG, itemsDrag, parseTagPayload } from './mime';
import { renderRowPreview } from './rowPreview';

/**
 * A table row as a drag source (the rows it takes: `dragIdsOf`) and, while a tag chip is being dragged, as a drop target
 * (spec 8.2, 8.3). React Aria's `useDrag` with `hasDragButton`: without it React Aria takes ↩ on the row (the table opens it
 * with that key) and reads a synthetic mouse press as a virtual one, so no native drag starts. The row has no drag button
 * — the keyboard's way to file items is 컬렉션에 추가 ▸.
 */
export function useRowDnd(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, itemId: string, dragIdsOf: (rowId: string) => string[]): { rowProps: HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>; isDropTarget: boolean } {
  const open = useDndGate();
  const tagDragging = useTagDragging();
  const preview = useRef(renderRowPreview);
  const { dragProps } = useDrag({
    isDisabled: !open,
    hasDragButton: true,
    preview,
    getAllowedDropOperations: () => ['copy', 'move'],
    onDragStart: () => dragState.beginItems(dragIdsOf(itemId)),
    getItems: () => [itemsDrag(dragState.get().itemIds)],
    onDragEnd: () => dragState.endUnlessNative(),
  });
  const { dropProps, isDropTarget } = useDrop({
    ref,
    // A row that takes drops all the time swallows every dragover, Finder's files too: the window overlay would never show over the table.
    isDisabled: !open || !tagDragging,
    getDropOperation: (types) => (types.has(MIME_TAG) && tagDropIds(itemId) !== null ? 'copy' : 'cancel'),
    onDrop: async (e) => {
      const item = e.items.find((i): i is TextDropItem => i.kind === 'text' && i.types.has(MIME_TAG));
      const tagId = item ? parseTagPayload(await item.getText(MIME_TAG)) : null;
      if (tagId) await dropActions.tagOn(tagId, itemId);
    },
  });
  return { rowProps: { ...dragProps, ...dropProps } as HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, isDropTarget };
}
```

```ts
import { useDrag } from 'react-aria-components';
import { dragState, useDndGate } from './dragState';
import { tagDrag } from './mime';

/** A tag chip as a drag source (spec 8.3): a copy of the tag onto rows. `hasDragButton` keeps a press a press (it toggles the filter) and a synthetic mouse a native drag. */
export function useChipDrag(tag: { id: string; name: string }) {
  const open = useDndGate();
  return useDrag({
    isDisabled: !open,
    hasDragButton: true,
    getItems: () => [tagDrag(tag)],
    getAllowedDropOperations: () => ['copy'],
    onDragStart: () => dragState.beginTag(tag.id),

  });
}
```

`R/dnd/treeDnd.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { StorageMode } from '@learn/domain';
import { useDragAndDrop, type DragTypes, type DropOperation, type DropTarget, type DroppableCollectionOnItemDropEvent } from 'react-aria-components';
import { api } from '../api';
import { currentModel } from '../sidebar/actions';
import { importTarget, type ImportTarget } from '../sidebar/importTarget';
import { dropActions, viewedScope } from './actions';
import { dragState, useDndGate } from './dragState';
import { filesFromDrop } from './fileDrop';
import { MIME_COLLECTION, MIME_ITEMS, MIME_TAG, collectionDrag, parseCollectionPayload, parseItemsPayload } from './mime';
import { collectionOnCollection, filesOnRow, itemsOnCollection } from './rules';

/** What the sidebar does with files dropped on a row: MainWindow's drop, told where they go (a collection, or null for 내 라이브러리). */
export type FilesDropHandler = (paths: string[], mode: StorageMode, unresolved: number, into: ImportTarget | null) => void;

/** What the tree answers while a drag is over a row (rules.ts has the reasons). */
function treeDropOperation(target: DropTarget, types: DragTypes, allowed: DropOperation[]): DropOperation {
  // Only "on" a row: the tree also offers "between" targets, which it never takes — a collection's place is its name's.
  if (target.type !== 'item' || target.dropPosition !== 'on') return 'cancel';
  const key = String(target.key);
  const model = currentModel();
  if (dragState.filesOver()) {
    if (filesOnRow(key, model) === null) return 'cancel';
    return allowed.includes('copy') ? 'copy' : (allowed[0] ?? 'cancel'); // ⌥ and the move key narrow what is allowed, not whether files drop
  }
  if (types.has(MIME_COLLECTION)) return collectionOnCollection({ dragged: dragState.get().collectionId, target: key, model });
  if (types.has(MIME_ITEMS)) return itemsOnCollection({ target: key, model, scope: viewedScope(), itemIds: dragState.get().itemIds, allowed });
  return 'cancel'; // a tag chip drops on table rows only
}

async function onItemDrop(e: DroppableCollectionOnItemDropEvent, onFiles: FilesDropHandler): Promise<void> {
  const key = String(e.target.key);
  const alt = dragState.alt(); // read before any wait: the next event may change it
  const first = e.items[0];
  if (first?.kind === 'text') {
    if (first.types.has(MIME_COLLECTION)) {
      const id = parseCollectionPayload(await first.getText(MIME_COLLECTION));
      if (id) await dropActions.collectionOn(id, key);
    } else if (first.types.has(MIME_ITEMS)) {
      const ids = parseItemsPayload(await first.getText(MIME_ITEMS));
      if (ids) await dropActions.itemsOn(key, ids, e.dropOperation);
    }
    return;
  }
  const model = currentModel();
  const target = filesOnRow(key, model);
  if (!target) return;
  const { paths, unresolved } = await filesFromDrop(e.items, (file) => api().pathForFile(file));
  onFiles(paths, alt ? 'linked' : 'managed', unresolved, target.kind === 'collection' ? importTarget(model, { kind: 'all' }, target.id) : null);
}

/**
 * The tree's drag and drop (spec 8.2–8.4): a collection row is a source (moving it) and every collection row, and
 * 내 라이브러리 for files, is a target. React Aria's own spring-loading (800 ms) and edge scrolling (20 px) are used as
 * they are: passing `onDropActivate` would replace the spring.
 */
export function useSidebarDnd(onFiles: FilesDropHandler) {
  const open = useDndGate();
  return useDragAndDrop({
    isDisabled: !open,
    getItems: (keys) =>
      [...keys].flatMap((key) => {
        const node = currentModel()?.node(String(key));
        return node ? [collectionDrag(node)] : [];
      }),
    getAllowedDropOperations: () => ['move'],
    onDragStart: (e) => dragState.beginCollection(String([...e.keys][0])),
    onDragEnd: () => dragState.endUnlessNative(),
    acceptedDragTypes: 'all',
    getDropOperation: treeDropOperation,
    onItemDrop: (e) => void onItemDrop(e, onFiles),
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useDrop, type TextDropItem } from 'react-aria-components';
import { currentModel } from '../sidebar/actions';
import { dropActions } from './actions';
import { dragState, useDndGate } from './dragState';
import { MIME_COLLECTION, parseCollectionPayload } from './mime';
import { collectionOnCollection } from './rules';

/**
 * The 컬렉션 heading as a drop target (spec 8.3): a collection dropped on it becomes a top-level one. A plain drop target of
 * its own, outside the tree's: the keyboard drag finds it among its targets too.
 */
export function RootDropArea({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const open = useDndGate();
  const { dropProps, isDropTarget } = useDrop({
    ref,
    isDisabled: !open,
    getDropOperation: (types) => (types.has(MIME_COLLECTION) ? collectionOnCollection({ dragged: dragState.get().collectionId, target: null, model: currentModel() }) : 'cancel'),
    onDrop: async (e) => {
      const item = e.items.find((i): i is TextDropItem => i.kind === 'text' && i.types.has(MIME_COLLECTION));
      const id = item ? parseCollectionPayload(await item.getText(MIME_COLLECTION)) : null;
      if (id) await dropActions.collectionOn(id, null);
    },
  });
  return (
    <div ref={ref} {...dropProps} className="heading-drop" data-testid="collections-heading-drop" data-drop-target={isDropTarget || undefined}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```
