`R/palette/items.ts` — import에 `type Match`는 이미 있다. 13–37행(`const openedAt` … `rankItems` 끝)을 다음으로 바꾼다:
```ts
const openedAt = (i: LibraryItem): number => (i.openedAt === null ? -Infinity : Date.parse(i.openedAt));
/** -1 when `a` comes first (the larger value), 1 when `b` does, 0 when equal. */
const larger = (a: number | string, b: number | string): number => (a === b ? 0 : a > b ? -1 : 1);

/** A 초성 match scores past every letter match, and a match outside the title past every 초성 match (a title is far shorter than 2^20 characters). */
const INITIALS = 1 << 20;
const NO_TITLE = 1 << 21;

/**
 * How well the title matched, lower first (spec 7.2): a letter match by its offset, then a 초성 match by its offset
 * (ㅅㅎ reads 신호, but a title that holds 신호 itself is the better answer), then rows that matched in another field.
 */
export function matchScore(match: Match | null): number {
  if (match === null) return NO_TITLE;
  return (match.kind === 'initials' ? INITIALS : 0) + match.start;
}

interface Scored extends RankedItem {
  score: number;
}

/** Among equal scores: the last opened, then the newest added, then the id (stable). Negative when `a` comes first. */
const tieBreak = (a: LibraryItem, b: LibraryItem): number => larger(openedAt(a), openedAt(b)) || larger(a.createdAt, b.createdAt) || -larger(a.id, b.id);

/**
 * The 자료 group: the quick search's matches (search.ts, the same rules) ranked by `matchScore`, the best `max` kept. Each
 * match is scored once and only a row that could enter the top `max` is compared further — a partial selection over the
 * matches instead of sorting all of them on every keystroke (measured at 10,000 matches in items.rank.test.ts). The dates behind
 * a tie are parsed only for rows that tie.
 */
export function rankItems(items: readonly LibraryItem[], result: SearchResult, max = ITEM_RESULTS_MAX): RankedItem[] {
  const top: Scored[] = [];
  if (max <= 0) return [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (!result.ids.has(item.id)) continue;
    const match = result.titleMatches.get(item.id) ?? null;
    const score = matchScore(match);
    if (top.length === max && score > top[max - 1]!.score) continue; // worse than everything kept: nothing to compare
    let at = top.length;
    while (at > 0 && (score < top[at - 1]!.score || (score === top[at - 1]!.score && tieBreak(item, top[at - 1]!.item) < 0))) at--;
    if (at === max) continue; // ties with the last kept and loses the tie-break
    top.splice(at, 0, { item, match, score });
    if (top.length > max) top.pop();
  }
  return top.map(({ item, match }) => ({ item, match }));
}
```
(파일 위의 `import { initialOf, matchKorean, type Match } from './hangul';`는 이미 `Match`를 가져온다.)

```ts
    expect(ids('   ')).toEqual([]);
    expect(rankCollections(buildOrganizeModel({ ...SNAPSHOT, collections: [], members: {} }, []), '노트')).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { parseQuery } from '../library/search';
import type { CollectionNode, OrganizeModel } from '../organize/model';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { matchKorean, type Match } from './hangul';

/** Spec 7.2: the 컬렉션 group lists five at most. */
export const COLLECTION_RESULTS_MAX = 5;

export interface RankedCollection {
  node: CollectionNode;
  /** Where the first query word matched the name (for <mark>). */
  match: Match;
  /** "분자생물학 안 · 14개" (mockup): the parent's name and the collection's count; just "14개" at the top level. */
  secondary: string;
}

const collator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true });

/** Where the first query word is in `name`, or null when any word is missing: every word must be in the name. */
function nameMatch(name: string, words: readonly string[]): Match | null {
  let first: Match | null = null;
  for (const word of words) {
    const m = matchKorean(word, name);
    if (!m) return null;
    first ??= m;
  }
  return first;
}

/** Negative when `a` ranks first: the earlier match, then the shorter path, then the name (then the id, so nothing swaps between renders). */
function rank(a: { node: CollectionNode; match: Match }, b: { node: CollectionNode; match: Match }, model: OrganizeModel): number {
  return (
    a.match.start - b.match.start ||
    model.path(a.node.id).length - model.path(b.node.id).length ||
    collator.compare(a.node.name, b.node.name) ||
    (a.node.id < b.node.id ? -1 : 1)
  );
}

/**
 * The 컬렉션 group for a palette query (spec 7.2): the collections whose NAME holds every word of the query (letters or
 * 초성, as the item search reads a word), the best `max` by `rank`. A selection over the tree in one pass, like rankItems.
 */
export function rankCollections(model: OrganizeModel, query: string, max = COLLECTION_RESULTS_MAX): RankedCollection[] {
  const words = parseQuery(query).map((term) => term.text);
  if (words.length === 0 || max <= 0) return [];
  const top: Array<{ node: CollectionNode; match: Match }> = [];
  for (const node of model.flat) {
    const match = nameMatch(node.name, words);
    if (!match) continue;
    const entry = { node, match };
    let at = top.length;
    while (at > 0 && rank(entry, top[at - 1]!, model) < 0) at--;
    if (at === max) continue;
    top.splice(at, 0, entry);
    if (top.length > max) top.pop();
  }
  return top.map(({ node, match }) => {
    const parent = model.path(node.id).at(-2);
    return { node, match, secondary: t.palette.collectionMeta(parent?.name ?? null, model.count(node.id)) };
  });
}
```
(문자열 `t.palette.collectionMeta`는 Step 7에서 만든다 — 두 단계를 한 번에 돌린다.)

`R/ui/renderCount.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
/**
 * E2E only: a page that wants to know which components render sets `window.__learnRenders = {}` (tests/e2e/helpers.ts
 * watchRenders), and each call then adds one to that component's count. React's Profiler reports nothing in the production
 * build the E2E runs, so this is the measure that can fail. A normal run never creates the object: a call is one property read.
 */
export function countRender(component: string): void {
  const counts = (globalThis as { __learnRenders?: Record<string, number> }).__learnRenders;
  if (counts !== undefined) counts[component] = (counts[component] ?? 0) + 1;
}
```

```ts

/** E2E only: starts the render counts of R/ui/renderCount.ts in this page, from zero. */
export const watchRenders = (page: Page): Promise<void> =>
  page.evaluate(() => {
    (window as unknown as { __learnRenders?: Record<string, number> }).__learnRenders = {};
  });

/** How often each counted component rendered since watchRenders. */
export const renderCounts = (page: Page): Promise<Record<string, number>> =>
  page.evaluate(() => ({ ...((window as unknown as { __learnRenders?: Record<string, number> }).__learnRenders ?? {}) }));
```
`E/organize-search.spec.ts`(새 파일 — 뒤 단계가 시험을 더한다):
```ts
// Search and palette with the organize data (M5): the tag names the quick search reads, the view it is limited to
// and the empty state that names it, 내 라이브러리 전체에서 찾기, the palette's 컬렉션 group, the item ranking, the render
// count of a keystroke and the cut of the long fields.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, renderCounts, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, seedLibrary, seedMetadata, watchRenders } from './helpers';

const FILES = [
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4'),
];
const SIGNAL = '세포 신호 전달 개요';
const FOLD = '단백질 접힘 강의 노트';
const BAYES = 'Intro to Bayesian Inference';
const PHOTO = '광합성 명반응';
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of FILES) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

/** Four items with known titles; the first has an abstract and a memo. */
async function library(page: Page) {
  const [a, b, c, d] = await importPaths(page, FILES);
  await seedMetadata(page, a!.id, { creators: [{ name: '김철수', role: 'author' }], date: '2024', publisher: '분자생물학회', abstract: '수용체가 신호를 증폭하는 과정을 다룹니다.', extra: '시험 범위' }, SIGNAL);
  await seedMetadata(page, b!.id, { creators: [{ name: '이영희', role: 'author' }], date: '2023', publisher: 'Learn Press' }, FOLD);
  await seedMetadata(page, c!.id, { creators: [{ name: 'Jane Smith', role: 'lecturer' }], date: '2021' }, BAYES);
  await seedMetadata(page, d!.id, { creators: [] }, PHOTO);
  await expect(rowByTitle(page, PHOTO)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(rowByTitle(page, SIGNAL)).toBeVisible();
  return [a!, b!, c!, d!] as const;
}
const input = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input');

/** The render counts once none has changed for three polls: what a keystroke renders is final by then. */
async function settledRenders(page: Page): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  let last = JSON.stringify(await renderCounts(page));
  for (let quiet = 0; quiet < 3; ) {
    await page.waitForTimeout(150);
    const now = JSON.stringify(await renderCounts(page));
    quiet = now === last ? quiet + 1 : 0;
    last = now;
  }
  return JSON.parse(last) as Record<string, number>;
}

test('typing in the quick search re-renders the table, the toolbar and the field, never the main window', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [first] = await library(page);
    await seedLibrary(app, { count: 300, from: first });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('304개');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    await watchRenders(page);
    // The first character turns "a search is active" on in the command context, which the main window reports to the menu bar: once.
    await page.keyboard.insertText('세');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText(/ \/ 304개$/);
    const before = await settledRenders(page);
    expect(before['MainWindow'] ?? 0, 'the counter reaches the main window').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const ch of ['포', ' ', '신', '호']) await page.keyboard.insertText(ch);
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('세포 신호');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText(/^\d+개 \/ 304개$/);
    const after = await settledRenders(page);
    expect(after['MainWindow'], 'the main window rendered again while the query changed').toBe(before['MainWindow']);
    for (const name of ['LibraryView', 'LibraryToolbar', 'LibrarySearch']) {
      expect(after[name] ?? 0, `${name} follows the query`).toBeGreaterThan(before[name] ?? 0);
    }
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```tsx
import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { Toolbar } from '../shell/Toolbar';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { countRender } from '../ui/renderCount';
import { useSearch } from './useSearch';

/**
 * The library view's toolbar: the view's name and "N개 / M개" while a search or a tag filter narrows the view (M the view's
 * items, N what is left). It subscribes to the quick search itself, so a keystroke renders this and not MainWindow, which
 * hands it the same `actions` and `trailing` elements again.
 */
export function LibraryToolbar(props: {
  title: string;
  titleTip?: string;
  /** The whole list: the search index belongs to it. */
  items: readonly LibraryItem[];
  /** The view's items, before the tags and the search. */
  scoped: number;
  /** The view's items that have every chosen tag. */
  filtered: readonly LibraryItem[];
  actions: ReactNode;
  trailing: ReactNode;
}) {
  countRender('LibraryToolbar');
  const found = useSearch(props.items);
  const tagCount = useLibrary((s) => s.tagFilter.size);
  const shown = useMemo(() => (found ? props.filtered.reduce((n, i) => n + (found.ids.has(i.id) ? 1 : 0), 0) : props.filtered.length), [found, props.filtered]);
  const count = props.items.length === 0 ? undefined : found || tagCount > 0 ? t.shell.countOf(shown, props.scoped) : t.shell.count(props.scoped);
  return <Toolbar title={props.title} titleTip={props.titleTip} count={count} actions={props.actions} trailing={props.trailing} />;
}
```

`R/library/useLibraryRows.ts` — Task 3의 모양에서 두 곳을 바꾼다. 반환 형과 본문:
```ts
export function useLibraryRows(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): { rows: readonly LibraryItem[]; titleMatches: ReadonlyMap<string, Match> | null; view: ScopeView } {
  const { sort } = useLibrarySettings();
  const view = useScopeView(items);
  const sorted = useMemo(() => sortItems(view.filtered, sort), [view.filtered, sort]);
  // Quick search filters the sorted rows: the order stays the table's (spec 4.2); relevance ranks only the palette.
  // The index is built once per list (buildSearchIndex) and each query searched once (search), shared with the toolbar.
  const found = useSearch(items);
  const rows = useMemo(() => keepFound(sorted, found), [sorted, found]);
  return { rows, titleMatches: found?.titleMatches ?? null, view };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * ⌘F (`library.find`): the quick search field takes the focus with its text selected (spec 4.1). `select: false` leaves the
 * text as it is (the caret where it was): the focus returning after a button that kept the query.
 */
export function focusQuickSearch(opts: { select?: boolean } = {}): void {
  field.current?.focus();
  if (opts.select ?? true) field.current?.select();
}
```

```tsx
import { SearchX } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { PaneEmpty } from '../ui/PaneEmpty';
import { focusQuickSearch } from './LibrarySearch';

/**
 * Nothing matches the query (spec 3.3, 7.1), in the table body's place. It says where the search looked: the view's name
 * outside 내 라이브러리 (`view`, null in it), and how many tags narrowed the result. Two actions: empty the query, and —
 * outside 내 라이브러리 — search the whole library with the same query (the registry's library.findEverywhere).
 */
export function SearchEmpty({ query, view, tagCount }: { query: string; view: string | null; tagCount: number }) {
  const setQuery = useLibrary((s) => s.setQuery);
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const everywhere = commandById('library.findEverywhere');
  return (
    <PaneEmpty
      icon={SearchX}
      title={t.library.searchEmptyTitle(query)}
      top
      testId="search-empty"
      action={
        <div className="pe-actions">
          <Button
            testId="search-empty-clear"
            onPress={() => {
              setQuery('');
              focusQuickSearch(); // the button goes with the state; typing goes on in the field
            }}
          >
            {t.library.searchClear}
          </Button>
          {view !== null && (
            <Button
              testId="search-empty-everywhere"
              isDisabled={!isEnabled(everywhere.id)}
              disabledReason={t.common.busy}
              onPress={() => {
                // The view changes and the query stays; the button may go with the empty state, so the field takes the focus.
                if (run(everywhere.id)) focusQuickSearch({ select: false });
              }}
            >
              {everywhere.label}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      }
    >
      {t.library.searchEmptyBody(view, tagCount)}
    </PaneEmpty>
  );
}
```

`R/palette/searchRow.ts` 전체:
```ts
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import type { CommandContextState, CommandId } from '@learn/domain';
import { focusQuickSearch } from '../library/LibrarySearch';
import { SCOPE_ALL } from '../organize/scope';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';

/**
 * 라이브러리에서 ‘…’ 검색 (spec §4.4): back to the library when the reader shows (nav.back, through the registry), the
 * view to 내 라이브러리 when it is a narrower one (the row says 라이브러리, and the 자료 rows above it searched all of it),
 * the query into the quick search — the table filters as if it had been typed there — and the focus in its field with the
 * query selected, as ⌘F leaves it (focusQuickSearch). Synchronous, so the field is mounted (the library view's toolbar)
 * before it takes the focus.
 */
export function searchLibrary(query: string, run: (id: CommandId) => boolean, view: CommandContextState['view']): void {
  flushSync(() => {
    if (view === 'viewer') run('nav.back');
    const library = useLibrary.getState();
    if (library.scope.kind !== 'all') library.setScope(SCOPE_ALL);
    library.setQuery(query);
  });
  focusQuickSearch();
}

/** ↩ on a 컬렉션 row (spec 7.2): the library shows that collection — from the reader, back to the library first. The query stays. */
export function showCollection(collectionId: string, run: (id: CommandId) => boolean, view: CommandContextState['view']): void {
  flushSync(() => {
    if (view === 'viewer') run('nav.back');
    useLibrary.getState().setScope({ kind: 'collection', id: collectionId });
  });
}
```

```ts
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('1개 / 4개');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, FOLD).locator('mark')).toHaveCount(0); // a tag-only match marks nothing in the title
    await find('ㄱㄴ', [FOLD]); // the 초성 of 개념
    await find('GQ', [PHOTO]); // any case
    await find('수용체', sorted(SIGNAL, PHOTO)); // SIGNAL's abstract, PHOTO's tag
    await find('접힘 핵심', [FOLD]); // a word of the title and a word of the tags: one more field of the AND
    await input(page).fill('광합성 핵심');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible();

    // The same query follows the data, with no reload: a rename, a tag put on, taken off, deleted.
    await find('개념', [FOLD]);
    await page.evaluate((tagId) => window.learn.tags.rename({ tagId, name: '정리 완료' }), core);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible(); // 개념 is no tag name now
    await find('정리', [FOLD]);
    await assignTag(page, core, [a.id]);
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual(sorted(SIGNAL, FOLD));
    await page.evaluate((i) => window.learn.tags.unassign(i), { tagId: core, itemIds: [b.id] });
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await page.evaluate((tagId) => window.learn.tags.remove({ tagId }), core);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible();

    // The palette reads the same tag names.
    await input(page).fill('');
    await paletteWith(app, page, 'Gq');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-result')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-result')).toHaveAttribute('data-item-id', d.id);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the search is limited to the view and the tag filter; its empty state names the view and offers 내 라이브러리 전체에서 찾기', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [a, b] = await library(page);
    const bio = await createCollection(page, '분자생물학');
    await addToCollection(page, bio, [a.id]);
    const key = await createTag(page, '핵심');
    await assignTag(page, key, [b.id]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    const empty = page.getByTestId('search-empty');
    const body = empty.locator('.pe-text');

    // 내 라이브러리: the plain sentence and one action.
    await input(page).fill('효소 억제제');
    await expect(body).toHaveText('제목·저자·태그·출판사·원래 이름·초록·메모에서 찾았습니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty-clear')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty-everywhere')).toHaveCount(0);

    // A collection: the query stays across the view change (spec 3.5); the sentence names the view; both actions.
    await page.getByTestId(`nav-collection-${bio}`).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-title')).toHaveText('분자생물학');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('효소 억제제');
    await expect(body).toHaveText('‘분자생물학’의 제목·저자·태그·출판사·원래 이름·초록·메모에서 찾았습니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty-everywhere')).toHaveText('내 라이브러리 전체에서 찾기');
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'quick search, no results in a collection');

    // The results are the view's: FOLD is in the library, not in 분자생물학.
    await input(page).fill('접힘');
    await expect(empty).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('0개 / 1개');
    await page.getByTestId('search-empty-everywhere').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-title')).toHaveText('내 라이브러리');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('접힘'); // kept
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused(); // the button went with the empty state
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([FOLD]);
    await expect(empty).toHaveCount(0);

    // A special view is named in the same way.
    await page.getByTestId('nav-scope-unfiled').click();
    await input(page).fill('신호'); // SIGNAL is filed in 분자생물학
    await expect(body).toHaveText('‘미분류’의 제목·저자·태그·출판사·원래 이름·초록·메모에서 찾았습니다.');
    await page.getByTestId('search-empty-everywhere').click();
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);

    // The tag filter narrows the same way; the empty state says how many tags did it (spec 3.6).
    await input(page).fill('');
    await chip(page, key).click(); // 핵심: FOLD alone
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([FOLD]);
    await input(page).fill('광합성'); // PHOTO is in the library but has no 핵심
    await expect(body).toHaveText('제목·저자·태그·출판사·원래 이름·초록·메모에서 찾았습니다. 고른 태그 1개로 거른 결과입니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('0개 / 4개');
    await page.getByTestId('search-empty-clear').click();
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([FOLD]); // the filter stays when the query goes
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

`E/helpers.ts` — `SeedRow`(487–492행)에 두 선택 필드를 더하고, `seedRows`가 옵션을 받는다.
```ts
export interface SeedRow {
  title: string;
  creators: string[];
  year: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
  /** Long search fields, only for the 1만 항목 @perf (seedRows' `longTexts`). */
  abstract?: string;
  extra?: string;
}
```
`seedRows` 위(`SEED_NAMES` 아래)에 더하고, 시그니처와 반환을 바꾼다:
```ts
/** Words from the Korean list up to `length` characters; from the row's number, so rows differ and every run is the same. */
function longText(from: number, length: number): string {
  const words: string[] = [];
  for (let k = from, size = 0; size < length; k++) {
    const word = SEED_KO[k % SEED_KO.length]!;
    words.push(word);
    size += word.length + 1;
  }
  return words.join(' ').slice(0, length);
}
/** One row in ten has a 600-character abstract; one in a hundred a 6,000-character abstract and a 5,000-character memo (past the 4,000 cut). */
const longTextsOf = (i: number): Pick<SeedRow, 'abstract' | 'extra'> =>
  i % 100 === 7 ? { abstract: longText(i, 6_000), extra: longText(i + 1, 5_000) } : i % 10 === 3 ? { abstract: longText(i, 600) } : {};
```
```ts
export function seedRows(count: number, seed = 1, base = Date.parse('2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z'), opts: { longTexts?: boolean } = {}): SeedRow[] {
```
그리고 `Array.from` 콜백의 `return { title: …, creators: …, year: …, createdAt: … };`를
```ts
    const row: SeedRow = {
      title: `${pick(words)} ${pick(words)} ${i + 1}`,
      creators: Array.from({ length: Math.floor(rand() * 5) }, () => pick(SEED_NAMES)),
      year: rand() < 0.1 ? null : 1985 + Math.floor(rand() * 41),
      createdAt: new Date(base - i * 60_000).toISOString(),
    };
    return opts.longTexts ? { ...row, ...longTextsOf(i) } : row;
```

```ts
        const log = (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog;
        const until = performance.now() + 3000;
        while (performance.now() < until) {
          const m = log.marks.find((x) => x.name === name && x.at > t0);
          if (m) return m.at;
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
        }
        return null;
      }, [t0, name] as const);
```
(본문의 나머지는 그대로다. 줄 수가 다르면 `learn:table:painted`를 `name`으로, 인자를 `[t0, name]`으로 바꾸는 것이 전부다.)

⑤ 긴 글 페이로드 — `const listIpcMs = listed.out;` 아래에 더한다:
```ts
    // The long fields' payload (spec 7.1): the seeded abstracts and memos, each cut at 4,000 characters.
    const searchTextsPayload = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      const r = await window.learn.library.searchTexts();
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.searchTexts failed: ${r.code}`);
      const longestField = r.data.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, t.abstract?.length ?? 0, t.extra?.length ?? 0), 0);
      return { items: r.data.length, bytes: new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(r.data)).length, longestField, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) };
    });
    expect(searchTextsPayload.items, 'every seeded row with an abstract or a memo comes back').toBe(libraryRows.filter((r) => r.abstract || r.extra).length);
    expect(searchTextsPayload.longestField, 'no field is longer than the cut (SEARCH_TEXT_FIELD_MAX)').toBeLessThanOrEqual(4000);
```
⑥ 팔레트 — `expect(searchMs.length, "quick search is timed …").toBeGreaterThan(0);`(524행) **바로 아래**에 더한다:
```ts

    // The palette (spec 12: input → paint, p95 ≤ 50 ms at 10,000 items): ⌘K, then the same inputs typed and erased in its
    // field, each timed to the first frame that paints its rows (usePaintMark, learn:palette:painted).
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.palette');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-input')).toBeFocused();
    const paletteInputCount = () => page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog.paletteInputs.length);
    await page.keyboard.insertText('a'); // the warm-up: not timed
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    await page.keyboard.press('Backspace');
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    const paletteMs: number[] = [];
    let paletteUnpainted = 0;
    const timePaletteInput = async (act: () => Promise<void>) => {
      const before = await paletteInputCount();
      await act();
      await expect.poll(paletteInputCount).toBe(before + 1);
      const t0 = await page.evaluate((i) => (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog.paletteInputs[i]!, before);
      const painted = await paintedAfter(t0, 'learn:palette:painted');
      if (painted === null) paletteUnpainted++;
      else paletteMs.push(Math.round(painted - t0));
    };
    for (const step of steps) {
      for (const ch of step.chars) await timePaletteInput(() => page.keyboard.insertText(ch));
      for (let i = 0; i < step.chars.length; i++) await timePaletteInput(() => page.keyboard.press('Backspace'));
    }
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette')).toBeHidden();
    expect(paletteUnpainted, 'every palette input re-drew its rows (usePaintMark on the query)').toBe(0);
    expect(paletteMs.length, 'enough palette inputs for a p95').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20);
```

컨트롤러가 CI 녹색 뒤 `scripts/evidence.sh m5-organize organize task10`을 실행한다(구현자는 macOS를 실행하지 않는다). 받은 `evidence/task10/<run>/`에서 본다: `evidence-results/m5-organize.json`의 `checks` 중 위 다섯(`search: the placeholder …`, `palette: 자료 → 컬렉션 → 명령 …`, `palette: ↩ on the collection row …`, `search: the collection view's no-results …`, `search: 내 라이브러리 전체에서 찾기 …`)이 모두 `ok`, `results.searchAndPalette.group.font`가 SF 계열; PNG `m5-10-palette-collections(.window/.screen/-dark).png`(SF 글꼴의 컬렉션 행, 폴더 아이콘, 오른쪽 "분자생물학 안 · 1개" 2차색, 커서 행에 ↩ 키캡, 세 묶음 머리)와 `m5-10-search-none-collection.window.png`(두 단추가 한 줄, 본문 줄바꿈)로 Step 16의 Mac 짝 비평을 한 번 더 한다. 실행 id·분·결과를 `docs/mac-verification.md`의 M5 실행 기록에 한 줄 적는다. 실제 한국어 IME로 컬렉션 행을 고르는 것(조합 중 ↩)은 자동화할 수 없으므로 Task 12의 실기 목록에 있다.

### Task 11: 성능 — 정리 픽스처(`seedOrganize`), `organize-perf.json`, 예산과 CI 2배 실패선

#### 제안 판정 (Q-110 … Q-119)

뼈대·명세·앞 작업과 어긋나거나 정하지 않은 곳이다. 아래 모양대로 구현하고, 컨트롤러가 거부하면 해당 단계만 고친다.

1. **Q-110 (픽스처의 "중복 묶음 50개"는 M4 시드로는 만들 수 없다 — `seedOrganize`가 자료마다 파일을 따로 준다).** M4의 `seedItems`는 만든 1만 개가 모두 원본 한 개의 자산을 가리키게 한다(`M/test-hooks.ts:30-36`의 `assetId: from.assetId`, 한 트랜잭션·파일 복사 없음이 이유다). `readOrganizeSnapshot`의 `duplicates`는 "같은 sha256을 가진 살아 있는 자료 2개 이상"이므로(`DB/library-repository.ts:290`의 `duplicateGroups`와 같다) 이 상태 그대로는 **1만 1개짜리 묶음 하나**가 되어 "중복" 특수 보기(1만 행)·스냅샷 크기·`duplicates` 개수 모두 명세 12절의 픽스처(묶음 50개)와 다르다. 제안: 뼈대(P-20)의 `seedOrganize({ collections, memberships, tags, assignments })`에 두 필드를 더한다 — `items: string[]`(조직할 자료 id 전부, 아래 모든 색인이 이 배열의 자리다. 소속·붙임 3만·2만 쌍이 uuid 대신 숫자 쌍이라 페이로드가 1/5이다)와 `duplicates?: number[][]`(자리 묶음; 주어지면 묶음 안의 자료는 가짜 sha256을 가진 자산 한 행을 **나눠 쓰고**, 나머지 자료는 각자 자산 한 행을 갖는다 — 자산 행은 원본의 `relative_path`를 그대로 가리키므로 파일은 하나다). 반환은 `{ collectionIds, tagIds }`(입력 순서). 틀렸을 때 비용: `duplicates`를 빼면 "중복" 보기·`organize` 크기만 픽스처와 달라진다(다른 측정은 같다).
2. **Q-111 (목록 IPC "M4 값 이하"의 기준 수와 판정 방법).** 명세 12절은 `library:list`를 "M4 값(Linux CI 기록) 이하"로 쓴다. M4의 기록은 `docs/mac-verification.md:454`의 **269ms**(Task 10의 Linux xvfb 실행; 예산 150, CI 실패선 300)이고 `docs/acceptance.md` AC16도 "269ms (… 여유가 얇다)"로 같다. GitHub의 Linux CI(run 40244798965)는 통과했지만 그 값은 어디에도 적혀 있지 않다. 러너마다 값이 90–269ms로 흔들리므로(Mac 90·121) 절대값 269를 CI 실패선으로 쓰면 가짜 실패가 난다. 제안: ① CI 실패선은 M4와 같은 **300ms**(2 × 150)로 그대로 두고, ② `library-perf.json`의 `listIpcMs`에 `m4BaselineMs: 269`와 `vsM4Ms`(중앙값 − 269)를 기록하며, ③ 중앙값이 269를 넘으면 시험 주석(`testInfo.annotations`)에 `list IPC above the M4 record`를 남겨 보고서에서 보이게 한다(실패시키지 않는다). `tagIds`를 뺐으므로 보통은 아래에 있어야 하고, 넘으면 아래 "점검 순서"의 목록 IPC 줄을 본다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 269를 하드 한도로 올리면 러너 잡음으로 실패 메일이 늘어난다(메모리: 실패 메일을 줄인다).
3. **Q-112 (1만 항목 시험의 60초 한도 — 새 시험은 90초, 같은 라이브러리를 한 세션에서 쓴다).** M4 P-23은 1만 항목 시험을 CI에서 60초로 막았고 Task 10이 팔레트 입력 약 44번을 더하며 이미 90초로 올렸다. 이 작업의 새 시험(`organize-perf.evidence.ts`)은 시드(1만 + 조직 5만 쌍) 한 번, 세션 한 번(재시작 없음)으로 측정 일곱 가지를 5–12번씩 하고 틀마다 입출력 조용해지기를 기다려 약 45–55초 걸릴 것으로 본다(구현 중 실측을 커밋 본문에 적는다). 한도는 **Linux CI 90초, 그 밖 240초**. 한도는 멈춤을 잡는 안전장치이고 제품 예산이 아니다. 전체 증거 실행의 `globalTimeout`(1,440,000ms; 전형 884s)은 약 90초 늘어도 여유가 있고, Mac `all`의 시간 재계산은 Task 12 몫이다. M4의 1만 항목 시험(`library-perf.json`)은 같은 조직 픽스처를 시드에 더하고(몇 초) Task 10이 올린 90초 안에 머문다(구현 중 실측으로 확인). 틀렸을 때 비용: 한도 숫자 하나.
4. **Q-113 (끝 시각의 정의 — 표식이 아니라 "그 프레임을 그리기 직전의 DOM이 기대한 상태"; 한 측정은 새 표식 없음).** M4는 검색·정렬을 `learn:table:painted` 표식으로 재고(`usePaintMark`), 인스펙터는 `requestAnimationFrame`에서 DOM을 보고 그 프레임의 `performance.now()`를 끝으로 썼다(`V/perf.evidence.ts` 인스펙터 줄). 이 작업의 일곱 측정 중 여섯은 표식이 닿는 곳이 서로 다른 작업(Task 3 파이프라인, 5 사이드바, 6 점, 8 드롭)에 흩어져 있어 표식을 더하면 그 작업의 코드를 건드리게 된다. 제안: **새 표식 없음.** 페이지에 시험이 `window.__learnOrg` 탐침을 심고(캡처 단계에서 `pointerdown`·`keydown(1)`·`drop`·`contextmenu`의 `timeStamp`를 기록), 사건 뒤 매 `requestAnimationFrame` 콜백에서 **기대한 DOM 상태**(도구 막대 "N개", 0번 행의 자료 id, 보이는 모든 행의 태그 점, 사이드바 행의 개수)가 되었는지 보아 처음 그렇게 된 콜백의 `performance.now()`를 끝으로 쓴다. 이 콜백은 그 프레임의 그리기 직전이므로 M4의 "표식 → 다음 프레임" 정의와 같다. 상태를 비교하므로 "빈/낡은 표를 그린 프레임"은 통과하지 못한다. 이 작업이 다른 작업의 마크업에 기대는 곳(아래 "가정하는 선택자")은 한 곳에 모은다.
5. **Q-114 (컨텍스트 메뉴 열기 — main의 `Menu.popup` 호출 직전까지를 잰다).** 네이티브 메뉴를 그리는 일은 OS 몫이고 macOS의 `popup`은 메뉴가 닫힐 때까지 돌아오지 않아 시험이 닫을 수도 없다. M4는 메뉴를 시간 재지 않았고 `stubContextMenu`가 `Menu.prototype.popup`을 대신한다(`E/helpers.ts:782`). 제안: 같은 대체가 `popup` 호출 순간의 `performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()`(에포크 ms, 소수)를 `globalThis.__learnPopupAt`에 쌓게 하고(`recordedPopupTimes(app)`), 페이지 쪽은 `contextmenu` 이벤트의 `performance.timeOrigin + e.timeStamp`를 적는다. 끝 − 처음 = 렌더러 이벤트 → 선택 id 만들기 → IPC(1만 id의 `z.uuid()` 검증) → `getItems`(500개씩 20번) → `contextMenuEntries` → `popup` 호출까지다. 사용자가 느끼는 "열림"에서 빠지는 것은 OS가 메뉴를 그리는 시간 하나뿐이고 그것은 우리가 고칠 수 없다(실기 목록: "1만 개 선택에서 오른쪽 클릭이 머뭇거리지 않는다"). 두 프로세스의 시계 차는 ±1ms 안(같은 기계의 벽시계). 틀렸을 때 비용: 시험 도우미 한 곳.
6. **Q-115 (100행 드롭 — 실제 마우스 끌기로 잰다, 복사 연산만).** 합성 `dispatchEvent(drop)`은 RAC `useDrag`의 `getItems`·`dragstart`·`useDrop` 해석을 거치지 않고, 드롭 처리기를 직접 부르면 처리기 앞의 일을 빼먹는다. 스파이크는 Playwright의 `page.mouse.down/move/up`이 Chromium의 진짜 끌기를 일으키고 RAC·`dragend`가 그대로 돈다는 것을 Linux와 Mac에서 확인했고(`plan-task-1.md` 18번, 드롭 → 처리기 0.3ms) 남는 시간은 드롭 뒤(IPC → DB → 알림 → 스냅샷 → 모델 → 사이드바 그리기)에 있다. 그래서 끌기는 실제로, 끝은 대상 행의 `.count`가 100이 되는 프레임으로 한다(Q-113). 대상은 시험이 매번 새로 만드는 빈 컬렉션(`0 드롭 N` — 이름순으로 맨 위라 가상화된 트리에 늘 마운트되어 있고 개수가 0 → 100으로 정확히 100 늘어난다). ⌘/Shift 이동(빼기 + 넣기 두 호출)은 시간 재지 않는다 — 명세 12절의 줄이 "드롭 → 대상 개수"이고 이동은 같은 넣기에 빼기 한 번이 더해질 뿐이다(Task 8의 E2E가 동작을 확인한다). 틀렸을 때 비용: 시험 한 곳.
7. **Q-116 (실패선은 단발 측정의 중앙값, 연속 입력의 p95; 최댓값은 기록).** M4와 같은 규칙이다(`gate(result.sortToPaintMs.median, …)`, 입력은 p95). 보기 전환·태그 필터·`1` 키·드롭·메뉴는 5회 이상 단발이라 중앙값, 방향이 둘인 것(태그 필터 켜기/끄기, `1` 붙이기/떼기)은 방향마다 중앙값을 따로 본다(붙이기가 더 무겁다). 최댓값은 JSON에만 남는다.
8. **Q-117 (검색·팔레트는 조직 픽스처 위에서 `library-perf.json`에 이어서 잰다 — 입력 단계 둘을 더한다).** 명세 12절은 "검색 입력(태그 필드 포함)"과 "팔레트 입력"을 `library-perf.json`에 두라고 한다. Task 10이 만든 측정(`paletteInputToPaintMs`)을 조직 픽스처(태그 이름이 색인에 들어간 상태, 컬렉션 200개가 팔레트 결과에 들어간 상태) 위로 옮기고, 검색 칸에는 태그 이름 두 글자 단계, 팔레트에는 컬렉션 이름 두 글자 단계를 더한다. 검색 칸의 단계는 "태그 이름 앞 두 글자"(첫 글자는 두 태그가 공유하고 둘째 글자에서 좁혀지게 픽스처가 이름을 정한다 — 입력마다 행이 달라져야 M4의 `usePaintMark` 검증("모든 입력이 행을 다시 그렸다")이 유지된다), 팔레트의 단계는 "컬렉션 이름 앞 두 글자"다. 한 곳씩만 쓰는 단계라 `searchSteps`는 그대로 두고 `organizeSteps`를 새로 더한다.
9. **Q-118 (측정이 "IPC 없이 끝났다"를 같이 확인한다).** 명세 3.1·10.3: 보기 전환·태그 필터는 IPC가 없고, 컬렉션에 넣기는 `collections:addItems` 한 번 + 스냅샷만 다시 받는다. 느린 것과 별개로 "전체 목록을 다시 받았다"는 회귀를 시간 예산이 못 잡을 수 있으므로(1만 항목에서는 잡힐 때도 있다) 시험이 main의 IPC 카운터(Task 3의 `ipcCalls`)로 단언한다: 전환·필터 구간 동안 `library:list`·`library:organize` 증가 0, 드롭 구간 `collections:addItems` +1, `library:list` +0, `library:organize` ≤ +1, 메뉴는 `ui:showContextMenu`가 클릭마다 +1. 틀렸을 때 비용: 기대 숫자 한 곳.
10. **Q-119 (보기 전환 대상 — 가상화된 트리에 마운트된 행만; 깊은 컬렉션은 같은 코드 길).** 사이드바는 RAC `Virtualizer` 안에 있어(Q-30) 접힌 깊은 컬렉션 행은 DOM에 없다. 전환 대상은 마운트된 루트 3개(하위 포함 자료가 가장 많은 순)와 특수 보기(전체·미분류·중복)다. 깊은 컬렉션으로의 전환은 `subtreeItems`가 모델에서 미리 계산된 같은 집합 조회라 비용이 다르지 않고, 조상을 펼치는 일은 Task 5의 E2E가 확인한다. 틀렸을 때 비용: 전환 순서 배열 한 줄.

#### 이 작업이 하는 것

명세 12절의 표를 `@perf` 시험 두 개로 닫는다.

1. **픽스처**: M4의 1만 항목(+ 원본 PDF 1개 = 목록 1만 1개) 위에 컬렉션 200개(깊이 1–4, 깊이 4가 반드시 있음), 태그 50개(색 태그 8개: 자리 1–8, `TAG_COLORS` 순서), 소속 3만 쌍, 태그 붙임 2만 쌍, 중복 묶음 50개(각 2–4개)를 한 트랜잭션으로 더한다. `__learnTest.seedOrganize`(main, E2E 전용, 시드 전용)와 순수 생성기 `V/organize-fixture.ts`(시드된 난수, 단위 테스트가 개수·깊이·결정성·사실표를 따로 계산해 맞춘다).
2. **새 시험** `V/organize-perf.evidence.ts` → `evidence-results/organize-perf.json`: `library:organize` IPC, 보기 전환 → 첫 행, 태그 필터 클릭 → 그리기, `1` 키(하나 선택 / 1만 1개 선택) → 점, 100행 드롭 → 대상 개수, 컨텍스트 메뉴(1만 1개 선택) → `popup`. 모두 5회 이상, Linux CI는 예산의 2배에서 실패(`V/budget.ts`의 `limitFailures`, 단위 테스트가 실패할 수 있음을 보인다), Mac 값은 보고.
3. **M4의 1만 항목 시험** (`library-perf.json`): 같은 픽스처를 시드에 더하고 태그·컬렉션 입력 단계를 더한다. 목록 IPC에 M4 기준 269를 곁들인다(Q-111).
4. 점검 순서(예산을 넘을 때 어디부터), Mac 단계, Task 12가 쓸 문서 줄.

범위 밖: 시각 변화 없음(투어·디자인 비평 없음), 제품 코드 변경은 없다 — 예산을 넘으면 아래 "점검 순서"로 그 코드를 고치는 일이 이 작업에 붙는다(고친 내용과 전후 값은 커밋 본문에).

- Create: `V/organize-fixture.ts`, `V/organize-fixture.test.ts`, `V/budget.ts`, `V/budget.test.ts`, `V/organize-perf.evidence.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: 픽스처 생성기 — 실패하는 단위 테스트** `V/organize-fixture.test.ts`

사실표(`facts`)를 생성기 자신의 계산이 아니라 **입력에서 따로(무식하게) 다시 계산해** 맞춘다 — 생성기가 틀린 사실표를 내도 통과하는 시험이 되지 않도록.
```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { SPEC_12, buildOrganizeFixture, type OrganizeFixture } from './organize-fixture';

const N = 10_001; // the 10,000 seeded items and the imported PDF they copy

/** What the input says, computed the plain way: a collection's items with every descendant collection's, by walking parents. */
function subtreeItems(fx: OrganizeFixture, root: number): Set<number> {
  const { collections, memberships } = fx.input;
  const inside = (c: number): boolean => {
    for (let x: number | null = c; x !== null; x = collections[x]!.parent) if (x === root) return true;
    return false;
  };
  return new Set(memberships.filter(([c]) => inside(c)).map(([, i]) => i));
}
const tagItems = (fx: OrganizeFixture, tag: number) => new Set(fx.input.assignments.filter(([t]) => t === tag).map(([, i]) => i));
const depthOf = (fx: OrganizeFixture, c: number): number => {
  const p = fx.input.collections[c]!.parent;
  return p === null ? 1 : 1 + depthOf(fx, p);
};

describe('the organise fixture is the one spec 12 describes', () => {
  const fx = buildOrganizeFixture(N);
  const { input } = fx;

  it('has the counts of spec 12', () => {
    expect(input.collections).toHaveLength(200);
    expect(input.tags).toHaveLength(50);
    expect(input.memberships).toHaveLength(30_000);
    expect(input.assignments).toHaveLength(20_000);
    expect(input.duplicates).toHaveLength(50);
  });
  it('nests collections at most four deep, reaches four, and puts every parent before its child', () => {
    const depths = input.collections.map((_, c) => depthOf(fx, c));
    expect(Math.max(...depths)).toBe(4);
    expect(depths.filter((d) => d === 1)).toHaveLength(12);
    input.collections.forEach((c, i) => expect(c.parent === null || c.parent < i).toBe(true));
    expect(new Set(input.collections.map((c) => c.name)).size).toBe(200);
  });
  it('gives 8 tags a colour and a position 1–8 in the colour order, and the others none', () => {
    expect(input.tags.slice(0, 8).map((t) => t.position)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);
    expect(new Set(input.tags.slice(0, 8).map((t) => t.color)).size).toBe(8);
    expect(input.tags.slice(8).every((t) => t.color === null && t.position === null)).toBe(true);
    expect(new Set(input.tags.map((t) => t.name.toLowerCase())).size).toBe(50);
  });
  it('has no repeated pair, and every index points at an item, a collection or a tag', () => {
    const pairs = (xs: Array<[number, number]>) => new Set(xs.map(([a, b]) => a * N + b));
    expect(pairs(input.memberships).size).toBe(30_000);
    expect(pairs(input.assignments).size).toBe(20_000);
    for (const [c, i] of input.memberships) expect(c < 200 && i < N).toBe(true);
    for (const [t, i] of input.assignments) expect(t < 50 && i < N).toBe(true);
  });
  it('keeps the first 50 items free of the tag at position 1 (the one-item key press starts from "not tagged")', () => {
    expect(input.assignments.some(([t, i]) => t === 0 && i < 50)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('makes 50 disjoint duplicate groups of 2–4 items', () => {
    const all = input.duplicates!.flat();
    expect(new Set(all).size).toBe(all.length);
    for (const g of input.duplicates!) expect(g.length >= 2 && g.length <= 4).toBe(true);
    expect(fx.facts.duplicateItems).toBe(all.length);
  });
  it('is the same every time, and another seed is another fixture', () => {
    expect(buildOrganizeFixture(N)).toEqual(fx);
    expect(buildOrganizeFixture(N, SPEC_12, 12).input.memberships).not.toEqual(input.memberships);
  });
});

describe('the facts the timings are checked against', () => {
  const fx = buildOrganizeFixture(N);

  it('lists the views to switch between with the counts and first items recomputed from the input', () => {
    const filed = new Set(fx.input.memberships.map(([, i]) => i));
    const dupItems = new Set(fx.input.duplicates!.flat());
    const byLabel = new Map(fx.facts.scopes.map((s) => [s.label, s]));
    expect(byLabel.get('all')).toMatchObject({ count: N, first: 0 });
    expect(byLabel.get('unfiled')).toMatchObject({ count: N - filed.size, first: [...Array(N).keys()].find((i) => !filed.has(i)) });
    expect(byLabel.get('duplicates')).toMatchObject({ count: dupItems.size, first: Math.min(...dupItems) });
    const roots = fx.facts.scopes.filter((s) => s.kind === 'collection');
    expect(roots).toHaveLength(3);
    for (const r of roots) {
      const items = subtreeItems(fx, r.collection!);
      expect(r.count).toBe(items.size);
      expect(r.first).toBe(Math.min(...items));
      expect(fx.input.collections[r.collection!]!.parent).toBeNull();
    }
    const sizes = roots.map((r) => r.count);
    expect(sizes).toEqual([...sizes].sort((a, b) => b - a)); // the three largest, largest first
  });
  it('has views of different sizes, so a switch always changes the count the timing waits for', () => {
    const counts = fx.facts.scopes.map((s) => s.count);
    expect(new Set(counts).size).toBe(counts.length);
    expect(counts.every((c) => c > 0)).toBe(true);
  });
  it('gives each tag its count and first item, and a count that is not the whole library', () => {
    for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
      const items = tagItems(fx, t);
      expect(fx.facts.tagCount[t]).toBe(items.size);
      expect(fx.facts.tagFirst[t]).toBe(Math.min(...items));
      expect(items.size).toBeGreaterThan(100);
      expect(items.size).toBeLessThan(N);
    }
  });
  it('names the first two tags and the first two top-level collections so that a second typed character narrows', () => {
    const [a, b] = fx.facts.tagNames;
    expect([...a!][0]).toBe([...b!][0]);
    expect([...a!][1]).not.toBe([...b!][1]);
    const [c, d] = fx.facts.collectionNames;
    expect([...c!][0]).toBe([...d!][0]);
    expect([...c!][1]).not.toBe([...d!][1]);
  });
});

describe('a small library gets a small fixture from the same code', () => {
  it('scales by the spec', () => {
    const spec = { ...SPEC_12, collections: 20, roots: 3, tags: 12, memberships: 400, assignments: 200, duplicateGroups: 5 };
    const fx = buildOrganizeFixture(300, spec);
    expect(fx.input.collections).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(fx.input.memberships).toHaveLength(400);
    expect(fx.input.assignments).toHaveLength(200);
    expect(fx.input.duplicates).toHaveLength(5);
  });
  it('refuses a spec its library cannot hold, instead of looping', () => {
    expect(() => buildOrganizeFixture(10, { ...SPEC_12, collections: 5, roots: 2, memberships: 100 })).toThrow(/memberships/);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 픽스처 생성기와 `seedOrganizeFixture` 구현** `V/organize-fixture.ts`

난수는 `seedRows`의 것과 같은 mulberry32이지만 **따로** 만든다 — `seedRows`의 생성기는 함수 안에 갇혀 있고, 이 흐름이 거기 끼면 다른 모든 시험의 시드가 바뀐다.
```ts
// The organise fixture of spec 12 over a seeded library: collections, tags, memberships, assignments and duplicate groups,
// drawn from a seeded generator so a run measures the same library every time. Pure (the unit test checks it against
// what its own input says); seedOrganizeFixture hands it to main's E2E hook and checks the snapshot main then sends.
import { expect, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { TAG_COLORS, type TagColorId } from '../../packages/domain/src/tag-colors';

export interface OrganizeSeedInput {
  items: string[];
  collections: Array<{ name: string; parent: number | null }>;
  memberships: Array<[number, number]>;
  tags: Array<{ name: string; color: TagColorId | null; position: number | null }>;
  assignments: Array<[number, number]>;
  duplicates?: number[][];
}

export interface FixtureSpec {
  collections: number;
  roots: number;
  maxDepth: number;
  tags: number;
  coloured: number;
  memberships: number;
  assignments: number;
  duplicateGroups: number;
  /** The share of items drawn out of every collection before memberships are drawn (some more end up with none by chance). */
  unfiledShare: number;
}
export const SPEC_12: FixtureSpec = {
  collections: 200, roots: 12, maxDepth: 4, tags: 50, coloured: 8, memberships: 30_000, assignments: 20_000, duplicateGroups: 50, unfiledShare: 0.1,
};

export interface ScopeFact {
  label: string;
  kind: 'all' | 'unfiled' | 'duplicates' | 'collection';
  collection?: number;
  /** Items in the view. */
  count: number;
  /** Index of the first row under the default sort (newest first = list order = lowest index). */
  first: number;
}
export interface OrganizeFacts {
  /** all, the three largest top-level collections (largest first), unfiled, duplicates. */
  scopes: ScopeFact[];
  tagCount: number[];
  tagFirst: number[];
  tagNames: string[];
  collectionNames: string[];
  duplicateItems: number;
}
export interface OrganizeFixture {
  spec: FixtureSpec;
  n: number;
  input: Omit<OrganizeSeedInput, 'items'>;
  facts: OrganizeFacts;
}

const ROOT_NAMES = ['분자생물학', '분석화학', '통계학', '열역학', '선형대수', '신경과학', '유기화학', '물리학', '진화생물학', '확률론', '면역학', '세포생물학'];
const PART_WORDS = ['개요', '실험', '연습', '요약', '과제', '부록'];
const COLOURED_TAG_NAMES = ['복습필요', '복원본', '시험범위', '읽는 중', '질문', '참고', '보류', '인용'];
/** Items 0 … RESERVED-1 never get the tag at position 1, so a key press on one of them starts from "not tagged". */
const RESERVED = 50;

function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed | 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

export function buildOrganizeFixture(n: number, spec: FixtureSpec = SPEC_12, seed = 11): OrganizeFixture {
  const rand = mulberry32(seed);
  const int = (m: number) => Math.floor(rand() * m);
  if (spec.coloured > COLOURED_TAG_NAMES.length || spec.coloured > spec.tags || spec.coloured > TAG_COLORS.length) throw new Error('fixture: too many coloured tags');

  // Collections. The first beyond the roots chain down from root 0, so the deepest level is always there.
  const depth: number[] = [];
  const collections: OrganizeSeedInput['collections'] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < spec.collections; i++) {
    let parent: number | null;
    if (i < spec.roots) parent = null;
    else if (i < spec.roots + spec.maxDepth - 1) parent = i === spec.roots ? 0 : i - 1;
    else {
      let p = int(i);
      while (depth[p]! >= spec.maxDepth) p = int(i);
      parent = p;
    }
    depth.push(parent === null ? 1 : depth[parent]! + 1);
    const part = PART_WORDS[int(PART_WORDS.length)]!;
    collections.push({ name: parent === null ? (ROOT_NAMES[i] ?? `주제 ${i + 1}`) : `${part} ${i + 1}`, parent });
  }

  // Memberships: distinct (collection, item) pairs over the items that are not set aside as unfiled.
  const filed: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (rand() >= spec.unfiledShare) filed.push(i);
  if (spec.memberships > filed.length * spec.collections) throw new Error('fixture: more memberships than the library can hold');
  const memberships: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  const seenMember = new Set<number>();
  while (memberships.length < spec.memberships) {
    const item = filed[int(filed.length)]!;
    const c = int(spec.collections);
    if (seenMember.has(c * n + item)) continue;
    seenMember.add(c * n + item);
    memberships.push([c, item]);
  }

  // Tags: the first `coloured` get colour and position in the colour order; half the assignments go to them.
  const tags: OrganizeSeedInput['tags'] = Array.from({ length: spec.tags }, (_, k) =>
    k < spec.coloured
      ? { name: COLOURED_TAG_NAMES[k]!, color: TAG_COLORS[k]!.id, position: k + 1 }
      : { name: `주제 ${String(k - spec.coloured + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`, color: null, position: null },
  );
  const reserved = Math.min(RESERVED, Math.floor(n / 10));
  if (spec.assignments > (n - reserved) * spec.tags) throw new Error('fixture: more assignments than the library can hold');
  const assignments: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  const seenTag = new Set<number>();
  while (assignments.length < spec.assignments) {
    const t = rand() < 0.5 ? int(spec.coloured) : int(spec.tags);
    const item = int(n);
    if (t === 0 && item < reserved) continue;
    if (seenTag.has(t * n + item)) continue;
    seenTag.add(t * n + item);
    assignments.push([t, item]);
  }

  // Duplicate groups of 2–4 distinct items, no item in two groups.
  const used = new Set<number>();
  const duplicates: number[][] = [];
  for (let g = 0; g < spec.duplicateGroups; g++) {
    const size = 2 + int(3);
    const group: number[] = [];
    while (group.length < size) {
      const item = int(n);
      if (used.has(item)) continue;
      used.add(item);
      group.push(item);
    }
    duplicates.push(group.sort((a, b) => a - b));
  }

  return { spec, n, input: { collections, memberships, tags, assignments, duplicates }, facts: describe(n, spec, collections, memberships, assignments, duplicates, tags.map((t) => t.name)) };
}

/** The views and counts the timings wait for, derived from the drawn input (children come after parents, so one reverse pass folds a subtree in). */
function describe(
  n: number,
  spec: FixtureSpec,
  collections: OrganizeSeedInput['collections'],
  memberships: Array<[number, number]>,
  assignments: Array<[number, number]>,
  duplicates: number[][],
  tagNames: string[],
): OrganizeFacts {
  const sub: Array<Set<number>> = collections.map(() => new Set<number>());
  for (const [c, i] of memberships) sub[c]!.add(i);
  const filed = new Set(memberships.map(([, i]) => i));
  for (let c = collections.length - 1; c >= 0; c--) {
    const p = collections[c]!.parent;
    if (p !== null) for (const i of sub[c]!) sub[p]!.add(i);
  }
  const lowest = (xs: Iterable<number>) => Math.min(...xs);
  const roots = collections.flatMap((c, i) => (c.parent === null ? [i] : [])).sort((a, b) => sub[b]!.size - sub[a]!.size || a - b).slice(0, 3);
  const unfiled = [...Array(n).keys()].filter((i) => !filed.has(i));
  const dupItems = duplicates.flat();
  const tagSets = Array.from({ length: spec.tags }, () => new Set<number>());
  for (const [t, i] of assignments) tagSets[t]!.add(i);
  return {
    scopes: [
      { label: 'all', kind: 'all', count: n, first: 0 },
      ...roots.map((c): ScopeFact => ({ label: collections[c]!.name, kind: 'collection', collection: c, count: sub[c]!.size, first: lowest(sub[c]!) })),
      { label: 'unfiled', kind: 'unfiled', count: unfiled.length, first: unfiled[0]! },
      { label: 'duplicates', kind: 'duplicates', count: dupItems.length, first: lowest(dupItems) },
    ],
    tagCount: tagSets.map((s) => s.size),
    tagFirst: tagSets.map((s) => lowest(s)),
    tagNames,
    collectionNames: collections.filter((c) => c.parent === null).map((c) => c.name),
    duplicateItems: dupItems.length,
  };
}

interface Seeded { fixture: OrganizeFixture; ids: string[]; collectionIds: string[]; tagIds: string[] }

/**
 * Builds the fixture for the library's current items (list order, newest first), hands it to main in one transaction, and
 * checks the snapshot main sends back has the shape spec 12 names — a fixture that is not the one described would make
 * every timing after it a measurement of something else.
 */
export async function seedOrganizeFixture(app: ElectronApplication, page: Page, spec: FixtureSpec = SPEC_12): Promise<Seeded> {
  const ids = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = await window.learn.library.list();
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.list failed: ${r.code}`);
    return r.data.map((i) => i.id);
  });
  const fixture = buildOrganizeFixture(ids.length, spec);
  const seeded = await app.evaluate(
    (_electron, input) => (globalThis as unknown as { __learnTest: { seedOrganize(i: typeof input): { collectionIds: string[]; tagIds: string[] } } }).__learnTest.seedOrganize(input),
    { ...fixture.input, items: ids },
  );
  const snap = await page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = await window.learn.library.organize();
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.organize failed: ${r.code}`);
    const sum = (m: Record<string, string[]>) => Object.values(m).reduce((a, v) => a + v.length, 0);
    return {
      collections: r.data.collections.length,
      tags: r.data.tags.length,
      positions: r.data.tags.flatMap((t) => (t.position === null ? [] : [t.position])).sort((a, b) => a - b),
      members: sum(r.data.members),
      tagged: sum(r.data.tagged),
      duplicateGroups: r.data.duplicates.length,
      duplicateItems: r.data.duplicates.reduce((a, g) => a + g.length, 0),
    };
  });
  expect(snap, 'the snapshot main sends is the fixture spec 12 describes').toEqual({
    collections: spec.collections,
    tags: spec.tags,
    positions: Array.from({ length: spec.coloured }, (_, k) => k + 1),
    members: spec.memberships,
    tagged: spec.assignments,
    duplicateGroups: spec.duplicateGroups,
    duplicateItems: fixture.facts.duplicateItems,
  });
  return { fixture, ids, ...seeded };
}
```

```ts
/** A library of `count` items that share one managed file, as seedItems makes them, in a real in-memory database. */
function libraryOf(count: number): { db: Db; deps: OrganizeSeedDeps; ids: string[] } {
  const db = openDatabase(':memory:');
  migrate(db, { dbFile: null });
  const repo = new LibraryRepository(db);
  const now = nowIso();
  const asset = {
    id: newId(), sha256: 'a'.repeat(64), storageMode: 'managed' as const, relativePath: 'assets/aa/aaaa', externalPath: null,
    originalName: 'lecture.pdf', mime: 'application/pdf', size: 1234, availability: 'available' as const, createdAt: now, checkedAt: now,
  };
  const revisionId = newId();
  const first = newId();
  repo.insertImported({ item: { id: first, type: 'pdf', title: 'source', createdAt: now }, asset, assetIsNew: true, revision: { id: revisionId, createdAt: now }, job: null });
  const rest = Array.from({ length: count - 1 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: newId(), type: 'pdf' as const, title: `item ${i + 2}`, createdAt: now, metadataJson: '{}', assetId: asset.id, revisionId,
  }));
  repo.insertItemsForAsset(rest);
  return { db, deps: { db, collections: new CollectionsRepository(db), tags: new TagsRepository(db) }, ids: [first, ...rest.map((r) => r.id)] };
}

    expect([...snap.tagged[out.tagIds[0]!]!].sort()).toEqual([ids[0]!, ids[1]!].sort());
    expect(snap.tagged[out.tagIds[1]!]).toEqual([ids[4]]);
```

② `seedItems` 함수(36행 `}`) 바로 뒤, `export interface LearnTestHooks`(38행) 앞에 더한다:
```ts
export interface SeedOrganizeInput {
  /** Ids of the items to organise, in the order every index below counts them by. */
  items: string[];
  /** `parent` is the index of an earlier entry, or null for a top-level collection. */
  collections: Array<{ name: string; parent: number | null }>;
  /** [collection index, item index] */
  memberships: Array<[number, number]>;
  /** A coloured tag has both `color` and `position` (1–8); an uncoloured one has neither. */
  tags: Array<{ name: string; color: TagColorId | null; position: number | null }>;
  /** [tag index, item index] */
  assignments: Array<[number, number]>;
  /**
   * Item-index groups that share one file. Given, every other item gets a file of its own, so these groups are the
   * library's only duplicates; left out, the items keep the one file seedItems gave them all.
   */
  duplicates?: number[][];
}
export interface SeedOrganizeResult {
  collectionIds: string[];
  tagIds: string[];
}
export interface OrganizeSeedDeps {
  db: Db;
  collections: CollectionsRepository;
  tags: TagsRepository;
}

interface FileRow {
  storage_mode: string;
  relative_path: string | null;
  external_path: string | null;
  original_name: string;
  mime: string;
  size: number;
  availability: string;
  created_at: string;
  checked_at: string | null;
}

/**
 * Items that share one file are one duplicate group for the snapshot (same sha256), and seedItems makes every item share
 * one. Each group gets one asset row of its own and every other item another, all pointing at the original's stored
 * file with a made-up hash (and the revision row an asset must have), so the groups are exactly the duplicates.
 */
function giveFiles(db: Db, itemIds: readonly string[], groups: readonly number[][]): void {
  const groupOf = new Map<number, number>();
  groups.forEach((g, k) =>
    g.forEach((i) => {
      if (groupOf.has(i)) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: item ${i} is in two duplicate groups`);
      groupOf.set(i, k);
    }),
  );
  const read = db.prepare(
    `SELECT a.storage_mode, a.relative_path, a.external_path, a.original_name, a.mime, a.size, a.availability, a.created_at, a.checked_at
       FROM item_assets ia JOIN assets a ON a.id = ia.asset_id WHERE ia.item_id = ? AND ia.role = 'original'`,
  );
  const insertAsset = db.prepare(
    `INSERT INTO assets (id, sha256, storage_mode, relative_path, external_path, original_name, mime, size, availability, created_at, checked_at)
     VALUES (@id, @sha256, @storage_mode, @relative_path, @external_path, @original_name, @mime, @size, @availability, @created_at, @checked_at)`,
  );
  const insertRevision = db.prepare('INSERT INTO source_revisions (id, asset_id, hash, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)');
  const repoint = db.prepare(`UPDATE item_assets SET asset_id = ? WHERE item_id = ? AND role = 'original'`);
  const groupAsset = new Map<number, string>();
  itemIds.forEach((itemId, i) => {
    const g = groupOf.get(i);
    let assetId = g === undefined ? undefined : groupAsset.get(g);
    if (assetId === undefined) {
      const file = read.get(itemId) as FileRow | undefined;
      if (!file) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: item ${i} has no original file`);
      assetId = newId();
      const sha256 = createHash('sha256').update(g === undefined ? `seed-file:item-${i}` : `seed-file:group-${g}`).digest('hex');
      insertAsset.run({ id: assetId, sha256, ...file });
      insertRevision.run(newId(), assetId, sha256, file.created_at);
      if (g !== undefined) groupAsset.set(g, assetId);
    }
    repoint.run(assetId, itemId);
  });
}

/**
 * The organise fixture (collections, memberships, tags, assignments, duplicate groups) in one transaction through the
 * repositories, so every rule they enforce (names, positions, live items only) holds for the seed too. Seed-only: ids
 * are fresh each time; what is deterministic is the structure the indexes describe.
 */
export function seedOrganize(deps: OrganizeSeedDeps, input: SeedOrganizeInput): SeedOrganizeResult {
  const item = (i: number, what: string): string => {
    const id = input.items[i];
    if (id === undefined) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: ${what} points at item ${i}, and there are ${input.items.length}`);
    return id;
  };
  return deps.db.transaction(() => {
    const collectionIds: string[] = [];
    input.collections.forEach((c, i) => {
      if (c.parent !== null && !(c.parent >= 0 && c.parent < i)) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: collection ${i} has parent ${c.parent}, which is not an earlier entry`);
      collectionIds.push(deps.collections.create({ name: c.name, parentId: c.parent === null ? null : collectionIds[c.parent]! }).id);
    });
    const members = new Map<number, string[]>();
    for (const [c, i] of input.memberships) {
      if (collectionIds[c] === undefined) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: a membership points at collection ${c}`);
      const list = members.get(c) ?? [];
      list.push(item(i, 'a membership'));
      members.set(c, list);
    }
    for (const [c, ids] of members) {
      const added = deps.collections.addItemsChanged(collectionIds[c]!, ids);
      if (added.length !== ids.length) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: collection ${c} took ${added.length} of ${ids.length} memberships (a repeated pair?)`);
    }
    const tagIds = input.tags.map((t) => {
      if ((t.color === null) !== (t.position === null)) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: tag ${t.name} needs both colour and position, or neither`);
      const made = deps.tags.create(t.name);
      return t.color === null ? made.id : deps.tags.setColor(made.id, t.color, t.position).id;
    });
    const tagged = new Map<number, string[]>();
    for (const [t, i] of input.assignments) {
      if (tagIds[t] === undefined) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: an assignment points at tag ${t}`);
      const list = tagged.get(t) ?? [];
      list.push(item(i, 'an assignment'));
      tagged.set(t, list);
    }
    for (const [t, ids] of tagged) {
      const added = deps.tags.assignChanged(tagIds[t]!, ids);
      if (added.length !== ids.length) throw new Error(`seedOrganize: tag ${t} took ${added.length} of ${ids.length} assignments (a repeated pair?)`);
    }
    if (input.duplicates) {
      input.duplicates.forEach((g) => g.forEach((i) => item(i, 'a duplicate group')));
      giveFiles(deps.db, input.items, input.duplicates);
    }
    return { collectionIds, tagIds };
  })();
}
```

```ts
export interface LearnTestHooks {
  /** Returns how many items were added. */
  seedItems(input: SeedItemsInput): number;
  /** Seed-only: the organise fixture over items that exist (E2E, one transaction). */
  seedOrganize(input: SeedOrganizeInput): SeedOrganizeResult;
}

```

```ts
    expect(limitFailures([{ what: 'scope switch, median', value: 201, budget: 100 }])).toEqual([

  it('reports every measurement beyond its limit at once, and only those', () => {
```

```ts
// V/budget.ts
/** One measured value against its spec budget. */
export interface Limit {
  what: string;
  value: number;
  budget: number;
}

/**
 * The Linux CI rule (spec 1 condition 2, spec 12): a value fails beyond `factor` times its budget. Every failure is
 * returned, not the first, so one run shows which measurements went over.
 */
export function limitFailures(limits: readonly Limit[], factor = 2): string[] {
  return limits
    .filter((l) => l.value > factor * l.budget)
    .map((l) => `${l.what}: ${l.value} ms against the Linux CI limit ${factor * l.budget} ms (budget ${l.budget} ms)`);
}
```

Expected: 먼저 FAIL(`./budget` 없음), 파일을 만든 뒤 PASS.

(`import` 줄은 파일 맨 위의 기존 import 줄 옆으로 올려도 된다.) `V/search-steps.ts`: `SearchStep.group` 합집합(현재 `'ko' | 'initials' | 'en' | 'creator'`)을 `'ko' | 'initials' | 'en' | 'creator' | 'tag' | 'collection'`으로 바꾸고, 파일 끝에 더한다:
```ts
/**
 * Two more typed steps for a library with the organise fixture: the first two characters of a tag name (the quick search
 * reads tag names) and of a top-level collection name (the palette lists collections). The fixture names the first two of
 * each so they share a first character and differ in the second: the second input narrows the result, so every input
 * redraws the rows the test waits for.
 */
export function organizeSteps(names: { tag: string; collection: string }): { tag: SearchStep[]; collection: SearchStep[] } {
  const two = (name: string) => [...name.replace(/\s/gu, '')].slice(0, 2);
  return { tag: [{ group: 'tag', chars: two(names.tag) }], collection: [{ group: 'collection', chars: two(names.collection) }] };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: `stubContextMenu`가 `popup` 시각을 기록한다** `E/helpers.ts`

현재 782–798행(`export async function stubContextMenu` … 닫는 `}`)을 다음으로 바꾼다. 바뀌는 것은 `__learnPopupAt` 한 줄과 그 선언뿐이다:
```ts
export async function stubContextMenu(app: ElectronApplication, pick: string | null): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ Menu }, pick) => {
    interface LiveItem { id?: string; label: string; enabled: boolean; visible: boolean; checked: boolean; type: string; click(): void }
    const g = globalThis as { __learnPopups?: PopupItem[][]; __learnPopupAt?: number[] };
    g.__learnPopups = [];
    g.__learnPopupAt = [];
    Menu.prototype.popup = function popup(this: { items: LiveItem[] }, options?: { callback?: () => void }) {
      // Epoch ms with the fraction: a page's `performance.timeOrigin + event.timeStamp` is on the same clock to about a millisecond.
      g.__learnPopupAt!.push(performance.timeOrigin + performance.now());
      g.__learnPopups!.push(this.items.map((i) => ({ id: i.id ?? null, label: i.label, enabled: i.enabled, checked: i.checked, type: i.type })));
      const target = pick === null ? undefined : this.items.find((i) => i.label === pick && i.enabled && i.visible);
      setTimeout(() => {
        target?.click();
        options?.callback?.();
      }, 0);
    };
  }, pick);
}

/** When each popup menu was shown since `stubContextMenu` (epoch ms), oldest first: the moment main called `Menu.popup`. */
export const recordedPopupTimes = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<number[]> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnPopupAt?: number[] }).__learnPopupAt ?? []);
```
